# Open F:\Leontiev_Project\g_08_1.wbpj in Workbench 2024 R2 first.
# Builds geometry and mesh for ONE selected CSV row. No Fluent solve.
TABLE_PATH = r'F:\Leontiev_Project\project_inputs.csv'
ROW_INDEX = 0
ROOT = r'F:\Leontiev_Project'
import csv,math,json,time,uuid
RUN_TOKEN=str(uuid.uuid4())
def stage(name):
    with open(ROOT+r'\mesh_workflow_progress.json','w') as f:
        json.dump({'row':ROW_INDEX,'stage':name,'time':time.time(),'run_token':RUN_TOKEN},f)
stage('reading_table')
with open(TABLE_PATH,'rb') as f:
    reader=csv.DictReader(f)
    reader.fieldnames=[s.lstrip('\xef\xbb\xbf') for s in reader.fieldnames]
    rows=list(reader)
row=rows[ROW_INDEX]
mesh_mode=row.get('mesh_mode','series').strip().lower()
if mesh_mode not in ('series','control'):raise ValueError('mesh_mode must be series or control')
mesh_size_mm={'series':0.75,'control':0.25}[mesh_mode]
parameters=dict((str(p.DisplayText),p) for p in Parameters.GetAllParameters())
CFD_COLUMNS=set(('secondary_inlet_mode','p0_inlet_svz_MPa','p_outlet_svz_MPa','p0_inlet_dzv_MPa','p_outlet_dzv_MPa','mass_flow_inlet_dzv_kg_s','T0_inlet_svz_K','T0_inlet_dzv_K','gas_material','gas_model','wall_material','turbulent_prandtl','first_layer_height_um'))
first_layer_height_um=float(row.get('first_layer_height_um',1.0))
if not 0.08<=first_layer_height_um<=1.0:raise ValueError('First layer height must be 0.08 to 1 um')
with open(ROOT+r'\mesh_run_config.json','w') as f:
    json.dump({'first_layer_height_um':first_layer_height_um,'run_token':RUN_TOKEN},f)
values={'GEO_first_layer_height':first_layer_height_um/1000.0}
for key,value in row.items():
    if key in ('case_id','mesh_mode'):continue
    name='GEO_'+key[:-3] if key.endswith('_mm') else None
    if key in CFD_COLUMNS:continue
    if name not in parameters:raise ValueError('Unknown geometry column: '+key)
    number=float(value)
    if math.isnan(number) or math.isinf(number):raise ValueError('Non-finite dimension '+key)
    values[name]=number
if set(values)!=set(n for n in parameters if n.startswith('GEO_')):
    raise ValueError('CSV must contain every geometry parameter')
system1=GetSystem(Name='SYS 1')
dp=Parameters.GetBaseDesignPoint()
mesh=system1.GetContainer(ComponentName='Mesh')
stage('closing_mesh_before_geometry')
mesh.Exit(SaveDatabase=True)
for name,value in values.items():
    dp.SetParameterExpression(Parameter=parameters[name],Expression=repr(value)+' [mm]')
stage('geometry_update')
system1.GetComponent(Name='Geometry').Update(AllDependencies=True)
stage('mesh_refresh')
system1.GetComponent(Name='Mesh').Refresh()
mesh.Edit()
mesh.SendCommand(Language='Python',Command="MESH_RUN_TOKEN="+repr(RUN_TOKEN)+";"+"MESH_MODE="+repr(mesh_mode)+"; execfile(r'"+ROOT+r"\mesh_scope.py')")
scope=json.load(open(ROOT+r'\mesh_repair.json'))
if scope.get('run_token')!=RUN_TOKEN:raise RuntimeError('Stale mesh scoping result')
if scope.get('error'):raise RuntimeError(scope['error'])
stage('mesh_generation')
mesh.SendCommand(Language='Python',Command="MESH_RUN_TOKEN="+repr(RUN_TOKEN)+";"+"MESH_RESULT_PATH=r'"+ROOT+r"\mesh_current_generated.json'; execfile(r'"+ROOT+r"\mesh_generate.py')")
generated=json.load(open(ROOT+r'\mesh_current_generated.json'))
if generated.get('run_token')!=RUN_TOKEN:raise RuntimeError('Stale mesh generation result')
if generated.get('error') or not generated.get('generated'):
    raise RuntimeError(generated.get('error','Mesh generation not confirmed'))
if int(generated.get('Elements','0'))<=0:raise RuntimeError('Mesh has no elements')
stage('quality_and_export')
mesh.SendCommand(Language='Python',Command="MESH_RUN_TOKEN="+repr(RUN_TOKEN)+";"+"MESH_QUALITY_PATH=r'"+ROOT+r"\mesh_current_quality.json'; MESH_EXPORT_PATH=r'"+ROOT+r"\mesh_current.msh'; execfile(r'"+ROOT+r"\mesh_quality.py')")
quality=json.load(open(ROOT+r'\mesh_current_quality.json'))
if quality.get('run_token')!=RUN_TOKEN:raise RuntimeError('Stale quality result')
if not quality.get('exported'):raise RuntimeError(quality.get('export_error','Mesh export not confirmed'))
stage('saving_mesh')
mesh.Exit(SaveDatabase=True)
system1.GetComponent(Name='Mesh').Update(AllDependencies=True)
Save()
with open(ROOT+r'\last_mesh_row.json','w') as f:
    json.dump({'case_id':row['case_id'],'row_index':ROW_INDEX,'geometry_mm':values,'mesh_mode':mesh_mode,'mesh_size_mm':mesh_size_mm,'mesh':generated},f,indent=2)
stage('complete')
print('Geometry and mesh saved for row '+str(ROW_INDEX)+': '+row['case_id'])

FILE: apply_geometry_row.wbjn

# Run in an already opened g_08_1 Workbench project: File > Scripting > Run Script File.
# Geometry stage only. Select the zero-based CSV row here.
TABLE_PATH = r'F:\Leontiev_Project\geometry_inputs.csv'
ROW_INDEX = 0
import csv, math

with open(TABLE_PATH,'rb') as f:
    reader=csv.DictReader(f)
    reader.fieldnames=[s.lstrip('\xef\xbb\xbf') for s in reader.fieldnames]
    rows=list(reader)
row=rows[ROW_INDEX]
parameters=dict((str(p.DisplayText),p) for p in Parameters.GetAllParameters())
values={}
for key,value in row.items():
    if key=='case_id':continue
    name='GEO_'+key[:-3] if key.endswith('_mm') else None
    if name not in parameters:raise ValueError('Unknown geometry parameter: '+key)
    number=float(value)
    if math.isnan(number) or math.isinf(number):raise ValueError('Non-finite value: '+key)
    values[name]=number
expected=set(name for name in parameters if name.startswith('GEO_'))
if set(values)!=expected:raise ValueError('CSV must contain all geometry input columns')
dp=Parameters.GetBaseDesignPoint()
original=dict((name,parameters[name].Expression) for name in values)
component=GetSystem(Name='SYS 1').GetComponent(Name='Geometry')
try:
    for name,value in values.items():
        dp.SetParameterExpression(Parameter=parameters[name],Expression=repr(value)+' [mm]')
    component.Update(AllDependencies=True)
    Save()
except:
    for name,expression in original.items():dp.SetParameterExpression(Parameter=parameters[name],Expression=expression)
    component.Update(AllDependencies=True)
    raise
print('Geometry updated for CSV row '+str(ROW_INDEX)+': '+row['case_id'])

'SpaceClaim.Api.V242.Geometry.Line'}, {'bounds': [0.0, 0.0030067789836031034], 'start': [0.7, 0.01749977111015984, 0.0], 'end': [0.7, 0.014492992126556737, 0.0], 'type': 'SpaceClaim.Api.V242.Geometry.Line'}, {'bounds': [0.0, 0.694115991927624], 'start': [0.005884008072375991, 0.017499771110159625, 0.0], 'end': [0.7, 0.01749977111015984, 0.0], 'type': 'SpaceClaim.Api.V242.Geometry.Line'}]}}
    p = dict((k, float(v)/1000.0) for k,v in values.items())
    def v(name): return p[name + '_mm']
    for name, value in p.items():
        if math.isnan(value) or math.isinf(value):
            raise ValueError('Non-finite parameter: '+name)
        if name not in ('x_origin_mm','secondary_inlet_offset_mm') and value <= 0:
            raise ValueError('Parameter must be positive: '+name)
    if not 0 < v('inlet_curve_offset') < v('l_convergent'):
        raise ValueError('Inlet curve offset must be inside convergent length')
    if not v('r_throat') < min(v('r_inlet'),v('r_nozzle_exit')):
        raise ValueError('Throat radius must be smaller than inlet and nozzle exit')
    if v('r_exit_rounding') <= v('l_exit_rounding')/2:
        raise ValueError('Rounding radius must exceed half its chord length')
    x0=v('x_origin'); xt=x0+v('l_convergent'); xn=xt+v('l_nozzle'); xh=xn+v('l_heat_exchange')
    xi=xn+v('secondary_inlet_offset')
    if xi >= xh: raise ValueError('Secondary inlet is beyond heat exchange end')
    ri=v('r_inlet'); rt=v('r_throat'); rn=v('r_nozzle_exit'); rh=v('r_heat_exchange_end')
    rw0=rn+v('wall_thickness_inlet'); rw1=rh+v('wall_thickness_end')
    ro0=rw0+v('gap_secondary_inlet'); ro1=rw1+v('gap_secondary_end')
    xa=xh+v('l_exit_contraction'); xb=xa+v('l_exit_rounding'); xc=xb+v('l_exit_recovery'); xo=xc+v('l_exit_tail')
    rneck=v('r_exit_neck'); rout=v('r_outlet'); rad=v('r_exit_rounding'); half=v('l_exit_rounding')/2
    cy=rneck+math.sqrt(rad*rad-half*half)
    if cy-rad <= 0: raise ValueError('Rounded neck crosses the axis')
    def pt(x,y): return Point.Create(x,y,0)
    def line(a,b): return CurveSegment.Create(pt(*a),pt(*b))
    def spline(info, transform):
        knots=Array[Knot]([Knot(k['parameter'], k['multiplicity']) for k in info['knots']])
        cps=Array[ControlPoint]([ControlPoint(pt(*transform(cp['position'][0],cp['position'][1])),cp['weight']) for cp in info['control_points']])
        curve=NurbsCurve.CreateFromControlPoints(NurbsData(info['degree']+1,False,False,knots),cps)
        return CurveSegment.Create(curve,Interval.Create(*info['bounds']))
    svz=reference['air_svz']['edges']; refx=svz[4]['start'][0]; reft=svz[1]['start']; refin=svz[2]['start']; refri=refin[1]
    inlet=spline(svz[3], lambda x,y:(x0+(x-refx)/(refin[0]-refx)*v('inlet_curve_offset'), y/refri*ri))
    contraction=spline(svz[2], lambda x,y:(x0+v('inlet_curve_offset')+(x-refin[0])/(reft[0]-refin[0])*(v('l_convergent')-v('inlet_curve_offset')),rt+(y-reft[1])/(refri-reft[1])*(ri-rt)))
    frame=Frame.Create(pt((xa+xb)/2,cy),Direction.Create(0,-1,0),Direction.Create(1,0,0))
    arc=CurveSegment.Create(Circle.Create(frame,rad),Interval.Create(-math.asin(half/rad),math.asin(half/rad)))
    core=[line((xn,rn),(xh,rh)),line((xt,rt),(xn,rn)),contraction,inlet,line((x0,0),(xo,0)),line((xo,rout),(xo,0)),line((xc,rout),(xo,rout)),line((xb,rneck),(xc,rout)),arc,line((xh,rh),(xa,rneck))]
    wall=[line((xi,rw0),(xh,rw1)),line((xh,rw1),(xh,rh)),core[0],line((xn,rn),(xi,rw0))]
    secondary=[line((xi,rw0),(xi,ro0)),wall[0],line((xh,ro1),(xh,rw1)),line((xi,ro0),(xh,ro1))]
    loops=[('air_svz',core),('wall_abonite',wall),('air_dzv',secondary)]
    # Validate all sheets before replacing any existing bodies.
    shapes=[]
    for name,curves in loops:
        collection=List[ITrimmedCurve]()
        for c in curves: collection.Add(c)
        shape=Body.CreatePlanarBody(Plane.PlaneXY,collection)
        if name == 'air_svz':
            cuts=List[ITrimmedCurve]()
            for x,y in ((xt,rt),(xn,rn),(xh,rh)):
                cuts.Add(line((x,0),(x,y)))
            slope=(rn-rt)/(xn-xt)
            normal_factor=math.sqrt(1+slope*slope)
            total=0.0
            for layer in range(20):
                total+=first_layer_height_m*(1.2**layer)
                h=total*normal_factor
                if h>=rt: raise ValueError('Nozzle boundary layers exceed throat radius')
                cuts.Add(line((xt,rt-h),(xn,rn-h)))
            heat_normal_factor=math.sqrt(1+((rh-rn)/(xh-xn))**2)
            total=0.0
            for layer in range(20):
                total+=first_layer_height_m*(1.2**layer)
                if total*max(normal_factor,heat_normal_factor)>=min(rn,rh):
                    raise ValueError('Heat boundary layers exceed local channel radius')
                # Match the same layer endpoints at the nozzle/heat interface.
                cuts.Add(line((xn,rn-total*normal_factor),(xh,rh-total*heat_normal_factor)))
            xstart=x0+v('inlet_curve_offset')
            for x,y in ((xstart,ri),(xa,rneck),(xb,rneck),(xc,rout)):
                cuts.Add(line((x,0),(x,y)))
            total=0.0
            for layer in range(20):
                total+=first_layer_height_m*(1.2**layer)
                def transform_contraction(x,y):
                    xx=xstart+(x-refin[0])/(reft[0]-refin[0])*(v('l_convergent')-v('inlet_curve_offset'))
                    yy=rt+(y-reft[1])/(refri-reft[1])*(ri-rt)
                    factor=1+(normal_factor-1)*(xx-xstart)/(xt-xstart)
                    return (xx,yy-total*factor)
                cuts.Add(spline(svz[2],transform_contraction))
                cuts.Add(line((xh,rh-total*heat_normal_factor),(xa,rneck-total)))
                lower_frame=Frame.Create(pt((xa+xb)/2,cy-total),Direction.Create(0,-1,0),Direction.Create(1,0,0))
                cuts.Add(CurveSegment.Create(Circle.Create(lower_frame,rad),Interval.Create(-math.asin(half/rad),math.asin(half/rad))))
                cuts.Add(line((xb,rneck-total),(xc,rout-total)))
                cuts.Add(line((xc,rout-total),(xo,rout-total)))
            shape.ImprintCurves(cuts,None)
        shapes.append((name,shape))
    root=GetRootPart()
    if clear_existing:
        for g in list(root.Groups):
            # Preserve native script parameters and the published rebuilding script.
            if not g.HasDimension and g.Name != 'TubeGeometry' and not g.Name.startswith('GEO_'): g.Delete()
        for body in list(PartExtensions.GetAllBodies(root)): body.Delete()
    created={}
    for name,shape in shapes:
        created[name]=DesignBody.Create(root,name,shape)
    def group(name,items):
        collection=List[IDocObject]()
        for item in items: collection.Add(item)
        return Group.Create(root,name,collection)
    for name,body in created.items(): group(name,list(body.Faces))
    def match_edge(body,curve):
        a=curve.StartPoint; b=curve.EndPoint
        def distance(c,d): return math.sqrt((c.X-d.X)**2+(c.Y-d.Y)**2+(c.Z-d.Z)**2)
        hits=[]
        for e in body.Edges:
            q=e.Shape
            if min(distance(q.StartPoint,a)+distance(q.EndPoint,b),distance(q.StartPoint,b)+distance(q.EndPoint,a)) < 1e-7:
                hits.append(e)
        if len(hits)!=1: raise ValueError('Ambiguous edge match for '+body.Name)
        return hits[0]
    s=created['air_svz']; d=created['air_dzv']; w=created['wall_abonite']
    sections=[('convergent',x0+v('inlet_curve_offset'),xt),('nozzle',xt,xn),('heat',xn,xh),('exit_contraction',xh,xa),('exit_rounding',xa,xb),('exit_recovery',xb,xc),('exit_tail',xc,xo)]
    all_structured=[]
    for section,lo,hi in sections:
        faces=[]
        for face in s.Faces:
            xs=[q.X for e in face.Edges for q in (e.Shape.StartPoint,e.Shape.EndPoint)]
            if abs(min(xs)-lo)<1e-8 and abs(max(xs)-hi)<1e-8:faces.append(face)
        if len(faces)!=21 or any(f.Edges.Count!=4 for f in faces):raise ValueError('Expected 21 four-sided strips in '+section+'; found '+str(len(faces)))
        group('MESH_'+section,faces)
        all_structured+=faces
        axial=[];thin=[];bulk=[]
        for e in s.Edges:
            a=e.Shape.StartPoint;b=e.Shape.EndPoint
            if min(a.X,b.X)>=lo-1e-8 and max(a.X,b.X)<=hi+1e-8:
                if abs(a.X-b.X)>1e-8:axial.append(e)
                elif abs(a.Y-b.Y)<0.0002:thin.append(e)
                else:bulk.append(e)
        if (len(axial),len(thin),len(bulk))!=(22,40,2):raise ValueError('Bad partition in '+section+': '+str((len(axial),len(thin),len(bulk))))
        group('MESH_'+section+'_axial_edges',axial)
        group('MESH_'+section+'_layer_edges',thin)
        group('MESH_'+section+'_core_radial_edges',bulk)
    group('MESH_core_structured',all_structured)
    group('MESH_inflation_svz',[f for f in s.Faces if f not in all_structured])
    group('inlet_svz',[match_edge(s,core[3])]); group('axis',[e for e in s.Edges if abs(e.Shape.StartPoint.Y)<1e-9 and abs(e.Shape.EndPoint.Y)<1e-9]); group('outlet_svz',[e for e in s.Edges if abs(e.Shape.StartPoint.X-xo)<1e-9 and abs(e.Shape.EndPoint.X-xo)<1e-9])
    group('wall_outer-air_svz',[match_edge(s,core[i]) for i in (1,2,6,7,8,9)])
    group('wall-air_svz-wall_abonite',[match_edge(s,core[0]),match_edge(w,wall[2])])
    group('interior-air_dzv-wall_abonite',[match_edge(d,secondary[1]),match_edge(w,wall[0])])
    group('wall-wall_abonite',[match_edge(w,wall[i]) for i in (1,3)])
    group('inlet_dzv',[match_edge(d,secondary[0])]); group('outlet_dzv',[match_edge(d,secondary[2])]); group('wall_outer-air_dzv',[match_edge(d,secondary[3])])
    return {'bodies':[(b.Name,b.Faces.Count,b.Edges.Count) for b in created.values()], 'x_nozzle_exit_m':xn,'x_heat_exchange_end_m':xh,'x_outlet_m':xo}

for m in re.finditer(rb'\(3010 \(([0-9a-f]+) ([0-9a-f]+) ([0-9a-f]+) 1 2\)\n\(', b):
    f,l=int(m.group(2),16),int(m.group(3),16); s=m.end(); n=l-f+1

===========================================================================
FILE: dataset/a3_report.py
===========================================================================
"""Stage A3 summary: three meshes (coarse / work / fine) -> differences and grid convergence index (Roache, Celik 2008:
three grids, refinement ratio r = (N_fine/N_work)^(1/2) for 2D, safety factor 1.25).  Reads runs\\a3\\a3_results.csv.
08.10.2026 (review): only converged solutions enter the comparison — conjugate quantities (dT, Q, flows) need the
conjugate run converged, r and the adiabatic wall temperature need the adiabatic run converged; otherwise the value is
shown in brackets and GCI is 'оценка не получена'.  The last-report change of each quantity (iteration error) is shown
next to the mesh differences, so that the mesh effect can be compared with what is left of the iterations.
usage: python a3_report.py"""
import csv, math
from pathlib import Path
import gui_convergence as C

BASE = Path(r'F:\Leontiev_Project\runs\a3')
CONJ = [('dT_svz', 'ΔT СВЗ, K'), ('dT_dzv', 'ΔT ДЗВ, K'), ('Q', 'Q, Вт'), ('m_svz', 'G СВЗ, кг/с'), ('ratio', 'G_дз/G_сз')]
ADIAB = [('r_axis', 'r по оси'), ('r_1D', 'r по 1D M'), ('r_pwall', 'r по p стенки'), ('Tw_mean_K', 'T адиаб. стенки, K')]
FLAGS = [('yp_svz', 'y+ СВЗ'), ('yp_dzv', 'y+ ДЗВ')]
NAMES = {'coarse': 'грубая', 'work': 'рабочая', 'fine': 'мелкая'}


def gci(f1, f2, f3, r21, r32):
    """f1 fine, f2 work, f3 coarse.  Returns (observed order p, extrapolated value, GCI_fine %, GCI_work %) or None."""
    e21, e32 = f2 - f1, f3 - f2
    if e21 == 0 or e32 == 0 or e32 / e21 <= 0:   # oscillatory or exact: no monotone convergence
        return None
    s = 1.0
    p = abs(math.log(abs(e32 / e21))) / math.log(r21)
    for _ in range(50):   # fixed-point iteration for unequal ratios
        q = math.log((r21 ** p - s) / (r32 ** p - s))
        p = abs(math.log(abs(e32 / e21)) + q) / math.log(r21)
    ext = (r21 ** p * f1 - f2) / (r21 ** p - 1)
    g1 = 1.25 * abs((f1 - f2) / f1) / (r21 ** p - 1) * 100
    g2 = 1.25 * abs((f2 - f3) / f2) / (r32 ** p - 1) * 100
    return p, ext, g1, g2


def last_change(run_dir):
    """Change of dT_svz, dT_dzv, Q between the last two closed reports of a run (iteration error indicator)."""
    rows = C.closed_samples(run_dir) if Path(run_dir).exists() else []
    if len(rows) < 2:
        return {}
    a, b = rows[-2], rows[-1]
    return {k: abs(b[k] - a[k]) for k in ('dT_svz', 'dT_dzv', 'Q')}


def main(family=''):
    rows = {r['mesh']: r for r in csv.DictReader(open(BASE / 'a3_results.csv', encoding='utf-8'))}
    conj_dir = {}
    if family == 'v2':   # 09.10: mesh family v2 (Izotov nozzle): coarse_v2 / work_v2 / fine_v2 (+ _cont)
        v2 = {m: rows[f'{m}_v2'] for m in ('coarse', 'work', 'fine') if f'{m}_v2' in rows}
        if 'fine_v2_cont' in rows:
            v2['fine_cont'] = rows['fine_v2_cont']
        rows = v2
        for m in ('coarse', 'work', 'fine'):
            conj_dir[m] = BASE / f'a3_{m}_v2'
            if f'{m}_cont' in rows:
                rows[m] = rows[f'{m}_cont']
                conj_dir[m] = BASE / f'a3_{m}_v2_cont'
    elif 'fine2' in rows:   # 08.10: 'fine' (DZV over-refined, not converged) replaced by 'fine2' (author's choice б)
        rows['fine'] = rows['fine2']
        if 'fine2_cont' in rows:
            rows['fine_cont'] = rows['fine2_cont']
    for m in ('coarse', 'work', 'fine') if family != 'v2' else ():   # a continued run replaces the main row
        sfx = '2' if m == 'fine' and 'fine2' in rows else ''
        conj_dir[m] = BASE / f'a3_{m}{sfx}'
        if f'{m}_cont' in rows:
            rows[m] = rows[f'{m}_cont']
            conj_dir[m] = BASE / f'a3_{m}{sfx}_cont'
    names = [m for m in ('coarse', 'work', 'fine') if m in rows]
    ok = {m: {'conj': rows[m].get('converged') == 'True', 'adiab': rows[m].get('conv_adiab') == 'True'} for m in names}
    head = ' | '.join(f"{NAMES[m]} ({int(rows[m]['cells']):,} яч.)".replace(',', ' ') for m in names)
    out = ['Значения в скобках — из несошедшегося расчёта (для сравнения не используются).', '',
           f'| Величина | {head} | рабочая − мелкая, % | GCI рабочей, % | изменение за последний отчёт (рабочая) |',
           '|---' * (len(names) + 4) + '|']
    N = {m: float(rows[m]['cells']) for m in names}
    chg = last_change(conj_dir['work']) if 'work' in names else {}
    for group, keys in (('conj', CONJ), ('adiab', ADIAB), ('flag', FLAGS)):
        for k, title in keys:
            if any(rows[m].get(k) in ('', None) for m in names):
                continue
            v = {m: float(rows[m][k]) for m in names}
            good = {m: group == 'flag' or ok[m][group] for m in names}
            cells = ' | '.join(f'{v[m]:.4g}' if good[m] else f'({v[m]:.4g})' for m in names)
            diff = g = ''
            if group != 'flag':
                if 'fine' in names and good.get('fine') and good.get('work') and v['fine']:
                    diff = f"{(v['work'] - v['fine']) / abs(v['fine']) * 100:+.2f}"
                if len(names) == 3 and all(good.values()):
                    res = gci(v['fine'], v['work'], v['coarse'], math.sqrt(N['fine'] / N['work']), math.sqrt(N['work'] / N['coarse']))
                    g = f'{res[3]:.2f} (p={res[0]:.1f})' if res else 'немонотонно — оценка не получена'
                else:
                    g = 'оценка не получена (нет трёх сошедшихся)'
            it = f'{chg[k]:.3g}' if k in chg else ''
            out.append(f'| {title} | {cells} | {diff} | {g} | {it} |')
    text = '\n'.join(out)
    (BASE / f'a3_table{"_" + family if family else ""}.md').write_text(text + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
    print(text)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    import sys
    main(sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else '')

"""Stage A3 summary: three meshes (coarse / work / fine) -> differences and grid convergence index (Roache, Celik 2008:
three grids, refinement ratio r = (N_fine/N_work)^(1/2) for 2D, safety factor 1.25).  Reads runs\\a3\\a3_results.csv.
usage: python a3_report.py"""
import csv, math
from pathlib import Path

BASE = Path(r'F:\Leontiev_Project\runs\a3')
KEYS = [('dT_svz', 'ΔT СВЗ, K'), ('dT_dzv', 'ΔT ДЗВ, K'), ('Q', 'Q, Вт'), ('m_svz', 'G СВЗ, кг/с'), ('ratio', 'G_дз/G_сз'),
        ('r_axis', 'r по оси'), ('r_1D', 'r по 1D M'), ('r_pwall', 'r по p стенки'), ('Tw_mean_K', 'T адиаб. стенки, K'),
        ('yp_svz', 'y+ СВЗ'), ('yp_dzv', 'y+ ДЗВ')]


def gci(f1, f2, f3, r21, r32):
    """f1 fine, f2 work, f3 coarse.  Returns (observed order p, extrapolated value, GCI_fine %, GCI_work %) or None."""
    e21, e32 = f2 - f1, f3 - f2
    if e21 == 0 or e32 == 0 or e32 / e21 <= 0:   # oscillatory or exact: no monotone convergence
        return None
    s = 1.0
    p = abs(math.log(abs(e32 / e21))) / math.log(r21)
    for _ in range(50):   # fixed-point iteration for unequal ratios
        q = math.log((r21 ** p - s) / (r32 ** p - s))
        p = abs(math.log(abs(e32 / e21)) + q) / math.log(r21)
    ext = (r21 ** p * f1 - f2) / (r21 ** p - 1)
    g1 = 1.25 * abs((f1 - f2) / f1) / (r21 ** p - 1) * 100
    g2 = 1.25 * abs((f2 - f3) / f2) / (r32 ** p - 1) * 100
    return p, ext, g1, g2


def main():
    rows = {r['mesh']: r for r in csv.DictReader(open(BASE / 'a3_results.csv', encoding='utf-8'))}
    for m in ('coarse', 'work', 'fine'):   # a continued run (iteration limit in the main run) replaces the main row
        if f'{m}_cont' in rows:
            rows[m] = rows[f'{m}_cont']
    names = [m for m in ('coarse', 'work', 'fine') if m in rows]
    out = ['| Величина | ' + ' | '.join({'coarse': 'грубая', 'work': 'рабочая', 'fine': 'мелкая'}[m] + f" ({int(rows[m]['cells']):,} яч.)".replace(',', ' ')
                                         for m in names) + ' | рабочая − мелкая, % | GCI рабочей, % |', '|---' * (len(names) + 3) + '|']
    have3 = len(names) == 3
    if have3:
        N = {m: float(rows[m]['cells']) for m in names}
        r21, r32 = math.sqrt(N['fine'] / N['work']), math.sqrt(N['work'] / N['coarse'])
    for k, title in KEYS:
        vals = {m: rows[m].get(k, '') for m in names}
        if any(v in ('', None) for v in vals.values()):
            continue
        v = {m: float(x) for m, x in vals.items()}
        diff = g = ''
        if have3 and k not in ('yp_svz', 'yp_dzv'):
            diff = f"{(v['work'] - v['fine']) / abs(v['fine']) * 100:+.2f}" if v['fine'] else ''
            res = gci(v['fine'], v['work'], v['coarse'], r21, r32)
            g = f'{res[3]:.2f} (p={res[0]:.1f})' if res else 'немонотонно'
        out.append(f'| {title} | ' + ' | '.join(f'{v[m]:.4g}' for m in names) + f' | {diff} | {g} |')
    text = '\n'.join(out)
    (BASE / 'a3_table.md').write_text(text + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
    print(text)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

"""29.10.2026 — ПЛАН_v3 A3a (сокращённо), план по методу работы (runs\\plans\\a3a.json, plan_design.py): 3 новые трубы в наибольших

(отдельная папка runs\\a3a); итоговая проверка — финальной (замороженной) моделью (решение автора). Новые длины — сетка с нуля
(run_a9.scratch: идеальный метан FMG → ПР) при магистрали 5,5 МПа, затем продолжение к точкам плана (ступени магистрали 0,75 МПа).

import io, contextlib, json, sys, time

sys.path.insert(0, r'F:\Leontiev_Project\dataset')
sys.path.insert(0, r'F:\Leontiev_Project\program')
import run_a9 as A

R = Path(r'F:\Leontiev_Project\runs')
OUT = R / 'a3a'; OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True)

def wait_prev():
    import auto_enrich as AE
    while A.G.fluent_running() or any(AE._task_running(t) for t in
                                      ('Leontiev_queue_1029', 'Leontiev_knurl_eqflow', 'Leontiev_knurl_shallow', 'Leontiev_nozzle')):
        time.sleep(120)


def forecasts():
    import sppr
    with contextlib.redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()):
        M = sppr.Models()
    fc = {}
    for q in PLAN['points']:
        o = M.predict(q['td'], q['L'], q['dp'], q['pc'], q['t0'], 0.0, q['pm'])
        fc[q['id']] = dict(q, effect_K=o['effect_K'], sigma_K=o['sigma_K'], Q=o['Q'], m=o['m'], p=o['p'], p_hi=M.p_hi,
                           inside=all(o['inside']), n_train=M.n_train, time=time.strftime('%d.%m.%Y %H:%M:%S'))
    FC.write_text(json.dumps(fc, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1), encoding='utf-8')
    return fc


def reg(pm, pc, dp):
    return (pm, pc, pm, round(pm - dp / 1000, 6))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    wait_prev()
    A.qlog(f"=== A3a: проверка на новых трубах — начата ({PLAN['plan']})")
    fc = json.loads(FC.read_text(encoding='utf-8')) if FC.exists() else forecasts()

                                                     for t, v in fc.items()))
    n_calc = n_fail = 0
    tubes = {}
    for q in PLAN['points']:
        tubes.setdefault((q['td'], q['L']), []).append(q)
    for (td, L_mm), pts in tubes.items():
        pts.sort(key=lambda q: -q['pm'])
        q = pts[0]
        anchor = dict(id=f"{q['id'].split('_')[0]}_a", t_d=td, L_mm=L_mm, p_cons=q['pc'], dp_dzv_kPa=q['dp'], t0_svz=q['t0'], t0_dzv=q['t0'],
                      m_target=max(min(fc[q['id']]['m'], 1.0), 0.2), heater=0.0)
        cur = A.done_dir(anchor['id']) or A.scratch(anchor, anchor['id'])
        if not cur:
            n_calc += 1; n_fail += 1
            if n_calc == 2 and n_fail == 2:
                A.qlog('=== A3a: первые 2 расчёта не сошлись — СТОП, нужно решение автора'); sys.exit(1)
            continue
        pm_cur = 5.5
        for q in pts:
            if A.done_dir(q['id']):
                cur, pm_cur = A.done_dir(q['id']), q['pm']; continue
            src, k = cur, 0
            while abs(q['pm'] - pm_cur) > 0.8:
                k += 1; pm_cur = round(pm_cur + (0.75 if q['pm'] > pm_cur else -0.75), 2)
                src = A.cont(src / 'result.cas.h5', f"{q['id']}_s{k}", reg(pm_cur, q['pc'], q['dp']), [], q['t0'], q['t0'],
                             f'A3a: ступень магистрали {pm_cur}', A.AUX, limit=1500, l_mm=L_mm) or src
            d = A.cont(src / 'result.cas.h5', q['id'], reg(q['pm'], q['pc'], q['dp']), [], q['t0'], q['t0'], f'A3a: план, от {src.name}',
                       A.CSV, l_mm=L_mm)
            n_calc += 1; n_fail += not (d and A.converged(d))
            if n_calc == 2 and n_fail == 2:
                A.qlog('=== A3a: первые 2 расчёта не сошлись — СТОП, нужно решение автора'); sys.exit(1)
            if d:
                cur, pm_cur = d, q['pm']
    A.qlog('=== A3a — закончена')

        rn, pm, pc, dp, t0 = REGS[0]
        f = fc[f'{g}_{rn}']
        pt = dict(id=f'{g}_{rn}', t_d=td, L_mm=L, p_cons=pc, dp_dzv_kPa=dp, t0_svz=t0, t0_dzv=t0, m_target=max(f['m'], 0.2), heater=0.0)
        cur = A.done_dir(pt['id']) or (A.transfer(src_nb, pt) if src_nb else None)
        n_calc += 1; n_fail += not (cur and A.converged(cur))
        if n_calc == 2 and n_fail == 2:
            A.qlog('=== A3a: первые 2 расчёта не сошлись — СТОП, нужно решение автора'); sys.exit(1)
        if not cur:
            continue
        pm_cur = 5.5
        for rn, pm, pc, dp, t0 in REGS[1:]:
            tag = f'{g}_{rn}'
            if A.done_dir(tag):
                continue
            src, k = cur, 0
            while abs(pm - pm_cur) > 0.8:
                k += 1; pm_cur = round(pm_cur + (0.75 if pm > pm_cur else -0.75), 2)
                src = A.cont(src / 'result.cas.h5', f'{tag}_s{k}', (pm_cur, pc, pm_cur, round(pm_cur - dp / 1000, 6)), [], t0, t0,
                             f'A3a: ступень магистрали {pm_cur}', A.AUX, limit=1500, l_mm=L) or src
            d = A.cont(src / 'result.cas.h5', tag, (pm, pc, pm, round(pm - dp / 1000, 6)), [], t0, t0, f'A3a: {g}, от {src.name}', A.CSV, l_mm=L)
            n_calc += 1; n_fail += not (d and A.converged(d))
            if n_calc == 2 and n_fail == 2:
                A.qlog('=== A3a: первые 2 расчёта не сошлись — СТОП, нужно решение автора'); sys.exit(1)
            if d:
                cur, pm_cur = d, pm
    A.qlog('=== A3a — закончена')

FILE: dataset/a5_wall_htc.py

"""A5 diagnostics (09.10.2026): local heat transfer coefficients on both sides of the brass wall from the CFD (a5v3_m075,
reference a5v3_m000 for the adiabatic wall temperature) versus the correlations used in the 2017 paper
(SVZ: Nu = 0.021 Re^0.8 Pr^0.4, without the compressibility factor; DZV annulus: Dittus-Boelter 0.023, Dh = 2*gap).
Input: runs\\a5v3\\walls\\m075_svz.csv, m075_dzv.csv, m075_dzvcells.csv, m000_svz.csv (Fluent ascii exports)."""
import csv, math
from collections import defaultdict
from pathlib import Path
import CoolProp.CoolProp as CP

B = Path(r'F:\Leontiev_Project\runs\a5v3\walls')
G_SVZ, G_DZV = 0.04779, 0.036826
W = 0.05


def rd(name):
    return [{k.strip(): float(v) for k, v in r.items()} for r in csv.DictReader(open(B / name))]


def binned(rows, key, cond=lambda r: True):
    b = defaultdict(list)
    for r in rows:
        if cond(r):
            b[int(r['x-coordinate'] // W)].append(r[key])
    return {k: sum(v) / len(v) for k, v in b.items()}


svz, aw, dz = rd('m075_svz.csv'), rd('m000_svz.csv'), rd('m075_dzv.csv')
Tin, qin, Taw = binned(svz, 'temperature'), binned(svz, 'heat-flux'), binned(aw, 'temperature')
Tout = binned(dz, 'temperature')
qout = binned(dz, 'heat-flux', lambda r: r['heat-flux'] < 0)
cells = defaultdict(lambda: [0.0, 0.0])
for r in rd('m075_dzvcells.csv'):
    w = r['density'] * abs(r['axial-velocity']) * r['y-coordinate']
    c = cells[int(r['x-coordinate'] // W)]
    c[0] += w * r['temperature']; c[1] += w
Tb = {k: v[0] / v[1] for k, v in cells.items() if v[1] > 0}

print(' x_mm  d_mm  Tw_in   Taw   q_in  h_svz h_svz_DB |  Tb_dzv Tw_out  q_out  h_dzv h_dzv_DB')
for k in sorted(Tin):
    if k < 0 or k >= 14:
        continue
    x = (k + 0.5) * W
    d = 0.006 + 0.008 * min(x, 0.4) / 0.4
    hs = qin[k] / (Tin[k] - Taw[k]) if abs(Tin[k] - Taw[k]) > 1e-3 else float('nan')
    Tw = Tin[k]
    mu, lam, Pr = (CP.PropsSI(p, 'T', Tw, 'P', 1e5, 'Air') for p in ('V', 'L', 'Prandtl'))
    Re = 4 * G_SVZ / (math.pi * d * mu)
    hdb = 0.021 * Re ** 0.8 * Pr ** 0.4 * lam / d
    Dh, A = 0.003, math.pi * (0.016 ** 2 - 0.0145 ** 2)
    T2 = Tb.get(k, float('nan'))
    mu2, lam2, Pr2 = (CP.PropsSI(p, 'T', T2, 'P', 1.05e6, 'Air') for p in ('V', 'L', 'Prandtl'))
    Re2 = G_DZV * Dh / (A * mu2)
    hdb2 = 0.023 * Re2 ** 0.8 * Pr2 ** 0.4 * lam2 / Dh
    qo = qout.get(k, float('nan'))
    hd = abs(qo) / (T2 - Tout[k]) if abs(T2 - Tout[k]) > 1e-3 else float('nan')
    print('%5.0f %5.1f %6.1f %6.1f %6.0f %6.0f %6.0f   | %6.1f %6.1f %6.0f %6.0f %6.0f'
          % (x * 1e3, d * 1e3, Tin[k], Taw[k], qin[k], hs, hdb, T2, Tout[k], qo, hd, hdb2))

"""A5 diagnostics, corrected (10.10.2026).  a5_wall_htc.py averaged the DZV bulk temperature over exported cell centres
with weight rho*|u|*r WITHOUT the cell area вЂ” on a graded wall mesh the many small near-wall cells pull the 'bulk'
temperature toward the wall temperature (remark of the second reviewer, accepted).  Here every average is done by Fluent
itself (face-area and 2*pi*r weighting of the axisymmetric case):
  per 50 mm segment k (x 0.05k .. 0.05(k+1) m): wall heat flow (integral of heat-flux over an iso-clip of the fluid-side
  interface, W) and the area-weighted wall temperature; DZV bulk temperature = mass-weighted average on a radial line
  across the gap at the segment middle; SVZ adiabatic wall temperature from the m = 0 case.
h_dzv = |Q_k| / A_k / |Tb_dzv - Tw_dzv|,  h_svz = |Q_k| / A_k / |Tw_svz - Taw|.  Correlations as in a5_wall_htc.py.
Usage: python a5_wall_htc2.py <case m> <case m=0> <G_svz> <G_dzv> <out dir>   (default: old a5v3 m075 / m000)."""
import csv, math, subprocess, sys, time
from pathlib import Path
import CoolProp.CoolProp as CP

FLUENT = r'C:\Program Files\ANSYS Inc\v242\fluent\ntbin\win64\fluent.exe'
SVZ_SIDE = 'wall-air_svz-wall_abonite-contact_region-src'      # air side (src-non-overlapping is air)
DZV_SIDE = 'interior-air_dzv-wall_abonite-contact_region_2-trg'  # air side (trg-non-overlapping is air)
R_BRASS, R_OUT = 0.0145, 0.016
K = range(1, 14)


def r_in(x):
    return 0.003 + 0.004 * min(x, 0.4) / 0.4


def journal(case, case0, out):
    q = str(out).replace('\\', '/')
    L = [f'/file/start-transcript "{q}/htc.trn"', '/define/units length m', '/define/units temperature k',
         f'/file/read-case-data "{case}"']
    surf = []
    for k in K:
        x0, x1, xm = 0.05 * k, 0.05 * (k + 1), 0.05 * (k + 0.5)
        L += [f'/surface/iso-clip x-coordinate cs{k} {SVZ_SIDE} {x0} {x1}',
              f'/surface/iso-clip x-coordinate cd{k} {DZV_SIDE} {x0} {x1}',
              f'/surface/line-surface ld{k} {xm} {R_BRASS + 1e-6} {xm} {R_OUT - 1e-6}']
        surf.append(k)
    cs = ' '.join(f'cs{k}' for k in K); cd = ' '.join(f'cd{k}' for k in K); ld = ' '.join(f'ld{k}' for k in K)
    L += [f'/report/surface-integrals/integral {cs} {cd} () heat-flux yes "{q}/Q.txt"',
          f'/report/surface-integrals/area {cs} {cd} () yes "{q}/A.txt"',
          f'/report/surface-integrals/area-weighted-avg {cs} {cd} () temperature yes "{q}/Tw.txt"',
          f'/report/surface-integrals/mass-weighted-avg {ld} () temperature yes "{q}/Tb.txt"',
          f'/report/surface-integrals/mass-flow-rate {ld} () yes "{q}/G.txt"',
          '/file/stop-transcript', '/exit yes']
    (out / 'htc.jou').write_text('\n'.join(L) + '\n', encoding='ascii')
    L = [f'/file/start-transcript "{q}/htc0.trn"', '/define/units length m', '/define/units temperature k',
         f'/file/read-case-data "{case0}"']
    for k in K:
        L.append(f'/surface/iso-clip x-coordinate a{k} {SVZ_SIDE} {0.05 * k} {0.05 * (k + 1)}')
    L += [f'/report/surface-integrals/area-weighted-avg {" ".join(f"a{k}" for k in K)} () temperature yes "{q}/Taw.txt"',
          '/file/stop-transcript', '/exit yes']
    (out / 'htc0.jou').write_text('\n'.join(L) + '\n', encoding='ascii')


def parse(path):
    d = {}
    for line in open(path, encoding='utf-8', errors='ignore'):
        p = line.split()
        if len(p) == 2:
            try:
                d[p[0]] = float(p[1])
            except ValueError:
                pass
    return d


def main():
    a = sys.argv[1:]
    case = a[0] if a else 'F:/Leontiev_Project/runs/a5v3/a5v3_m075/result.cas.h5'
    case0 = a[1] if len(a) > 1 else 'F:/Leontiev_Project/runs/a5v3/a5v3_m000/result.cas.h5'
    g_svz = float(a[2]) if len(a) > 2 else 0.04779
    g_dzv = float(a[3]) if len(a) > 3 else 0.036826
    out = Path(a[4]) if len(a) > 4 else Path(r'F:\Leontiev_Project\runs\a5v3\walls2')
    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    journal(case, case0, out)
    t = time.time()
    try:
        if not (out / 'Taw.txt').exists():   # reports already written -> only the evaluation
            for j in ('htc.jou', 'htc0.jou'):
                subprocess.Popen([FLUENT, '2ddp', '-t1', '-g', '-i', str(out / j)], cwd=str(out)).wait(900)
    finally:
        ps = ("Get-Process cx2420,fluent,fl_mpi2420,mpiexec,hydra_pmi_proxy -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object "
              f"{{ $_.StartTime -gt (Get-Date).AddSeconds(-{int(time.time() - t) + 5}) }} | Stop-Process -Force")
        subprocess.run(['powershell', '-NoProfile', '-Command', ps])
    Q, A, Tw, Tb, G, Taw = (parse(out / f) for f in ('Q.txt', 'A.txt', 'Tw.txt', 'Tb.txt', 'G.txt', 'Taw.txt'))
    for d in (Tw, Tb, Taw):   # the case keeps its display units (C) despite /define/units
        if max(d.values()) < 150:
            d.update({k: v + 273.15 for k, v in d.items()})
    rows = []
    print(' x_mm  Tw_svz   Taw  Q_svz  h_svz h_svz_DB |  Tb_dzv Tw_dzv  Q_dzv  h_dzv h_dzv_DB  G_line')
    for k in K:
        x = 0.05 * (k + 0.5); d = 2 * r_in(x)
        qs, qd = Q.get(f'cs{k}'), Q.get(f'cd{k}')
        hs = abs(qs) / A[f'cs{k}'] / abs(Tw[f'cs{k}'] - Taw[f'a{k}'])
        mu, lam, Pr = (CP.PropsSI(p_, 'T', Tw[f'cs{k}'], 'P', 1e5, 'Air') for p_ in ('V', 'L', 'Prandtl'))
        hdb = 0.021 * (4 * g_svz / (math.pi * d * mu)) ** 0.8 * Pr ** 0.4 * lam / d
        T2 = Tb[f'ld{k}']
        hd = abs(qd) / A[f'cd{k}'] / abs(T2 - Tw[f'cd{k}'])
        Dh, Ar = 2 * (R_OUT - R_BRASS), math.pi * (R_OUT ** 2 - R_BRASS ** 2)
        mu2, lam2, Pr2 = (CP.PropsSI(p_, 'T', T2, 'P', 1.05e6, 'Air') for p_ in ('V', 'L', 'Prandtl'))
        hdb2 = 0.023 * (g_dzv * Dh / (Ar * mu2)) ** 0.8 * Pr2 ** 0.4 * lam2 / Dh
        r = dict(x_mm=x * 1e3, Tw_svz=Tw[f'cs{k}'], Taw=Taw[f'a{k}'], Q_svz=qs, h_svz=hs, h_svz_DB=hdb, Tb_dzv=T2,
                 Tw_dzv=Tw[f'cd{k}'], Q_dzv=qd, h_dzv=hd, h_dzv_DB=hdb2, G_line=G.get(f'ld{k}'))
        rows.append(r)
        print('%5.0f %7.2f %6.2f %6.1f %6.0f %6.0f   | %7.2f %6.2f %6.1f %6.0f %6.0f  %.5f' % tuple(r.values()))
    with open(out / 'htc.csv', 'w', newline='', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        w = csv.DictWriter(f, fieldnames=list(rows[0])); w.writeheader(); w.writerows(rows)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()


===========================================================================
FILE: dataset/a8_strategies.py
===========================================================================
"""16.10.2026 — А8: comparison of CFD-point selection strategies on the A9 reference (author: S3 alpha 10 %, eps 0.5 K;
reference + many repeats + confirming CFD; metric = effect in K).

Reference ("truth"): GP regression of the effect (heating vs throttle, K) + GP classifier "channel working" (no shock in
the channel), both fitted on ALL converged A9 points (A9_11, A9_35, A9_36 excluded by the author 16.10).
Factors (6): t/d, L/d (designer X0, 3x3 grid) and dp_dzv (log), p_cons, t0_dzv, heater (dispatcher U).
Decision of the LPR: the point of the candidate pool with the largest predicted effect among points with
P(working) >= 1 - alpha.  Same model and same recommendation rule for every strategy; they differ only in which
points they ask for (and S3 in when it stops):
  S1  maximin Latin hypercube, the whole budget at once;
  S2  sequential GP, next point = largest predictive std of the effect;
  S3  decision rule: next point where the recommendation may change (classifier uncertain AND effect could exceed the
      current best, or the current best is itself uncertain); statuses 'выдать' / 'досчитать' / 'вернуть'; stop when
      P(recommended point is not working) < alpha and the expected gain of one more CFD < eps.
Metrics per run: regret (K) = true effect at the reference optimum - true effect at the recommendation; recommending a
non-working regime; number of CFD used.  Output: runs\\a8\\a8_runs.csv, a8_summary.md."""
import csv, json, math, sys, time, warnings
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from scipy.stats import norm, qmc
from sklearn.gaussian_process import GaussianProcessRegressor, GaussianProcessClassifier
from sklearn.gaussian_process.kernels import Matern, ConstantKernel as Ck, WhiteKernel
warnings.filterwarnings('ignore')

A9 = Path(r'F:\Leontiev_Project\runs\a9')
OUT = Path(r'F:\Leontiev_Project\runs\a8')
EXCL = {'A9_11', 'A9_35', 'A9_36'}
ALPHA, EPS = 0.10, 0.5
N0, BUDGET, REPEATS, NOISE_K = 8, 24, 50, 0.05      # NOISE_K: repeat-from-scratch spread (A9_43/44: 0.00 / 0.01 K)
LEVELS = (8, 12, 16, 20, 24)   # budgets at which all strategies are compared (regret curve)
STABLE_K = 3                   # S3 'выдать': the recommendation unchanged over the last 3 CFD
TD, LD = (1.2, 1.4, 1.6), (30.0, 60.0, 100.0)
LO = np.array([1.2, 30.0, math.log(0.5), 0.3, -10.0, 0.0])
HI = np.array([1.6, 100.0, math.log(139.0), 1.6, 20.0, 20.0])
NAMES = ['t/d', 'L/d', 'ln dp_dzv', 'p_cons', 'T0_dzv', 'heater']


def load():
    design = {p['id']: p for p in csv.DictReader(open(A9 / 'a9_design.csv', encoding='utf-8'))}
    res = {r['tag']: r for r in csv.DictReader(open(A9 / 'a9_results.csv', encoding='utf-8'))}
    X, y, w, ids = [], [], [], []
    global LOGM
    LOGM = []
    for s in csv.DictReader(open(A9 / 'a9_points_status.csv', encoding='utf-8')):
        if s['id'] in EXCL or s['num_status'] != 'сошлась':
            continue
        p, r = design[s['id']], res[s['result']]
        LOGM.append(math.log(float(s['m'])))
        X.append([float(p['t_d']), float(p['L_d']), math.log(float(p['dp_dzv_kPa'])), float(p['p_cons']),
                  float(p['t0_dzv']), float(p['heater'])])
        y.append(float(r['dT_svz_vs_throttle']))
        w.append(0 if r.get('x_shock_m') else 1)
        ids.append(s['id'])
    return np.array(X), np.array(y), np.array(w), ids


def z(X):
    return (np.asarray(X) - LO) / (HI - LO)


def gpr(X, y):
    k = Ck(1.0) * Matern(length_scale=np.ones(6), length_scale_bounds=(0.05, 20), nu=2.5) + WhiteKernel(1e-3, (1e-6, 1e-1))
    return GaussianProcessRegressor(k, normalize_y=True, n_restarts_optimizer=2, random_state=0).fit(z(X), y)


def gpc(X, w):
    """'Working' classifier: GP regression of the label +1 / -1, P(working) = Phi(mean / std).  (sklearn's Laplace GPC
    was tried first: its probabilities never exceed ~0.92 even deep inside the working region, so the alpha = 10 %
    rule could not be met at all.)  Confident far inside a class, uncertain at the boundary and far from data."""
    k = Ck(1.0) * Matern(length_scale=np.ones(6), length_scale_bounds=(0.05, 20), nu=2.5) + WhiteKernel(1e-2, (1e-4, 0.3))
    return GaussianProcessRegressor(k, normalize_y=False, n_restarts_optimizer=1, random_state=0).fit(z(X), 2.0 * w - 1.0)


def p_work(c, X):
    mu, sd = c.predict(z(X), return_std=True)
    return norm.cdf(mu / np.maximum(sd, 1e-6))


M_RANGE = (0.2, 1.0)   # 16.10 v2: validated m range (A5, author 11.10); v1 searched up to m ~3-4 (t/d 1.6, dp 100 kPa)
M_MODEL = None


def pool(rng, n_per_geo=250):
    """Candidates: 9 geometries x LHS of the regime; kept only where the predicted m = G_DZV/G_SVZ is inside the validated
    range (GP of ln m fitted on all A9 points) — the decision space of the LPR is the validated region."""
    global M_MODEL
    if M_MODEL is None:
        Xa, _, _, _ = load()
        M_MODEL = gpr(Xa, np.array(LOGM))
    s = qmc.LatinHypercube(d=4, seed=rng.integers(1 << 31)).random(n_per_geo * 9 * 4)
    U = LO[2:] + s * (HI[2:] - LO[2:])
    G = np.array([(t, l) for t in TD for l in LD]).repeat(n_per_geo * 4, axis=0)
    P = np.hstack([G, U])
    m = np.exp(M_MODEL.predict(z(P)))
    P = P[(m >= M_RANGE[0]) & (m <= M_RANGE[1])]
    keep = []
    for t in TD:
        for l in LD:   # equal number of candidates per geometry
            idx = np.where((P[:, 0] == t) & (P[:, 1] == l))[0]
            keep.extend(rng.permutation(idx)[:n_per_geo])
    return P[np.array(keep)]


def recommend(m, c, P):
    mu = m.predict(z(P))
    pw = p_work(c, P)
    ok = pw >= 1 - ALPHA
    i = int(np.argmax(np.where(ok, mu, -1e9))) if ok.any() else int(np.argmax(pw))
    return i, ok.any()


def maximin_lhs(P, n, rng, tries=30):
    best, bd = None, -1
    for _ in range(tries):
        idx = rng.choice(len(P), n, replace=False)
        Z = z(P[idx]); d = np.sqrt(((Z[:, None] - Z[None]) ** 2).sum(-1)); d[np.diag_indices(n)] = 9
        if d.min() > bd:
            best, bd = idx, d.min()
    return list(best)


def run_one(strategy, ref_m, ref_c, P, true_mu, true_w, rng, start_seed=0):
    """One strategy, one start; the 'CFD' answer is the reference (+ repeat noise)."""
    def ask(i):
        return true_mu[i] + rng.normal(0, NOISE_K), int(true_w[i])
    best_true = float(true_mu[np.argmax(np.where(true_w, true_mu, -1e9))])
    curve = {}   # n CFD -> (regret K, recommended point not working)
    if strategy == 'S1':   # a separate maximin LHS for every budget level
        for n in LEVELS:
            obs = {i: ask(i) for i in maximin_lhs(P, n, rng)}
            Xo = P[list(obs)]; yo = np.array([v[0] for v in obs.values()]); wo = np.array([v[1] for v in obs.values()])
            rec, feasible = recommend(gpr(Xo, yo), gpc(Xo, wo), P)
            curve[n] = (best_true - float(true_mu[rec]), int(not true_w[rec]))
    start = maximin_lhs(P, N0, np.random.default_rng(start_seed))   # the same start set for S2 and S3 in one repeat
    obs = {i: ask(i) for i in start}
    status, stop_reason, hist, stop = 'досчитать', 'бюджет', [], None
    while strategy != 'S1':
        Xo = P[list(obs)]; yo = np.array([v[0] for v in obs.values()]); wo = np.array([v[1] for v in obs.values()])
        m, c = gpr(Xo, yo), gpc(Xo, wo)
        rec, feasible = recommend(m, c, P)
        if len(obs) in LEVELS:
            curve[len(obs)] = (best_true - float(true_mu[rec]), int(not true_w[rec]))
        hist.append((tuple(P[rec][:2]), float(m.predict(z(P[rec:rec + 1]))[0])))
        if len(obs) >= BUDGET:
            break
        mu, sd = m.predict(z(P), return_std=True)
        pw = p_work(c, P)
        if strategy == 'S2':
            cand = sd.copy(); cand[list(obs)] = -1
            nxt = int(np.argmax(cand))
        else:   # S3
            best = mu[rec]
            ei = (mu - best) * norm.cdf((mu - best) / np.maximum(sd, 1e-9)) + sd * norm.pdf((mu - best) / np.maximum(sd, 1e-9))
            gain = ei * pw                                  # expected improvement of the decision, feasible part
            bound = pw * (1 - pw) * 4 * np.maximum(mu - best + 2 * sd, 0)   # boundary points that could flip the choice
            risk_rec = 1 - pw[rec]
            confirmed = rec in obs and obs[rec][1] == 1   # 'выдать' only after the recommended point itself is computed
            stable = len(hist) >= STABLE_K and len({h[0] for h in hist[-STABLE_K:]}) == 1 and \
                max(h[1] for h in hist[-STABLE_K:]) - min(h[1] for h in hist[-STABLE_K:]) < EPS
            if stop is None and confirmed and stable and risk_rec < ALPHA and gain.max() < EPS and feasible:
                # the decision rule stops here; the run goes on only to draw the same regret curve as S2
                status, stop_reason = 'выдать', 'подтверждена CFD, устойчива, P(ошибки) < α, выигрыш < ε'
                stop = (len(obs), best_true - float(true_mu[rec]), int(not true_w[rec]))
            score = np.maximum(gain, bound)
            if rec not in obs:        # the recommended point itself not computed -> compute it (confirming CFD)
                score[rec] = score.max() + 1
            score[list(obs)] = -1
            nxt = int(np.argmax(score))
        obs[nxt] = ask(nxt)
    if strategy == 'S1':
        n_used, reg_used, bad_used = BUDGET, *curve[BUDGET]
        rec_txt = ''
    else:
        if not feasible and stop is None:
            status = 'вернуть'
        n_used, reg_used, bad_used = stop if stop else (len(obs), best_true - float(true_mu[rec]), int(not true_w[rec]))
        rec_txt = f'{P[rec][0]:.1f}/{P[rec][1]:.0f}'
    row = dict(strategy=strategy, n_cfd=n_used, regret_K=round(reg_used, 3), rec_not_working=bad_used, status=status,
               stop=stop_reason, rec_geometry=rec_txt)
    for n in LEVELS:
        row[f'regret_{n}'] = round(curve[n][0], 3)
        row[f'bad_{n}'] = curve[n][1]
    return row


def loo(X, y, w):
    """Accuracy of the reference itself: leave-one-out."""
    e, hit = [], []
    for i in range(len(X)):
        k = np.arange(len(X)) != i
        e.append(float(gpr(X[k], y[k]).predict(z(X[i:i + 1]))[0] - y[i]))
        hit.append(int((p_work(gpc(X[k], w[k]), X[i:i + 1])[0] >= 0.5) == w[i]))
    return np.array(e), np.array(hit)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    X, y, w, ids = load()
    t0 = time.time()
    e, hit = loo(X, y, w)
    ref_m, ref_c = gpr(X, y), gpc(X, w)
    info = dict(points=len(X), working=int(w.sum()), effect_range=[float(y.min()), float(y.max())],
                loo_rmse_K=round(float(np.sqrt((e ** 2).mean())), 3), loo_mae_K=round(float(np.abs(e).mean()), 3),
                loo_class_acc=round(float(hit.mean()), 3), kernel=str(ref_m.kernel_))
    print(json.dumps(info, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1), flush=True)
    rows = []
    for rep in range(REPEATS):
        rng = np.random.default_rng(1000 + rep)
        P = pool(rng)
        true_mu, true_w = ref_m.predict(z(P)), p_work(ref_c, P) >= 0.5
        for s in ('S1', 'S2', 'S3'):
            r = run_one(s, ref_m, ref_c, P, true_mu, true_w, np.random.default_rng(rep * 10 + int(s[1])), 5000 + rep)
            r['repeat'] = rep
            rows.append(r)
        print(f'{rep + 1}/{REPEATS} {time.time() - t0:.0f} s', flush=True)
        with open(OUT / 'a8_runs.csv', 'w', newline='', encoding='utf-8') as f:
            wr = csv.DictWriter(f, fieldnames=list(rows[0])); wr.writeheader(); wr.writerows(rows)
    lines = ['# А8 — итог сравнения стратегий на эталоне А9', '', f'Эталон: {json.dumps(info, ensure_ascii=False)}', '',
             f'N0 = {N0}, бюджет ≤ {BUDGET}, повторов {REPEATS}, α = {ALPHA}, ε = {EPS} K, шум повтора {NOISE_K} K', '',
             '## Недобор эффекта рекомендации (K), среднее / 90 % по повторам, при числе CFD',
             '| Стратегия | ' + ' | '.join(str(n) for n in LEVELS) + ' |', '|---|' + '---|' * len(LEVELS)]
    for s in ('S1', 'S2', 'S3'):
        rr = [r for r in rows if r['strategy'] == s]
        cells = []
        for n in LEVELS:
            reg = np.array([r[f'regret_{n}'] for r in rr]); bad = np.mean([r[f'bad_{n}'] for r in rr])
            cells.append(f'{reg.mean():.2f} / {np.quantile(reg, 0.9):.2f}' + (f' (недоп. {100 * bad:.0f} %)' if bad else ''))
        lines.append(f'| {s} | ' + ' | '.join(cells) + ' |')
    rr = [r for r in rows if r['strategy'] == 'S3']
    st = [r for r in rr if r['status'] == 'выдать']
    lines += ['', '## S3 — остановка по правилу ЛПР (α, ε, подтверждение CFD, устойчивость)',
              f"- «выдать»: {100 * len(st) / len(rr):.0f} % повторов; «вернуть»: {100 * np.mean([r['status'] == 'вернуть' for r in rr]):.0f} %; "
              f"не остановился до бюджета {BUDGET}: {100 * np.mean([r['status'] == 'досчитать' for r in rr]):.0f} %"]
    if st:
        reg = np.array([r['regret_K'] for r in st])
        lines.append(f"- при «выдать»: CFD {np.mean([r['n_cfd'] for r in st]):.1f} (мин {min(r['n_cfd'] for r in st)}, "
                     f"макс {max(r['n_cfd'] for r in st)}); недобор {reg.mean():.2f} K (90 % — {np.quantile(reg, 0.9):.2f}); "
                     f"доля с недобором < ε: {100 * np.mean(reg < EPS):.0f} %; недопустимый режим: "
                     f"{100 * np.mean([r['rec_not_working'] for r in st]):.0f} %")
    (OUT / 'a8_summary.md').write_text('\n'.join(lines) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
    print('\n'.join(lines))


===========================================================================
FILE: dataset/a8_strategies_архив_20261016_1900.py
===========================================================================
"""16.10.2026 — А8: comparison of CFD-point selection strategies on the A9 reference (author: S3 alpha 10 %, eps 0.5 K;
reference + many repeats + confirming CFD; metric = effect in K).

Reference ("truth"): GP regression of the effect (heating vs throttle, K) + GP classifier "channel working" (no shock in
the channel), both fitted on ALL converged A9 points (A9_11, A9_35, A9_36 excluded by the author 16.10).
Factors (6): t/d, L/d (designer X0, 3x3 grid) and dp_dzv (log), p_cons, t0_dzv, heater (dispatcher U).
Decision of the LPR: the point of the candidate pool with the largest predicted effect among points with
P(working) >= 1 - alpha.  Same model and same recommendation rule for every strategy; they differ only in which
points they ask for (and S3 in when it stops):
  S1  maximin Latin hypercube, the whole budget at once;
  S2  sequential GP, next point = largest predictive std of the effect;
  S3  decision rule: next point where the recommendation may change (classifier uncertain AND effect could exceed the
      current best, or the current best is itself uncertain); statuses 'выдать' / 'досчитать' / 'вернуть'; stop when
      P(recommended point is not working) < alpha and the expected gain of one more CFD < eps.
Metrics per run: regret (K) = true effect at the reference optimum - true effect at the recommendation; recommending a
non-working regime; number of CFD used.  Output: runs\\a8\\a8_runs.csv, a8_summary.md."""
import csv, json, math, sys, time, warnings
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from scipy.stats import norm, qmc
from sklearn.gaussian_process import GaussianProcessRegressor, GaussianProcessClassifier
from sklearn.gaussian_process.kernels import Matern, ConstantKernel as Ck, WhiteKernel
warnings.filterwarnings('ignore')

A9 = Path(r'F:\Leontiev_Project\runs\a9')
OUT = Path(r'F:\Leontiev_Project\runs\a8')
EXCL = {'A9_11', 'A9_35', 'A9_36'}
ALPHA, EPS = 0.10, 0.5
N0, BUDGET, REPEATS, NOISE_K = 8, 24, 50, 0.05      # NOISE_K: repeat-from-scratch spread (A9_43/44: 0.00 / 0.01 K)
LEVELS = (8, 12, 16, 20, 24)   # budgets at which all strategies are compared (regret curve)
STABLE_K = 3                   # S3 'выдать': the recommendation unchanged over the last 3 CFD
TD, LD = (1.2, 1.4, 1.6), (30.0, 60.0, 100.0)
LO = np.array([1.2, 30.0, math.log(0.5), 0.3, -10.0, 0.0])
HI = np.array([1.6, 100.0, math.log(139.0), 1.6, 20.0, 20.0])
NAMES = ['t/d', 'L/d', 'ln dp_dzv', 'p_cons', 'T0_dzv', 'heater']


def load():
    design = {p['id']: p for p in csv.DictReader(open(A9 / 'a9_design.csv', encoding='utf-8'))}
    res = {r['tag']: r for r in csv.DictReader(open(A9 / 'a9_results.csv', encoding='utf-8'))}
    X, y, w, ids = [], [], [], []
    for s in csv.DictReader(open(A9 / 'a9_points_status.csv', encoding='utf-8')):
        if s['id'] in EXCL or s['num_status'] != 'сошлась':
            continue
        p, r = design[s['id']], res[s['result']]
        X.append([float(p['t_d']), float(p['L_d']), math.log(float(p['dp_dzv_kPa'])), float(p['p_cons']),
                  float(p['t0_dzv']), float(p['heater'])])
        y.append(float(r['dT_svz_vs_throttle']))
        w.append(0 if r.get('x_shock_m') else 1)
        ids.append(s['id'])
    return np.array(X), np.array(y), np.array(w), ids


def z(X):
    return (np.asarray(X) - LO) / (HI - LO)


def gpr(X, y):
    k = Ck(1.0) * Matern(length_scale=np.ones(6), length_scale_bounds=(0.05, 20), nu=2.5) + WhiteKernel(1e-3, (1e-6, 1e-1))
    return GaussianProcessRegressor(k, normalize_y=True, n_restarts_optimizer=2, random_state=0).fit(z(X), y)


def gpc(X, w):
    """'Working' classifier: GP regression of the label +1 / -1, P(working) = Phi(mean / std).  (sklearn's Laplace GPC
    was tried first: its probabilities never exceed ~0.92 even deep inside the working region, so the alpha = 10 %
    rule could not be met at all.)  Confident far inside a class, uncertain at the boundary and far from data."""
    k = Ck(1.0) * Matern(length_scale=np.ones(6), length_scale_bounds=(0.05, 20), nu=2.5) + WhiteKernel(1e-2, (1e-4, 0.3))
    return GaussianProcessRegressor(k, normalize_y=False, n_restarts_optimizer=1, random_state=0).fit(z(X), 2.0 * w - 1.0)


def p_work(c, X):
    mu, sd = c.predict(z(X), return_std=True)
    return norm.cdf(mu / np.maximum(sd, 1e-6))


def pool(rng, n_per_geo=250):
    s = qmc.LatinHypercube(d=4, seed=rng.integers(1 << 31)).random(n_per_geo * 9)
    U = LO[2:] + s * (HI[2:] - LO[2:])
    G = np.array([(t, l) for t in TD for l in LD]).repeat(n_per_geo, axis=0)
    return np.hstack([G, U])


def recommend(m, c, P):
    mu = m.predict(z(P))
    pw = p_work(c, P)
    ok = pw >= 1 - ALPHA
    i = int(np.argmax(np.where(ok, mu, -1e9))) if ok.any() else int(np.argmax(pw))
    return i, ok.any()


def maximin_lhs(P, n, rng, tries=30):
    best, bd = None, -1
    for _ in range(tries):
        idx = rng.choice(len(P), n, replace=False)
        Z = z(P[idx]); d = np.sqrt(((Z[:, None] - Z[None]) ** 2).sum(-1)); d[np.diag_indices(n)] = 9
        if d.min() > bd:
            best, bd = idx, d.min()
    return list(best)


def run_one(strategy, ref_m, ref_c, P, true_mu, true_w, rng, start_seed=0):
    """One strategy, one start; the 'CFD' answer is the reference (+ repeat noise)."""
    def ask(i):
        return true_mu[i] + rng.normal(0, NOISE_K), int(true_w[i])
    best_true = float(true_mu[np.argmax(np.where(true_w, true_mu, -1e9))])
    curve = {}   # n CFD -> (regret K, recommended point not working)
    if strategy == 'S1':   # a separate maximin LHS for every budget level
        for n in LEVELS:
            obs = {i: ask(i) for i in maximin_lhs(P, n, rng)}
            Xo = P[list(obs)]; yo = np.array([v[0] for v in obs.values()]); wo = np.array([v[1] for v in obs.values()])
            rec, feasible = recommend(gpr(Xo, yo), gpc(Xo, wo), P)
            curve[n] = (best_true - float(true_mu[rec]), int(not true_w[rec]))
    start = maximin_lhs(P, N0, np.random.default_rng(start_seed))   # the same start set for S2 and S3 in one repeat
    obs = {i: ask(i) for i in start}
    status, stop_reason, hist, stop = 'досчитать', 'бюджет', [], None
    while strategy != 'S1':
        Xo = P[list(obs)]; yo = np.array([v[0] for v in obs.values()]); wo = np.array([v[1] for v in obs.values()])
        m, c = gpr(Xo, yo), gpc(Xo, wo)
        rec, feasible = recommend(m, c, P)
        if len(obs) in LEVELS:
            curve[len(obs)] = (best_true - float(true_mu[rec]), int(not true_w[rec]))
        hist.append((tuple(P[rec][:2]), float(m.predict(z(P[rec:rec + 1]))[0])))
        if len(obs) >= BUDGET:
            break
        mu, sd = m.predict(z(P), return_std=True)
        pw = p_work(c, P)
        if strategy == 'S2':
            cand = sd.copy(); cand[list(obs)] = -1
            nxt = int(np.argmax(cand))
        else:   # S3
            best = mu[rec]
            ei = (mu - best) * norm.cdf((mu - best) / np.maximum(sd, 1e-9)) + sd * norm.pdf((mu - best) / np.maximum(sd, 1e-9))
            gain = ei * pw                                  # expected improvement of the decision, feasible part
            bound = pw * (1 - pw) * 4 * np.maximum(mu - best + 2 * sd, 0)   # boundary points that could flip the choice
            risk_rec = 1 - pw[rec]
            confirmed = rec in obs and obs[rec][1] == 1   # 'выдать' only after the recommended point itself is computed
            stable = len(hist) >= STABLE_K and len({h[0] for h in hist[-STABLE_K:]}) == 1 and \
                max(h[1] for h in hist[-STABLE_K:]) - min(h[1] for h in hist[-STABLE_K:]) < EPS
            if stop is None and confirmed and stable and risk_rec < ALPHA and gain.max() < EPS and feasible:
                # the decision rule stops here; the run goes on only to draw the same regret curve as S2
                status, stop_reason = 'выдать', 'подтверждена CFD, устойчива, P(ошибки) < α, выигрыш < ε'
                stop = (len(obs), best_true - float(true_mu[rec]), int(not true_w[rec]))
            score = np.maximum(gain, bound)
            if rec not in obs:        # the recommended point itself not computed -> compute it (confirming CFD)
                score[rec] = score.max() + 1
            score[list(obs)] = -1
            nxt = int(np.argmax(score))
        obs[nxt] = ask(nxt)
    if strategy == 'S1':
        n_used, reg_used, bad_used = BUDGET, *curve[BUDGET]
        rec_txt = ''
    else:
        if not feasible and stop is None:
            status = 'вернуть'
        n_used, reg_used, bad_used = stop if stop else (len(obs), best_true - float(true_mu[rec]), int(not true_w[rec]))
        rec_txt = f'{P[rec][0]:.1f}/{P[rec][1]:.0f}'
    row = dict(strategy=strategy, n_cfd=n_used, regret_K=round(reg_used, 3), rec_not_working=bad_used, status=status,
               stop=stop_reason, rec_geometry=rec_txt)
    for n in LEVELS:
        row[f'regret_{n}'] = round(curve[n][0], 3)
        row[f'bad_{n}'] = curve[n][1]
    return row


def loo(X, y, w):
    """Accuracy of the reference itself: leave-one-out."""
    e, hit = [], []
    for i in range(len(X)):
        k = np.arange(len(X)) != i
        e.append(float(gpr(X[k], y[k]).predict(z(X[i:i + 1]))[0] - y[i]))
        hit.append(int((p_work(gpc(X[k], w[k]), X[i:i + 1])[0] >= 0.5) == w[i]))
    return np.array(e), np.array(hit)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    X, y, w, ids = load()
    t0 = time.time()
    e, hit = loo(X, y, w)
    ref_m, ref_c = gpr(X, y), gpc(X, w)
    info = dict(points=len(X), working=int(w.sum()), effect_range=[float(y.min()), float(y.max())],
                loo_rmse_K=round(float(np.sqrt((e ** 2).mean())), 3), loo_mae_K=round(float(np.abs(e).mean()), 3),
                loo_class_acc=round(float(hit.mean()), 3), kernel=str(ref_m.kernel_))
    print(json.dumps(info, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1), flush=True)
    rows = []
    for rep in range(REPEATS):
        rng = np.random.default_rng(1000 + rep)
        P = pool(rng)
        true_mu, true_w = ref_m.predict(z(P)), p_work(ref_c, P) >= 0.5
        for s in ('S1', 'S2', 'S3'):
            r = run_one(s, ref_m, ref_c, P, true_mu, true_w, np.random.default_rng(rep * 10 + int(s[1])), 5000 + rep)
            r['repeat'] = rep
            rows.append(r)
        print(f'{rep + 1}/{REPEATS} {time.time() - t0:.0f} s', flush=True)
        with open(OUT / 'a8_runs.csv', 'w', newline='', encoding='utf-8') as f:
            wr = csv.DictWriter(f, fieldnames=list(rows[0])); wr.writeheader(); wr.writerows(rows)
    lines = ['# А8 — итог сравнения стратегий на эталоне А9', '', f'Эталон: {json.dumps(info, ensure_ascii=False)}', '',
             f'N0 = {N0}, бюджет ≤ {BUDGET}, повторов {REPEATS}, α = {ALPHA}, ε = {EPS} K, шум повтора {NOISE_K} K', '',
             '## Недобор эффекта рекомендации (K), среднее / 90 % по повторам, при числе CFD',
             '| Стратегия | ' + ' | '.join(str(n) for n in LEVELS) + ' |', '|---|' + '---|' * len(LEVELS)]
    for s in ('S1', 'S2', 'S3'):
        rr = [r for r in rows if r['strategy'] == s]
        cells = []
        for n in LEVELS:
            reg = np.array([r[f'regret_{n}'] for r in rr]); bad = np.mean([r[f'bad_{n}'] for r in rr])
            cells.append(f'{reg.mean():.2f} / {np.quantile(reg, 0.9):.2f}' + (f' (недоп. {100 * bad:.0f} %)' if bad else ''))
        lines.append(f'| {s} | ' + ' | '.join(cells) + ' |')
    rr = [r for r in rows if r['strategy'] == 'S3']
    st = [r for r in rr if r['status'] == 'выдать']
    lines += ['', '## S3 — остановка по правилу ЛПР (α, ε, подтверждение CFD, устойчивость)',
              f"- «выдать»: {100 * len(st) / len(rr):.0f} % повторов; «вернуть»: {100 * np.mean([r['status'] == 'вернуть' for r in rr]):.0f} %; "
              f"не остановился до бюджета {BUDGET}: {100 * np.mean([r['status'] == 'досчитать' for r in rr]):.0f} %"]
    if st:
        reg = np.array([r['regret_K'] for r in st])
        lines.append(f"- при «выдать»: CFD {np.mean([r['n_cfd'] for r in st]):.1f} (мин {min(r['n_cfd'] for r in st)}, "
                     f"макс {max(r['n_cfd'] for r in st)}); недобор {reg.mean():.2f} K (90 % — {np.quantile(reg, 0.9):.2f}); "
                     f"доля с недобором < ε: {100 * np.mean(reg < EPS):.0f} %; недопустимый режим: "
                     f"{100 * np.mean([r['rec_not_working'] for r in st]):.0f} %")
    (OUT / 'a8_summary.md').write_text('\n'.join(lines) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
    print('\n'.join(lines))

"""17.10.2026 — А8 v3 по протоколу runs\\a8\\Протокол_А8_v3_20261017.md (записан до запуска).
Истина — быстрая физическая 1D-модель (A: калибрована по CFD, B: множители по умолчанию). 30 задач (27 диспетчера,
3 главного инженера), 10 повторов, стратегии S1, S2, S3, S4 с общим финальным выбором, Уилкоксон + Холм.
Запуск:  python a8_v3.py A            — основной (30 задач, α 10 %)
         python a8_v3.py A sens       — чувствительность α 5/20 % (задачи С2)
         python a8_v3.py B            — истина B (30 задач)
         python a8_v3.py report       — сводка и тесты по готовым прогонам"""
import os
os.environ.setdefault('OMP_NUM_THREADS', '1'); os.environ.setdefault('OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS', '1')
import csv, json, math, sys, time, warnings
from pathlib import Path
from multiprocessing import Pool
import numpy as np
from scipy.stats import norm, qmc, wilcoxon
from sklearn.gaussian_process import GaussianProcessRegressor
from sklearn.gaussian_process.kernels import Matern, ConstantKernel as Ck, WhiteKernel
warnings.filterwarnings('ignore')
sys.path.insert(0, r'F:\Leontiev_Project\dataset')
import fast1d as F

OUT = Path(r'F:\Leontiev_Project\runs\a8\v3')
CALIB = json.load(open(r'F:\Leontiev_Project\runs\fast1d\calib.json', encoding='utf-8'))['params']
N0, BUDGET, REPEATS, NOISE = 8, 24, 10, 0.05
LEVELS = (8, 12, 16, 20, 24)
EPS, STABLE_K = 0.5, 3
SCEN = {'С1': (0.6, -5.0), 'С2': (1.0, 5.0), 'С3': (1.4, 15.0)}
TD, LD = (1.2, 1.4, 1.6), (30.0, 60.0, 100.0)
LDP = (math.log(0.5), math.log(139.0))


def tasks():
    T = []
    k = 0
    for sc in SCEN:
        for td in TD:
            for ld in LD:
                T.append(dict(k=k, kind='диспетчер', scen=sc, td=td, ld=ld)); k += 1
    for sc in SCEN:
        T.append(dict(k=k, kind='инженер', scen=sc)); k += 1
    return T


def decode(t, u):
    """unit-cube decision -> fast1d inputs."""
    pc, t0 = SCEN[t['scen']]
    if t['kind'] == 'диспетчер':
        td, ld, a, b = t['td'], t['ld'], u[0], u[1]
    else:
        td, ld, a, b = 1.2 + 0.4 * u[0], 30 + 70 * u[1], u[2], u[3]
    return td, ld * 6.6, math.exp(LDP[0] + a * (LDP[1] - LDP[0])), pc, t0, 20.0 * b


def truth(t, which):
    f = OUT / f'truth_{which}_{t["k"]:02d}.npz'
    if f.exists():
        d = np.load(f)
        return d['U'], d['mu'], d['feas']
    d = 2 if t['kind'] == 'диспетчер' else 4
    U = qmc.LatinHypercube(d=d, seed=t['k']).random(400 if d == 2 else 1500)
    par = CALIB if which == 'A' else None
    mu, feas = [], []
    for u in U:
        o = F.run(*decode(t, u), par=par)
        mu.append(o['effect_K']); feas.append(bool(o['working']) and 0.2 <= o['m'] <= 1.0)
    mu, feas = np.array(mu), np.array(feas)
    np.savez(f, U=U, mu=mu, feas=feas)
    return U, mu, feas


def gpr(X, y):
    k = Ck(1.0) * Matern(length_scale=np.ones(X.shape[1]), length_scale_bounds=(0.05, 20), nu=2.5) + WhiteKernel(1e-3, (1e-6, 1e-1))
    return GaussianProcessRegressor(k, normalize_y=True, n_restarts_optimizer=1, random_state=0).fit(X, y)


def gpc(X, w):
    k = Ck(1.0) * Matern(length_scale=np.ones(X.shape[1]), length_scale_bounds=(0.05, 20), nu=2.5) + WhiteKernel(1e-2, (1e-4, 0.3))
    return GaussianProcessRegressor(k, normalize_y=False, n_restarts_optimizer=1, random_state=0).fit(X, 2.0 * w - 1.0)


def p_ok(c, U):
    m, s = c.predict(U, return_std=True)
    return norm.cdf(m / np.maximum(s, 1e-6))


def maximin(U, n, rng, tries=30):
    best, bd = None, -1
    for _ in range(tries):
        idx = rng.choice(len(U), n, replace=False)
        Z = U[idx]; d = np.sqrt(((Z[:, None] - Z[None]) ** 2).sum(-1)); d[np.diag_indices(n)] = 9
        if d.min() > bd:
            best, bd = idx, d.min()
    return list(best)


def recommend(m, c, U, alpha):
    mu = m.predict(U); pw = p_ok(c, U)
    ok = pw >= 1 - alpha
    return (int(np.argmax(np.where(ok, mu, -1e9))) if ok.any() else int(np.argmax(pw))), bool(ok.any())


def ei(mu, sd, best):
    s = np.maximum(sd, 1e-9); zz = (mu - best) / s
    return (mu - best) * norm.cdf(zz) + s * norm.pdf(zz)


def run_one(args):
    t, which, strat, rep, alpha = args
    U, mu_t, feas_t = truth(t, which)
    if not feas_t.any():
        return None
    best_true = float(mu_t[feas_t].max())
    rng = np.random.default_rng(1000 * t['k'] + rep)
    rng_obs = np.random.default_rng(10 ** 6 + 1000 * t['k'] + rep * 10 + int(strat[1]))
    ask = lambda i: (mu_t[i] + rng_obs.normal(0, NOISE), int(feas_t[i]))
    regret = lambda i: best_true - float(mu_t[i]) if feas_t[i] else best_true
    geo = (lambda i: U[i][:2]) if t['kind'] == 'инженер' else (lambda i: np.zeros(2))
    curve, stop = {}, None
    start = maximin(U, N0, np.random.default_rng(5000 + 1000 * t['k'] + rep))
    if strat == 'S1':
        for n in LEVELS:
            obs = {i: ask(i) for i in (start if n == N0 else maximin(U, n, rng))}
            Xo = U[list(obs)]; yo = np.array([v[0] for v in obs.values()]); wo = np.array([v[1] for v in obs.values()])
            rec, _ = recommend(gpr(Xo, yo), gpc(Xo, wo), U, alpha)
            curve[n] = (regret(rec), int(not feas_t[rec]))
    else:
        obs = {i: ask(i) for i in start}
        hist = []
        while True:
            Xo = U[list(obs)]; yo = np.array([v[0] for v in obs.values()]); wo = np.array([v[1] for v in obs.values()])
            m, c = gpr(Xo, yo), gpc(Xo, wo)
            rec, feasible = recommend(m, c, U, alpha)
            if len(obs) in LEVELS:
                curve[len(obs)] = (regret(rec), int(not feas_t[rec]))
            if len(obs) >= BUDGET:
                break
            mu, sd = m.predict(U, return_std=True); pw = p_ok(c, U)
            hist.append((geo(rec), float(mu[rec])))
            if strat == 'S2':
                sc = sd.copy()
            elif strat == 'S4':
                fo = [v[0] for v in obs.values() if v[1] == 1]
                sc = ei(mu, sd, max(fo)) * pw if fo else pw.copy()
            else:   # S3 (v2 rule)
                b = mu[rec]
                gain = ei(mu, sd, b) * pw
                bound = pw * (1 - pw) * 4 * np.maximum(mu - b + 2 * sd, 0)
                stable = len(hist) >= STABLE_K and max(np.abs(h[0] - hist[-1][0]).max() for h in hist[-STABLE_K:]) < 0.1 and \
                    max(h[1] for h in hist[-STABLE_K:]) - min(h[1] for h in hist[-STABLE_K:]) < EPS
                confirmed = rec in obs and obs[rec][1] == 1
                if stop is None and confirmed and stable and (1 - pw[rec]) < alpha and gain.max() < EPS and feasible:
                    stop = (len(obs), regret(rec), int(not feas_t[rec]))
                sc = np.maximum(gain, bound)
                if rec not in obs:
                    sc[rec] = sc.max() + 1
            sc[list(obs)] = -1
            nxt = int(np.argmax(sc))
            obs[nxt] = ask(nxt)
    row = dict(truth=which, task=t['k'], kind=t['kind'], scen=t['scen'], td=t.get('td', ''), ld=t.get('ld', ''), strat=strat,
               rep=rep, alpha=alpha, best_true=round(best_true, 4))
    for n in LEVELS:
        row[f'reg_{n}'] = round(curve[n][0], 4); row[f'bad_{n}'] = curve[n][1]
    row['stop_n'], row['stop_reg'], row['stop_bad'] = stop if stop else ('', '', '')
    return row


def runs(which, alpha_list, task_filter=None):
    OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    T = [t for t in tasks() if task_filter is None or task_filter(t)]
    for t in T:                    # truths first (sequential, cached)
        truth(t, which)
    jobs = [(t, which, s, r, a) for a in alpha_list for t in T for r in range(REPEATS) for s in ('S1', 'S2', 'S3', 'S4')]
    f = OUT / 'runs.csv'
    done = set()
    if f.exists():
        for r in csv.DictReader(open(f, encoding='utf-8')):
            done.add((r['truth'], int(r['task']), r['strat'], int(r['rep']), float(r['alpha'])))
    jobs = [j for j in jobs if (j[1], j[0]['k'], j[2], j[3], j[4]) not in done]
    t0 = time.time()
    with Pool(2) as pool:
        for i, row in enumerate(pool.imap_unordered(run_one, jobs)):
            if row is None:
                continue
            new = not f.exists()
            with open(f, 'a', newline='', encoding='utf-8') as fh:
                w = csv.DictWriter(fh, fieldnames=list(row))
                if new:
                    w.writeheader()
                w.writerow(row)
            if i % 20 == 0:
                print(f'{i + 1}/{len(jobs)} {time.time() - t0:.0f} s', flush=True)


def report():
    rows = list(csv.DictReader(open(OUT / 'runs.csv', encoding='utf-8')))
    out, tests = [f'# А8 v3 — итог по протоколу (Протокол_А8_v3_20261017.md), {time.strftime("%d.%m.%Y %H:%M")}', ''], {}
    for which in ('A', 'B'):
        for alpha in sorted({float(r['alpha']) for r in rows if r['truth'] == which}):
            R = [r for r in rows if r['truth'] == which and float(r['alpha']) == alpha]
            if not R:
                continue
            tk = sorted({int(r['task']) for r in R})
            out += [f'## Истина {which}, α = {alpha:.2f}: задач {len(tk)}, прогонов {len(R)}', '',
                    '| Стратегия | ' + ' | '.join(f'{n} CFD' for n in LEVELS) + ' | недопустимых, % | основной показатель (ср. промах 12–24), K |',
                    '|---|' + '---|' * (len(LEVELS) + 2)]
            prim = {}
            for s in ('S1', 'S2', 'S3', 'S4'):
                Rs = [r for r in R if r['strat'] == s]
                cells = []
                for n in LEVELS:
                    v = np.array([float(r[f'reg_{n}']) for r in Rs])
                    cells.append(f'{np.median(v):.3f} [{np.quantile(v, .25):.3f}–{np.quantile(v, .75):.3f}]')
                bad = 100 * np.mean([int(r[f'bad_{n}']) for r in Rs for n in LEVELS[1:]])
                prim[s] = {k: np.mean([np.mean([float(r[f'reg_{n}']) for n in LEVELS[1:]]) for r in Rs if int(r['task']) == k]) for k in tk}
                out.append(f'| {s} | ' + ' | '.join(cells) + f' | {bad:.1f} | {np.mean(list(prim[s].values())):.3f} |')
            ps = []
            for s in ('S1', 'S2', 'S4'):
                a = np.array([prim['S3'][k] for k in tk]); b = np.array([prim[s][k] for k in tk])
                p = float(wilcoxon(a, b).pvalue) if np.any(a != b) else 1.0
                ps.append((s, p, float(np.median(a - b))))
            order = sorted(ps, key=lambda x: x[1])
            holm, prev = {}, 0.0
            for i, (s, p, d) in enumerate(order):
                prev = max(prev, min(1.0, (3 - i) * p)); holm[s] = prev
            out += ['', 'Медиана ячейки — промах, K, [межквартильный размах]. Тест: Уилкоксон по задачам (основной показатель), поправка Холма:', '']
            for s, p, d in ps:
                out.append(f'- S3 против {s}: медиана разности {d:+.3f} K, p = {p:.4f}, p(Холм) = {holm[s]:.4f} → '
                           + ('значимо' if holm[s] < 0.05 else 'не значимо'))
            tests[f'{which}_{alpha}'] = {s: dict(p=p, p_holm=holm[s], median_diff=d) for s, p, d in ps}
            S3 = [r for r in R if r['strat'] == 'S3']
            st = [r for r in S3 if r['stop_n'] != '']
            if st:
                reg = np.array([float(r['stop_reg']) for r in st]); tol = np.array([0.02 * float(r['best_true']) for r in st])
                n_stop = np.array([int(r['stop_n']) for r in st])
                s4 = {(r['task'], r['rep']): r for r in R if r['strat'] == 'S4'}
                # S4 at the same budget: nearest level not below the stop
                s4reg = [float(s4[(r['task'], r['rep'])][f'reg_{min([n for n in LEVELS if n >= int(r["stop_n"])] or [24])}']) for r in st]
                out += ['', f'S3 «выдать»: {100 * len(st) / len(S3):.0f} % прогонов; расчётов до остановки — медиана {np.median(n_stop):.0f} '
                        f'(от {n_stop.min()} до {n_stop.max()}); промах при остановке — медиана {np.median(reg):.3f} K; '
                        f'ранняя остановка (промах > 2 % лучшего): {100 * np.mean(reg > tol):.0f} %; промах > ε: {100 * np.mean(reg > EPS):.0f} %; '
                        f'недопустимых при остановке: {100 * np.mean([int(r["stop_bad"]) for r in st]):.0f} %. '
                        f'S4 при том же бюджете (ближайший уровень ≥): медиана промаха {np.median(s4reg):.3f} K.', '']
    (OUT / 'summary.md').write_text('\n'.join(out) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
    (OUT / 'tests.json').write_text(json.dumps(tests, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1), encoding='utf-8')
    print('\n'.join(out))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    arg = sys.argv[1:]
    if arg[:1] == ['report']:
        report()
    elif arg[:2] == ['A', 'sens']:
        runs('A', (0.05, 0.20), lambda t: t['kind'] == 'диспетчер' and t['scen'] == 'С2')
    elif arg[:1] in (['A'], ['B']):
        runs(arg[0], (0.10,))
