"""27.10.2026 — закрыть запись журнала решений «Задача 2» (программа, П2 «досчитать»): прогноз до расчёта
(runs\\journal\\task2_forecast.json) → расчёт Fluent ST13/ST13c (runs\\station\\task2_results.csv) → разница → статус после
досчёта; станция по Fluent (те же 4 трубы, подогреватель после пучка, СПГ). Правит строки записи на месте (архив до правки)."""
import csv, json, shutil, sys, time
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0, r'F:\Leontiev_Project\dataset')
import grs_balance2 as B

R = Path(r'F:\Leontiev_Project\runs')
J = R / 'journal' / 'Журнал_решений.md'
fc = json.loads((R / 'journal' / 'task2_forecast.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
RR = {r['tag']: r for r in csv.DictReader(open(R / 'station' / 'task2_results.csv', encoding='utf-8'))}
tag = 'ST13c' if 'ST13c' in RR else 'ST13'
r = RR[tag]
conv = r['status'] != 'сбой'
shock = bool(r.get('x_shock_m'))
c = dict(effect_K=float(r['dT_svz_vs_throttle']), Q=float(r['Q']), G_svz=float(r['G_svz']), G_dzv=float(r['G_dzv']))
c['m'] = c['G_dzv'] / c['G_svz']
st = B.Station(p_main=4.0, T_main=0.0, flow_nm3h=5000, p_cons=0.6, T_min=-10.0)
B.tube = lambda bd, st_, heat: dict(c, working=not shock)
try:
    v = B.var_v(st, B.Bundle(td=1.6, L_mm=660, dp_kPa=5, n_on=4, heater_place='после', lng=True))
    stf = f"подогреватель {v['Q_heater_kW']:.1f} кВт, СПГ {v['lng_kgh']:.1f} кг/ч (4 трубы)"
except ValueError as e:
    stf = str(e)
d = fc['effect_K'] - c['effect_K']
in_omega = 0.2 <= c['m'] <= 0.96
if not conv:
    after = 'расчёт не сошёлся — запись не закрыта, выдавать нельзя'
elif shock:
    after = f"со скачком (x = {r['x_shock_m']} м) — «досчитать» оправдан, рекомендацию не выдавать; следующий по N вариант в Ω — заново через программу"
elif not in_omega:
    after = f"рабочий, но m = {c['m']:.3f} вне 0,2–0,96 — П1 «вернуть задачу»"
elif abs(d) <= 0.5:
    after = f"рабочий, промах {abs(d):.2f} K ≤ δ — после досчёта Δ1 «выдать» (ЛПР утверждает)"
else:
    after = f"рабочий, но промах {abs(d):.2f} K > δ — после переобучения задачу пересчитать"
row_calc = (f"| Проверочный расчёт Fluent и разница | подтверждён автором 27.10, выполнен ({tag}, t/d 1,6, L 660, 5 кПа, 4,0 МПа; "
            f"от A9_33c через 4,75 МПа): {r['status']}, {r['iter']} ит.; эффект {c['effect_K']:+.2f} K (прогноз {fc['effect_K']:+.2f} ± {fc['sigma_K']:.2f}, "
            f"разница {d:+.2f} K = {abs(d) / fc['sigma_K']:.1f} σ); Q {c['Q']:.0f} Вт ({100 * (fc['Q'] / c['Q'] - 1):+.1f} %); m {c['m']:.3f}; "
            f"станция по Fluent: {stf}. Итог: {after} |")
txt = J.read_text(encoding='utf-8')

seg = txt[head:end]

for i, l in enumerate(lines):
    if l.startswith('| Проверочный расчёт Fluent и разница |'):
        lines[i] = row_calc
    if l.startswith('| Решение ЛПР |'):
        lines[i] = '| Решение ЛПР | автор подтвердил предложенный расчёт Fluent (27.10); решение по конструкции — после досчёта |'

print(row_calc)

"""30.10.2026 — исполнитель очереди sppr.py --confirm (решение автора: команда ставит расчёт в очередь, а не запускает сразу).
Берёт из runs\\journal\\confirm_forecasts.json точки со статусом «в очереди» (прогноз уже записан ДО расчёта), считает их по одной
в одном окне Fluent: новая геометрия — перенос поля (run_a9.transfer) от ближайшего сошедшегося кейса той же L при режиме задачи;
посчитанная — продолжение (ступени магистрали 0,75 МПа). Результаты — runs\\station\\confirm_results.csv → идут в обучение
(model_compare читает confirm_*). Стоп: первые 2 расчёта не сошлись. После всех точек карточки: переобучение, повторное решение
задачи и запись в журнал решений «был … → посчитали → новый статус и лучший вариант»."""
import csv, io, contextlib, json, math, sys, time
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0, r'F:\Leontiev_Project\dataset')
sys.path.insert(0, r'F:\Leontiev_Project\program')
import run_a9 as A
import auto_enrich as AE   # сохраняет/возвращает пути run_a9 (30.10)
import run_station as S

FC = Path(r'F:\Leontiev_Project\runs\journal\confirm_forecasts.json')
CARDS = Path(r'F:\Leontiev_Project\program\cards')
A.BASE, A.CSV, A.AUX = S.OUT, S.OUT / 'confirm_results.csv', S.OUT / 'station_aux.csv'


def save(fc):
    FC.write_text(json.dumps(fc, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1), encoding='utf-8')


def result_row(tag):
    if not A.CSV.exists():
        return None
    return next((r for r in csv.DictReader(open(A.CSV, encoding='utf-8')) if r['tag'] == tag), None)


def run_point(tag, j, prev):
    reg = (j['pm'], j['pc'], j['pm'], round(j['pm'] - j['dp'] / 1000, 6))
    ts, td_ = j['T'] + j['heat'], j['T']
    if prev:   # та же геометрия уже посчитана в этой серии — продолжение от неё
        return A.cont(prev / 'result.cas.h5', tag, reg, [], ts, td_, f'{tag}: от {prev.name} (sppr --confirm)', A.CSV, l_mm=j['L'])
    src = [(p, x) for p, x in AE.sources() if abs(x[1] * 6.6 - j['L']) < 0.5]
    same = [(p, x) for p, x in src if abs(x[0] - j['td']) < 1e-6]
    pool = same or src
    key = lambda t: (abs(t[1][0] - j['td']) * 10 + abs(t[1][6] - j['pm']) + abs(math.log(math.exp(t[1][2]) / j['dp']))
                     + abs(t[1][4] - j['T']) / 10 + abs(t[1][3] - j['pc']) + t[1][5] / 10)
    sp, sx = min(pool, key=key)
    A.log(f"=== {tag}: старт от {sp.name} (t/d {sx[0]}, магистраль {sx[6]} МПа, перепад {math.exp(sx[2]):.1f} кПа)")
    if same:
        cur, p0, k = Path(sp), sx[6], 0
        while abs(j['pm'] - p0) > 0.8:
            k += 1; p0 = round(p0 + (0.75 if j['pm'] > p0 else -0.75), 2)
            cur = A.cont(cur / 'result.cas.h5', f'{tag}_r{k}', (p0, j['pc'], p0, round(p0 - j['dp'] / 1000, 6)), [], ts, td_,
                         f'{tag}: ступень магистрали {p0}', A.AUX, limit=1500, l_mm=j['L']) or cur
        return A.cont(cur / 'result.cas.h5', tag, reg, [], ts, td_, f'{tag}: от {cur.name} (sppr --confirm)', A.CSV, l_mm=j['L'])
    pt = dict(id=tag, t_d=j['td'], L_mm=j['L'], p_cons=j['pc'], dp_dzv_kPa=j['dp'], t0_svz=ts, t0_dzv=td_,
              m_target=max(min(j.get('m', 0.8), 1.0), 0.2), heater=j['heat'])
    return A.transfer(sp, pt, reg)   # новая t/d при той же L: шаблон + перенос поля


def finish(card_name, tags, fc):
    for mod in ('station_gp', 'classifier_final', 'classifier_variants', 'heldout_check', 'model_compare', 'sppr'):
        sys.modules.pop(mod, None)
    import sppr
    with contextlib.redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()):
        M = sppr.Models()
        d = sppr.main(CARDS / card_name, False, M=M)
    prev = fc[tags[0]]['prev']
    L = ['', f'## Продолжение задачи (карточка {card_name}): после расчёта очереди --confirm ({time.strftime("%d.%m.%Y %H:%M")})', '',
         '| Поле | Значение |', '|---|---|',
         f"| Было | **{prev['rule']} → {prev['status']}** ({prev['cat']}); лучший: {prev['best']}" + (f", {prev['N']:.1f} кВт" if prev['N'] is not None else '') + ' |']
    for t in tags:
        v = fc[t]
        r = result_row(v.get('result_tag') or t)
        j = v['job']
        if r and v['status'] == 'сошёлся':
            e = float(r['dT_svz_vs_throttle'])
            L.append(f"| {t}: t/d {j['td']}, L {j['L']:.0f}, перепад {j['dp']} кПа | прогноз {v['effect_K']:+.2f} ± {v['sigma_K']:.2f} K → Fluent {r['status']}, "
                     f"{e:+.2f} K; разница {v['effect_K'] - e:+.2f} K ({abs(v['effect_K'] - e) / max(v['sigma_K'], 1e-6):.1f} σ) |")
        else:
            L.append(f"| {t}: t/d {j['td']}, L {j['L']:.0f}, перепад {j['dp']} кПа | прогноз {v['effect_K']:+.2f} ± {v['sigma_K']:.2f} K → Fluent: {v['status']} |")
    b = d.get('best')
    L += [f"| Переобучение | {M.n_train} точек (было {fc[tags[0]]['n_train']}) |",
          f"| Стало | **{d['rule']} → {d['status']}** ({d.get('cat')}): {d['why']} |",
          '| Новый лучший вариант | ' + (f"{sppr.fmt(b)}; подогреватель {b['N']:.1f} кВт; СПГ {b['lng']:.1f} кг/ч" if b else '—') + ' |',
          '| Решение ЛПР | ожидает (утверждено / отклонено) |']
    with open(sppr.JOURNAL, 'a', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        f.write('\n'.join(L) + '\n')
    A.qlog(f'=== --confirm {card_name}: задача решена заново — {d["rule"]} {d.get("cat")}')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    fc = json.loads(FC.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
    todo = [t for t, v in fc.items() if v.get('status') == 'в очереди']
    A.qlog(f'=== очередь --confirm: {len(todo)} точек ({", ".join(todo)})')
    by_card = {}
    for t in todo:
        by_card.setdefault(fc[t]['card'], []).append(t)
    for card_name, tags in by_card.items():
        n_calc = n_fail = 0
        prev_geo = {}
        for t in tags:
            v = fc[t]
            j = dict(v['job'], m=v['m'])
            A.log(f"=== {t} ({card_name}): {j['why']}; t/d {j['td']}, L {j['L']:.0f}, перепад {j['dp']} кПа, магистраль {j['pm']} МПа; "
                  f"ПРОГНОЗ ДО расчёта {v['effect_K']:+.2f} ± {v['sigma_K']:.2f} K, m {v['m']:.3f}, p {v['p']:.3f}")
            g = (j['td'], j['L'])
            try:
                d = run_point(t, j, prev_geo.get(g))
            except Exception as ex:
                A.log(f'  {t}: ОШИБКА программы {ex!r}'); d = None
            ok = bool(d) and A.converged(d)
            n_calc += 1; n_fail += not ok
            fc = json.loads(FC.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
            fc[t]['status'] = 'сошёлся' if ok else 'не сошёлся'
            if d:
                fc[t]['result_tag'] = d.name
                if d.name != t:   # половинный псевдошаг (…h): x для обучения под фактическим тегом
                    fc[d.name] = dict(x=fc[t]['x'], alias_of=t)
            save(fc)
            if ok:
                prev_geo[g] = d
            if n_calc == 2 and n_fail == 2:
                A.qlog(f'=== --confirm {card_name}: первые 2 расчёта не сошлись — СТОП, нужно решение автора')
                for t2 in tags[2:]:
                    fc[t2]['status'] = 'снят (стоп-правило)'
                save(fc)
                break
        finish(card_name, tags, json.loads(FC.read_text(encoding='utf-8')))
    A.qlog('=== очередь --confirm — закончена')

FILE: dataset/cont_util.py

"""Shared helpers for continuation runs and result rows (08.10.2026).
continue_case: read a converged case, apply extra lines (gas, properties, T0), set the regime pressures, coupled with
auto-stop (up to LIMIT iterations), export axis, close Fluent.  record: one row with BOTH Fluent total temperatures
(dT_svz_total / dT_dzv_total, author 08.10) and, for methane, the enthalpy-based outlet temperatures of the gas at rest
plus the throttle reference (grs_temps.py)."""
import csv, subprocess, time
from pathlib import Path
import leontiev_pipeline as L
import gui_runner as G
import gui_convergence as C
from make_gui_prt_journal import GUI_PRT
import grs_temps

LIMIT = 5500
GUARD_ENERGY_W = None   # 11.10: if set, a stage is failed when the energy imbalance exceeds it (after 1500 it.)
GUARD_FRAC = None       # 29.10: if set, the guard is GUARD_FRAC * |Q of the tube| (W) instead of GUARD_ENERGY_W
STALL_MIN = 20  # 11.10: watchdog, minutes without a new iteration -> kill (G.status 'iter')
NPROC = 6    # 27.10: new PC (Ryzen 7 7700, 8 cores): 500-it test 6/7/8/10/12 -> 0.125/0.127/0.126/0.136/0.140 s/it (runs\speed_pc2_500); was 7 on the laptop
CFL = 20.0   # 09.10: module-level so a series can lower it (fine DZV layers were unstable at CFL 20 after the startup)
PARALLEL = False  # 27.10: several Fluent windows at once — no wait for a free Fluent, kill only this window's process tree
# 30.10: 3D-пучок (bundle3d_run.py) — решатель, предел времени, свои строки экспорта (последний файл — axis.csv: по нему
# continue_case понимает, что Fluent закончил) и правка строк журнала; по умолчанию — как для 2D
SOLVER_DIM = '2ddp'
TIME_LIMIT_H = 4
END_EXPORT = None
JOU_HOOK = None


def _kill(t0, proc):
    if PARALLEL:
        subprocess.run(['taskkill', '/PID', str(proc.pid), '/T', '/F'], capture_output=True, creationflags=subprocess.CREATE_NO_WINDOW)
    else:
        G.kill_since(t0)
COLS = ['tag', 'mesh', 'gas', 'p0_svz', 'p_out_svz', 'p0_dzv', 'p_out_dzv', 'T0_C', 'start', 'status', 'reason', 'converged',
        'iter', 'dT_svz_total', 'dT_dzv_total', 'Q', 'G_svz', 'G_dzv', 'ratio', 'net_W', 'dm_svz_pct', 'dm_dzv_pct',
        'dT_svz_h', 'dT_dzv_h', 'dT_svz_throttle', 'dT_dzv_throttle', 'dT_svz_vs_throttle', 'dT_dzv_vs_throttle',
        'yp_svz', 'M_mean_channel', 'M_outlet', 'x_shock_m', 'reversed_max_pct', 'minutes',
        'T0_dzv_C', 'G_dzv_target', 'G_dzv_miss_pct', 'cond_margin_K']   # 09.10


def t0_line(t0_C):
    return f'/define/boundary-conditions/set/pressure-inlet inlet_svz inlet_dzv () t0 no {t0_C:g} q'


def t0_lines(t0_svz_C, t0_dzv_C):
    """09.10.2026: separate inlet temperatures (heater on the SVZ line only, author's decision 0...+20 K)."""
    return [f'/define/boundary-conditions/set/pressure-inlet inlet_svz () t0 no {t0_svz_C:g} q',
            f'/define/boundary-conditions/set/pressure-inlet inlet_dzv () t0 no {t0_dzv_C:g} q']


def tmf_lines(g_kg_s, p_min_MPa, p_max_MPa):
    """09.10.2026: targeted mass flow at the DZV outlet.  Limits are ABSOLUTE pressures in the case units (atm, operating
    pressure 0).  Dataset rule (review): p_min >= consumer pressure + return-line losses, p_max just below p0_DZV.
    The achieved flow is checked afterwards (record: G_dzv vs target), an unreachable flow is a physical status."""
    atm = 0.101325
    return [f'/define/boundary-conditions/set/pressure-outlet outlet_dzv () targeted-mf-boundary? yes targeted-mf no {g_kg_s:g} '
            f'targeted-mf-pmin no {p_min_MPa / atm:.5f} targeted-mf-pmax no {p_max_MPa / atm:.5f} q']


def cond_margin(axis_csv):
    """09.10.2026: condensation flag for methane — min over the axis of (static T - T_sat(p)) where p < p_crit (K).
    Negative = the core flow is below the saturation line (the PR model does not represent condensation; real natural
    gas with heavier components condenses earlier)."""
    import CoolProp.CoolProp as CP
    pc = CP.PropsSI('Pcrit', 'Methane')
    best = None
    for r in csv.DictReader(open(axis_csv)):
        r = {k.strip(): v for k, v in r.items()}
        p, T = float(r['pressure']), float(r['temperature'])
        if 1e4 < p < pc:
            d = T - CP.PropsSI('T', 'P', p, 'Q', 1, 'Methane')
            best = d if best is None or d < best else best
    return None if best is None else round(best, 2)


def continue_case(src_case, out, extra, regime, log, tag, t0_C=None, wall_k=None, t0_dzv_C=None):
    """regime = (p0_svz, p_out_svz, p0_dzv, p_out_dzv) MPa.  Returns minutes or None on failure.
    wall_k: set the wall conductivity explicitly (a continued case keeps the value of its source case).
    t0_dzv_C: separate DZV inlet temperature (09.10); t0_C is then the SVZ inlet temperature."""
    if wall_k:
        extra = list(extra) + [L.wall_k_line(float(wall_k))]
    out = Path(out); out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    for f in list(out.glob('*.trn')) + list(out.glob('axis.csv')):
        f.unlink()
    q = L.fl(out)
    p0s, pos, p0d, pod = regime
    target = {'inlet_svz': p0s * 1e6, 'outlet_svz': pos * 1e6, 'pressure_inlet_dzv': p0d * 1e6, 'outlet_dzv': pod * 1e6}
    lines = ['/file/confirm-overwrite? no', f'/file/start-transcript "{q}/run.trn"', f'/file/read-case-data "{L.fl(src_case)}"']
    lines += [g.format(prt=0.85) for g in GUI_PRT] + list(extra) + G.bc_lines(target)
    if t0_dzv_C is not None:
        lines += t0_lines(25.0 if t0_C is None else t0_C, t0_dzv_C)
    elif t0_C is not None:
        lines.append(t0_line(t0_C))
    lines += C.coupled_journal(dict(coupled_iters=LIMIT, report_every=500, cfl=CFL), out)
    lines += [f'/file/write-case-data "{q}/result.cas.h5"']
    lines += ([s.format(q=q) for s in END_EXPORT] if END_EXPORT else
              [f'/file/export/ascii "{q}/axis.csv" axis () yes mach-number pressure total-pressure temperature '
               'total-temperature axial-velocity () yes'])
    lines += ['/file/stop-transcript']
    if JOU_HOOK:
        lines = JOU_HOOK(lines)
    (out / 'cont.jou').write_text('\n'.join(lines) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
    log(f'=== {tag}: продолжение с {Path(src_case).parent.name}; режим СВЗ {p0s}->{pos}, ДЗВ {p0d}->{pod} МПа'
        + (f', T0 {t0_C:g} °C' if t0_C is not None else ''))
    while not PARALLEL and G.fluent_running():
        time.sleep(60)
    t0 = time.time()
    proc = subprocess.Popen([L.FLUENT, SOLVER_DIM, f'-t{NPROC}', '-i', str(out / 'cont.jou')], cwd=str(out), stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,
                     stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL, close_fds=True)
    first, said = None, False
    last_it, t_it = None, time.time()
    prev_ce, cur_ce, last_ce_it = None, None, None
    while not (out / 'axis.csv').exists():
        rows = C.closed_samples(out)
        if rows and first is None:
            first = rows[0]['iteration'] - 500
        c = C.update_control(out, True, max_iter=first + LIMIT if first is not None else None)
        if c['stop_requested'] and not said:
            log('  критерии сходимости выполнены в двух проверках подряд — Fluent сохранит кейс'); said = True
        # 11.10 22:15: guard against a slow blow-up at a large CFL (cell a at CFL 100: energy imbalance 2 -> 4530 W)
        ce = (c.get('checks') or {}).get('energy_W')
        # 13.10 15:10: only a GROWING imbalance is a blow-up (knurl h 0.5 after the field transfer: 602 -> 471 -> 363 W,
        # a decaying start transient, was killed by the absolute rule)
        if ce and c['checked_iteration'] != last_ce_it:
            prev_ce, last_ce_it, cur_ce = cur_ce, c['checked_iteration'], ce['value']
        # 29.10 (решение автора): порог страховки — доля теплового потока трубы Q (GUARD_FRAC), а не абсолютные Вт: у новой
        # геометрии (RU 2836642) дисбаланс колебался ±200…430 Вт при стабильных выходах (Q ≈ 1080 Вт) и снимался правилом 300 Вт
        guard = GUARD_ENERGY_W
        if GUARD_FRAC and rows and rows[-1].get('Q'):
            guard = GUARD_FRAC * abs(rows[-1]['Q'])
        if (guard and ce and first is not None and c['checked_iteration'] - first >= 1500 and ce['value'] > guard
                and prev_ce is not None and cur_ce > prev_ce):
            _kill(t0, proc); log(f'  {tag}: СБОЙ (дисбаланс энергии {ce["value"]:.0f} Вт > {guard:.0f} Вт — неустойчиво при CFL {CFL:g})')
            return None
        st = G.status(out)
        if st and (st['fpe'] or st['error']):
            _kill(t0, proc); log(f'  {tag}: СБОЙ (расходимость или ошибка журнала) на итерации {st["iter"]}'); return None
        if time.time() - t0 > TIME_LIMIT_H * 3600:
            _kill(t0, proc); log(f'  {tag}: СБОЙ (время)'); return None
        # 11.10: watchdog — 10.10 Fluent hung twice (iteration not finishing, CPU busy, Stop ignored)
        it = st['iter'] if st else None
        if it != last_it:
            last_it, t_it = it, time.time()
        elif it is not None and time.time() - t_it > STALL_MIN * 60:
            _kill(t0, proc); log(f'  {tag}: СБОЙ (зависание: итерация {it} не меняется {STALL_MIN} мин)'); return None
        time.sleep(10)
    time.sleep(10)
    _kill(t0, proc)
    return round((time.time() - t0) / 60, 1)


def record(csv_path, tag, mesh, gas, regime, out, minutes, log, start='', t0_C=25.0, l_heat_mm=400.0, t0_dzv_C=None,
           g_dzv_target=None):
    """t0_C = SVZ inlet temperature; t0_dzv_C = DZV inlet temperature (09.10; default = t0_C).  g_dzv_target: targeted DZV
    flow — the achieved flow is checked (|G - target| > 1 % -> reason gets 'расход ДЗВ не достигнут')."""
    out = Path(out)
    p0s, pos, p0d, pod = regime
    t0d = t0_C if t0_dzv_C is None else t0_dzv_C
    row = dict(tag=tag, mesh=mesh, gas=gas, p0_svz=p0s, p_out_svz=pos, p0_dzv=p0d, p_out_dzv=pod, T0_C=t0_C, start=start,
               minutes=minutes, T0_dzv_C=t0d, G_dzv_target=g_dzv_target)
    st = G.status(out) if out.exists() else None
    if st and st['samples'] and (out / 'axis.csv').exists():
        b = st['samples'][-1]; cl = C.closed_samples(out)
        conv = G.converged(out)
        status_, reason, info = G.classify(out, dict(l_heat_mm=l_heat_mm), conv)
        row.update(status=status_, reason=reason, converged=conv, iter=st['iter'], dT_svz_total=round(b['dT_svz'] + 25 - t0_C, 3),
                   dT_dzv_total=round(b['dT_dzv'] + 25 - t0d, 3), Q=round(b['Q'], 1), ratio=round(b['ratio'], 4),
                   yp_svz=round(b['yp_svz'], 3), **{k: info.get(k) for k in ('M_mean_channel', 'M_outlet', 'x_shock_m', 'reversed_max_pct')})
        if cl:
            row.update(G_svz=round(cl[-1]['m_svz'], 6), G_dzv=round(cl[-1]['m_dzv'], 6), net_W=round(cl[-1]['net'], 3),
                       dm_svz_pct=round(cl[-1]['dm'], 4), dm_dzv_pct=round(cl[-1]['dm_dzv'], 4))
            if g_dzv_target:
                miss = abs(cl[-1]['m_dzv'] - g_dzv_target) / g_dzv_target * 100
                row['G_dzv_miss_pct'] = round(miss, 2)
                if miss > 1.0:
                    row['reason'] = f"{row['reason']}; расход ДЗВ не достигнут ({miss:.1f} %)"
            if gas.startswith('ch4'):
                row.update(grs_temps.outlet_temps(b['Q'], cl[-1]['m_svz'], cl[-1]['m_dzv'], 273.15 + t0_C, p0s, pos, pod, p0d,
                                                  T0_dzv_K=273.15 + t0d))
                try:
                    row['cond_margin_K'] = cond_margin(out / 'axis.csv')
                except Exception:
                    pass
        log(f"{tag}: {status_} ({reason}); полная T: СВЗ {row['dT_svz_total']:+.3f} K, ДЗВ {row['dT_dzv_total']:+.3f} K; "
            f"Q {row['Q']:.1f} Вт; G {row.get('G_svz')}/{row.get('G_dzv')} кг/с"
            + (f"; по энтальпии: СВЗ {row['dT_svz_h']:+.2f} K (дроссель {row['dT_svz_throttle']:+.2f}, эффект {row['dT_svz_vs_throttle']:+.2f}), "
               f"ДЗВ {row['dT_dzv_h']:+.2f} K" if 'dT_svz_h' in row else ''))
    else:
        row.update(status='сбой', reason='нет результата')
        log(f'{tag}: нет результата (сбой)')
    new = not Path(csv_path).exists()
    # 09.10: new columns are appended; an older file keeps its own header (no column shift)
    cols = COLS if new else (next(csv.reader(open(csv_path, encoding='utf-8')), None) or COLS)
    with open(csv_path, 'a', newline='', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        w = csv.DictWriter(f, fieldnames=cols, extrasaction='ignore')
        if new:
            w.writeheader()
        w.writerow(row)
    return row

"""Shared helpers for continuation runs and result rows (08.10.2026).
continue_case: read a converged case, apply extra lines (gas, properties, T0), set the regime pressures, coupled with
auto-stop (up to LIMIT iterations), export axis, close Fluent.  record: one row with BOTH Fluent total temperatures
(dT_svz_total / dT_dzv_total, author 08.10) and, for methane, the enthalpy-based outlet temperatures of the gas at rest
plus the throttle reference (grs_temps.py)."""
import csv, subprocess, time
from pathlib import Path
import leontiev_pipeline as L
import gui_runner as G
import gui_convergence as C
from make_gui_prt_journal import GUI_PRT
import grs_temps

LIMIT = 5500
COLS = ['tag', 'mesh', 'gas', 'p0_svz', 'p_out_svz', 'p0_dzv', 'p_out_dzv', 'T0_C', 'start', 'status', 'reason', 'converged',
        'iter', 'dT_svz_total', 'dT_dzv_total', 'Q', 'G_svz', 'G_dzv', 'ratio', 'net_W', 'dm_svz_pct', 'dm_dzv_pct',
        'dT_svz_h', 'dT_dzv_h', 'dT_svz_throttle', 'dT_dzv_throttle', 'dT_svz_vs_throttle', 'dT_dzv_vs_throttle',
        'yp_svz', 'M_mean_channel', 'M_outlet', 'x_shock_m', 'reversed_max_pct', 'minutes']


def t0_line(t0_C):
    return f'/define/boundary-conditions/set/pressure-inlet inlet_svz inlet_dzv () t0 no {t0_C:g} q'


def continue_case(src_case, out, extra, regime, log, tag, t0_C=None, wall_k=None):
    """regime = (p0_svz, p_out_svz, p0_dzv, p_out_dzv) MPa.  Returns minutes or None on failure.
    wall_k: set the wall conductivity explicitly (a continued case keeps the value of its source case)."""
    if wall_k:
        extra = list(extra) + [L.wall_k_line(float(wall_k))]
    out = Path(out); out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    for f in list(out.glob('*.trn')) + list(out.glob('axis.csv')):
        f.unlink()
    q = L.fl(out)
    p0s, pos, p0d, pod = regime
    target = {'inlet_svz': p0s * 1e6, 'outlet_svz': pos * 1e6, 'pressure_inlet_dzv': p0d * 1e6, 'outlet_dzv': pod * 1e6}
    lines = ['/file/confirm-overwrite? no', f'/file/start-transcript "{q}/run.trn"', f'/file/read-case-data "{L.fl(src_case)}"']
    lines += [g.format(prt=0.85) for g in GUI_PRT] + list(extra) + G.bc_lines(target)
    if t0_C is not None:
        lines.append(t0_line(t0_C))
    lines += C.coupled_journal(dict(coupled_iters=LIMIT, report_every=500, cfl=20.0), out)
    lines += [f'/file/write-case-data "{q}/result.cas.h5"',
              f'/file/export/ascii "{q}/axis.csv" axis () yes mach-number pressure total-pressure temperature '
              'total-temperature axial-velocity () yes', '/file/stop-transcript']
    (out / 'cont.jou').write_text('\n'.join(lines) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
    log(f'=== {tag}: продолжение с {Path(src_case).parent.name}; режим СВЗ {p0s}->{pos}, ДЗВ {p0d}->{pod} МПа'
        + (f', T0 {t0_C:g} °C' if t0_C is not None else ''))
    while G.fluent_running():
        time.sleep(60)
    t0 = time.time()
    subprocess.Popen([L.FLUENT, '2ddp', '-t7', '-i', str(out / 'cont.jou')], cwd=str(out), stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,
                     stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL, close_fds=True)
    first, said = None, False
    while not (out / 'axis.csv').exists():
        rows = C.closed_samples(out)
        if rows and first is None:
            first = rows[0]['iteration'] - 500
        c = C.update_control(out, True, max_iter=first + LIMIT if first is not None else None)
        if c['stop_requested'] and not said:
            log('  критерии сходимости выполнены в двух проверках подряд — Fluent сохранит кейс'); said = True
        st = G.status(out)
        if st and (st['fpe'] or st['error']):
            G.kill_since(t0); log(f'  {tag}: СБОЙ (расходимость или ошибка журнала) на итерации {st["iter"]}'); return None
        if time.time() - t0 > 4 * 3600:
            G.kill_since(t0); log(f'  {tag}: СБОЙ (время)'); return None
        time.sleep(10)
    time.sleep(10)
    G.kill_since(t0)
    return round((time.time() - t0) / 60, 1)


def record(csv_path, tag, mesh, gas, regime, out, minutes, log, start='', t0_C=25.0, l_heat_mm=400.0):

               minutes=minutes)

                   dT_dzv_total=round(b['dT_dzv'] + 25 - t0_C, 3), Q=round(b['Q'], 1), ratio=round(b['ratio'], 4),
                   yp_svz=round(b['yp_svz'], 3), **{k: info.get(k) for k in ('M_mean_channel', 'M_outlet', 'x_shock_m', 'reversed_max_pct')})
        if cl:
            row.update(G_svz=round(cl[-1]['m_svz'], 6), G_dzv=round(cl[-1]['m_dzv'], 6), net_W=round(cl[-1]['net'], 3),
                       dm_svz_pct=round(cl[-1]['dm'], 4), dm_dzv_pct=round(cl[-1]['dm_dzv'], 4))
            if gas.startswith('ch4'):
                row.update(grs_temps.outlet_temps(b['Q'], cl[-1]['m_svz'], cl[-1]['m_dzv'], 273.15 + t0_C, p0s, pos, pod, p0d))
        log(f"{tag}: {status_} ({reason}); полная T: СВЗ {row['dT_svz_total']:+.3f} K, ДЗВ {row['dT_dzv_total']:+.3f} K; "
            f"Q {row['Q']:.1f} Вт; G {row.get('G_svz')}/{row.get('G_dzv')} кг/с"
            + (f"; по энтальпии: СВЗ {row['dT_svz_h']:+.2f} K (дроссель {row['dT_svz_throttle']:+.2f}, эффект {row['dT_svz_vs_throttle']:+.2f}), "
               f"ДЗВ {row['dT_dzv_h']:+.2f} K" if 'dT_svz_h' in row else ''))
    else:
        row.update(status='сбой', reason='нет результата')
        log(f'{tag}: нет результата (сбой)')
    new = not Path(csv_path).exists()
    with open(csv_path, 'a', newline='', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        w = csv.DictWriter(f, fieldnames=COLS, extrasaction='ignore')
        if new:
            w.writeheader()

    return row

"""Shared helpers for continuation runs and result rows (08.10.2026).
continue_case: read a converged case, apply extra lines (gas, properties, T0), set the regime pressures, coupled with
auto-stop (up to LIMIT iterations), export axis, close Fluent.  record: one row with BOTH Fluent total temperatures

from make_gui_prt_journal import GUI_PRT
import grs_temps

LIMIT = 5500
CFL = 20.0   # 09.10: module-level so a series can lower it (fine DZV layers were unstable at CFL 20 after the startup)
COLS = ['tag', 'mesh', 'gas', 'p0_svz', 'p_out_svz', 'p0_dzv', 'p_out_dzv', 'T0_C', 'start', 'status', 'reason', 'converged',
        'iter', 'dT_svz_total', 'dT_dzv_total', 'Q', 'G_svz', 'G_dzv', 'ratio', 'net_W', 'dm_svz_pct', 'dm_dzv_pct',

    pressure 0).  Dataset rule (review): p_min >= consumer pressure + return-line losses, p_max just below p0_DZV.
    The achieved flow is checked afterwards (record: G_dzv vs target), an unreachable flow is a physical status."""

    return [f'/define/boundary-conditions/set/pressure-outlet outlet_dzv () targeted-mf-boundary? yes targeted-mf no {g_kg_s:g} '
            f'targeted-mf-pmin no {p_min_MPa / atm:.5f} targeted-mf-pmax no {p_max_MPa / atm:.5f} q']


def cond_margin(axis_csv):
    """09.10.2026: condensation flag for methane — min over the axis of (static T - T_sat(p)) where p < p_crit (K).
    Negative = the core flow is below the saturation line (the PR model does not represent condensation; real natural
    gas with heavier components condenses earlier)."""
    import CoolProp.CoolProp as CP
    pc = CP.PropsSI('Pcrit', 'Methane')
    best = None
    for r in csv.DictReader(open(axis_csv)):
        r = {k.strip(): v for k, v in r.items()}
        p, T = float(r['pressure']), float(r['temperature'])
        if 1e4 < p < pc:
            d = T - CP.PropsSI('T', 'P', p, 'Q', 1, 'Methane')
            best = d if best is None or d < best else best
    return None if best is None else round(best, 2)


def continue_case(src_case, out, extra, regime, log, tag, t0_C=None, wall_k=None, t0_dzv_C=None):
    """regime = (p0_svz, p_out_svz, p0_dzv, p_out_dzv) MPa.  Returns minutes or None on failure.
    wall_k: set the wall conductivity explicitly (a continued case keeps the value of its source case).
    t0_dzv_C: separate DZV inlet temperature (09.10); t0_C is then the SVZ inlet temperature."""
    if wall_k:
        extra = list(extra) + [L.wall_k_line(float(wall_k))]
    out = Path(out); out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    for f in list(out.glob('*.trn')) + list(out.glob('axis.csv')):
        f.unlink()
    q = L.fl(out)
    p0s, pos, p0d, pod = regime
    target = {'inlet_svz': p0s * 1e6, 'outlet_svz': pos * 1e6, 'pressure_inlet_dzv': p0d * 1e6, 'outlet_dzv': pod * 1e6}
    lines = ['/file/confirm-overwrite? no', f'/file/start-transcript "{q}/run.trn"', f'/file/read-case-data "{L.fl(src_case)}"']
    lines += [g.format(prt=0.85) for g in GUI_PRT] + list(extra) + G.bc_lines(target)
    if t0_dzv_C is not None:
        lines += t0_lines(25.0 if t0_C is None else t0_C, t0_dzv_C)
    elif t0_C is not None:
        lines.append(t0_line(t0_C))
    lines += C.coupled_journal(dict(coupled_iters=LIMIT, report_every=500, cfl=CFL), out)
    lines += [f'/file/write-case-data "{q}/result.cas.h5"',
              f'/file/export/ascii "{q}/axis.csv" axis () yes mach-number pressure total-pressure temperature '
              'total-temperature axial-velocity () yes', '/file/stop-transcript']
    (out / 'cont.jou').write_text('\n'.join(lines) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
    log(f'=== {tag}: продолжение с {Path(src_case).parent.name}; режим СВЗ {p0s}->{pos}, ДЗВ {p0d}->{pod} МПа'
        + (f', T0 {t0_C:g} °C' if t0_C is not None else ''))
    while G.fluent_running():
        time.sleep(60)
    t0 = time.time()
    subprocess.Popen([L.FLUENT, '2ddp', '-t7', '-i', str(out / 'cont.jou')], cwd=str(out), stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,
                     stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL, close_fds=True)
    first, said = None, False
    while not (out / 'axis.csv').exists():
        rows = C.closed_samples(out)
        if rows and first is None:
            first = rows[0]['iteration'] - 500
        c = C.update_control(out, True, max_iter=first + LIMIT if first is not None else None)
        if c['stop_requested'] and not said:
            log('  критерии сходимости выполнены в двух проверках подряд — Fluent сохранит кейс'); said = True
        st = G.status(out)
        if st and (st['fpe'] or st['error']):
            G.kill_since(t0); log(f'  {tag}: СБОЙ (расходимость или ошибка журнала) на итерации {st["iter"]}'); return None
        if time.time() - t0 > 4 * 3600:
            G.kill_since(t0); log(f'  {tag}: СБОЙ (время)'); return None
        time.sleep(10)
    time.sleep(10)
    G.kill_since(t0)
    return round((time.time() - t0) / 60, 1)


def record(csv_path, tag, mesh, gas, regime, out, minutes, log, start='', t0_C=25.0, l_heat_mm=400.0, t0_dzv_C=None,
           g_dzv_target=None):
    """t0_C = SVZ inlet temperature; t0_dzv_C = DZV inlet temperature (09.10; default = t0_C).  g_dzv_target: targeted DZV
    flow — the achieved flow is checked (|G - target| > 1 % -> reason gets 'расход ДЗВ не достигнут')."""
    out = Path(out)
    p0s, pos, p0d, pod = regime
    t0d = t0_C if t0_dzv_C is None else t0_dzv_C
    row = dict(tag=tag, mesh=mesh, gas=gas, p0_svz=p0s, p_out_svz=pos, p0_dzv=p0d, p_out_dzv=pod, T0_C=t0_C, start=start,
               minutes=minutes, T0_dzv_C=t0d, G_dzv_target=g_dzv_target)
    st = G.status(out) if out.exists() else None
    if st and st['samples'] and (out / 'axis.csv').exists():
        b = st['samples'][-1]; cl = C.closed_samples(out)
        conv = G.converged(out)
        status_, reason, info = G.classify(out, dict(l_heat_mm=l_heat_mm), conv)
        row.update(status=status_, reason=reason, converged=conv, iter=st['iter'], dT_svz_total=round(b['dT_svz'] + 25 - t0_C, 3),
                   dT_dzv_total=round(b['dT_dzv'] + 25 - t0d, 3), Q=round(b['Q'], 1), ratio=round(b['ratio'], 4),
                   yp_svz=round(b['yp_svz'], 3), **{k: info.get(k) for k in ('M_mean_channel', 'M_outlet', 'x_shock_m', 'reversed_max_pct')})
        if cl:
            row.update(G_svz=round(cl[-1]['m_svz'], 6), G_dzv=round(cl[-1]['m_dzv'], 6), net_W=round(cl[-1]['net'], 3),
                       dm_svz_pct=round(cl[-1]['dm'], 4), dm_dzv_pct=round(cl[-1]['dm_dzv'], 4))
            if g_dzv_target:
                miss = abs(cl[-1]['m_dzv'] - g_dzv_target) / g_dzv_target * 100
                row['G_dzv_miss_pct'] = round(miss, 2)
                if miss > 1.0:
                    row['reason'] = f"{row['reason']}; расход ДЗВ не достигнут ({miss:.1f} %)"
            if gas.startswith('ch4'):
                row.update(grs_temps.outlet_temps(b['Q'], cl[-1]['m_svz'], cl[-1]['m_dzv'], 273.15 + t0_C, p0s, pos, pod, p0d,
                                                  T0_dzv_K=273.15 + t0d))
                try:
                    row['cond_margin_K'] = cond_margin(out / 'axis.csv')
                except Exception:
                    pass
        log(f"{tag}: {status_} ({reason}); полная T: СВЗ {row['dT_svz_total']:+.3f} K, ДЗВ {row['dT_dzv_total']:+.3f} K; "
            f"Q {row['Q']:.1f} Вт; G {row.get('G_svz')}/{row.get('G_dzv')} кг/с"
            + (f"; по энтальпии: СВЗ {row['dT_svz_h']:+.2f} K (дроссель {row['dT_svz_throttle']:+.2f}, эффект {row['dT_svz_vs_throttle']:+.2f}), "
               f"ДЗВ {row['dT_dzv_h']:+.2f} K" if 'dT_svz_h' in row else ''))
    else:
        row.update(status='сбой', reason='нет результата')
        log(f'{tag}: нет результата (сбой)')
    new = not Path(csv_path).exists()
    # 09.10: new columns are appended; an older file keeps its own header (no column shift)
    cols = COLS if new else (next(csv.reader(open(csv_path, encoding='utf-8')), None) or COLS)
    with open(csv_path, 'a', newline='', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        w = csv.DictWriter(f, fieldnames=cols, extrasaction='ignore')
        if new:
            w.writeheader()
        w.writerow(row)
    return row

"""Shared helpers for continuation runs and result rows (08.10.2026).
continue_case: read a converged case, apply extra lines (gas, properties, T0), set the regime pressures, coupled with
auto-stop (up to LIMIT iterations), export axis, close Fluent.  record: one row with BOTH Fluent total temperatures
(dT_svz_total / dT_dzv_total, author 08.10) and, for methane, the enthalpy-based outlet temperatures of the gas at rest
plus the throttle reference (grs_temps.py)."""
import csv, subprocess, time
from pathlib import Path
import leontiev_pipeline as L
import gui_runner as G
import gui_convergence as C
from make_gui_prt_journal import GUI_PRT
import grs_temps

LIMIT = 5500
GUARD_ENERGY_W = None   # 11.10: if set, a stage is failed when the energy imbalance exceeds it (after 1500 it.)
STALL_MIN = 20  # 11.10: watchdog, minutes without a new iteration -> kill (G.status 'iter')
NPROC = 7    # 10.10: Fluent processes (module-level; 4 = physical cores, the laptop throttled at 94-99 C with 7)
CFL = 20.0   # 09.10: module-level so a series can lower it (fine DZV layers were unstable at CFL 20 after the startup)
COLS = ['tag', 'mesh', 'gas', 'p0_svz', 'p_out_svz', 'p0_dzv', 'p_out_dzv', 'T0_C', 'start', 'status', 'reason', 'converged',
        'iter', 'dT_svz_total', 'dT_dzv_total', 'Q', 'G_svz', 'G_dzv', 'ratio', 'net_W', 'dm_svz_pct', 'dm_dzv_pct',
        'dT_svz_h', 'dT_dzv_h', 'dT_svz_throttle', 'dT_dzv_throttle', 'dT_svz_vs_throttle', 'dT_dzv_vs_throttle',
        'yp_svz', 'M_mean_channel', 'M_outlet', 'x_shock_m', 'reversed_max_pct', 'minutes',
        'T0_dzv_C', 'G_dzv_target', 'G_dzv_miss_pct', 'cond_margin_K']   # 09.10


def t0_line(t0_C):
    return f'/define/boundary-conditions/set/pressure-inlet inlet_svz inlet_dzv () t0 no {t0_C:g} q'


def t0_lines(t0_svz_C, t0_dzv_C):
    """09.10.2026: separate inlet temperatures (heater on the SVZ line only, author's decision 0...+20 K)."""
    return [f'/define/boundary-conditions/set/pressure-inlet inlet_svz () t0 no {t0_svz_C:g} q',
            f'/define/boundary-conditions/set/pressure-inlet inlet_dzv () t0 no {t0_dzv_C:g} q']


def tmf_lines(g_kg_s, p_min_MPa, p_max_MPa):
    """09.10.2026: targeted mass flow at the DZV outlet.  Limits are ABSOLUTE pressures in the case units (atm, operating
    pressure 0).  Dataset rule (review): p_min >= consumer pressure + return-line losses, p_max just below p0_DZV.
    The achieved flow is checked afterwards (record: G_dzv vs target), an unreachable flow is a physical status."""
    atm = 0.101325
    return [f'/define/boundary-conditions/set/pressure-outlet outlet_dzv () targeted-mf-boundary? yes targeted-mf no {g_kg_s:g} '
            f'targeted-mf-pmin no {p_min_MPa / atm:.5f} targeted-mf-pmax no {p_max_MPa / atm:.5f} q']


def cond_margin(axis_csv):
    """09.10.2026: condensation flag for methane — min over the axis of (static T - T_sat(p)) where p < p_crit (K).
    Negative = the core flow is below the saturation line (the PR model does not represent condensation; real natural
    gas with heavier components condenses earlier)."""

        r = {k.strip(): v for k, v in r.items()}
        p, T = float(r['pressure']), float(r['temperature'])
        if 1e4 < p < pc:
            d = T - CP.PropsSI('T', 'P', p, 'Q', 1, 'Methane')
            best = d if best is None or d < best else best
    return None if best is None else round(best, 2)


def continue_case(src_case, out, extra, regime, log, tag, t0_C=None, wall_k=None, t0_dzv_C=None):
    """regime = (p0_svz, p_out_svz, p0_dzv, p_out_dzv) MPa.  Returns minutes or None on failure.
    wall_k: set the wall conductivity explicitly (a continued case keeps the value of its source case).
    t0_dzv_C: separate DZV inlet temperature (09.10); t0_C is then the SVZ inlet temperature."""
    if wall_k:
        extra = list(extra) + [L.wall_k_line(float(wall_k))]
    out = Path(out); out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    for f in list(out.glob('*.trn')) + list(out.glob('axis.csv')):
        f.unlink()
    q = L.fl(out)
    p0s, pos, p0d, pod = regime
    target = {'inlet_svz': p0s * 1e6, 'outlet_svz': pos * 1e6, 'pressure_inlet_dzv': p0d * 1e6, 'outlet_dzv': pod * 1e6}
    lines = ['/file/confirm-overwrite? no', f'/file/start-transcript "{q}/run.trn"', f'/file/read-case-data "{L.fl(src_case)}"']
    lines += [g.format(prt=0.85) for g in GUI_PRT] + list(extra) + G.bc_lines(target)
    if t0_dzv_C is not None:
        lines += t0_lines(25.0 if t0_C is None else t0_C, t0_dzv_C)
    elif t0_C is not None:
        lines.append(t0_line(t0_C))
    lines += C.coupled_journal(dict(coupled_iters=LIMIT, report_every=500, cfl=CFL), out)
    lines += [f'/file/write-case-data "{q}/result.cas.h5"',
              f'/file/export/ascii "{q}/axis.csv" axis () yes mach-number pressure total-pressure temperature '
              'total-temperature axial-velocity () yes', '/file/stop-transcript']
    (out / 'cont.jou').write_text('\n'.join(lines) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
    log(f'=== {tag}: продолжение с {Path(src_case).parent.name}; режим СВЗ {p0s}->{pos}, ДЗВ {p0d}->{pod} МПа'
        + (f', T0 {t0_C:g} °C' if t0_C is not None else ''))
    while G.fluent_running():
        time.sleep(60)
    t0 = time.time()
    subprocess.Popen([L.FLUENT, '2ddp', f'-t{NPROC}', '-i', str(out / 'cont.jou')], cwd=str(out), stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,
                     stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL, close_fds=True)
    first, said = None, False
    last_it, t_it = None, time.time()
    prev_ce, cur_ce, last_ce_it = None, None, None
    while not (out / 'axis.csv').exists():
        rows = C.closed_samples(out)
        if rows and first is None:
            first = rows[0]['iteration'] - 500
        c = C.update_control(out, True, max_iter=first + LIMIT if first is not None else None)
        if c['stop_requested'] and not said:
            log('  критерии сходимости выполнены в двух проверках подряд — Fluent сохранит кейс'); said = True
        # 11.10 22:15: guard against a slow blow-up at a large CFL (cell a at CFL 100: energy imbalance 2 -> 4530 W)
        ce = (c.get('checks') or {}).get('energy_W')
        # 13.10 15:10: only a GROWING imbalance is a blow-up (knurl h 0.5 after the field transfer: 602 -> 471 -> 363 W,
        # a decaying start transient, was killed by the absolute rule)
        if ce and c['checked_iteration'] != last_ce_it:
            prev_ce, last_ce_it, cur_ce = cur_ce, c['checked_iteration'], ce['value']
        if (GUARD_ENERGY_W and ce and first is not None and c['checked_iteration'] - first >= 1500 and ce['value'] > GUARD_ENERGY_W
                and prev_ce is not None and cur_ce > prev_ce):
            G.kill_since(t0); log(f'  {tag}: СБОЙ (дисбаланс энергии {ce["value"]:.0f} Вт > {GUARD_ENERGY_W} — неустойчиво при CFL {CFL:g})')
            return None
        st = G.status(out)
        if st and (st['fpe'] or st['error']):
            G.kill_since(t0); log(f'  {tag}: СБОЙ (расходимость или ошибка журнала) на итерации {st["iter"]}'); return None
        if time.time() - t0 > 4 * 3600:
            G.kill_since(t0); log(f'  {tag}: СБОЙ (время)'); return None
        # 11.10: watchdog — 10.10 Fluent hung twice (iteration not finishing, CPU busy, Stop ignored)
        it = st['iter'] if st else None
        if it != last_it:
            last_it, t_it = it, time.time()
        elif it is not None and time.time() - t_it > STALL_MIN * 60:
            G.kill_since(t0); log(f'  {tag}: СБОЙ (зависание: итерация {it} не меняется {STALL_MIN} мин)'); return None
        time.sleep(10)
    time.sleep(10)
    G.kill_since(t0)
    return round((time.time() - t0) / 60, 1)

def t0_lines(t0_svz_C, t0_dzv_C):
    """09.10.2026: separate inlet temperatures (heater on the SVZ line only, author's decision 0...+20 K)."""
    return [f'/define/boundary-conditions/set/pressure-inlet inlet_svz () t0 no {t0_svz_C:g} q',
            f'/define/boundary-conditions/set/pressure-inlet inlet_dzv () t0 no {t0_dzv_C:g} q']


def tmf_lines(g_kg_s, p_min_MPa, p_max_MPa):
    """09.10.2026: targeted mass flow at the DZV outlet.  Limits are ABSOLUTE pressures in the case units (atm, operating
    pressure 0).  Dataset rule (review): p_min >= consumer pressure + return-line losses, p_max just below p0_DZV.
    The achieved flow is checked afterwards (record: G_dzv vs target), an unreachable flow is a physical status."""
    atm = 0.101325
    return [f'/define/boundary-conditions/set/pressure-outlet outlet_dzv () targeted-mf-boundary? yes targeted-mf no {g_kg_s:g} '
            f'targeted-mf-pmin no {p_min_MPa / atm:.5f} targeted-mf-pmax no {p_max_MPa / atm:.5f} q']


def cond_margin(axis_csv):
    """09.10.2026: condensation flag for methane — min over the axis of (static T - T_sat(p)) where p < p_crit (K).
    Negative = the core flow is below the saturation line (the PR model does not represent condensation; real natural
    gas with heavier components condenses earlier)."""
    import CoolProp.CoolProp as CP
    pc = CP.PropsSI('Pcrit', 'Methane')
    best = None
    for r in csv.DictReader(open(axis_csv)):
        r = {k.strip(): v for k, v in r.items()}
        p, T = float(r['pressure']), float(r['temperature'])
        if 1e4 < p < pc:
            d = T - CP.PropsSI('T', 'P', p, 'Q', 1, 'Methane')
            best = d if best is None or d < best else best
    return None if best is None else round(best, 2)


def continue_case(src_case, out, extra, regime, log, tag, t0_C=None, wall_k=None, t0_dzv_C=None):
    """regime = (p0_svz, p_out_svz, p0_dzv, p_out_dzv) MPa.  Returns minutes or None on failure.
    wall_k: set the wall conductivity explicitly (a continued case keeps the value of its source case).
    t0_dzv_C: separate DZV inlet temperature (09.10); t0_C is then the SVZ inlet temperature."""
    if wall_k:
        extra = list(extra) + [L.wall_k_line(float(wall_k))]
    out = Path(out); out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    for f in list(out.glob('*.trn')) + list(out.glob('axis.csv')):
        f.unlink()
    q = L.fl(out)
    p0s, pos, p0d, pod = regime
    target = {'inlet_svz': p0s * 1e6, 'outlet_svz': pos * 1e6, 'pressure_inlet_dzv': p0d * 1e6, 'outlet_dzv': pod * 1e6}
    lines = ['/file/confirm-overwrite? no', f'/file/start-transcript "{q}/run.trn"', f'/file/read-case-data "{L.fl(src_case)}"']
    lines += [g.format(prt=0.85) for g in GUI_PRT] + list(extra) + G.bc_lines(target)
    if t0_dzv_C is not None:
        lines += t0_lines(25.0 if t0_C is None else t0_C, t0_dzv_C)
    elif t0_C is not None:
        lines.append(t0_line(t0_C))
    lines += C.coupled_journal(dict(coupled_iters=LIMIT, report_every=500, cfl=CFL), out)
    lines += [f'/file/write-case-data "{q}/result.cas.h5"',
              f'/file/export/ascii "{q}/axis.csv" axis () yes mach-number pressure total-pressure temperature '
              'total-temperature axial-velocity () yes', '/file/stop-transcript']
    (out / 'cont.jou').write_text('\n'.join(lines) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
    log(f'=== {tag}: продолжение с {Path(src_case).parent.name}; режим СВЗ {p0s}->{pos}, ДЗВ {p0d}->{pod} МПа'
        + (f', T0 {t0_C:g} °C' if t0_C is not None else ''))
    while G.fluent_running():
        time.sleep(60)
    t0 = time.time()
    subprocess.Popen([L.FLUENT, '2ddp', f'-t{NPROC}', '-i', str(out / 'cont.jou')], cwd=str(out), stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,
                     stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL, close_fds=True)
    first, said = None, False
    last_it, t_it = None, time.time()
    prev_ce, cur_ce, last_ce_it = None, None, None
    while not (out / 'axis.csv').exists():
        rows = C.closed_samples(out)
        if rows and first is None:
            first = rows[0]['iteration'] - 500
        c = C.update_control(out, True, max_iter=first + LIMIT if first is not None else None)
        if c['stop_requested'] and not said:
            log('  критерии сходимости выполнены в двух проверках подряд — Fluent сохранит кейс'); said = True
        # 11.10 22:15: guard against a slow blow-up at a large CFL (cell a at CFL 100: energy imbalance 2 -> 4530 W)
        ce = (c.get('checks') or {}).get('energy_W')
        # 13.10 15:10: only a GROWING imbalance is a blow-up (knurl h 0.5 after the field transfer: 602 -> 471 -> 363 W,
        # a decaying start transient, was killed by the absolute rule)
        if ce and c['checked_iteration'] != last_ce_it:
            prev_ce, last_ce_it, cur_ce = cur_ce, c['checked_iteration'], ce['value']
        if (GUARD_ENERGY_W and ce and first is not None and c['checked_iteration'] - first >= 1500 and ce['value'] > GUARD_ENERGY_W
                and prev_ce is not None and cur_ce > prev_ce):
            G.kill_since(t0); log(f'  {tag}: СБОЙ (дисбаланс энергии {ce["value"]:.0f} Вт > {GUARD_ENERGY_W} — неустойчиво при CFL {CFL:g})')
            return None
        st = G.status(out)
        if st and (st['fpe'] or st['error']):
            G.kill_since(t0); log(f'  {tag}: СБОЙ (расходимость или ошибка журнала) на итерации {st["iter"]}'); return None
        if time.time() - t0 > 4 * 3600:
            G.kill_since(t0); log(f'  {tag}: СБОЙ (время)'); return None
        # 11.10: watchdog — 10.10 Fluent hung twice (iteration not finishing, CPU busy, Stop ignored)
        it = st['iter'] if st else None
        if it != last_it:
            last_it, t_it = it, time.time()
        elif it is not None and time.time() - t_it > STALL_MIN * 60:
            G.kill_since(t0); log(f'  {tag}: СБОЙ (зависание: итерация {it} не меняется {STALL_MIN} мин)'); return None
        time.sleep(10)
    time.sleep(10)
    G.kill_since(t0)
    return round((time.time() - t0) / 60, 1)


def record(csv_path, tag, mesh, gas, regime, out, minutes, log, start='', t0_C=25.0, l_heat_mm=400.0, t0_dzv_C=None,
           g_dzv_target=None):
    """t0_C = SVZ inlet temperature; t0_dzv_C = DZV inlet temperature (09.10; default = t0_C).  g_dzv_target: targeted DZV
    flow — the achieved flow is checked (|G - target| > 1 % -> reason gets 'расход ДЗВ не достигнут')."""
    out = Path(out)
    p0s, pos, p0d, pod = regime
    t0d = t0_C if t0_dzv_C is None else t0_dzv_C
    row = dict(tag=tag, mesh=mesh, gas=gas, p0_svz=p0s, p_out_svz=pos, p0_dzv=p0d, p_out_dzv=pod, T0_C=t0_C, start=start,
               minutes=minutes, T0_dzv_C=t0d, G_dzv_target=g_dzv_target)
    st = G.status(out) if out.exists() else None
    if st and st['samples'] and (out / 'axis.csv').exists():
        b = st['samples'][-1]; cl = C.closed_samples(out)
        conv = G.converged(out)
        status_, reason, info = G.classify(out, dict(l_heat_mm=l_heat_mm), conv)
        row.update(status=status_, reason=reason, converged=conv, iter=st['iter'], dT_svz_total=round(b['dT_svz'] + 25 - t0_C, 3),
                   dT_dzv_total=round(b['dT_dzv'] + 25 - t0d, 3), Q=round(b['Q'], 1), ratio=round(b['ratio'], 4),
                   yp_svz=round(b['yp_svz'], 3), **{k: info.get(k) for k in ('M_mean_channel', 'M_outlet', 'x_shock_m', 'reversed_max_pct')})
        if cl:
            row.update(G_svz=round(cl[-1]['m_svz'], 6), G_dzv=round(cl[-1]['m_dzv'], 6), net_W=round(cl[-1]['net'], 3),
                       dm_svz_pct=round(cl[-1]['dm'], 4), dm_dzv_pct=round(cl[-1]['dm_dzv'], 4))
            if g_dzv_target:
                miss = abs(cl[-1]['m_dzv'] - g_dzv_target) / g_dzv_target * 100
                row['G_dzv_miss_pct'] = round(miss, 2)
                if miss > 1.0:
                    row['reason'] = f"{row['reason']}; расход ДЗВ не достигнут ({miss:.1f} %)"
            if gas.startswith('ch4'):
                row.update(grs_temps.outlet_temps(b['Q'], cl[-1]['m_svz'], cl[-1]['m_dzv'], 273.15 + t0_C, p0s, pos, pod, p0d,
                                                  T0_dzv_K=273.15 + t0d))
                try:
                    row['cond_margin_K'] = cond_margin(out / 'axis.csv')
                except Exception:
                    pass
        log(f"{tag}: {status_} ({reason}); полная T: СВЗ {row['dT_svz_total']:+.3f} K, ДЗВ {row['dT_dzv_total']:+.3f} K; "
            f"Q {row['Q']:.1f} Вт; G {row.get('G_svz')}/{row.get('G_dzv')} кг/с"
            + (f"; по энтальпии: СВЗ {row['dT_svz_h']:+.2f} K (дроссель {row['dT_svz_throttle']:+.2f}, эффект {row['dT_svz_vs_throttle']:+.2f}), "
               f"ДЗВ {row['dT_dzv_h']:+.2f} K" if 'dT_svz_h' in row else ''))
    else:
        row.update(status='сбой', reason='нет результата')
        log(f'{tag}: нет результата (сбой)')
    new = not Path(csv_path).exists()
    # 09.10: new columns are appended; an older file keeps its own header (no column shift)
    cols = COLS if new else (next(csv.reader(open(csv_path, encoding='utf-8')), None) or COLS)
    with open(csv_path, 'a', newline='', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        w = csv.DictWriter(f, fieldnames=cols, extrasaction='ignore')
        if new:
            w.writeheader()
        w.writerow(row)
    return row

"""New queue handoff after W1. No modification of the running scientific scripts."""
import argparse, hashlib, json, os, subprocess, sys, time
from pathlib import Path
sys.dont_write_bytecode=True
ROOT=Path(r"F:\Leontiev_Project")
D=ROOT/"dataset"
Q=ROOT/"runs"/"queue"
W=ROOT/"runs"/"knurl_cont"
PY=Path(r"C:\Users\Roman\AppData\Local\Programs\Python\Python314\python.exe")
sys.path.insert(0,str(D))
import jobqueue as JQ

RESUME_STOP_TEXT="Контроль после benchmark и W2/W3 (cores_after_w1_1102): очередь остановить перед M1/M2; снимать только после проверки принятого итога W.\n"
FAILURE_STOP_TEXT="Fail-closed guard cores_after_w1_1102: controller failed; do not resume the queue without checking coordination_block.json.\n"

def install_resume_guard():
    # Fixed path/text: install before reading an unverified plan or importing its settings.
    Q.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    with (Q/"STOP").open("x",encoding="utf-8") as f:f.write(RESUME_STOP_TEXT)

def ensure_failure_guard():
    Q.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    try:
        with (Q/"STOP").open("x",encoding="utf-8") as f:f.write(FAILURE_STOP_TEXT)
    except FileExistsError:pass  # Never overwrite another guard.

def require_resume_guard(c):
    if c.get("resume_stop_text")!=RESUME_STOP_TEXT:raise RuntimeError("registered resume STOP text differs from fixed script guard")
    stop=Q/"STOP"
    if not stop.exists() or stop.read_text(encoding="utf-8")!=RESUME_STOP_TEXT:raise RuntimeError("resume STOP missing/changed")

def identity_matches(actual,expected):
    if not actual or not expected:return False
    return (all(int(actual.get(k,-1))==int(expected.get(k,-2)) for k in ("ProcessId","ParentProcessId"))
            and all(actual.get(k)==expected.get(k) for k in ("Name","CommandLine","CreationDate")))

def require_identities(c,pp):
    bypid={int(p["ProcessId"]):p for p in pp}
    for role in ("w","runner"):
        expected=c["original_"+role+"_identity"]
        if int(expected["ProcessId"])!=int(c["original_"+role+"_pid"]):raise RuntimeError(role+" PID/identity plan disagreement")
        if not identity_matches(bypid.get(int(expected["ProcessId"])),expected):raise RuntimeError(role+" process identity changed or absent")

def require_waiting_order(c,jobs):
    expected=[c["benchmark_job_id"],c["resume_job_id"],"J0034","J0035"]
    actual=[j["id"] for j in jobs if j.get("status")=="ждёт"][:4]
    if actual!=expected:raise RuntimeError("unexpected waiting queue order: "+repr(actual)+"; expected "+repr(expected))

def verified_stop_waiting_w(c):
    # Re-read both process identities and all solver state immediately before the one targeted stop.
    require_own_hold(c)
    current=procs();require_identities(c,current)
    if solver_busy(current):raise RuntimeError("solver became busy before waiting-orchestrator stop")
    identities=json.dumps({"w":c["original_w_identity"],"runner":c["original_runner_identity"]},ensure_ascii=False)
    command="[Console]::OutputEncoding=[System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false); $e=ConvertFrom-Json @'\n"+identities+"\n'@; "
    command+="foreach ($role in @('w','runner')) { $x=$e.$role; $a=Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter ('ProcessId = '+$x.ProcessId); if (-not $a -or $a.ParentProcessId -ne $x.ParentProcessId -or $a.Name -cne $x.Name -or $a.CommandLine -cne $x.CommandLine -or $a.CreationDate.ToUniversalTime().ToString('o') -cne $x.CreationDate) { throw ('process identity mismatch: '+$role) } }; "
    command+="$b=@(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.Name -match '^(fluent|cx2420|fl_mpi2420|fl2420|RunWB2|AnsMeshingServer|AnsysWBU|SpaceClaim)\\.exe$' }); if ($b.Count -gt 0) { throw 'solver/Workbench became busy' }; Stop-Process -Id ([int]$e.w.ProcessId) -ErrorAction Stop"
    ps(command)

def wait_scheduler_ready(state,statep):
    deadline=time.monotonic()+60
    while True:
        taskstate=ps("(Get-ScheduledTask -TaskName 'Leontiev_queue_runner').State.ToString()")
        if taskstate=="Ready":
            state.update(phase="scheduler_ready",scheduler_ready=now());save(statep,state);return
        if taskstate not in ("Running","Queued") or time.monotonic()>=deadline:
            state.update(phase="scheduler_not_ready",scheduler_state=taskstate);save(statep,state)
            raise RuntimeError("queue scheduled task is not Ready: "+taskstate)
        time.sleep(2)

def start_queue_confirmed(c,state,statep):
    # Start-ScheduledTask can succeed while IgnoreNew silently ignores a launch.
    # Confirm an actual new runner (or the first benchmark's running state).
    try:
        ps("Start-ScheduledTask -TaskName 'Leontiev_queue_runner'")
        state.update(phase="start_requested",start_requested=now());save(statep,state)
        deadline=time.monotonic()+60
        while True:
            pp=procs()
            expected=c["original_runner_identity"]
            new=[p for p in pp if p.get("Name")=="python.exe"
                 and p.get("CommandLine")==expected["CommandLine"]
                 and not identity_matches(p,expected)
                 and p.get("CreationDate","")>expected["CreationDate"]]
            jobs=JQ.load()
            job=next((j for j in jobs if j.get("id")==c["benchmark_job_id"]),{})
            if new or job.get("status")=="идёт":
                state.update(phase="transferred",transferred=now(),new_runner_identity=new[0] if new else None,
                             start_confirmation="new runner identity" if new else "benchmark job running",
                             benchmark_job_started=job.get("started"))
                save(statep,state);return
            if time.monotonic()>=deadline:raise RuntimeError("Start-ScheduledTask returned but new queue execution was not observed")
            time.sleep(2)
    except Exception:
        ensure_failure_guard()
        state.update(phase="start_unconfirmed",start_unconfirmed=now());save(statep,state)
        raise

def ps(command):
    r=subprocess.run(["powershell","-NoProfile","-Command",command],capture_output=True,text=True,encoding="utf-8",errors="replace",creationflags=subprocess.CREATE_NO_WINDOW)
    if r.returncode: raise RuntimeError(r.stderr.strip() or r.stdout.strip())
    return r.stdout.strip()
def now():
    return ps("[Console]::OutputEncoding=[System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false); Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd_HHmmss|dd.MM.yyyy HH:mm:ss zzz'")
def stamp(): return now().split("|",1)[0]
def load(p): return json.loads(Path(p).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
def save(p,x):
    p=Path(p); p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    tmp=p.with_suffix(p.suffix+".tmp")
    tmp.write_text(json.dumps(x,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),encoding="utf-8"); os.replace(tmp,p)
def sha(p):
    h=hashlib.sha256()
    with open(p,"rb") as f:
        for b in iter(lambda:f.read(1024*1024),b""):h.update(b)
    return h.hexdigest().upper()
def archive(p,move=False):
    p=Path(p)
    dest=p.with_name(p.stem+"_архив_"+stamp()+p.suffix)
    if dest.exists(): raise RuntimeError("archive already exists: "+str(dest))
    if dest.resolve().parent!=p.resolve().parent: raise RuntimeError("invalid archive path")
    if move: p.rename(dest)
    else:
        import shutil
        shutil.copy2(p,dest)
    return str(dest)
def journal(s):
    f=ROOT/"Журнал_работ.md"
    archive(f)
    with f.open("a",encoding="utf-8") as out:out.write("\n- "+now().split("|",1)[1]+" — тест ядер после W1: "+s+"\n")
    print(s,flush=True)
def procs():
    raw=ps("[Console]::OutputEncoding=[System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false); @(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.Name -match 'python|fluent|cx2420|fl_mpi2420|fl2420|RunWB2|AnsMeshingServer|AnsysWBU|SpaceClaim' } | Select-Object ProcessId,ParentProcessId,Name,CommandLine,@{N='CreationDate';E={$_.CreationDate.ToUniversalTime().ToString('o')}}) | ConvertTo-Json -Compress")
    x=json.loads(raw) if raw else []
    return x if isinstance(x,list) else [x]
def solver_busy(pp):
    return [p for p in pp if any(t in p["Name"].lower() for t in ("fluent","cx2420","fl_mpi2420","fl2420","runwb2","ansmeshing","ansyswbu","spaceclaim"))]
def registered(planpath):
    p=Path(planpath)
    if sha(p)!=p.with_suffix(".sha256").read_text(encoding="utf-8").strip():raise RuntimeError("plan hash mismatch")
    plan=load(p)
    for f,h in plan["code_sha256"].items():
        fp=Path(f) if Path(f).is_absolute() else D/f
        if sha(fp)!=h:raise RuntimeError("code hash mismatch: "+str(fp))
    return plan
def require_own_hold(c):
    f=W/"HOLD"
    if not f.exists() or f.read_text(encoding="utf-8")!=c["hold_text"]:raise RuntimeError("HOLD missing/changed")
def w1_ready(res):
    return bool(res.get("W1",{}).get("done") and res["W1"].get("ok"))
def no_other_w_started(res):
    # An existing real attempt folder is enough to refuse a silent retry, even if results were lost.
    return not any(res.get(t) or (W/t).exists() for t in ("W2","W3"))
def boundary_ready(plan,res,pp,journal_tail):
    c=plan["coordination"]
    if not w1_ready(res) or not no_other_w_started(res):return False
    if solver_busy(pp):return False
    try:require_identities(c,pp)
    except (KeyError,TypeError,ValueError,RuntimeError):return False
    if "HOLD перед W2 — жду снятия" not in journal_tail:return False
    return all(Path(plan["source"][k]).is_file() and Path(plan["source"][k]).stat().st_size>0 for k in ("case","data"))
def fail(plan,why):
    ensure_failure_guard()
    if plan is not None:
        try:
            out=Path(plan["output"])
            save(out/"coordination_block.json",dict(why=why,time=now()))
        except Exception as e:print("could not save coordination_block: "+repr(e),file=sys.stderr,flush=True)
    print("COORDINATION BLOCK: "+why,flush=True)
    return 3
def watch(planpath,plan):
    c=plan["coordination"]; out=Path(plan["output"]); statep=out/"coordination_state.json"
    state=load(statep) if statep.exists() else {}
    if state.get("transferred"):
        print("handoff already completed; no action");return 0
    require_own_hold(c)
    start=time.monotonic()
    while time.monotonic()-start<c["watch_timeout_s"]:
        registered(planpath)
        res=load(W/"results.json") if (W/"results.json").exists() else {}
        if (W/"BLOCK.json").exists():return fail(plan,"W BLOCK; benchmark not started")
        if res.get("W1",{}).get("done") and not res["W1"].get("ok"):return fail(plan,"W1 not accepted")
        pp=procs()
        try:require_identities(c,pp)
        except RuntimeError as e:return fail(plan,str(e)+"; no blind restart")
        if w1_ready(res):
            require_own_hold(c)
            with (ROOT/"Журнал_работ.md").open("rb") as f:
                f.seek(0,2); n=f.tell();f.seek(max(0,n-65536));tail=f.read().decode("utf-8",errors="replace")
            if boundary_ready(plan,res,pp,tail):break
        time.sleep(c.get("poll_seconds",15))
    else:return fail(plan,"watch time budget reached")
    stop=Q/"STOP"
    if not stop.exists() or sha(stop)!=c["initial_stop_sha256"]:return fail(plan,"queue STOP changed; not removing another guard")
    state.update(phase="boundary_confirmed",boundary_confirmed=now(),w1_result=res["W1"])
    save(statep,state)
    # Kill only the waiting Python orchestrator. There is no Fluent/Workbench at this boundary.
    verified_stop_waiting_w(c)
    deadline=time.monotonic()+180
    while time.monotonic()<deadline:
        pp=procs()
        if not any(int(p["ProcessId"]) in (int(c["original_w_pid"]),int(c["original_runner_pid"])) for p in pp):break
        time.sleep(2)
    else:return fail(plan,"original queue runner did not leave; not forcing it")
    if solver_busy(pp):return fail(plan,"unexpected solver after boundary; no handoff")
    state.update(phase="original_processes_stopped",original_processes_stopped=now());save(statep,state)
    # Preserve original return code; mark the old whole-series job as split, not completed.
    with JQ.locked():
        jobs=JQ.load()
        require_waiting_order(c,jobs)
        byid={j["id"]:j for j in jobs}
        if c["benchmark_job_id"] not in byid or c["resume_job_id"] not in byid:return fail(plan,"new queue jobs missing")
        if byid[c["benchmark_job_id"]]["status"]!="ждёт" or byid[c["resume_job_id"]]["status"]!="ждёт":return fail(plan,"new jobs already handled")
        archive(JQ.JOBS)
        old=byid[c["original_job_id"]]
        old.update(status="снято",split_after="W1",split_by="автор: тест 6/7/8 после текущего расчёта",split_jobs=[c["benchmark_job_id"],c["resume_job_id"]],
                   note="W1 завершена и сохранена. Ожидающий W2 оркестратор завершён на HOLD для вставки теста; исходный rc сохранён. W2/W3 продолжает "+c["resume_job_id"])
        JQ.save(jobs)
    state.update(phase="queue_rewritten",queue_rewritten=now(),next_job=c["benchmark_job_id"])
    save(statep,state)
    journal("W1 принята и сохранена; на подтверждённой паузе перед W2 завершён только ожидающий Python, без прерывания CFD. "+c["original_job_id"]+" разделена; далее "+c["benchmark_job_id"]+" → "+c["resume_job_id"]+" → M1/M2. Старые код/планы не изменены.")
    state.update(phase="handoff_logged",handoff_logged=now());save(statep,state)
    wait_scheduler_ready(state,statep)
    if sha(stop)!=c["initial_stop_sha256"]:return fail(plan,"STOP changed during handoff")
    state["stop_archive"]=archive(stop,move=True);state["phase"]="initial_stop_archived";save(statep,state)
    start_queue_confirmed(c,state,statep)
    print("queue started for benchmark then resume",flush=True)
    return 0
def resume(planpath,plan):
    c=plan["coordination"];out=Path(plan["output"]);stop=Q/"STOP"
    # This guard forces a checkpoint before M even if benchmark or W2/W3 fails.
    require_resume_guard(c)
    statep=out/"coordination_state.json";state=load(statep) if statep.exists() else {}
    if (out/"BLOCK.json").exists():return fail(plan,"benchmark BLOCK; W2/W3 not resumed")
    bp=out/"results.json"
    if not bp.exists():return fail(plan,"benchmark results missing")
    bench=load(bp)
    import speed_knurl_1102 as benchmark
    benchmark_plan=benchmark.registered(planpath)
    benchmark.validate_complete(benchmark_plan,bench)
    if (W/"BLOCK.json").exists():return fail(plan,"W BLOCK; not released")
    require_own_hold(c)
    res=load(W/"results.json")
    if not w1_ready(res) or not no_other_w_started(res):return fail(plan,"unexpected W saved state; no blind restart")
    if solver_busy(procs()):return fail(plan,"Fluent/Workbench busy")
    registered(planpath)
    state["hold_archive"]=archive(W/"HOLD",move=True);state["resume_started"]=now();save(statep,state)
    journal("Тест "+c["benchmark_job_id"]+" окончен (9/9); возобновляю W2/W3 по исходному плану, W1 пропускается по done=true. Число процессов остаётся 6; контроль перед M через штатный STOP.")
    r=subprocess.run([str(PY),"-B","-u",str(D/"knurl_cont.py"),"run"],cwd=str(D),env=dict(os.environ,PYTHONIOENCODING="utf-8"))
    final=load(W/"results.json") if (W/"results.json").exists() else {}
    ok=r.returncode==0 and all(final.get(t,{}).get("done") and final[t].get("ok") for t in ("W1","W2","W3"))
    state.update(resume_finished=now(),resume_rc=r.returncode,resume_ok=ok);save(statep,state)
    if not ok:return fail(plan,"W2/W3 not complete/accepted; keep STOP before M")
    journal("W1/W2/W3 приняты; исполнитель остановится перед M на контрольную проверку. Результат теста ядер хранится отдельно, настройки текущей W-серии не менялись.")
    return 0
def check(plan):
    c=plan["coordination"]
    assert c["original_job_id"]!=c["benchmark_job_id"]!=c["resume_job_id"]
    assert len({c["original_job_id"],c["benchmark_job_id"],c["resume_job_id"]})==3
    assert "стоп" not in c["hold_text"].lower()
    assert plan["trials"]==[[6,7,8],[8,6,7],[7,8,6]]
    assert plan["warmup_iterations"]==25 and plan["timed_iterations"]==100
    assert sum(len(x) for x in plan["trials"])==9
    assert c["watch_timeout_s"]>0
    assert c["resume_stop_text"]==RESUME_STOP_TEXT
    for role in ("w","runner"):
        e=c["original_"+role+"_identity"]
        assert int(e["ProcessId"])==int(c["original_"+role+"_pid"])
        assert e["Name"]=="python.exe" and e["CommandLine"] and e["CreationDate"]
        assert isinstance(e["ParentProcessId"],int)
    print("coordination check passed; no processes or files changed")
    return 0
def main():
    p=argparse.ArgumentParser();p.add_argument("mode",choices=("watch","resume","check"));p.add_argument("--plan",required=True);args=p.parse_args()
    plan=None
    try:
        if args.mode=="resume":install_resume_guard()
        plan=registered(args.plan)
        return {"watch":lambda:watch(args.plan,plan),"resume":lambda:resume(args.plan,plan),"check":lambda:check(plan)}[args.mode]()
    except Exception as e:
        if args.mode in ("resume","watch"):return fail(plan,repr(e))
        print("CHECK ERROR: "+repr(e),file=sys.stderr,flush=True);return 3
if __name__=="__main__":raise SystemExit(main())

"""New queue handoff after W1. No modification of the running scientific scripts."""
import argparse, hashlib, json, os, subprocess, sys, time
from pathlib import Path
sys.dont_write_bytecode=True
ROOT=Path(r"F:\Leontiev_Project")
D=ROOT/"dataset"
Q=ROOT/"runs"/"queue"
W=ROOT/"runs"/"knurl_cont"
PY=Path(r"C:\Users\Roman\AppData\Local\Programs\Python\Python314\python.exe")
sys.path.insert(0,str(D))
import jobqueue as JQ

def ps(command):
    r=subprocess.run(["powershell","-NoProfile","-Command",command],capture_output=True,text=True,encoding="utf-8",errors="replace",creationflags=subprocess.CREATE_NO_WINDOW)
    if r.returncode: raise RuntimeError(r.stderr.strip() or r.stdout.strip())
    return r.stdout.strip()
def now():
    return ps("[Console]::OutputEncoding=[System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false); Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd_HHmmss|dd.MM.yyyy HH:mm:ss zzz'")
def stamp(): return now().split("|",1)[0]
def load(p): return json.loads(Path(p).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
def save(p,x):
    p=Path(p); p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    tmp=p.with_suffix(p.suffix+".tmp")
    tmp.write_text(json.dumps(x,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),encoding="utf-8"); os.replace(tmp,p)
def sha(p):
    h=hashlib.sha256()
    with open(p,"rb") as f:
        for b in iter(lambda:f.read(1024*1024),b""):h.update(b)
    return h.hexdigest().upper()
def archive(p,move=False):
    p=Path(p)
    dest=p.with_name(p.stem+"_архив_"+stamp()+p.suffix)
    if dest.exists(): raise RuntimeError("archive already exists: "+str(dest))
    if dest.resolve().parent!=p.resolve().parent: raise RuntimeError("invalid archive path")
    if move: p.rename(dest)
    else:
        import shutil
        shutil.copy2(p,dest)
    return str(dest)
def journal(s):
    f=ROOT/"Журнал_работ.md"
    archive(f)
    with f.open("a",encoding="utf-8") as out:out.write("\n- "+now().split("|",1)[1]+" — тест ядер после W1: "+s+"\n")
    print(s,flush=True)
def procs():
    raw=ps("[Console]::OutputEncoding=[System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false); @(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.Name -match 'python|cx2420|fl_mpi2420|fl2420|RunWB2|AnsMeshingServer|AnsysWBU|SpaceClaim' } | Select-Object ProcessId,ParentProcessId,Name,CommandLine,CreationDate) | ConvertTo-Json -Compress")
    x=json.loads(raw) if raw else []
    return x if isinstance(x,list) else [x]
def solver_busy(pp):
    return [p for p in pp if any(t in p["Name"].lower() for t in ("cx2420","fl_mpi2420","fl2420","runwb2","ansmeshing","ansyswbu","spaceclaim"))]
def registered(planpath):
    p=Path(planpath)
    if sha(p)!=p.with_suffix(".sha256").read_text(encoding="utf-8").strip():raise RuntimeError("plan hash mismatch")
    plan=load(p)
    for f,h in plan["code_sha256"].items():
        fp=Path(f) if Path(f).is_absolute() else D/f
        if sha(fp)!=h:raise RuntimeError("code hash mismatch: "+str(fp))
    return plan
def require_own_hold(c):
    f=W/"HOLD"
    if not f.exists() or f.read_text(encoding="utf-8")!=c["hold_text"]:raise RuntimeError("HOLD missing/changed")
def w1_ready(res):
    return bool(res.get("W1",{}).get("done") and res["W1"].get("ok"))
def no_other_w_started(res):
    return not any(res.get(t,{}).get("done") for t in ("W2","W3"))
def boundary_ready(plan,res,pp,journal_tail):
    c=plan["coordination"]
    if not w1_ready(res) or not no_other_w_started(res):return False
    if solver_busy(pp):return False
    target=next((p for p in pp if int(p["ProcessId"])==int(c["original_w_pid"])),None)
    if not target or "knurl_cont.py" not in (target.get("CommandLine") or ""):return False
    if "HOLD перед W2 — жду снятия" not in journal_tail:return False
    return all(Path(plan["source"][k]).is_file() and Path(plan["source"][k]).stat().st_size>0 for k in ("case","data"))
def fail(plan,why):
    out=Path(plan["output"])
    save(out/"coordination_block.json",dict(why=why,time=now()))
    print("COORDINATION BLOCK: "+why,flush=True)
    return 3
def watch(planpath,plan):
    c=plan["coordination"]; out=Path(plan["output"]); statep=out/"coordination_state.json"
    state=load(statep) if statep.exists() else {}
    if state.get("transferred"):
        print("handoff already completed; no action");return 0
    require_own_hold(c)
    start=time.monotonic()
    while time.monotonic()-start<c["watch_timeout_s"]:
        registered(planpath)
        res=load(W/"results.json") if (W/"results.json").exists() else {}
        if (W/"BLOCK.json").exists():return fail(plan,"W BLOCK; benchmark not started")
        if res.get("W1",{}).get("done") and not res["W1"].get("ok"):return fail(plan,"W1 not accepted")
        pp=procs()
        if not any(int(p["ProcessId"])==int(c["original_w_pid"]) for p in pp):
            return fail(plan,"original W orchestrator absent; manual audit required, no blind restart")
        if w1_ready(res):
            require_own_hold(c)
            with (ROOT/"Журнал_работ.md").open("rb") as f:
                f.seek(0,2); n=f.tell();f.seek(max(0,n-65536));tail=f.read().decode("utf-8",errors="replace")
            if boundary_ready(plan,res,pp,tail):break
        time.sleep(c.get("poll_seconds",15))
    else:return fail(plan,"watch time budget reached")
    stop=Q/"STOP"
    if not stop.exists() or sha(stop)!=c["initial_stop_sha256"]:return fail(plan,"queue STOP changed; not removing another guard")
    state.update(boundary_confirmed=now(),w1_result=res["W1"])
    save(statep,state)
    # Kill only the waiting Python orchestrator. There is no Fluent/Workbench at this boundary.
    pid=int(c["original_w_pid"])
    ps("$p=Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter \"ProcessId = "+str(pid)+"\"; if (-not $p -or $p.Name -ne 'python.exe' -or $p.CommandLine -notlike '*knurl_cont.py*') { throw 'PID ownership mismatch' }; Stop-Process -Id "+str(pid)+" -ErrorAction Stop")
    deadline=time.monotonic()+180
    while time.monotonic()<deadline:
        pp=procs()
        if not any(int(p["ProcessId"]) in (int(c["original_w_pid"]),int(c["original_runner_pid"])) for p in pp):break
        time.sleep(2)
    else:return fail(plan,"original queue runner did not leave; not forcing it")
    if solver_busy(pp):return fail(plan,"unexpected solver after boundary; no handoff")
    # Preserve original return code; mark the old whole-series job as split, not completed.
    with JQ.locked():
        jobs=JQ.load()
        byid={j["id"]:j for j in jobs}
        if c["benchmark_job_id"] not in byid or c["resume_job_id"] not in byid:return fail(plan,"new queue jobs missing")
        if byid[c["benchmark_job_id"]]["status"]!="ждёт" or byid[c["resume_job_id"]]["status"]!="ждёт":return fail(plan,"new jobs already handled")
        archive(JQ.JOBS)
        old=byid[c["original_job_id"]]
        old.update(status="снято",split_after="W1",split_by="автор: тест 6/7/8 после текущего расчёта",split_jobs=[c["benchmark_job_id"],c["resume_job_id"]],
                   note="W1 завершена и сохранена. Ожидающий W2 оркестратор завершён на HOLD для вставки теста; исходный rc сохранён. W2/W3 продолжает "+c["resume_job_id"])
        JQ.save(jobs)
    state.update(transferred=now(),next_job=c["benchmark_job_id"])
    save(statep,state)
    journal("W1 принята и сохранена; на подтверждённой паузе перед W2 завершён только ожидающий Python, без прерывания CFD. "+c["original_job_id"]+" разделена; далее "+c["benchmark_job_id"]+" → "+c["resume_job_id"]+" → M1/M2. Старые код/планы не изменены.")
    if sha(stop)!=c["initial_stop_sha256"]:return fail(plan,"STOP changed during handoff")
    state["stop_archive"]=archive(stop,move=True);save(statep,state)
    ps("Start-ScheduledTask -TaskName 'Leontiev_queue_runner'")
    print("queue started for benchmark then resume",flush=True)
    return 0
