    record('CFD physics and gas/solid phases configured')
    for name,n in ns.items():
        if name.startswith('MESH_'):n.SendToSolver=False
    old=[o for o in model.Mesh.Children if str(o.Name)=='Structured_core']
    fm=old[0] if old else model.Mesh.AddFaceMeshing();fm.Name='Structured_core';fm.Location=ns['MESH_core_structured'].Location;fm.MappedMesh=True;fm.ConstrainBoundary=True
    record('face meshing configured')
    for section in sections:
        faces=[geo.GeoEntityById(i) for i in ns['MESH_'+section].Location.Ids]
        assert len(faces)==21 and all(len(f.Edges)==4 for f in faces)
        try:
            _v=json.load(open(r'F:\Leontiev_Project\dataset\current_variant.json'))
        except Exception:
            _v={}
        _ax=float(_v.get('axial_size_m') or .0005);_conv=int(_v.get('convergent_div') or 200)
        # stage A3 (07.10.2026): divisions per geometric wall strip (20 strips, first 1 um) and core radial divisions
        _lay=int(_v.get('layer_div') or 1);_core=int(_v.get('core_div') or 70)
        axial=int(math.ceil(max(geo.GeoEntityById(i).Length for i in ns['MESH_'+section+'_axial_edges'].Location.Ids)/_ax))
        if section=='convergent':axial=_conv
        # 08.10.2026 (mesh v2): nozzle axial divisions with growth from the throat cell to the channel cell (no x10 jump);
        # convergent wall strips may keep a coarser split than the rest (inlet reversed flow on the fine mesh)
        _ndiv=int(_v.get('nozzle_div') or 0);_nbias=float(_v.get('nozzle_bias') or 0)
        if section=='nozzle' and _ndiv:axial=_ndiv
        _lay_s=int(_v.get('layer_div_convergent') or _lay) if section=='convergent' else _lay
        prefix='Nozzle_' if section=='nozzle' else 'Nozzle_'+section+'_'
        for suffix,group,count in (('axial','_axial_edges',axial),('layers','_layer_edges',_lay_s),('core_radial' if section=='nozzle' else 'radial','_core_radial_edges',_core)):
            name=prefix+suffix;old=[o for o in model.Mesh.Children if str(o.Name)==name];o=old[0] if old else model.Mesh.AddSizing()
            o.Name=name;o.NamedSelection=ns['MESH_'+section+group];o.Type=SizingType.NumberOfDivisions;o.NumberOfDivisions=count;o.Behavior=SizingBehavior.Hard
            if group=='_axial_edges':
                if section=='nozzle' and _nbias>1:
                    # same convention as the core radial bias below: small cells at the end of a non-reversed edge;
                    # keep edges that end at the throat (low x), reverse the others
                    o.BiasType=BiasType.ooooo_ooo_o_o;o.BiasOption=BiasOptionType.Factor;o.BiasFactor=_nbias
                    reverse=[i for i in o.Location.Ids if list(geo.GeoEntityById(i).Vertices)[0].X<list(geo.GeoEntityById(i).Vertices)[-1].X]
                    if reverse:
                        info=ExtAPI.SelectionManager.CreateSelectionInfo(SelectionTypeEnum.GeometryEntities);info.Ids=reverse;o.ReverseBias=info
                else:

                if reverse:
                    info=ExtAPI.SelectionManager.CreateSelectionInfo(SelectionTypeEnum.GeometryEntities);info.Ids=reverse;o.ReverseBias=info
            record('sizing '+name,{'count':count,'ids':list(o.Location.Ids),'bias':str(o.BiasType)})
    bodies={str(b.Name).split('\\')[-1]:b for a in geo.Assemblies for p in a.Parts for b in p.Bodies}
    gas_edges=set(e.Id for e in bodies['air_dzv'].Edges)

    assert wallids

        if str(o.Name)=='Core_quadrilateral_method':o.NamedSelection=ns['MESH_core_structured']
    record('setup finished; no mesh generation yet')
except:record('python exception',traceback.format_exc())

"""Outlet temperatures of the real gas by enthalpy (author 08.10.2026: methane real gas is the plan gas; heating of the
SVZ is counted against throttling to the consumer pressure, cooling of the DZV against the inlet; Fluent total
temperatures are recorded as well).  Energy balance per channel (closes within ~1 W in the CFD):
    h0_out_svz = h0_in + Q / G_svz,   h0_out_dzv = h0_in - Q / G_dzv
Gas at rest after the outlet (consumer / pipe): T = T(h0_out, p_out) — CoolProp HEOS (methane).
Throttle reference: T(h0_in, p_out) — the same pressure reduction without the tube.
usage: from grs_temps import outlet_temps; outlet_temps(Q, G_svz, G_dzv, T0_K, p0_MPa, p_svz_out_MPa, p_dzv_out_MPa)"""
import CoolProp.CoolProp as CP

FLUID = 'Methane'


def outlet_temps(Q_W, G_svz, G_dzv, T0_K=298.15, p0_MPa=5.5, p_svz_out_MPa=0.3, p_dzv_out_MPa=5.2, p0_dzv_MPa=None,
                 T0_dzv_K=None):
    """09.10.2026: T0_dzv_K — separate DZV inlet temperature (heater on the SVZ line only); T0_K is the SVZ inlet.
    Changes are returned relative to each stream's own inlet temperature."""
    p0d = (p0_dzv_MPa or p0_MPa) * 1e6
    T0d = T0_dzv_K or T0_K
    h_in_s = CP.PropsSI('H', 'T', T0_K, 'P', p0_MPa * 1e6, FLUID)
    h_in_d = CP.PropsSI('H', 'T', T0d, 'P', p0d, FLUID)
    ps, pd = p_svz_out_MPa * 1e6, p_dzv_out_MPa * 1e6
    T_svz = CP.PropsSI('T', 'H', h_in_s + Q_W / G_svz, 'P', ps, FLUID)
    T_dzv = CP.PropsSI('T', 'H', h_in_d - Q_W / G_dzv, 'P', pd, FLUID)
    T_thr_s = CP.PropsSI('T', 'H', h_in_s, 'P', ps, FLUID)
    T_thr_d = CP.PropsSI('T', 'H', h_in_d, 'P', pd, FLUID)
    return dict(dT_svz_h=round(T_svz - T0_K, 3), dT_dzv_h=round(T_dzv - T0d, 3),
                dT_svz_throttle=round(T_thr_s - T0_K, 3), dT_dzv_throttle=round(T_thr_d - T0d, 3),
                dT_svz_vs_throttle=round(T_svz - T_thr_s, 3), dT_dzv_vs_throttle=round(T_dzv - T_thr_d, 3))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    print(outlet_temps(1506.8, 0.158237, 0.049462))

"""Project convergence checks; only closed, complete coupled reports may stop a run."""
import json
import math
from pathlib import Path
import leontiev_pipeline as L


STOP_LIMITS = {   # fixed for the whole plan (task A1); author's decision 07.10.2026:
    # mass unchanged (< 1 %, SVZ channel); energy <= 5 W absolute (was 0.1 W);
    # dT drift <= 0.05 K/100 it (was 0.02); Q drift <= 1 W/100 it (was 0.1 %/100 it, now in watts);
    # mass-flow drift <= 0.1 %/100 it (unchanged, now a separate criterion)
    'continuity': 2.5e-4, 'mass_svz_pct': 1.0, 'energy_W': 5.0,   # 12.10 author 1e-4 -> 1.5e-4; 15.10 author -> 2.5e-4 (plateau ~2e-4 on the 200-mm cell); others unchanged
    'drift_K_per_100': 0.05, 'drift_Q_W_per_100': 1.0, 'drift_flow_pct_per_100': 0.1,   # SVZ flow
    'drift_flow_dzv_pct_per_100': 0.3}   # 15.10 author: DZV flow drift 0.1 -> 0.3 %/100 it (SVZ flow stays 0.1)


def strict_checks(previous, current):
    """Stop criteria between two closed reports.  y+ is NOT a stop criterion (mesh quality flag, stage A3)."""
    delta = current['iteration'] - previous['iteration']
    if delta <= 0:
        return {}
    drift = max(abs(current[k] - previous[k]) for k in ('dT_svz', 'dT_dzv')) * 100 / delta
    dQ = abs(current['Q'] - previous['Q']) * 100 / delta
    rel, rel_dzv = (abs(current[k] - previous[k]) / max(abs(current[k]), 1e-12) * 100 * 100 / delta for k in ('m_svz', 'm_dzv'))
    values = {
        'continuity': (current['continuity'], STOP_LIMITS['continuity'], False),
        'mass_svz_pct': (abs(current['dm']), STOP_LIMITS['mass_svz_pct'], True),
        'energy_W': (abs(current['net']), STOP_LIMITS['energy_W'], False),
        'drift_K_per_100': (drift, STOP_LIMITS['drift_K_per_100'], False),
        'drift_Q_W_per_100': (dQ, STOP_LIMITS['drift_Q_W_per_100'], False),
        'drift_flow_pct_per_100': (rel, STOP_LIMITS['drift_flow_pct_per_100'], False),
        'drift_flow_dzv_pct_per_100': (rel_dzv, STOP_LIMITS['drift_flow_dzv_pct_per_100'], False),
    }
    finite = all(math.isfinite(current[k]) and math.isfinite(previous[k])
                 for k in ('continuity', 'dm', 'net', 'dT_svz', 'dT_dzv', 'Q', 'm_svz', 'm_dzv'))
    return {k: {'value': value, 'passed': finite and (value < limit if exclusive else value <= limit)}
            for k, (value, limit, exclusive) in values.items()}


def channel_energy(fl):
    """Energy imbalance of each part (author 07.10, option б: recorded, not a stop criterion).
    Wall pairs: zone without '-shadow' = brass side, '-shadow' = gas side (same for every build).
    The three sums add up to the total 'net' (checked on a1_n95_545, edge03, ref085/grs)."""
    g = lambda k: fl.get(k, 0.0)
    return dict(e_svz=g('inlet_svz') + g('outlet_svz') + g('wall-air_svz-wall_abonite-shadow'),
                e_dzv=g('inlet_dzv') + g('outlet_dzv') + g('interior-air_dzv-wall_abonite-shadow'),
                e_solid=g('wall-air_svz-wall_abonite') + g('interior-air_dzv-wall_abonite') + g('wall-wall_abonite'))


def closed_samples(out):
    rows = []
    for path in sorted(Path(out).glob('coupled_*.trn')):
        text = path.read_text(encoding='utf-8', errors='replace')
        # stop-transcript issued from Scheme writes no "Transcript Stop Time" footer (07.10): a block is
        # closed once its report has been written completely
        if 'GRS_SAMPLE_END' not in text:
            continue
        samples, residuals = L.parse_trn(path)
        if not samples or not residuals:
            continue
        s, r = samples[-1], residuals[-1]
        required = ('inlet_mass_flow_rate_svz', 'outlet_mass_flow_rate_svz',
                    'outlet_total_temp_svz', 'outlet_total_temp_dzv', 'net', 'yp_svz', 'yp_dzv')
        if not all(k in s for k in required):
            continue
        mass = s['inlet_mass_flow_rate_svz']
        md = s.get('inlet_mass_flow_rate_dzv', float('nan'))
        rows.append(dict(iteration=r['it'], sample=s['sample'], continuity=r['continuity'],
                         dm=100*(mass+s['outlet_mass_flow_rate_svz'])/mass if mass else float('nan'),
                         dm_dzv=100*(md+s.get('outlet_mass_flow_rate_dzv', float('nan')))/md if md else float('nan'),
                         dT_svz=s['outlet_total_temp_svz']-25, dT_dzv=s['outlet_total_temp_dzv']-25,
                         Q=s['flux'].get('interior-air_dzv-wall_abonite', float('nan')),
                         **channel_energy(s['flux']),
                         m_svz=mass, m_dzv=s.get('inlet_mass_flow_rate_dzv', float('nan')),
                         net=s['net'], yp_svz=s['yp_svz'], yp_dzv=s['yp_dzv']))
    return rows


def decision(rows, consecutive=2):   # 2 checks x 500 it = criteria hold over the last 1000 iterations
    if len(rows) < consecutive + 1:
        return False
    pairs = zip(rows[-consecutive-1:-1], rows[-consecutive:])
    return all(bool(c := strict_checks(a, b)) and all(x['passed'] for x in c.values()) for a, b in pairs)


def write_control(out, stop):
    path = Path(out) / 'convergence_control.scm'
    text = '(set! grs-stop? %s)\n' % ('#t' if stop else '#f')
    if path.exists() and path.read_text(encoding='ascii') == text:
        return
    tmp = path.with_suffix('.tmp')
    tmp.write_text(text, encoding='ascii')
    tmp.replace(path)


def update_control(out, enabled=True, max_iter=None):
    rows = closed_samples(out)
    stop = enabled and decision(rows)
    # iteration limit enforced by the runner (author 07.10: 8000 -> 6000 coupled), so it also applies to runs
    # whose journal was written with a larger number of blocks
    limit = bool(max_iter and rows and rows[-1]['iteration'] >= max_iter)
    write_control(out, stop or limit)
    result = dict(stop_requested=stop, limit_reached=limit and not stop, max_iter=max_iter, complete_reports=len(rows),
                  checked_iteration=rows[-1]['iteration'] if rows else None,
                  required_consecutive=2, includes_yplus=False, limits=STOP_LIMITS,
                  checks=strict_checks(rows[-2], rows[-1]) if len(rows) > 1 else {})
    (Path(out) / 'convergence.json').write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False), encoding='utf-8')
    return result


def coupled_journal(p, out):
    """Bounded blocks, flushed report files, then a normal case/data save in the caller.

    The runner evaluates previous completed blocks during the next block. A requested
    stop takes effect at the next block boundary; no process interruption is needed.
    """
    n, every = int(p['coupled_iters']), int(p.get('report_every', 500))
    if n < 1 or every < 1:
        raise ValueError('Число итераций и интервал отчёта должны быть положительными.')
    write_control(out, False)
    q = L.fl(out)
    lines = ['/file/stop-transcript'] + list(L.SOLVER_HEADER)
    lines += [f"(rpsetvar 'pressure/cpl-courant-number {float(p['cfl'])})",
              f"(rpsetvar 'pressure-coupled/courant-number {float(p['cfl'])})",
              '(define grs-stop? #f)', '(define grs-completed 0)']
    for idx, start in enumerate(range(0, n, every), 1):
        count = min(every, n-start)
        path = f'{q}/coupled_{idx:05d}.trn'
        lines += [f'(load "{q}/convergence_control.scm")', '(if (not grs-stop?) (begin',
                  f' (ti-menu-load-string "/file/start-transcript \\\"{path}\\\"")',
                  f' (ti-menu-load-string "/solve/iterate {count}")',
                  f' (set! grs-completed (+ grs-completed {count}))',
                  L.REPORT_BLOCK.format(it='grs-completed'),
                  ' (ti-menu-load-string "/file/stop-transcript")',
                  # author 07.10: wait ~15 s after each report so the runner can evaluate it and set the stop
                  # flag before the next block starts (otherwise one extra block of 500 it after convergence)
                  ' (system "ping -n 16 127.0.0.1 > nul")', '))']
    lines += [f'/file/start-transcript "{q}/finish.trn"',
              '(display "GRS_COUPLED_COMPLETED ") (write grs-completed) (newline)',
              '(display "GRS_STOP_REQUESTED ") (write grs-stop?) (newline)']
    return lines

FILE: dataset/gui_convergence_архив_20261007_0915.py

"""Project convergence checks; only closed, complete coupled reports may stop a run."""
import json
import math
from pathlib import Path
import leontiev_pipeline as L


def strict_checks(previous, current):
    delta = current['iteration'] - previous['iteration']
    if delta <= 0:
        return {}
    drift = max(abs(current[k] - previous[k]) for k in ('dT_svz', 'dT_dzv')) * 100 / delta
    values = {
        'continuity': (current['continuity'], 1e-4, False),
        'mass_svz_pct': (abs(current['dm']), 1.0, True),
        'energy_W': (abs(current['net']), 0.1, False),
        'drift_K_per_100': (drift, 0.02, True),
        'yplus_max': (max(current['yp_svz'], current['yp_dzv']), 1.0, False),
    }
    finite = all(math.isfinite(current[k]) and math.isfinite(previous[k])
                 for k in ('continuity', 'dm', 'net', 'yp_svz', 'yp_dzv', 'dT_svz', 'dT_dzv'))
    return {k: {'value': value, 'passed': finite and (value < limit if exclusive else value <= limit)}
            for k, (value, limit, exclusive) in values.items()}


def closed_samples(out):
    rows = []
    for path in sorted(Path(out).glob('coupled_*.trn')):
        text = path.read_text(encoding='utf-8', errors='replace')
        if 'Transcript Stop Time:' not in text:
            continue
        samples, residuals = L.parse_trn(path)
        if not samples or not residuals:
            continue
        s, r = samples[-1], residuals[-1]
        required = ('inlet_mass_flow_rate_svz', 'outlet_mass_flow_rate_svz',
                    'outlet_total_temp_svz', 'outlet_total_temp_dzv', 'net', 'yp_svz', 'yp_dzv')
        if not all(k in s for k in required):
            continue
        mass = s['inlet_mass_flow_rate_svz']
        rows.append(dict(iteration=r['it'], sample=s['sample'], continuity=r['continuity'],
                         dm=100*(mass+s['outlet_mass_flow_rate_svz'])/mass if mass else float('nan'),
                         dT_svz=s['outlet_total_temp_svz']-25, dT_dzv=s['outlet_total_temp_dzv']-25,
                         net=s['net'], yp_svz=s['yp_svz'], yp_dzv=s['yp_dzv']))
    return rows


def decision(rows, consecutive=3):
    if len(rows) < consecutive + 1:
        return False
    pairs = zip(rows[-consecutive-1:-1], rows[-consecutive:])
    return all(bool(c := strict_checks(a, b)) and all(x['passed'] for x in c.values()) for a, b in pairs)


def write_control(out, stop):
    path = Path(out) / 'convergence_control.scm'
    text = '(set! grs-stop? %s)\n' % ('#t' if stop else '#f')
    if path.exists() and path.read_text(encoding='ascii') == text:
        return
    tmp = path.with_suffix('.tmp')
    tmp.write_text(text, encoding='ascii')
    tmp.replace(path)


def update_control(out, enabled=True):
    rows = closed_samples(out)
    stop = enabled and decision(rows)
    write_control(out, stop)
    result = dict(stop_requested=stop, complete_reports=len(rows),
                  checked_iteration=rows[-1]['iteration'] if rows else None,
                  required_consecutive=3, includes_yplus=True,
                  checks=strict_checks(rows[-2], rows[-1]) if len(rows) > 1 else {})
    (Path(out) / 'convergence.json').write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False), encoding='utf-8')
    return result


def coupled_journal(p, out):
    """Bounded blocks, flushed report files, then a normal case/data save in the caller.

    The runner evaluates previous completed blocks during the next block. A requested
    stop takes effect at the next block boundary; no process interruption is needed.
    """
    n, every = int(p['coupled_iters']), int(p.get('report_every', 500))
    if n < 1 or every < 1:
        raise ValueError('Число итераций и интервал отчёта должны быть положительными.')
    write_control(out, False)
    q = L.fl(out)
    lines = ['/file/stop-transcript'] + list(L.SOLVER_HEADER)
    lines += [f"(rpsetvar 'pressure/cpl-courant-number {float(p['cfl'])})",
              f"(rpsetvar 'pressure-coupled/courant-number {float(p['cfl'])})",
              '(define grs-stop? #f)', '(define grs-completed 0)']
    for idx, start in enumerate(range(0, n, every), 1):
        count = min(every, n-start)
        path = f'{q}/coupled_{idx:05d}.trn'
        lines += [f'(load "{q}/convergence_control.scm")', '(if (not grs-stop?) (begin',
                  f' (ti-menu-load-string "/file/start-transcript \\\"{path}\\\"")',
                  f' (ti-menu-load-string "/solve/iterate {count}")',
                  f' (set! grs-completed (+ grs-completed {count}))',
                  L.REPORT_BLOCK.format(it='grs-completed'),
                  ' (ti-menu-load-string "/file/stop-transcript")', '))']
    lines += [f'/file/start-transcript "{q}/finish.trn"',
              '(display "GRS_COUPLED_COMPLETED ") (write grs-completed) (newline)',

"""Project convergence checks; only closed, complete coupled reports may stop a run."""
import json
import math
from pathlib import Path
import leontiev_pipeline as L


STOP_LIMITS = {   # project thresholds (v4 "строгие критерии"), fixed for the whole plan (task A1)
    'continuity': 1e-4, 'mass_svz_pct': 1.0, 'energy_W': 0.1,
    'drift_K_per_100': 0.02, 'drift_rel_pct_per_100': 0.1}


def strict_checks(previous, current):
    """Stop criteria between two closed reports.  y+ is NOT a stop criterion (mesh quality flag, stage A3)."""
    delta = current['iteration'] - previous['iteration']
    if delta <= 0:
        return {}
    drift = max(abs(current[k] - previous[k]) for k in ('dT_svz', 'dT_dzv')) * 100 / delta
    rel = max(abs(current[k] - previous[k]) / max(abs(current[k]), 1e-12) for k in ('Q', 'm_svz', 'm_dzv')) * 100 * 100 / delta
    values = {
        'continuity': (current['continuity'], STOP_LIMITS['continuity'], False),

    if len(rows) < consecutive + 1:
        return False
    pairs = zip(rows[-consecutive-1:-1], rows[-consecutive:])
    return all(bool(c := strict_checks(a, b)) and all(x['passed'] for x in c.values()) for a, b in pairs)


def write_control(out, stop):
    path = Path(out) / 'convergence_control.scm'
    text = '(set! grs-stop? %s)\n' % ('#t' if stop else '#f')
    if path.exists() and path.read_text(encoding='ascii') == text:
        return
    tmp = path.with_suffix('.tmp')
    tmp.write_text(text, encoding='ascii')
    tmp.replace(path)


def update_control(out, enabled=True):
    rows = closed_samples(out)
    stop = enabled and decision(rows)
    write_control(out, stop)
    result = dict(stop_requested=stop, complete_reports=len(rows),
                  checked_iteration=rows[-1]['iteration'] if rows else None,
                  required_consecutive=2, includes_yplus=False, limits=STOP_LIMITS,
                  checks=strict_checks(rows[-2], rows[-1]) if len(rows) > 1 else {})
    (Path(out) / 'convergence.json').write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False), encoding='utf-8')
    return result


def coupled_journal(p, out):
    """Bounded blocks, flushed report files, then a normal case/data save in the caller.

    The runner evaluates previous completed blocks during the next block. A requested
    stop takes effect at the next block boundary; no process interruption is needed.
    """
    n, every = int(p['coupled_iters']), int(p.get('report_every', 500))
    if n < 1 or every < 1:
        raise ValueError('Число итераций и интервал отчёта должны быть положительными.')
    write_control(out, False)
    q = L.fl(out)
    lines = ['/file/stop-transcript'] + list(L.SOLVER_HEADER)
    lines += [f"(rpsetvar 'pressure/cpl-courant-number {float(p['cfl'])})",
              f"(rpsetvar 'pressure-coupled/courant-number {float(p['cfl'])})",
              '(define grs-stop? #f)', '(define grs-completed 0)']
    for idx, start in enumerate(range(0, n, every), 1):
        count = min(every, n-start)
        path = f'{q}/coupled_{idx:05d}.trn'
        lines += [f'(load "{q}/convergence_control.scm")', '(if (not grs-stop?) (begin',
                  f' (ti-menu-load-string "/file/start-transcript \\\"{path}\\\"")',
                  f' (ti-menu-load-string "/solve/iterate {count}")',
                  f' (set! grs-completed (+ grs-completed {count}))',
                  L.REPORT_BLOCK.format(it='grs-completed'),
                  ' (ti-menu-load-string "/file/stop-transcript")', '))']
    lines += [f'/file/start-transcript "{q}/finish.trn"',
              '(display "GRS_COUPLED_COMPLETED ") (write grs-completed) (newline)',
              '(display "GRS_STOP_REQUESTED ") (write grs-stop?) (newline)']
    return lines

"""Project convergence checks; only closed, complete coupled reports may stop a run."""
import json
import math
from pathlib import Path
import leontiev_pipeline as L


STOP_LIMITS = {   # fixed for the whole plan (task A1); author's decision 07.10.2026:
    # mass unchanged (< 1 %, SVZ channel); energy <= 5 W absolute (was 0.1 W);
    # dT drift <= 0.05 K/100 it (was 0.02); Q drift <= 1 W/100 it (was 0.1 %/100 it, now in watts);
    # mass-flow drift <= 0.1 %/100 it (unchanged, now a separate criterion)
    'continuity': 1e-4, 'mass_svz_pct': 1.0, 'energy_W': 5.0,
    'drift_K_per_100': 0.05, 'drift_Q_W_per_100': 1.0, 'drift_flow_pct_per_100': 0.1}


def strict_checks(previous, current):
    """Stop criteria between two closed reports.  y+ is NOT a stop criterion (mesh quality flag, stage A3)."""
    delta = current['iteration'] - previous['iteration']
    if delta <= 0:
        return {}
    drift = max(abs(current[k] - previous[k]) for k in ('dT_svz', 'dT_dzv')) * 100 / delta
    dQ = abs(current['Q'] - previous['Q']) * 100 / delta
    rel = max(abs(current[k] - previous[k]) / max(abs(current[k]), 1e-12) for k in ('m_svz', 'm_dzv')) * 100 * 100 / delta
    values = {
        'continuity': (current['continuity'], STOP_LIMITS['continuity'], False),
        'mass_svz_pct': (abs(current['dm']), STOP_LIMITS['mass_svz_pct'], True),
        'energy_W': (abs(current['net']), STOP_LIMITS['energy_W'], False),
        'drift_K_per_100': (drift, STOP_LIMITS['drift_K_per_100'], False),
        'drift_Q_W_per_100': (dQ, STOP_LIMITS['drift_Q_W_per_100'], False),
        'drift_flow_pct_per_100': (rel, STOP_LIMITS['drift_flow_pct_per_100'], False),
    }
    finite = all(math.isfinite(current[k]) and math.isfinite(previous[k])
                 for k in ('continuity', 'dm', 'net', 'dT_svz', 'dT_dzv', 'Q', 'm_svz', 'm_dzv'))
    return {k: {'value': value, 'passed': finite and (value < limit if exclusive else value <= limit)}
            for k, (value, limit, exclusive) in values.items()}


def closed_samples(out):
    rows = []
    for path in sorted(Path(out).glob('coupled_*.trn')):
        text = path.read_text(encoding='utf-8', errors='replace')
        # stop-transcript issued from Scheme writes no "Transcript Stop Time" footer (07.10): a block is
        # closed once its report has been written completely
        if 'GRS_SAMPLE_END' not in text:
            continue
        samples, residuals = L.parse_trn(path)
        if not samples or not residuals:
            continue
        s, r = samples[-1], residuals[-1]
        required = ('inlet_mass_flow_rate_svz', 'outlet_mass_flow_rate_svz',
                    'outlet_total_temp_svz', 'outlet_total_temp_dzv', 'net', 'yp_svz', 'yp_dzv')
        if not all(k in s for k in required):
            continue
        mass = s['inlet_mass_flow_rate_svz']
        md = s.get('inlet_mass_flow_rate_dzv', float('nan'))
        rows.append(dict(iteration=r['it'], sample=s['sample'], continuity=r['continuity'],
                         dm=100*(mass+s['outlet_mass_flow_rate_svz'])/mass if mass else float('nan'),
                         dm_dzv=100*(md+s.get('outlet_mass_flow_rate_dzv', float('nan')))/md if md else float('nan'),
                         dT_svz=s['outlet_total_temp_svz']-25, dT_dzv=s['outlet_total_temp_dzv']-25,
                         Q=s['flux'].get('interior-air_dzv-wall_abonite', float('nan')),
                         m_svz=mass, m_dzv=s.get('inlet_mass_flow_rate_dzv', float('nan')),
                         net=s['net'], yp_svz=s['yp_svz'], yp_dzv=s['yp_dzv']))
    return rows


def decision(rows, consecutive=2):   # 2 checks x 500 it = criteria hold over the last 1000 iterations
    if len(rows) < consecutive + 1:
        return False
    pairs = zip(rows[-consecutive-1:-1], rows[-consecutive:])
    return all(bool(c := strict_checks(a, b)) and all(x['passed'] for x in c.values()) for a, b in pairs)


def write_control(out, stop):
    path = Path(out) / 'convergence_control.scm'
    text = '(set! grs-stop? %s)\n' % ('#t' if stop else '#f')
    if path.exists() and path.read_text(encoding='ascii') == text:
        return
    tmp = path.with_suffix('.tmp')
    tmp.write_text(text, encoding='ascii')
    tmp.replace(path)


def update_control(out, enabled=True):
    rows = closed_samples(out)
    stop = enabled and decision(rows)
    write_control(out, stop)
    result = dict(stop_requested=stop, complete_reports=len(rows),
                  checked_iteration=rows[-1]['iteration'] if rows else None,
                  required_consecutive=2, includes_yplus=False, limits=STOP_LIMITS,
                  checks=strict_checks(rows[-2], rows[-1]) if len(rows) > 1 else {})
    (Path(out) / 'convergence.json').write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False), encoding='utf-8')
    return result


def coupled_journal(p, out):
    """Bounded blocks, flushed report files, then a normal case/data save in the caller.

    The runner evaluates previous completed blocks during the next block. A requested
    stop takes effect at the next block boundary; no process interruption is needed.
    """
    n, every = int(p['coupled_iters']), int(p.get('report_every', 500))
    if n < 1 or every < 1:
        raise ValueError('Число итераций и интервал отчёта должны быть положительными.')
    write_control(out, False)
    q = L.fl(out)
    lines = ['/file/stop-transcript'] + list(L.SOLVER_HEADER)
    lines += [f"(rpsetvar 'pressure/cpl-courant-number {float(p['cfl'])})",
              f"(rpsetvar 'pressure-coupled/courant-number {float(p['cfl'])})",
              '(define grs-stop? #f)', '(define grs-completed 0)']
    for idx, start in enumerate(range(0, n, every), 1):
        count = min(every, n-start)
        path = f'{q}/coupled_{idx:05d}.trn'
        lines += [f'(load "{q}/convergence_control.scm")', '(if (not grs-stop?) (begin',
                  f' (ti-menu-load-string "/file/start-transcript \\\"{path}\\\"")',
                  f' (ti-menu-load-string "/solve/iterate {count}")',
                  f' (set! grs-completed (+ grs-completed {count}))',
                  L.REPORT_BLOCK.format(it='grs-completed'),
                  ' (ti-menu-load-string "/file/stop-transcript")', '))']
    lines += [f'/file/start-transcript "{q}/finish.trn"',
              '(display "GRS_COUPLED_COMPLETED ") (write grs-completed) (newline)',
              '(display "GRS_STOP_REQUESTED ") (write grs-stop?) (newline)']
    return lines

              '(display "GRS_COUPLED_COMPLETED ") (write grs-completed) (newline)',
              '(display "GRS_STOP_REQUESTED ") (write grs-stop?) (newline)']
    return lines


===========================================================================
FILE: dataset/gui_convergence_архив_20261012_0800.py
===========================================================================
"""Project convergence checks; only closed, complete coupled reports may stop a run."""
import json
import math
from pathlib import Path
import leontiev_pipeline as L


STOP_LIMITS = {   # fixed for the whole plan (task A1); author's decision 07.10.2026:
    # mass unchanged (< 1 %, SVZ channel); energy <= 5 W absolute (was 0.1 W);
    # dT drift <= 0.05 K/100 it (was 0.02); Q drift <= 1 W/100 it (was 0.1 %/100 it, now in watts);
    # mass-flow drift <= 0.1 %/100 it (unchanged, now a separate criterion)
    'continuity': 1e-4, 'mass_svz_pct': 1.0, 'energy_W': 5.0,
    'drift_K_per_100': 0.05, 'drift_Q_W_per_100': 1.0, 'drift_flow_pct_per_100': 0.1}


def strict_checks(previous, current):
    """Stop criteria between two closed reports.  y+ is NOT a stop criterion (mesh quality flag, stage A3)."""
    delta = current['iteration'] - previous['iteration']
    if delta <= 0:
        return {}
    drift = max(abs(current[k] - previous[k]) for k in ('dT_svz', 'dT_dzv')) * 100 / delta
    dQ = abs(current['Q'] - previous['Q']) * 100 / delta
    rel = max(abs(current[k] - previous[k]) / max(abs(current[k]), 1e-12) for k in ('m_svz', 'm_dzv')) * 100 * 100 / delta
    values = {
        'continuity': (current['continuity'], STOP_LIMITS['continuity'], False),
        'mass_svz_pct': (abs(current['dm']), STOP_LIMITS['mass_svz_pct'], True),
        'energy_W': (abs(current['net']), STOP_LIMITS['energy_W'], False),
        'drift_K_per_100': (drift, STOP_LIMITS['drift_K_per_100'], False),
        'drift_Q_W_per_100': (dQ, STOP_LIMITS['drift_Q_W_per_100'], False),
        'drift_flow_pct_per_100': (rel, STOP_LIMITS['drift_flow_pct_per_100'], False),
    }
    finite = all(math.isfinite(current[k]) and math.isfinite(previous[k])
                 for k in ('continuity', 'dm', 'net', 'dT_svz', 'dT_dzv', 'Q', 'm_svz', 'm_dzv'))
    return {k: {'value': value, 'passed': finite and (value < limit if exclusive else value <= limit)}
            for k, (value, limit, exclusive) in values.items()}


def channel_energy(fl):
    """Energy imbalance of each part (author 07.10, option б: recorded, not a stop criterion).
    Wall pairs: zone without '-shadow' = brass side, '-shadow' = gas side (same for every build).
    The three sums add up to the total 'net' (checked on a1_n95_545, edge03, ref085/grs)."""
    g = lambda k: fl.get(k, 0.0)
    return dict(e_svz=g('inlet_svz') + g('outlet_svz') + g('wall-air_svz-wall_abonite-shadow'),
                e_dzv=g('inlet_dzv') + g('outlet_dzv') + g('interior-air_dzv-wall_abonite-shadow'),
                e_solid=g('wall-air_svz-wall_abonite') + g('interior-air_dzv-wall_abonite') + g('wall-wall_abonite'))


def closed_samples(out):
    rows = []
    for path in sorted(Path(out).glob('coupled_*.trn')):
        text = path.read_text(encoding='utf-8', errors='replace')
        # stop-transcript issued from Scheme writes no "Transcript Stop Time" footer (07.10): a block is
        # closed once its report has been written completely
        if 'GRS_SAMPLE_END' not in text:
            continue
        samples, residuals = L.parse_trn(path)
        if not samples or not residuals:
            continue
        s, r = samples[-1], residuals[-1]
        required = ('inlet_mass_flow_rate_svz', 'outlet_mass_flow_rate_svz',
                    'outlet_total_temp_svz', 'outlet_total_temp_dzv', 'net', 'yp_svz', 'yp_dzv')
        if not all(k in s for k in required):
            continue
        mass = s['inlet_mass_flow_rate_svz']
        md = s.get('inlet_mass_flow_rate_dzv', float('nan'))
        rows.append(dict(iteration=r['it'], sample=s['sample'], continuity=r['continuity'],
                         dm=100*(mass+s['outlet_mass_flow_rate_svz'])/mass if mass else float('nan'),
                         dm_dzv=100*(md+s.get('outlet_mass_flow_rate_dzv', float('nan')))/md if md else float('nan'),
                         dT_svz=s['outlet_total_temp_svz']-25, dT_dzv=s['outlet_total_temp_dzv']-25,
                         Q=s['flux'].get('interior-air_dzv-wall_abonite', float('nan')),
                         **channel_energy(s['flux']),
                         m_svz=mass, m_dzv=s.get('inlet_mass_flow_rate_dzv', float('nan')),
                         net=s['net'], yp_svz=s['yp_svz'], yp_dzv=s['yp_dzv']))
    return rows


def decision(rows, consecutive=2):   # 2 checks x 500 it = criteria hold over the last 1000 iterations
    if len(rows) < consecutive + 1:
        return False
    pairs = zip(rows[-consecutive-1:-1], rows[-consecutive:])
    return all(bool(c := strict_checks(a, b)) and all(x['passed'] for x in c.values()) for a, b in pairs)


def write_control(out, stop):
    path = Path(out) / 'convergence_control.scm'
    text = '(set! grs-stop? %s)\n' % ('#t' if stop else '#f')
    if path.exists() and path.read_text(encoding='ascii') == text:
        return
    tmp = path.with_suffix('.tmp')
    tmp.write_text(text, encoding='ascii')
    tmp.replace(path)


def update_control(out, enabled=True, max_iter=None):
    rows = closed_samples(out)
    stop = enabled and decision(rows)
    # iteration limit enforced by the runner (author 07.10: 8000 -> 6000 coupled), so it also applies to runs
    # whose journal was written with a larger number of blocks
    limit = bool(max_iter and rows and rows[-1]['iteration'] >= max_iter)
    write_control(out, stop or limit)
    result = dict(stop_requested=stop, limit_reached=limit and not stop, max_iter=max_iter, complete_reports=len(rows),
                  checked_iteration=rows[-1]['iteration'] if rows else None,
                  required_consecutive=2, includes_yplus=False, limits=STOP_LIMITS,
                  checks=strict_checks(rows[-2], rows[-1]) if len(rows) > 1 else {})
    (Path(out) / 'convergence.json').write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False), encoding='utf-8')
    return result


def coupled_journal(p, out):
    """Bounded blocks, flushed report files, then a normal case/data save in the caller.

    The runner evaluates previous completed blocks during the next block. A requested
    stop takes effect at the next block boundary; no process interruption is needed.
    """
    n, every = int(p['coupled_iters']), int(p.get('report_every', 500))
    if n < 1 or every < 1:
        raise ValueError('Число итераций и интервал отчёта должны быть положительными.')
    write_control(out, False)
    q = L.fl(out)
    lines = ['/file/stop-transcript'] + list(L.SOLVER_HEADER)
    lines += [f"(rpsetvar 'pressure/cpl-courant-number {float(p['cfl'])})",
              f"(rpsetvar 'pressure-coupled/courant-number {float(p['cfl'])})",
              '(define grs-stop? #f)', '(define grs-completed 0)']
    for idx, start in enumerate(range(0, n, every), 1):
        count = min(every, n-start)
        path = f'{q}/coupled_{idx:05d}.trn'
        lines += [f'(load "{q}/convergence_control.scm")', '(if (not grs-stop?) (begin',
                  f' (ti-menu-load-string "/file/start-transcript \\\"{path}\\\"")',
                  f' (ti-menu-load-string "/solve/iterate {count}")',
                  f' (set! grs-completed (+ grs-completed {count}))',
                  L.REPORT_BLOCK.format(it='grs-completed'),
                  ' (ti-menu-load-string "/file/stop-transcript")',
                  # author 07.10: wait ~15 s after each report so the runner can evaluate it and set the stop
                  # flag before the next block starts (otherwise one extra block of 500 it after convergence)
                  ' (system "ping -n 16 127.0.0.1 > nul")', '))']
    lines += [f'/file/start-transcript "{q}/finish.trn"',
              '(display "GRS_COUPLED_COMPLETED ") (write grs-completed) (newline)',
              '(display "GRS_STOP_REQUESTED ") (write grs-stop?) (newline)']
    return lines

        lines += [f'(load "{q}/convergence_control.scm")', '(if (not grs-stop?) (begin',
                  f' (ti-menu-load-string "/file/start-transcript \\\"{path}\\\"")',
                  f' (ti-menu-load-string "/solve/iterate {count}")',
                  f' (set! grs-completed (+ grs-completed {count}))',
                  L.REPORT_BLOCK.format(it='grs-completed'),
                  ' (ti-menu-load-string "/file/stop-transcript")',
                  # author 07.10: wait ~15 s after each report so the runner can evaluate it and set the stop
                  # flag before the next block starts (otherwise one extra block of 500 it after convergence)
                  ' (system "ping -n 16 127.0.0.1 > nul")', '))']
    lines += [f'/file/start-transcript "{q}/finish.trn"',
              '(display "GRS_COUPLED_COMPLETED ") (write grs-completed) (newline)',
              '(display "GRS_STOP_REQUESTED ") (write grs-stop?) (newline)']
    return lines

"""31.10.2026 — вкладка «Решение (главный инженер)», перестройка по замечаниям автора 31.10 (сутки без автора):
 • сверху крупно рядом со статусом — какой уровень ответил: «по готовой карте / подбор по модели / нужен расчёт / вне области»;
 • кнопки «Утвердить / Отклонить / Заказать расчёт» → запись в журнал решений (runs\\journal\\Журнал_решений.md);
 • при «досчитать» и «нет данных» (в т. ч. накатка) — «Посчитать при этих условиях» прямо здесь (в очередь — после подтверждения,
   с обязательным «зачем»; точки вне Ω и с перепадом < 5 кПа не ставятся; накатка — по D-30);
 • рекомендация группами: условия станции / что выбирает проектировщик (трубы, t/d, L, накатка) / что выбирает эксплуатация
   (задвижка, подогреватель) / результат; погрешность — от всех четырёх выходов модели (не «± 0,0»); p — «p = … при пороге …»;
 • график справа: топливо, кВт и СПГ, кг/ч от перепада задвижки, закрашены «вне области» и «скачок»; ниже — «тепло Q — потеря давления ДЗВ».
Расход — м³/ч при стандартных условиях (20 °C, 101,325 кПа): 5000 м³/ч = 0,928 кг/с."""

    def _pump(self):
        while self._todo:
            try:
                self._todo.pop(0)()
            except Exception as e:
                self.act_lab.config(text=f'ошибка окна: {e!r}')
        self.after(200, self._pump)

    def set_result(self, res):
        self.res = res; self.show()

    def show(self):
        if not self.res:
            return
        import sppr
        s = self.res['seasons'][self.season.get()]
        d, base, b, card, form = s['d'], s['base'], s['d'].get('best'), s['card'], self.res['form']

            cool = card['T_main'] - b['T_dzv'] if b.get('T_dzv') is not None else None
            L += ['ВЫБИРАЕТ ПРОЕКТИРОВЩИК',
                  f"  число труб {b['n']} (не больше {tb.get('n_max', '—')}: {card['flow_nm3h']:.0f} м³/ч / расход одной трубы {tb.get('g_tube', float('nan')):.4f} кг/с)",
                  f"  шаг труб t/d (плотность пучка) {b['td']:g};  длина теплообмена L {b['L']:.0f} мм;  труба — {kind_text(b['kind'])}",
                  'ВЫБИРАЕТ ЭКСПЛУАТАЦИЯ',
                  f"  перепад задвижки ДЗВ {b['dp']:g} кПа;  подогреватель {z}: до сопел {b.get('pre', 0):.1f} + после пучка {b.get('post', 0):.1f} кВт",
                  f"  T СВЗ перед соплами {card['T_main'] + heat:+.1f} °C (подогрев {heat:.1f} K)",
                  'РЕЗУЛЬТАТ',
                  f"  топливо (всё тепло) {pmv(b['N'], e.get('N'))} кВт  ({b['fuel']:.2f} м³/ч газа)",
                  '  СПГ ' + (f"{pmv(b['lng'], e.get('lng'))} кг/ч" if card['dzv_to'] == 'СПГ' else 'нет (сценарий без СПГ)'),
                  f"  T газа потребителю не ниже {card['T_min']:+.0f} °C (уставка подогревателя)",

                  f"  труба: эффект {o['effect_K']:+.2f} ± {o['sigma_K']:.2f} K; тепло {o['Q']:.0f} ± {o.get('sigma_Q', 0):.0f} Вт; доля ДЗВ m {o['m']:.3f} ± {o.get('sigma_m', 0):.3f}; "

                L.append(f"  транзит: газ ДЗВ уходит при {b.get('p_dzv', float('nan')):.3f} МПа (потеря {b['dp']:g} кПа)" +

            L.append('  источник: ' + (f"Fluent, расчёт {o['src']}" if o.get('cfd') else
                                         f"модель ГП по {self.res['n_train']} точкам Fluent (заморожено), σ × {sppr.SIGMA_MULT:g}; подбор {self.res['time']}"))
        else:
            L += ['РЕКОМЕНДАЦИИ НЕТ — см. причину и «Что делать дальше».']
        self.rec.config(text='\n'.join(L))

        vb, lb = s.get('vb'), s.get('lng_b')

        self.bs.insert('', 'end', values=('как сейчас: клапан + подогреватель', f"{base['Q_heater_kW']:.1f}", f"{base['fuel_nm3h']:.2f}", '0'))
        self.bs.insert('', 'end', values=('+ установка СПГ без пучка (сырьё — как газ ДЗВ)', f"{vb['Q_heater_kW']:.1f}" if vb else 'нет данных',

                self.tops.insert('', 'end', values=(who, why, '', '', '', '', '')); continue
            er = sp.get(id(r)) or {}
            self.tops.insert('', 'end', values=(who, f"{kind_text(r['kind'])}, t/d {r['td']:g}, L {r['L']:.0f} мм", r['n'], f"{r['dp']:g}", pmv(r['N'], er.get('N')),
                                                pmv(r['lng'], er.get('lng')) if card['dzv_to'] == 'СПГ' else '—', STATUS.get(r['rule'], ('—',))[0]))

        self.actions(s, d, b, card, form)
        self.src.config(text=f"данные: {self.res['n_train']} точек Fluent в обучении (заморожено); порог класса p = {self.res['p_hi']:.3f}; "
                             'программа только рекомендует — на станции ничем не управляет')

    def draw(self, s, b, card):
        a = self.ax1; a.clear()
        if getattr(self, 'tw', None) is not None:   # вторая ось (СПГ) прошлого подбора — убрать, иначе линии рисуются дважды
            self.tw.remove(); self.tw = None
        ch = s.get('chart') or []
        if ch:
            xs = [c[0] for c in ch]
            edges = [xs[0] - (xs[1] - xs[0]) / 2 if len(xs) > 1 else xs[0] - 1] + [(xs[i] + xs[i + 1]) / 2 for i in range(len(xs) - 1)] + \
                    [xs[-1] + (xs[-1] - xs[-2]) / 2 if len(xs) > 1 else xs[0] + 1]
            lab = set()
            for i, (dp, N, lng, cat, m, p) in enumerate(ch):
                zone = 'скачок' if p < 0.5 or 'скачок' in cat else ('вне области' if not (0.2 <= m <= 0.96) or cat.startswith('П1') else None)
                if zone:
                    a.axvspan(edges[i], edges[i + 1], color='#f4c7c3' if zone == 'скачок' else '#d9d9d9', alpha=0.8,
                              label=None if zone in lab else zone); lab.add(zone)
            pts = [(c[0], c[1]) for c in ch if c[1] is not None]
            a.plot([q[0] for q in pts], [q[1] for q in pts], 'o-', color='tab:red', label='топливо, кВт')
            a.set_ylabel('топливо, кВт', color='tab:red', fontsize=8)
            if card['dzv_to'] == 'СПГ':
                a2 = self.tw = a.twinx()
                pl = [(c[0], c[2]) for c in ch if c[2] is not None]
                a2.plot([q[0] for q in pl], [q[1] for q in pl], 's--', color='tab:blue', label='СПГ, кг/ч')
                a2.set_ylabel('СПГ, кг/ч', color='tab:blue', fontsize=8); a2.tick_params(labelsize=7)
            if b:
                a.axvline(b['dp'], color='k', lw=1, ls=':'); a.plot([b['dp']], [b['N']], '*', color='k', ms=13, label='выбранный')
            a.legend(fontsize=6, loc='upper left')
            a.set_title(f"Топливо и СПГ от перепада задвижки (t/d {b['td']:g}, L {b['L']:.0f} мм, {b['n']} труб(ы) по месту, подогреватель {b['z']})", fontsize=8)
        else:
            a.text(0.5, 0.5, 'нет данных для графика (выбрана точка Fluent или нет варианта)', ha='center', transform=a.transAxes, fontsize=8)
        a.set_xlabel('перепад задвижки ДЗВ, кПа', fontsize=8); a.tick_params(labelsize=7); a.grid(alpha=0.3)
        a = self.ax2; a.clear()
        for ln, sty, colr in ((s['sm_line'], 'o-', 'tab:blue'), (s.get('sm_ref'), 'o--', 'tab:gray')):
            if ln and ln[2]:
                (td, Lm), z, pts = ln
                x = [p[0] for p in pts]; y = [p[1] for p in pts]; e = [p[2] for p in pts]
                a.plot(x, y, sty, color=colr, label=f'гладкая t/d {td:g}, L {Lm:.0f} мм (модель ± σ)')
                a.fill_between(x, np.array(y) - e, np.array(y) + e, color=colr, alpha=0.15)
        if s['kn_pts']:
            a.plot([p[0] for p in s['kn_pts']], [p[1] for p in s['kn_pts']], 'D-', color='tab:orange', label='накатка (Fluent)')
        else:
            a.text(0.02, 0.95, 'накатка: нет данных при этих условиях', transform=a.transAxes, fontsize=7, color='tab:orange', va='top')
        a.set_xlabel('потеря давления ДЗВ, кПа', fontsize=8); a.set_ylabel('тепло одной трубы Q, Вт', fontsize=8)
        a.set_title('Тепло Q — потеря давления ДЗВ', fontsize=8); a.tick_params(labelsize=7); a.grid(alpha=0.3); a.legend(fontsize=6, loc='lower right')
        self.fig.tight_layout(); self.canvas.draw_idle()

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    def actions(self, s, d, b, card, form):
        for w in self.act_box.winfo_children():
            w.destroy()
        self.to_order = []
        txt = []
        if d['rule'] == 'П2' and d.get('calc'):
            c = d['calc']
            self.to_order.append(dict(kind='гладкая', td=c['td'], L=c['L'], dp=float(c['dp']), pm=card['p_main'], pc=card['p_cons'], T=card['T_main'],
                                      heat=float(c.get('heat') or 0.0) if c['z'] == 'до сопел' else 0.0, h=0.0, pitch=0.0, ar=2.151))
            txt.append(f"ДОСЧИТАТЬ: нужен расчёт Fluent — {kind_text(c['kind'])}, t/d {c['td']:g}, L {c['L']:.0f} мм, перепад {c['dp']:g} кПа; "
                       f"прогноз до расчёта: эффект {c['o']['effect_K']:+.2f} ± {c['o']['sigma_K']:.2f} K, m {c['o']['m']:.2f}.")
        if form['knurl'] and not s.get('knurl_at'):
            for h, pch in KNURL_NODATA:
                self.to_order.append(dict(kind='накатка', td=1.4, L=400.0, dp=30.0, pm=card['p_main'], pc=card['p_cons'], T=card['T_main'], heat=0.0,
                                          h=h, pitch=pch, ar=2.151))
            txt.append('НАКАТКА — нет данных при этих условиях: можно посчитать накатку 0,1 / 0,3 / 1,0 мм (шаг 2 мм, t/d 1,4, L 400, перепад 30 кПа) '
                       'по D-30 (с нуля).')
        if d['rule'] == 'П1':
            txt.append('ВЕРНУТЬ ЗАДАЧУ — что вне области и ближайшее допустимое:\n• ' + '\n• '.join(s['outside'] or [d['why']]) +
                       ('\nЧто сделать: ' + '; '.join(s.get('todo') or []) if s.get('todo') else ''))
        if d['rule'] == 'П3' and not txt:
            txt.append('ВЫДАТЬ: рекомендацию можно утвердить (кнопка «Утвердить» — запись в журнал решений). Режимная карта для диспетчера — этап 3.')
        self.act_lab.config(text='\n'.join(txt))
        if self.to_order:
            ttk.Label(self.act_box, text='Зачем (что изменит в тексте / в решении):').pack(side='left')
            self.why_e = tk.Entry(self.act_box, width=70); self.why_e.pack(side='left', padx=4)
            self.why_e.insert(0, f"решение задачи «{card['title']}»: статус {STATUS.get(d['rule'], ('',))[0]} → проверка расчётом Fluent")
            ttk.Button(self.act_box, text=f'Посчитать при этих условиях ({len(self.to_order)})', command=lambda: self.order(self.to_order)).pack(side='left', padx=6)

    def journal(self, what):
        s = self.res['seasons'][self.season.get()]
        d, b, card = s['d'], s['d'].get('best'), s['card']
        rec = (f"{kind_text(b['kind'])}, t/d {b['td']:g}, L {b['L']:.0f} мм, труб {b['n']}, задвижка {b['dp']:g} кПа, подогреватель {b['z']}; "
               f"топливо {b['N']:.1f} кВт, СПГ {b['lng']:.1f} кг/ч") if b else '—'
        with open(JOURNAL, 'a', encoding='utf-8') as f:
            f.write(f"\n## Решение главного инженера (интерфейс, {time.strftime('%d.%m.%Y %H:%M')}): {card['title']}\n\n| Поле | Значение |\n|---|---|\n"
                    f"| Условия | магистраль {card['p_main']:g} МПа, потребитель {card['p_cons']:g} МПа, {card['flow_nm3h']:.0f} м³/ч (ст. усл. 20 °C), "
                    f"газ {card['T_main']:+.1f} °C, T потребителю ≥ {card['T_min']:+.0f} °C, газ ДЗВ — {card['dzv_to']}, цель — {card['goal']} |\n"
                    f"| Статус программы | {d['status']} ({d.get('cat')}); ответ — {LEVEL_TEXT[s['level']]} |\n| Рекомендация | {rec} |\n| Решение ЛПР | **{what}** |\n")

    def decide(self, what):
        if not self.res:
            return
        if messagebox.askyesno('Решение главного инженера', f'Записать в журнал решений: «{what}»?'):
            self.journal(what); messagebox.showinfo('Журнал решений', f'Записано: {what} (runs\\journal\\Журнал_решений.md)')

    def order_best(self):
        if not self.res:
            return
        s = self.res['seasons'][self.season.get()]
        b, card = s['d'].get('best'), s['card']
        if self.to_order:
            return self.order(self.to_order)
        if not b or b['kind'] != 'гладкий':
            messagebox.showinfo('Заказать расчёт', 'Выбранный вариант — точка Fluent или варианта нет: заказывать нечего.'); return
        self.order([dict(kind='гладкая', td=b['td'], L=b['L'], dp=float(b['dp']), pm=card['p_main'], pc=card['p_cons'], T=card['T_main'],
                         heat=float(b.get('heat') or 0.0) if b['z'] == 'до сопел' else 0.0, h=0.0, pitch=0.0, ar=2.151)], check=True)

    def order(self, pts, check=False):
        why = getattr(self, 'why_e', None).get().strip() if getattr(self, 'why_e', None) and self.why_e.winfo_exists() else ''
        if check or bad_why(why):
            import tkinter.simpledialog as sd
            why = sd.askstring('Зачем этот расчёт', 'Что изменит в тексте / в решении (не «тест»):', initialvalue=why, parent=self) or ''
        if bad_why(why):
            messagebox.showerror('Заказать расчёт', 'Нужно поле «зачем» (не пустое и не «тест») — без него в очередь не ставится.'); return
        M = models()
        put, skip = [], []
        for p in pts:
            if p['dp'] < 5.0:
                skip.append(f"перепад {p['dp']:g} кПа < 5"); continue
            if p['kind'] == 'гладкая':
                o = M.predict(p['td'], p['L'], p['dp'], p['pc'], p['T'], p['heat'], p['pm'])
                if not (0.2 <= o['m'] <= 0.96):
                    skip.append(f"t/d {p['td']}, L {p['L']:.0f}, перепад {p['dp']:g}: прогноз m {o['m']:.2f} вне Ω"); continue
                p = dict(p, _fc=o)
            put.append(p)
        if not put:
            messagebox.showinfo('Заказать расчёт', 'Ничего не поставлено: ' + '; '.join(skip)); return
        if not messagebox.askyesno('Заказать расчёт', f"Поставить в общую очередь {len(put)} расчёт(а) Fluent (перед запасной работой)?" +
                                   ('\nНе ставятся: ' + '; '.join(skip) if skip else '')):
            return
        import jobqueue as JQ, gui_series as GS
        fc = json.loads(GS.FC.read_text(encoding='utf-8')) if GS.FC.exists() else {}
        made = []
        for kind in ('гладкая', 'накатка'):
            grp = [p for p in put if p['kind'] == kind]
            if not grp:
                continue
            no = GS.next_series_no()
            q = [dict(tag=f'IF{no:03d}_{k:02d}', **{x: p[x] for x in ('td', 'L', 'pm', 'pc', 'dp', 'T', 'heat', 'h', 'pitch', 'ar')}) for k, p in enumerate(grp, 1)]
            r = JQ.add([dict(series=f"решение главного инженера: {kind}, {len(q)} расч.", kind='point', series_no=no, tube=kind, points=q, mesh=None,
                             plan='вкладка «Решение»' + ('; накатка — D-30' if kind == 'накатка' else ''), stdout=f'runs\\station\\IF{no:03d}_stdout.txt',
                             est_h=(3.0 if kind == 'накатка' else 1.0) * len(q), text_change=why,
                             passport=dict(kind=kind, geometry=dict(t_d=q[0]['td'], L_mm=q[0]['L']), regime=dict(p_main=q[0]['pm'], p_cons=q[0]['pc'],
                                                                                                                   dp_dzv_kPa=q[0]['dp'], T0_dzv=q[0]['T'])))],
                       by='главный инженер (интерфейс, вкладка «Решение»)', after=GS.backup_after())
            for p, qq in zip(grp, q):
                o = p.get('_fc') or {}
                fc[qq['tag']] = dict(job=r[0]['id'], kind=kind, point=qq, x=o.get('x'), effect_K=o.get('effect_K'), sigma_K=o.get('sigma_K'), m=o.get('m'),
                                     p=o.get('p'), time=time.strftime('%d.%m.%Y %H:%M:%S'), status='в очереди', в_обучение=False)
            made.append(f"{r[0]['id']} ({kind}, {len(q)})")
        GS.FC.write_text(json.dumps(fc, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1), encoding='utf-8')
        self.journal('заказан расчёт: ' + ', '.join(made))
        messagebox.showinfo('Заказать расчёт', 'Поставлено: ' + ', '.join(made) + '. Прогноз до расчёта записан; запись — в журнале решений.')
