"""Night 13->14.10.2026 (author: plan item 2) — COUNTERFLOW against the experiment, Leontiev et al. 2017, Table 2 run 2
(M 1.8, P0 1.05 MPa, T0 299 K, smooth DZV, countercurrent; Fig. 7: runs 1 (co-) and 2 (counter-) lie on one curve:
dTc -11.8 / -8.9 / -6.0 / -5.5 / -5.0 K and dTh +1.2 / +2.6 / +3.7 / +3.8 / +4.1 K at m 0.11 / 0.30 / 0.60 / 0.75 / 0.95;
the paper: 'the flow organization pattern has no appreciable effect').
Model: the accepted A5 rig (geometry v5 with dzv_counterflow, resolved DZV mesh 40 layers, air k(T), brass 110, SST,
Prt 0.85), global pseudo step (Conservative).  A template of the counterflow rig mesh (10 it.), the converged co-flow
field of the same m interpolated, the DZV gas started MOVING in the counterflow direction; DZV outlet pressures as in
the accepted co-flow points.  Points: m ~0.26 (1.04746 MPa), ~0.63 (1.03762), ~0.75 (1.033195).  Reference m = 0 is
the same as for co-flow (no DZV flow): +0.026 K (extrapolated, A5 v3b).  Waits for run_knurl_eq_m.py."""
import sys, time, traceback
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0, r'F:\Leontiev_Project\dataset')
import run_night1213 as R        # Conservative global pseudo step in L.SOLVER_HEADER
import run_a5v3b6 as B6
import cont_util as U
import leontiev_pipeline as L
import gui_runner as G
import run_a3 as A3
B5, B, A = B6.B5, B6.B, B6.A
F, P = R.F, R.P
U.NPROC, U.CFL = 7, 20.0
ATM = 0.101325
EXP = {0.11: (-11.8, 1.2), 0.30: (-8.9, 2.6), 0.60: (-6.0, 3.7), 0.75: (-5.5, 3.8), 0.95: (-5.0, 4.1)}   # Fig. 7, +-0.3 K
DT_H0 = 0.026
DZV_AREA = 3.14159 * (0.016 ** 2 - 0.0145 ** 2)


def exp_at(m, i):
    pts = sorted((k, v[i]) for k, v in EXP.items())
    for (a, fa), (b, fb) in zip(pts, pts[1:]):
        if a <= m <= b:
            return fa + (fb - fa) * (m - a) / (b - a)
    return None


def template():
    p = dict(G.DEFAULTS)
    p.update(A3.MESHES['work_v2'], **A.RIG)
    p.update(run_id='a5cf_tpl', prt=0.85, mesh_custom=True, wait_free=True, gas='air', wall_k=110.0, dzv_layers=40,
             dzv_counterflow=True, p0_svz_MPa=1.05, p_out_svz_MPa=0.1, p0_dzv_MPa=1.05, p_out_dzv_MPa=1.048,
             extra_lines=[U.t0_line(A.T0_C)], retries=0, startup_iters=10, coupled_iters=10, cfl=5.0)
    G.RUNS = A.BASE
    A.log('=== противоток против опыта (run 2): шаблон стенда с противотоком ДЗВ')
    G.run(p, lambda s: A.log('  ' + s), lambda: False)
    return A.BASE / 'a5cf_tpl' / 'result.cas.h5'


def point(tpl, src, tag, pod, g_dzv):
    U.LIMIT = 6000
    ip = A.BASE / 'ip_cf' / f'{src}.ip'
    ip.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    if not (ip.exists() or F.write_ip_from(A.BASE / src / 'result.cas.h5', ip)):
        return A.log(f'  {tag}: нет файла переноса')
    u = -g_dzv / (12.2 * DZV_AREA)
    init = [f'/file/interpolate/read-data "{L.fl(ip)}"', f'/solve/patch air_dzv () pressure {pod / ATM:.5f}',
            f'/solve/patch air_dzv () temperature {A.T0_C}', f'/solve/patch air_dzv () x-velocity ok {u:.2f}',
            '/solve/patch air_dzv () y-velocity ok 0', '/solve/patch air_dzv () k 0.1', '/solve/patch air_dzv () omega 1000',
            f'/solve/patch wall_abonite () temperature {A.T0_C - 2}']
    mins = U.continue_case(tpl, A.BASE / tag, A.TMF_OFF + init, (B.P0, 0.1, B.P0, pod), A.log, tag, t0_C=A.T0_C)
    r = U.record(A.CSV, tag, 'rig_work_v2_counterflow', 'air', (B.P0, 0.1, B.P0, pod), A.BASE / tag, mins, A.log,
                 start=f'перенос поля {src} (прямоток) на стенд с противотоком; ДЗВ с {u:.1f} м/с', t0_C=A.T0_C, l_heat_mm=700.0)
    try:
        m = float(r['G_dzv']) / float(r['G_svz'])
        dtc, dth = float(r['dT_dzv_total']), float(r['dT_svz_total']) - DT_H0
        ec, eh = exp_at(m, 0), exp_at(m, 1)
        A.log(f'  противоток {tag}: m {m:.3f}; ΔTc {dtc:+.2f} (опыт {ec if ec is None else round(ec, 2)}); '
              f'ΔTh {dth:+.2f} (опыт {eh if eh is None else round(eh, 2)}); Q {r.get("Q")} Вт; статус {r.get("status")}')
        r0 = B6.rows_of(src)
        A.log(f'  прямоток {src}: ΔTc {float(r0["dT_dzv_total"]):+.2f}, ΔTh {float(r0["dT_svz_total"]) - DT_H0:+.2f}, Q {r0["Q"]} Вт')
    except Exception:
        pass


def write_ip_from(case, ip):
    q = L.fl(ip.parent)
    jou = ip.with_suffix('.jou')
    jou.write_text('\n'.join([f'/file/read-case-data "{L.fl(case)}"', f'/file/interpolate/write-data "{L.fl(ip)}" yes yes',
                              '/exit yes']) + '\n', encoding='ascii')
    t = time.time()
    try:
        __import__('subprocess').Popen([L.FLUENT, '2ddp', '-t1', '-g', '-i', str(jou)], cwd=str(ip.parent)).wait(900)
    finally:
        G.kill_since(t)
    return ip.exists()


F.write_ip_from = write_ip_from


def main():
    while P.running('run_knurl_eq_m'):
        time.sleep(60)
    tpl = template()
    if not tpl.exists():
        return A.log('  шаблон стенда с противотоком не построен — остановка')
    for src, tag, pod in (('a5v3_m030i', 'a5cf_m030', 1.04746), ('a5v3_m075i', 'a5cf_m063', 1.03762),
                          ('a5v3_m075e', 'a5cf_m075', 1.033195)):
        g = float(B6.rows_of(src)['G_dzv'])
        try:
            point(tpl, src, tag, pod, g)
        except Exception:
            A.log(f'{tag}: ОШИБКА программы: ' + traceback.format_exc())


if __name__ == '__main__':
    P.qlog('=== противоток против опыта (run 2) — ждёт окончания накатки')
    try:
        main()
    except Exception:
        A.log('противоток: ОШИБКА программы: ' + traceback.format_exc())
    P.qlog('=== противоток против опыта — закончен')

FILE: dataset/run_a5_counterflow2.py

"""13.10.2026 22:50 — counterflow vs the experiment, second try.  With the global pseudo step the three points diverged
at once (AMG divergence / FPE at it. 20 after the field transfer + DZV patch) — as the 'Aggressive' check on m075e did.
The accepted A5 points were obtained from transferred fields with the LOCAL time step (formulation 0), CFL 5 — the same
here (this process does not import the global-step patch).  Template a5cf_tpl and the .ip files are reused."""
import sys, time, traceback
sys.path.insert(0, r'F:\Leontiev_Project\dataset')
import run_a5v3b6 as B6
import cont_util as U
import leontiev_pipeline as L
B5, B, A = B6.B5, B6.B, B6.A
U.NPROC, U.CFL, U.LIMIT = 7, 5.0, 8000
assert not any('formulation 1' in x for x in L.SOLVER_HEADER)
ATM = 0.101325
EXP = {0.11: (-11.8, 1.2), 0.30: (-8.9, 2.6), 0.60: (-6.0, 3.7), 0.75: (-5.5, 3.8), 0.95: (-5.0, 4.1)}   # Fig. 7
DT_H0 = 0.026
DZV_AREA = 3.14159 * (0.016 ** 2 - 0.0145 ** 2)


def exp_at(m, i):
    pts = sorted((k, v[i]) for k, v in EXP.items())
    for (a, fa), (b, fb) in zip(pts, pts[1:]):
        if a <= m <= b:
            return fa + (fb - fa) * (m - a) / (b - a)
    return None


def point(src, tag, pod):
    g = float(B6.rows_of(src)['G_dzv'])
    u = -g / (12.2 * DZV_AREA)
    ip = A.BASE / 'ip_cf' / f'{src}.ip'
    init = [f'/file/interpolate/read-data "{L.fl(ip)}"', f'/solve/patch air_dzv () pressure {pod / ATM:.5f}',
            f'/solve/patch air_dzv () temperature {A.T0_C}', f'/solve/patch air_dzv () x-velocity ok {u:.2f}',
            '/solve/patch air_dzv () y-velocity ok 0', '/solve/patch air_dzv () k 0.1', '/solve/patch air_dzv () omega 1000',
            f'/solve/patch wall_abonite () temperature {A.T0_C - 2}']
    tpl = A.BASE / 'a5cf_tpl' / 'result.cas.h5'
    mins = U.continue_case(tpl, A.BASE / tag, A.TMF_OFF + init, (B.P0, 0.1, B.P0, pod), A.log, tag, t0_C=A.T0_C)
    r = U.record(A.CSV, tag, 'rig_work_v2_counterflow', 'air', (B.P0, 0.1, B.P0, pod), A.BASE / tag, mins, A.log,
                 start=f'перенос поля {src} (прямоток) на стенд с противотоком; ДЗВ с {u:.1f} м/с; CFL 5 локальный шаг',
                 t0_C=A.T0_C, l_heat_mm=700.0)
    try:
        m = float(r['G_dzv']) / float(r['G_svz'])
        dtc, dth = float(r['dT_dzv_total']), float(r['dT_svz_total']) - DT_H0
        ec, eh = exp_at(m, 0), exp_at(m, 1)
        r0 = B6.rows_of(src)
        A.log(f'  ПРОТИВОТОК {tag}: m {m:.3f}; ΔTc {dtc:+.2f} (опыт {ec if ec is None else round(ec, 2)}); ΔTh {dth:+.2f} '
              f'(опыт {eh if eh is None else round(eh, 2)}); Q {r.get("Q")} Вт; статус {r.get("status")} | прямоток {src}: '
              f'ΔTc {float(r0["dT_dzv_total"]):+.2f}, ΔTh {float(r0["dT_svz_total"]) - DT_H0:+.2f}, Q {r0["Q"]} Вт')
    except Exception:
        pass


if __name__ == '__main__':
    B6.P if hasattr(B6, 'P') else None
    A.qlog('=== противоток против опыта, повтор с локальным шагом CFL 5 — начат')
    for src, tag, pod in (('a5v3_m030i', 'a5cf2_m030', 1.04746), ('a5v3_m075i', 'a5cf2_m063', 1.03762),
                          ('a5v3_m075e', 'a5cf2_m075', 1.033195)):
        try:
            point(src, tag, pod)
        except Exception:
            A.log(f'{tag}: ОШИБКА программы: ' + traceback.format_exc())
    A.qlog('=== противоток против опыта (повтор) — закончен')

"""A5 diagnostics (09.10.2026 night, agreed by the author 22:20): the experiment check (run 1, Fig. 8a) showed the model
heat transfer 40-47 % below the experiment at m 0.3-0.77 (12 % at m 0.11).  Short series on the rig geometry v3:
  D1  m 0.30 (targeted flow 0.01473 kg/s) — continuation of the non-converged a5v3_m030
  D2  m 0.77 with Prt 0.65 (sensitivity) + its own m = 0 base (dTh = T*h2(m) - T*h2(0) needs the same model)
  D3  m 0.77 with realizable k-epsilon + enhanced wall treatment + its own m = 0 base
Rows -> runs\\a5v3\\a5_diag_results.csv; log runs\\a5v3\\a5v3_log.txt."""
import sys, time, traceback
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0, r'F:\Leontiev_Project\dataset')
import cont_util as U
import run_a5v3 as A
from make_gui_prt_journal import GUI_PRT

CSV = A.BASE / 'a5_diag_results.csv'
REG = (1.05, 0.1, 1.05, 1.0)
KE = ['/define/models/viscous/ke-realizable? yes', '/define/models/viscous/near-wall-treatment/enhanced-wall-treatment? yes',
      "(rpsetvar 'k/scheme 1)", "(rpsetvar 'epsilon/scheme 1)"]


def prt(v):
    return [g.format(prt=v) for g in GUI_PRT[:2]]   # rpsetvar keprt / wallprt only (no GUI panel)


def run(tag, src, extra, g_target=None, base=False):
    out = A.BASE / tag
    lines = list(extra) + (A.TMF_OFF if base else A.tmf(g_target))
    reg = (1.05, 0.1, 1.05, 1.05) if base else REG
    m = U.continue_case(src, out, lines, reg, A.log, tag, t0_C=A.T0_C)
    r = U.record(CSV, tag, 'rig_work_v2', 'air', reg, out, m, A.log, start=f'продолжение {Path(src).parent.name}',
                 t0_C=A.T0_C, l_heat_mm=700.0, g_dzv_target=g_target)
    return r, out / 'result.cas.h5'


def compare(tag, r, r0, m_exp):
    try:
        mc = float(r['G_dzv']) / float(r['G_svz'])
        dtc = float(r['dT_dzv_total']); dth = float(r['dT_svz_total']) - float(r0['dT_svz_total'])
        A.log(f'  {tag}: m {mc:.3f}; ΔTc {dtc:+.2f} (опыт {A.exp_at(mc, 0) if hasattr(A, "exp_at") else m_exp[0]}) K; '
              f'ΔTh {dth:+.2f} K (опыт {m_exp[1]:+.1f}); Q {r["Q"]} Вт; сошёлся {r.get("converged")}, опорный {r0.get("converged")}')
    except Exception:
        A.log(f'  {tag}: сравнение не получено')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    A.qlog('=== А5 диагностика (D1–D3) — начат')
    try:
        B = A.BASE
        run('a5d_m030_cont', B / 'a5v3_m030' / 'result.cas.h5', [], 0.30 * A.G_SUP)
        r2, _ = run('a5d_prt065_m075', B / 'a5v3_m075' / 'result.cas.h5', prt(0.65), 0.75 * A.G_SUP)
        r20, _ = run('a5d_prt065_m000', B / 'a5v3_m000' / 'result.cas.h5', prt(0.65), base=True)
        compare('Prt 0,65', r2, r20, (-5.5, 3.8))
        r3, _ = run('a5d_ke_m075', B / 'a5v3_m075' / 'result.cas.h5', KE, 0.75 * A.G_SUP)
        r30, _ = run('a5d_ke_m000', B / 'a5v3_m000' / 'result.cas.h5', KE, base=True)
        compare('k-ε realizable', r3, r30, (-5.5, 3.8))
    except Exception:
        A.log('ОШИБКА программы: ' + traceback.format_exc())
    A.qlog('=== А5 диагностика (D1–D3) — закончен (приёмка — по результатам)')

"""Stage A5 on geometry v3 «as in the experiment» (agreed 08.10/09.10.2026: experiment check before the dataset, one
night).  Leontiev, Zditovets et al., Exp. Therm. Fluid Sci. 88 (2017) 202-219, Table 2 run 1: M_is 1.8, concurrent
flows, smooth subsonic channel, P*h1 = P*c1 = 1.05 MPa, T*h1 299.0 K, T*c1 298.9 K, G_sup 0.0491 kg/s, m 0.108-0.752.
Points read from Fig. 8a (литература\\опыт_2017_точки_с_рисунков.csv, +-0.3 K; the text, sect. 4.4.2, ties Fig. 8a
to runs 1 and 3, i.e. run 1 = smooth channel, concurrent):  m 0.11: dTc -11.8, dTh +1.2;  0.30: -8.9, +2.6;
0.75: -5.5, +3.8 K.   dTh(m) = T*h2(m) - T*h2(m=0) (Eq. 14),  dTc(m) = T*c2(m) - T*0 (Eq. 15).
Model: geometry v3 (cone 6 -> 14 mm over 400 mm + cylinder 14 mm to 700 mm, brass OD 29 mm -> wall 11.5 mm at the
inlet, DZV gap 1.5 mm, throat d 5.0 mm, nozzle exit d 6.0 mm, Izotov nozzle), work_v2 mesh settings, air ideal gas
with k(T), SST + Prt 0.85, brass k = 110, outer DZV wall adiabatic (rig: steel tube to the room, a_a 5-10 W/(m2 K) —
neglected), SVZ outlet 0.1 MPa (receiver near-atmospheric; supersonic exit), T0 299.0 K (25.85 C) at both inlets.
The DZV flow is set as in the rig — by the mass flow (Fluent targeted mass flow at outlet_dzv, syntax checked 09.10).
Order: (S) from scratch with a fixed small DZV pressure drop -> m = 0.30 -> 0.11 -> 0.75 (targeted mass flow,
continuations) -> m = 0 (outlet = inlet pressure, no DZV flow; reference of Eq. 14).
Waits for run_after_0909.py.  Rows -> runs\\a5v3\\a5v3_results.csv (cont_util.record), summary a5v3_summary.csv."""
import csv, subprocess, sys, time, traceback
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0, r'F:\Leontiev_Project\dataset')
import gui_runner as G
import run_a3 as A3
import cont_util as U

BASE = Path(r'F:\Leontiev_Project\runs\a5v3')
CSV = BASE / 'a5v3_results.csv'
QLOG = Path(r'F:\Leontiev_Project\runs\queue_log.txt')
T0_C = 25.85
G_SUP = 0.0491
EXP = {0.11: (-11.8, 1.2), 0.30: (-8.9, 2.6), 0.75: (-5.5, 3.8)}   # m: (dTc, dTh), Fig. 8a, +-0.3 K
RIG = dict(r_end_mm=7.0, l_heat_mm=700.0, l_cone_mm=400.0, gap_mm=1.5, r_nozzle_exit_mm=3.0, r_throat_mm=2.5,
           wall_thickness_inlet_mm=11.5, neck_ratio=1.0, r_outlet_mm=7.0, l_exit_recovery_mm=12.0, l_exit_tail_mm=5.0,
           r_exit_rounding_mm=100.0)


def log(s):
    line = time.strftime('%H:%M:%S ') + s
    print(line, flush=True)
    BASE.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with (BASE / 'a5v3_log.txt').open('a', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        f.write(line + '\n')


def qlog(s):
    with QLOG.open('a', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        f.write(time.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S ') + s + '\n')


def running(name):
    out = subprocess.run(['powershell', '-NoProfile', '-Command',
                          f"Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter \"Name='python.exe'\" | ? {{$_.CommandLine -match '{name}'}} | Measure-Object | % Count"],
                         capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.strip()
    return out not in ('', '0')


def tmf(g):
    # absolute-pressure limits in atm (case units): 3 atm .. 10.362 atm (p0 1.05 MPa = 10.3627 atm)
    return [f'/define/boundary-conditions/set/pressure-outlet outlet_dzv () targeted-mf-boundary? yes targeted-mf no {g:g} '
            'targeted-mf-pmin no 3 targeted-mf-pmax no 10.362 q']


TMF_OFF = ['/define/boundary-conditions/set/pressure-outlet outlet_dzv () targeted-mf-boundary? no q']


def main():
    p = dict(G.DEFAULTS)
    p.update(A3.MESHES['work_v2'], **RIG)
    p.update(run_id='a5v3_start', prt=0.85, mesh_custom=True, wait_free=True, gas='air', wall_k=110.0,
             p0_svz_MPa=1.05, p_out_svz_MPa=0.1, p0_dzv_MPa=1.05, p_out_dzv_MPa=1.048,
             extra_lines=[U.t0_line(T0_C)])
    G.RUNS = BASE
    log('=== А5 v3 («как в опыте», run 1 табл. 2): с нуля, ДЗВ 1,05 -> 1,048 МПа (стартовое поле)')
    t0 = time.time()
    G.run(p, lambda s: log('  ' + s), lambda: False)
    start = BASE / p['run_id']
    U.record(CSV, 'a5v3_start', 'rig_work_v2', 'air', (1.05, 0.1, 1.05, 1.048), start, round((time.time() - t0) / 60, 1),
             log, start='с нуля (FMG)', t0_C=T0_C, l_heat_mm=700.0)
    prev = start / 'result.cas.h5'
    if not prev.exists():
        return log('А5 v3: нет стартового решения — остановка')
    rows = {}
    for m in (0.30, 0.11, 0.75):
        tag = f'a5v3_m{int(round(m * 100)):03d}'
        out = BASE / tag
        mins = U.continue_case(prev, out, tmf(m * G_SUP), (1.05, 0.1, 1.05, 1.0), log, f'{tag} (G_ДЗВ {m * G_SUP:.5f} кг/с)',
                               t0_C=T0_C)
        pod = 0.0
        if (out / 'result.cas.h5').exists():
            try:
                import run_after_0909 as R
                pod = round(R.outlet_pressures(out).get('outlet_dzv', 0.0), 5)
                log(f'  {tag}: давление на выходе ДЗВ {pod:.5f} МПа (перепад {1.05 - pod:.5f} МПа)')
            except Exception:
                log(f'  {tag}: давление на выходе ДЗВ не прочитано')
        rows[m] = U.record(CSV, tag, 'rig_work_v2', 'air', (1.05, 0.1, 1.05, pod), out, mins, log,
                           start=f'продолжение {prev.parent.name}', t0_C=T0_C, l_heat_mm=700.0)
        if (out / 'result.cas.h5').exists():
            prev = out / 'result.cas.h5'
    out = BASE / 'a5v3_m000'
    mins = U.continue_case(prev, out, TMF_OFF, (1.05, 0.1, 1.05, 1.05), log, 'a5v3_m000 (ДЗВ без расхода, опорный для ф. 14)',
                           t0_C=T0_C)
    r0 = U.record(CSV, 'a5v3_m000', 'rig_work_v2', 'air', (1.05, 0.1, 1.05, 1.05), out, mins, log,
                  start=f'продолжение {prev.parent.name}', t0_C=T0_C, l_heat_mm=700.0)
    # 09.10 (review): a difference dTh(m) = T*h2(m) - T*h2(0) is accepted only if BOTH runs converged; the experiment is
    # compared at the ACTUAL m (linear interpolation between the Fig. 8a points); the acceptance tolerance is set by the
    # author before the results (provisional: |dTh| <= 0.5 K, |dTc| <= 1.0 K, digitization +-0.3 K included) and the
    # trend over m must agree.  The criterion is only printed here, the decision is the author's.
    def exp_at(mc, i):
        pts = sorted((k, v[i]) for k, v in EXP.items())
        if mc <= pts[0][0]: return pts[0][1] if mc >= pts[0][0] - 0.03 else None
        for (a, fa), (b, fb) in zip(pts, pts[1:]):
            if a <= mc <= b: return fa + (fb - fa) * (mc - a) / (b - a)
        return pts[-1][1] if mc <= pts[-1][0] + 0.03 else None
    base_ok = str(r0.get('converged')) == 'True'
    log(f'  опорный m = 0: статус {r0.get("status")}, сошёлся {base_ok}' + ('' if base_ok else ' — разности ΔTh НЕ принимаются'))
    with (BASE / 'a5v3_summary.csv').open('w', newline='', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        w = csv.writer(f)
        w.writerow(['m_target', 'm_calc', 'status', 'converged', 'base_m0_converged', 'G_sup', 'dTc_calc', 'dTc_exp_at_m',
                    'dTc_diff', 'dTh_calc', 'dTh_exp_at_m', 'dTh_diff'])
        for m, r in sorted(rows.items()):
            try:
                mc = float(r['G_dzv']) / float(r['G_svz'])
                dtc = float(r['dT_dzv_total'])
                dth = float(r['dT_svz_total']) - float(r0['dT_svz_total'])
                ec, eh = exp_at(mc, 0), exp_at(mc, 1)
                conv = str(r.get('converged')) == 'True'
                w.writerow([m, round(mc, 3), r['status'], conv, base_ok, r['G_svz'], round(dtc, 3),
                            '' if ec is None else round(ec, 2), '' if ec is None else round(dtc - ec, 2),
                            round(dth, 3), '' if eh is None else round(eh, 2), '' if eh is None or not base_ok else round(dth - eh, 2)])
                # author 09.10 12:20: |dTh| <= 0.5 K, |dTc| <= 1.0 K (+ the same trend over m, judged on the whole set)
                ok = (conv and base_ok and ec is not None and eh is not None and abs(dtc - ec) <= 1.0 and abs(dth - eh) <= 0.5)
                log(f'  сверка m {m}: m расч. {mc:.3f}; ΔTc {dtc:+.2f} (опыт при этом m {ec if ec is None else round(ec, 2)}) K; '
                    f'ΔTh {dth:+.2f} (опыт {eh if eh is None else round(eh, 2)}) K; G СВЗ {r["G_svz"]} (опыт 0,0491); '
                    f'сошёлся {conv}, опорный {base_ok}; в допуске: {"да" if ok else "нет"}')
            except Exception:
                w.writerow([m, '', r.get('status'), '', base_ok, '', '', '', '', '', '', ''])


if __name__ == '__main__':
    qlog('=== А5 v3 (сверка с опытом): жду окончания run_after_0909')
    while running('run_after_0909') or running('run_resume_0909'):
        time.sleep(60)
    qlog('=== А5 v3 (сверка с опытом) — начат')
    try:
        main()
    except Exception:
        log('ОШИБКА программы: ' + traceback.format_exc())
    qlog('=== А5 v3 (сверка с опытом) — закончен (приёмка — по результатам)')

===========================================================================
FILE: dataset/run_a5v3b2.py
===========================================================================
"""A5 v3b, continuations redone (10.10.2026 06:20).  In run_a5v3b.py (resolved DZV mesh, 40 layers) the start field was
obtained (a5v3_start: iteration limit, shock x 0.551 m, as in the old series), but BOTH continuations with the targeted
DZV mass flow failed: m 0.30 diverged at iteration 8212 (NaN at inlet_dzv), m 0.11 swung the DZV flow from +0.022 to
-0.006 kg/s with an energy imbalance of 1076 W at 8500.  The targeted-mass-flow outlet is unstable on the fine DZV
layers.  Fix: the DZV flow is set by a FIXED outlet pressure (stable pressure BC); the pressure is estimated from the old
series (1.04968 / 1.04873 / 1.04381 MPa for m 0.11 / 0.30 / 0.75) with a factor 2 on the pressure drop for the finer
wall layers; if the achieved m is off by more than 15 %, ONE correction continuation with dp*(m_target/m)^1.8.  The
experiment is compared at the ACTUAL m anyway (run_a5v3 summary logic).  CFL 5 for all continuations.
Order: start -> m 0.11 -> 0.30 -> 0.75 -> m 0 (reference), each from the previous converged case.
Rows -> runs\\a5v3b\\a5v3_results.csv (same file), summary a5v3_summary.csv; log a5v3_log.txt."""
import csv, sys, time, traceback
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0, r'F:\Leontiev_Project\dataset')
import run_a5v3 as A
import cont_util as U

A.BASE = Path(r'F:\Leontiev_Project\runs\a5v3b')
A.CSV = A.BASE / 'a5v3_results.csv'
U.CFL = 5.0
P0 = 1.05
DP0 = {0.11: 2 * 0.00032, 0.30: 2 * 0.00127, 0.75: 2 * 0.00619}
log = A.log


def run_point(prev, m, dp, tag):
    out = A.BASE / tag
    pod = round(P0 - dp, 6)
    mins = U.continue_case(prev, out, A.TMF_OFF, (P0, 0.1, P0, pod), log, f'{tag} (давление на выходе ДЗВ {pod:.5f} МПа)',
                           t0_C=A.T0_C)
    r = U.record(A.CSV, tag, 'rig_work_v2', 'air', (P0, 0.1, P0, pod), out, mins, log, start=f'продолжение {prev.parent.name}',
                 t0_C=A.T0_C, l_heat_mm=700.0)
    return out, r


def main():
    prev = A.BASE / 'a5v3_start' / 'result.cas.h5'
    rows = {}
    for m in (0.11, 0.30, 0.75):
        tag = f'a5v3_m{int(round(m * 100)):03d}p'
        dp = DP0[m]
        out, r = run_point(prev, m, dp, tag)
        if (out / 'result.cas.h5').exists() and r.get('G_dzv') and r.get('G_svz'):
            mc = float(r['G_dzv']) / float(r['G_svz'])
            log(f'  {tag}: достигнутый m {mc:.3f} (цель {m})')
            if mc > 0 and abs(mc - m) / m > 0.15:
                prev = out / 'result.cas.h5'
                dp = dp * (m / mc) ** 1.8
                out, r = run_point(prev, m, dp, tag + '2')
        rows[m] = r
        if (out / 'result.cas.h5').exists():
            prev = out / 'result.cas.h5'
    out = A.BASE / 'a5v3_m000p'
    mins = U.continue_case(prev, out, A.TMF_OFF, (P0, 0.1, P0, P0), log, 'a5v3_m000p (ДЗВ без расхода, опорный для ф. 14)',
                           t0_C=A.T0_C)
    r0 = U.record(A.CSV, 'a5v3_m000p', 'rig_work_v2', 'air', (P0, 0.1, P0, P0), out, mins, log,
                  start=f'продолжение {prev.parent.name}', t0_C=A.T0_C, l_heat_mm=700.0)
    summary(rows, r0)


def summary(rows, r0):
    """Same comparison as run_a5v3.main (actual m, author's tolerance |dTh| <= 0.5 K, |dTc| <= 1.0 K)."""
    def exp_at(mc, i):
        pts = sorted((k, v[i]) for k, v in A.EXP.items())
        if mc <= pts[0][0]: return pts[0][1] if mc >= pts[0][0] - 0.03 else None
        for (a, fa), (b, fb) in zip(pts, pts[1:]):
            if a <= mc <= b: return fa + (fb - fa) * (mc - a) / (b - a)
        return pts[-1][1] if mc <= pts[-1][0] + 0.03 else None
    base_ok = str(r0.get('converged')) == 'True'
    log(f'  опорный m = 0: статус {r0.get("status")}, сошёлся {base_ok}' + ('' if base_ok else ' — разности ΔTh НЕ принимаются'))
    with (A.BASE / 'a5v3_summary.csv').open('w', newline='', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        w = csv.writer(f)
        w.writerow(['m_target', 'm_calc', 'status', 'converged', 'base_m0_converged', 'G_sup', 'dTc_calc', 'dTc_exp_at_m',
                    'dTc_diff', 'dTh_calc', 'dTh_exp_at_m', 'dTh_diff'])
        for m, r in sorted(rows.items()):
            try:
                mc = float(r['G_dzv']) / float(r['G_svz'])
                dtc = float(r['dT_dzv_total'])
                dth = float(r['dT_svz_total']) - float(r0['dT_svz_total'])
                ec, eh = exp_at(mc, 0), exp_at(mc, 1)
                conv = str(r.get('converged')) == 'True'
                w.writerow([m, round(mc, 3), r['status'], conv, base_ok, r['G_svz'], round(dtc, 3),
                            '' if ec is None else round(ec, 2), '' if ec is None else round(dtc - ec, 2),
                            round(dth, 3), '' if eh is None else round(eh, 2), '' if eh is None or not base_ok else round(dth - eh, 2)])
                ok = (conv and base_ok and ec is not None and eh is not None and abs(dtc - ec) <= 1.0 and abs(dth - eh) <= 0.5)
                log(f'  сверка m {m}: m расч. {mc:.3f}; ΔTc {dtc:+.2f} (опыт при этом m {ec if ec is None else round(ec, 2)}) K; '
                    f'ΔTh {dth:+.2f} (опыт {eh if eh is None else round(eh, 2)}) K; Q {r.get("Q")} Вт; '
                    f'сошёлся {conv}, опорный {base_ok}; в допуске: {"да" if ok else "нет"}')
            except Exception:
                w.writerow([m, '', r.get('status'), '', base_ok, '', '', '', '', '', '', ''])


if __name__ == '__main__':
    A.qlog('=== А5 v3b2 (продолжения с фиксированным давлением на выходе ДЗВ, CFL 5) — начат')
    try:
        main()
    except Exception:
        log('ОШИБКА программы: ' + traceback.format_exc())
    A.qlog('=== А5 v3b2 — закончен (приёмка — по результатам)')

"""A5 v3b, continuations at CFL 10 (10.10.2026 08:00).  run_a5v3b2.py (fixed DZV outlet pressure, CFL 5) made the DZV

def b2_done_m011():
    if not A.CSV.exists():
        return False
    return any(r.get('tag') == 'a5v3_m011p' for r in csv.DictReader(open(A.CSV, encoding='utf-8')))


def stop_b2():
    subprocess.run(['powershell', '-NoProfile', '-Command',
                    "Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter \"Name='python.exe'\" | ? {$_.CommandLine -match 'run_a5v3b2'} | "
                    "% { Stop-Process -Id $_.ProcessId -Force }"])


def point(prev, m, dp, tag):
    U.CFL = 10.0
    out, r = B.run_point(prev, m, dp, tag)
    if not (out / 'result.cas.h5').exists():

        U.CFL = 5.0
        out, r = B.run_point(prev, m, dp, tag + 'c5')
    return out, r


def main():

    stop_b2()
    time.sleep(15)
    t_kill = time.time() - 60
    G.kill_since(t_kill)   # a Fluent b2 may have started for its next point
    src = A.BASE / 'a5v3_m011p' / 'result.cas.h5'
    prev = src if src.exists() else A.BASE / 'a5v3_start' / 'result.cas.h5'
    log(f'=== А5 v3b3: продолжения при CFL 10 от {prev.parent.name}')
    rows = {}
    for m in (0.11, 0.30, 0.75):
        tag = f'a5v3_m{int(round(m * 100)):03d}q'
        dp = B.DP0[m]
        out, r = point(prev, m, dp, tag)
        if (out / 'result.cas.h5').exists() and r.get('G_dzv') and r.get('G_svz'):
            mc = float(r['G_dzv']) / float(r['G_svz'])
            log(f'  {tag}: достигнутый m {mc:.3f} (цель {m})')
            if mc > 0 and abs(mc - m) / m > 0.15:
                prev = out / 'result.cas.h5'
                dp = dp * (m / mc) ** 1.8
                out, r = point(prev, m, dp, tag + '2')
        rows[m] = r
        if (out / 'result.cas.h5').exists():
            prev = out / 'result.cas.h5'
    U.CFL = 10.0
    out = A.BASE / 'a5v3_m000q'
    mins = U.continue_case(prev, out, A.TMF_OFF, (B.P0, 0.1, B.P0, B.P0), log, 'a5v3_m000q (ДЗВ без расхода, опорный для ф. 14)',
                           t0_C=A.T0_C)
    r0 = U.record(A.CSV, 'a5v3_m000q', 'rig_work_v2', 'air', (B.P0, 0.1, B.P0, B.P0), out, mins, log,
                  start=f'продолжение {prev.parent.name}', t0_C=A.T0_C, l_heat_mm=700.0)
    B.summary(rows, r0)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    A.qlog('=== А5 v3b3 (продолжения при CFL 10) — ждёт m 0,11 из b2')

===========================================================================
FILE: dataset/run_a5v3b5.py
===========================================================================
"""A5 v3b from INTERPOLATED old converged fields (10.10.2026 11:30).  b2/b4 (CFL 5, fixed DZV outlet pressure) are
stable but the SVZ mass balance falls only ~0.15 %/1000 iterations (7.45 % at 13500): the channel shock of the
from-scratch start field leaves far too slowly (CFL 10 is unstable on the resolved DZV layers).  The old series
(coarse DZV mesh, same geometry) has converged shock-free fields (a5v3_m011, m075, m000; m030 at the limit).  Each point
here: read the new-mesh case (a5v3_m011p: settings, 40 DZV layers) -> /file/interpolate/read-data of the old field of the
same m (SVZ zone id 8 matches; the DZV zone does not, so the DZV fluid is patched to rest at the outlet pressure,
25.85 C, k 0.1, omega 1000 — case units atm / C; the brass wall to 23 C) -> CFL 5, LIMIT 8000.  Interpolation files:
runs\\a5v3b\\ip_old\\*.ip (written 11:12 from runs\\a5v3\\*\\result.cas.h5; syntax checked in ip_old\\probe.trn).
Each point is independent (no chain); summary as in b2."""
import sys, traceback
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0, r'F:\Leontiev_Project\dataset')
import run_a5v3b2 as B
import cont_util as U
import leontiev_pipeline as L

A = B.A
log = B.log
U.CFL = 5.0
U.LIMIT = 8000
TEMPLATE = A.BASE / 'a5v3_m011p' / 'result.cas.h5'
IP = A.BASE / 'ip_old'
ATM = 0.101325


def init_lines(ip, p_dzv_MPa):
    return [f'/file/interpolate/read-data "{L.fl(ip)}"',
            f'/solve/patch air_dzv () pressure {p_dzv_MPa / ATM:.5f}',
            '/solve/patch air_dzv () temperature 25.85',
            '/solve/patch air_dzv () x-velocity ok 0',
            '/solve/patch air_dzv () y-velocity ok 0',
            '/solve/patch air_dzv () k 0.1',
            '/solve/patch air_dzv () omega 1000',
            '/solve/patch wall_abonite () temperature 23']


def run(tag, old, pod):
    out = A.BASE / tag
    mins = U.continue_case(TEMPLATE, out, A.TMF_OFF + init_lines(IP / f'{old}.ip', pod), (B.P0, 0.1, B.P0, pod), log,
                           f'{tag} (поле {old} старой серии, давление на выходе ДЗВ {pod:.5f} МПа)', t0_C=A.T0_C)
    return U.record(A.CSV, tag, 'rig_work_v2', 'air', (B.P0, 0.1, B.P0, pod), out, mins, log,
                    start=f'интерполяция {old} на сетку a5v3_m011p', t0_C=A.T0_C, l_heat_mm=700.0)


def main():
    log(f'=== А5 v3b5: от интерполированных полей старой серии, CFL 5, предел {U.LIMIT}')
    rows = {}
    for m, old in ((0.11, 'a5v3_m011'), (0.75, 'a5v3_m075'), (0.30, 'a5v3_m030')):
        pod = round(B.P0 - B.DP0[m], 6)
        r = run(f'a5v3_m{int(round(m * 100)):03d}i', old, pod)
        if r.get('G_dzv') and r.get('G_svz'):
            log(f'  достигнутый m {float(r["G_dzv"]) / float(r["G_svz"]):.3f} (цель {m})')
        rows[m] = r
    r0 = run('a5v3_m000i', 'a5v3_m000', B.P0)
    B.summary(rows, r0)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    A.qlog('=== А5 v3b5 (от интерполированных полей старой серии) — начат')
    try:
        main()
    except Exception:
        log('ОШИБКА программы: ' + traceback.format_exc())
    A.qlog('=== А5 v3b5 — закончен (приёмка — по результатам)')

"""A5 v3b, order changed after the review (10.10.2026 12:00, author agreed): after m 0.11 (run_a5v3b5.py, interpolated

def rows_of(tag):

        return None
    for r in csv.DictReader(open(A.CSV, encoding='utf-8')):
        if r.get('tag') == tag:
            return r
    return None


def main():
    while rows_of('a5v3_m011i') is None:
        time.sleep(20)
    subprocess.run(['powershell', '-NoProfile', '-Command',
                    "Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter \"Name='python.exe'\" | ? {$_.CommandLine -match 'run_a5v3b5'} | "
                    "% { Stop-Process -Id $_.ProcessId -Force }"])

import sys, time, traceback
sys.path.insert(0, r'F:\Leontiev_Project\dataset')

B5, B, A, log = B6.B5, B6.B, B6.A, B6.log

def point(tag, old, pod, extra=()):
    for attempt in (1, 2):
        t = tag if attempt == 1 else tag + 'b'
        out = A.BASE / t
        mins = U.continue_case(B5.TEMPLATE, out, A.TMF_OFF + B5.init_lines(B5.IP / f'{old}.ip', pod) + list(extra),
                               (B.P0, 0.1, B.P0, pod), log, f'{t} (поле {old} старой серии; ДЗВ {"закрыт" if extra else f"{pod:.5f} МПа"})',
                               t0_C=A.T0_C)
        r = U.record(A.CSV, t, 'rig_work_v2', 'air', (B.P0, 0.1, B.P0, pod), out, mins, log,
                     start=f'интерполяция {old} на сетку a5v3_m011p', t0_C=A.T0_C, l_heat_mm=700.0)
        if (out / 'result.cas.h5').exists():
            return r
        log(f'  {t}: нет результата' + (' — повтор' if attempt == 1 else ''))
    return r


def a5():

        f'предел {U.LIMIT}, сторож {U.STALL_MIN} мин')

"""Night 11->12.10.2026, queue revised at 04:50.  The m = 0 reference with a closed DZV (a5v3_m000w, outlet_dzv -> wall)
runs at ~22 s/iteration (GMRES stabilisation every iteration: stagnant gas in the resolved DZV layers; 340 iterations

interpolation), m ~0.05 and ~0.02 (fixed DZV outlet pressure, dp ~ m^1.8 from m 0.117 at 640 Pa), and T*h2(m = 0)
extrapolated linearly from them (the closest pair; the m 0.117 point is printed as a check of linearity).  Then a point

import sys, time, traceback
sys.path.insert(0, r'F:\Leontiev_Project\dataset')
import run_a5v3b6 as B6
import cont_util as U

B5, B, A, log = B6.B5, B6.B, B6.A, B6.log
U.CFL = 5.0
U.LIMIT = 4000
U.NPROC = 7
DP011, M011 = 0.00064, 0.117


def cont(src_tag, tag, pod):
    src = A.BASE / src_tag / 'result.cas.h5'
    out = A.BASE / tag
    mins = U.continue_case(src, out, A.TMF_OFF, (B.P0, 0.1, B.P0, pod), log, f'{tag} (от {src_tag}; ДЗВ {pod:.6f} МПа)',
                           t0_C=A.T0_C)
    return U.record(A.CSV, tag, 'rig_work_v2', 'air', (B.P0, 0.1, B.P0, pod), out, mins, log, start=f'продолжение {src_tag}',
                    t0_C=A.T0_C, l_heat_mm=700.0)


def mc(r):
    try:
        return float(r['G_dzv']) / float(r['G_svz'])
    except (KeyError, TypeError, ValueError, ZeroDivisionError):
        return None


def a5():
    log('=== ночь 11→12.10 (04:50): опорная m 0 через малые расходы — m 0,05 и 0,02 от a5v3_m011i, экстраполяция к m 0')
    rows = {0.11: B6.rows_of('a5v3_m011i'), 0.75: B6.rows_of('a5v3_m075i'), 0.30: B6.rows_of('a5v3_m030i')}
    small = []
    for m, tag in ((0.05, 'a5v3_m005s'), (0.02, 'a5v3_m002s')):
        pod = round(B.P0 - DP011 * (m / M011) ** 1.8, 7)
        r = cont('a5v3_m011i' if not small else small[-1][2], tag, pod)
        if (A.BASE / tag / 'result.cas.h5').exists() and mc(r) is not None:
            small.append((mc(r), float(r['dT_svz_total']), tag, str(r.get('converged')) == 'True'))
            log(f'  {tag}: m {mc(r):.4f}, ΔT СВЗ полн. {float(r["dT_svz_total"]):+.3f} K, сошёлся {r.get("converged")}')
    if len(small) == 2:
        (m1, t1, _, c1), (m2, t2, _, c2) = small
        t0 = t2 - (t1 - t2) / (m1 - m2) * m2
        r11 = rows[0.11]
        log(f'  опорная T*h2(m=0) по экстраполяции: ΔT СВЗ полн. {t0:+.3f} K (m {m2:.4f}: {t2:+.3f}, m {m1:.4f}: {t1:+.3f}; '
            f'проверка линейности — m {mc(r11):.3f}: {float(r11["dT_svz_total"]):+.3f} K)')
        r0 = dict(dT_svz_total=t0, converged=str(c1 and c2), status='экстраполяция к m 0 (m 0,02 и 0,05)')
        B.summary(rows, r0)
    else:
        log('  малые расходы не дали двух точек — сводка ΔTh не составлена')
    # exact m 0.75 (the achieved 0.633 is inside the experiment range, this one is at the experiment point itself)
    m_act = mc(rows[0.75])
    if m_act:
        pod = round(B.P0 - (B.P0 - 1.03762) * (0.75 / m_act) ** 1.8, 6)
        r = cont('a5v3_m075i', 'a5v3_m075e', pod)
        log(f'  a5v3_m075e: m {mc(r) if mc(r) else "?"}')


def anchor():
    import run_pilot_cell as P   # its import sets U.CFL = 10 — on the resolved DZV layers only CFL 5 is stable (10.10)
    P.U.NPROC = 7
    P.U.CFL = 5.0
    P.anchor_recheck()


if __name__ == '__main__':
    A.qlog('=== ночь 11→12.10 (04:50, пересмотр): А5 малые расходы + m 0,75 точно, затем якорь — начат')
    for name, fn in (('А5 b9', a5), ('якорь (сетка ДЗВ 31 слой)', anchor)):
        t0 = time.time()
        try:
            fn()
            A.qlog(f'ночь 11→12.10: {name} — завершён за {(time.time() - t0) / 60:.0f} мин')
        except Exception:
            log(f'{name}: ОШИБКА программы: ' + traceback.format_exc())
            A.qlog(f'ночь 11→12.10: {name} — ОШИБКА программы')
    A.qlog('=== ночь 11→12.10 — очередь закончена')

FILE: dataset/run_a6.py

"""Stage A6: gas.  Geometry v2 (nozzle after Izotov 2009), mesh work_v2, SST + Prt 0.85, patent regime
(SVZ 5.5 -> 0.3 MPa, DZV 5.5 -> 5.2 MPa), T0 25 C.
  air        : runs\\a3\\a3_work_v2 (A3, air ideal, k(T))
  ch4_ideal  : methane ideal gas, cp0/k/mu polynomials (CoolProp), from scratch (FMG)
  ch4_pr     : methane Peng-Robinson, continued from the ch4_ideal solution (only the density model and critical
               constants change), so the start is robust
Energy balance for the real gas is checked with the total-enthalpy fluxes through every boundary (report block).
usage: python run_a6.py [ch4_ideal] [ch4_pr]     results: runs\\a6\\a6_results.csv, log runs\\a6\\a6_log.txt"""
import csv, subprocess, sys, time
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0, r'F:\Leontiev_Project\dataset')
import leontiev_pipeline as L
import gui_runner as G
import gui_convergence as C
import run_a3 as A3
from make_gui_prt_journal import GUI_PRT

BASE = Path(r'F:\Leontiev_Project\runs\a6')
LIMIT = 5500
COLS = ['gas', 'status', 'reason', 'converged', 'iter', 'dT_svz', 'dT_dzv', 'Q', 'm_svz', 'm_dzv', 'ratio', 'net_W',
        'energy_svz_W', 'energy_dzv_W', 'dm_svz_pct', 'yp_svz', 'M_mean_channel', 'M_outlet', 'minutes']


def log(s):
    line = time.strftime('%H:%M:%S ') + s
    print(line, flush=True)
    BASE.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with (BASE / 'a6_log.txt').open('a', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        f.write(line + '\n')


def record(gas, p, out, minutes):
    st = G.status(out)
    res = dict(gas=gas, minutes=minutes)
    if st and st['samples'] and (out / 'axis.csv').exists():
        b = st['samples'][-1]
        cl = C.closed_samples(out)
        status_, reason, info = G.classify(out, p, G.converged(out))
        res.update(status=status_, reason=reason, converged=G.converged(out), iter=st['iter'],
                   dT_svz=round(b['dT_svz'], 3), dT_dzv=round(b['dT_dzv'], 3), Q=round(b['Q'], 1),
                   m_svz=round(cl[-1]['m_svz'], 6), m_dzv=round(cl[-1]['m_dzv'], 6), ratio=round(b['ratio'], 4),
                   net_W=round(cl[-1]['net'], 3), energy_svz_W=round(cl[-1]['e_svz'], 3), energy_dzv_W=round(cl[-1]['e_dzv'], 3),
                   dm_svz_pct=round(cl[-1]['dm'], 4), yp_svz=round(b['yp_svz'], 3),
                   M_mean_channel=info.get('M_mean_channel'), M_outlet=info.get('M_outlet'))
        log(f"{gas}: {status_} ({reason}); ΔT СВЗ {res['dT_svz']:+.3f} K, ΔT ДЗВ {res['dT_dzv']:+.3f} K, Q {res['Q']:.1f} Вт, "
            f"G СВЗ {res['m_svz']} кг/с, G_дз/G_сз {res['ratio']}, баланс энергии {res['net_W']} Вт, y+ {res['yp_svz']}")
    else:
        res.update(status='сбой', reason='нет результата')
        log(f'{gas}: нет результата (сбой)')
    new = not (BASE / 'a6_results.csv').exists()
    with (BASE / 'a6_results.csv').open('a', newline='', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        w = csv.DictWriter(f, fieldnames=COLS, extrasaction='ignore')
        if new:
            w.writeheader()
        w.writerow(res)
    return res


def ch4_ideal():
    p = dict(G.DEFAULTS)
    p.update(A3.MESHES['work_v2'], run_id='a6_ch4_ideal', prt=0.85, mesh_custom=True, wait_free=True, gas='ch4_ideal')
    G.RUNS = BASE
    log('=== ch4_ideal: метан, идеальный газ (полиномы cp0, k, mu по CoolProp), рабочая сетка v2, с нуля')
    t0 = time.time()
    G.run(p, lambda s: log('  ' + s), lambda: False)
    return record('ch4_ideal', p, BASE / p['run_id'], round((time.time() - t0) / 60, 1))


def ch4_pr():
    src = BASE / 'a6_ch4_ideal' / 'result.cas.h5'
    if not src.exists():
        return log('ch4_pr: нет решения с идеальным метаном — пропускаю')
    out = BASE / 'a6_ch4_pr'
    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    q = L.fl(out)
    lines = ['/file/confirm-overwrite? no', f'/file/start-transcript "{q}/run.trn"', f'/file/read-case-data "{L.fl(src)}"']
    lines += [g.format(prt=0.85) for g in GUI_PRT] + list(L.CH4_PR_LINES) + ['/define/materials/list-properties air']
    lines += C.coupled_journal(dict(coupled_iters=LIMIT, report_every=500, cfl=20.0), out)
    lines += [f'/file/write-case-data "{q}/result.cas.h5"',
              f'/file/export/ascii "{q}/axis.csv" axis () yes mach-number pressure total-pressure temperature '
              'total-temperature axial-velocity () yes', '/file/stop-transcript']
    (out / 'a6.jou').write_text('\n'.join(lines) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
    log('=== ch4_pr: метан, Пенг–Робинсон; продолжение решения ch4_ideal')
    while G.fluent_running():
        time.sleep(60)
    t0 = time.time()
    subprocess.Popen([L.FLUENT, '2ddp', '-t7', '-i', str(out / 'a6.jou')], cwd=str(out), stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,
                     stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL, close_fds=True)
    first, said = None, False
    while not (out / 'axis.csv').exists():
        rows = C.closed_samples(out)
        if rows and first is None:
            first = rows[0]['iteration'] - 500
        c = C.update_control(out, True, max_iter=first + LIMIT if first is not None else None)
        if c['stop_requested'] and not said:
            log('  критерии сходимости выполнены в двух проверках подряд — Fluent сохранит кейс'); said = True
        st = G.status(out)
        if st and (st['fpe'] or st['error']):
            G.kill_since(t0); log(f'  ch4_pr: СБОЙ (расходимость или ошибка журнала) на итерации {st["iter"]}'); break
        if time.time() - t0 > 5 * 3600:
            G.kill_since(t0); log('  ch4_pr: СБОЙ (время)'); break
        time.sleep(10)
    time.sleep(10)
    G.kill_since(t0)
    p = dict(G.DEFAULTS, **A3.MESHES['work_v2'], run_id='a6_ch4_pr', prt=0.85, gas='ch4_pr', startup='продолжение a6_ch4_ideal')
    res = record('ch4_pr', p, out, round((time.time() - t0) / 60, 1))
    if (out / 'axis.csv').exists():
        G.append_result(p, G.status(out), out, G.converged(out), '', res['minutes'])
    return res


def main(parts=None):
    parts = parts or ['ch4_ideal', 'ch4_pr']
    for name, fn in (('ch4_ideal', ch4_ideal), ('ch4_pr', ch4_pr)):
        if name in parts:
            try:
                fn()
            except Exception:
                import traceback; log('ОШИБКА программы: ' + traceback.format_exc())
    log('=== А6 закончен')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main(sys.argv[1:])

SRC400_P = 0.3
CONS = '/solve/set/pseudo-time-method/global-time-step-settings yes 1 1 yes 1'
HALF = '/solve/set/pseudo-time-method/global-time-step-settings yes 1 0.5 yes 1'
ATM = 0.101325
U.NPROC, U.CFL, U.GUARD_ENERGY_W = 6, 20.0, 300.0   # 27.10: 6 Fluent processes on the new PC (was 7)


def log(s):
    line = time.strftime('%H:%M:%S ') + s
    print(line, flush=True)
    BASE.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with (BASE / 'a9_log.txt').open('a', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        f.write(line + '\n')


def qlog(s):
    PC.qlog(s)


def set_step(line):
    i = L.SOLVER_HEADER.index(next(x for x in L.SOLVER_HEADER if 'global-time-step-settings' in x))
    L.SOLVER_HEADER[i] = line


def ok(d):
    return (Path(d) / 'result.cas.h5').exists()


def done_dir(pid):
    """The latest saved result of a design point (resume after a pause): id, idh, idc, idch."""
    for t in (pid + 'ch', pid + 'c', pid + 'h', pid):
        if ok(BASE / t):
            return BASE / t
    return None


def converged(d):
    import gui_convergence as C
    rows = C.closed_samples(d)
    return C.decision(rows) if rows else False


def regime(pt):
    return (5.5, float(pt['p_cons']), 5.5, round(5.5 - float(pt['dp_dzv_kPa']) / 1000.0, 6))


POINT_LIMIT = 6000   # 16.10 author: cap per design point (run_a9_l660 sets 3000); unconverged -> reviewed later
RESUME_CONT = True   # 16.10: False -> a saved unconverged point is reused as is (no continuation on resume)


def cont(src_case, tag, reg, extra, t0s, t0d, start, csv_path, limit=None, l_mm=400.0):
    """One continuation stage with the half-step fallback; returns the output dir that has a result (or None)."""
    for step, suffix in ((CONS, ''), (HALF, 'h')):
        set_step(step)
        U.LIMIT = min(limit, POINT_LIMIT) if limit else POINT_LIMIT
        out = BASE / (tag + suffix)
        mins = U.continue_case(src_case, out, list(extra), reg, log, tag + suffix, t0_C=t0s, t0_dzv_C=t0d)
        U.record(csv_path, tag + suffix, 'work_v2', 'ch4_pr', reg, out, mins, log, start=start + (' (шаг ×0,5)' if suffix else ''),
                 t0_C=t0s, t0_dzv_C=t0d, l_heat_mm=l_mm)
        if ok(out):
            set_step(CONS)
            return out
        log(f'  {tag + suffix}: нет результата' + (' — повтор с половинным псевдошагом' if not suffix else ''))
    set_step(CONS)
    return None


def to_regime(src_dir, src_p, pt, start):
    """Ramp the consumer pressure in 0.3-MPa steps if the jump is large, then the design point itself."""
    reg = regime(pt)
    t0d, t0s = float(pt['t0_dzv']), float(pt['t0_svz'])
    cur, p = Path(src_dir), src_p
    k = 0
    while abs(reg[1] - p) > 0.35:
        p = round(p + math.copysign(0.3, reg[1] - p), 3)
        k += 1
        done_aux = [BASE / f'{pt["id"]}_r{k}{s}' for s in ('', 'h') if ok(BASE / f'{pt["id"]}_r{k}{s}')]
        if not done_aux and (BASE / f'{pt["id"]}_r{k}h').exists():   # 16.10: this step already failed twice (full + half)
            log(f'  {pt["id"]}: ступень {p} МПа уже не прошла (оба псевдошага) — точка с прежнего поля')
            break
        aux = done_aux[0] if done_aux else cont(cur / 'result.cas.h5', f'{pt["id"]}_r{k}', (reg[0], p, reg[2], reg[3]), [], t0s, t0d,
                   f'ступень давления потребителя {p} МПа к {pt["id"]}', AUX, limit=1500, l_mm=float(pt['L_mm']))   # 16.10: reuse a saved step
        if not aux:
            log(f'  {pt["id"]}: ступень {p} МПа не прошла — точка с прежнего поля')
            break
        cur = aux
    return cont(cur / 'result.cas.h5', pt['id'], reg, [], t0s, t0d, start, CSV, l_mm=float(pt['L_mm']))


def cell_params(td, l_mm, run_id, pt, gas, startup, coupled):
    cell = L.cell_geometry(td, 1.5, 4.8, 3.3)
    reg = regime(pt)
    p = dict(G.DEFAULTS)
    p.update(A3.MESHES['work_v2'], prt=0.85, mesh_custom=True, wait_free=True, dzv_counterflow=True,
             dzv_layers=PC.dzv_layers(cell['gap_mm']), p_out_svz_MPa=reg[1], p_out_dzv_MPa=reg[3], gas=gas,
             extra_lines=[L.SYMMETRY_DZV_LINE] + U.t0_lines(float(pt['t0_svz']), float(pt['t0_dzv'])),
             retries=1 if coupled > 10 else 0, startup_iters=startup, coupled_iters=coupled, cfl=5.0, l_heat_mm=l_mm,
             run_id=run_id, **{k: cell[k] for k in ('gap_mm', 'wall_thickness_inlet_mm', 'wall_thickness_end_mm')})
    return p, cell


def scratch(pt, tag):
    """From scratch: ideal methane (FMG, startup 1000, 5500 coupled), then PR at the design regime."""
    G.RUNS = BASE
    p, _ = cell_params(float(pt['t_d']), float(pt['L_mm']), f'{tag}_ideal', pt, 'ch4_ideal', 1000, 5500)
    log(f'=== {tag}: С НУЛЯ (идеальный метан → ПР), t/d {pt["t_d"]}, L {pt["L_mm"]} мм')
    t0 = time.time()
    G.run(p, lambda s: log('  ' + s), lambda: False)
    U.record(AUX, f'{tag}_ideal', 'work_v2', 'ch4_ideal', regime(pt), BASE / p['run_id'], round((time.time() - t0) / 60, 1),
             log, start='с нуля (FMG)', t0_C=float(pt['t0_svz']), t0_dzv_C=float(pt['t0_dzv']), l_heat_mm=float(pt['L_mm']))
    if not ok(BASE / p['run_id']):
        return None
    return cont(BASE / p['run_id'] / 'result.cas.h5', tag, regime(pt), list(L.CH4_PR_LINES), float(pt['t0_svz']),
                float(pt['t0_dzv']), f'с нуля: продолжение {tag}_ideal (ПР)', CSV, l_mm=float(pt['L_mm']))


def write_ip(case, ip):
    jou = ip.with_suffix('.jou')
    jou.write_text('\n'.join([f'/file/read-case-data "{L.fl(case)}"', f'/file/interpolate/write-data "{L.fl(ip)}" yes yes',
                              '/exit yes']) + '\n', encoding='ascii')
    t = time.time()
    try:
        subprocess.Popen([L.FLUENT, '2ddp', '-t1', '-g', '-i', str(jou)], cwd=str(ip.parent)).wait(900)
    finally:
        G.kill_since(t)
    return ip.exists()


def transfer(src_dir, pt, reg=None):
    """New t/d at the same length: template (10 it.) + interpolation of the neighbour's field, DZV started moving.
    reg: (p_svz_in, p_svz_out, p_dzv_in, p_dzv_out) — 30.10: для станционных режимов (магистраль ≠ 5,5 МПа, sppr --confirm)."""
    G.RUNS = BASE
    td, l_mm = float(pt['t_d']), float(pt['L_mm'])
    tag = pt['id']
    p, cell = cell_params(td, l_mm, f'{tag}_tpl', pt, 'ch4_ideal', 10, 10)
    log(f'=== {tag}: шаблон новой геометрии t/d {td}, L {l_mm} мм; перенос поля {Path(src_dir).name}')
    G.run(p, lambda s: log('  ' + s), lambda: False)
    tpl = BASE / f'{tag}_tpl' / 'result.cas.h5'
    if not tpl.exists() and (BASE / f'{tag}_tpl' / 'initial.cas.h5').exists():
        # 30.10: FMG шаблона на мелкой сетке накатки (0,1–0,2 мм) расходится (T до 5000 K) — шаблону нужны только сетка и зоны,
        # поле всё равно заменяется переносом, поэтому берётся кейс после гибридной инициализации
        tpl = BASE / f'{tag}_tpl' / 'initial.cas.h5'
        log(f'  {tag}: FMG шаблона не прошла — шаблон из initial.cas.h5 (гибридная инициализация)')
    ip = BASE / 'ip' / f'{Path(src_dir).name}.ip'
    ip.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    if not tpl.exists() or not (ip.exists() or write_ip(Path(src_dir) / 'result.cas.h5', ip)):
        log(f'  {tag}: нет шаблона или файла переноса'); return None
    reg = reg or regime(pt)
    t0d, t0s = float(pt['t0_dzv']), float(pt['t0_svz'])
    area = math.pi * (cell['cell_r_eq_mm'] ** 2 - cell['cell_r_outer_mm'] ** 2) * 1e-6
    u = -float(pt['m_target']) * 0.162 / (42.0 * area)
    init = [f'/file/interpolate/read-data "{L.fl(ip)}"', f'/solve/patch air_dzv () pressure {reg[3] / ATM:.5f}',
            f'/solve/patch air_dzv () temperature {t0d:g}', f'/solve/patch air_dzv () x-velocity ok {u:.2f}',
            '/solve/patch air_dzv () y-velocity ok 0', '/solve/patch air_dzv () k 0.1', '/solve/patch air_dzv () omega 1000',
            f'/solve/patch wall_abonite () temperature {(t0d + t0s) / 2:g}']
    return cont(tpl, tag, reg, list(L.CH4_PR_LINES) + init, t0s, t0d,
                f'перенос поля {Path(src_dir).name} на t/d {td}; ДЗВ с {u:.1f} м/с', CSV, l_mm=l_mm)


def run_geometry(points, first_src=None, first_p=None):
    """points of one geometry sorted by consumer pressure; first_src: a field of THIS geometry (pilot) or None."""
    cur, cur_p = first_src, first_p
    for pt in points:
        t0 = time.time()
        try:
            done = done_dir(pt['id'])
            if done:   # resume after a pause: converged -> reuse; saved but not converged -> continue it (tag ...c)
                if RESUME_CONT and not converged(done):
                    log(f'  {pt["id"]}: возобновление — досчёт сохранённого {done.name}')
                    done = cont(done / 'result.cas.h5', pt['id'] + 'c', regime(pt), [], float(pt['t0_svz']),
                                float(pt['t0_dzv']), f'досчёт {done.name} после паузы', CSV, l_mm=float(pt['L_mm'])) or done
                cur, cur_p = done, float(pt['p_cons'])
                continue
            if cur is None:
                res = None
            else:
                res = to_regime(cur, cur_p, pt, f'продолжение {Path(cur).name}')
            if res:
                cur, cur_p = res, float(pt['p_cons'])
            log(f'  {pt["id"]}: {"готово" if res else "НЕТ РЕЗУЛЬТАТА"} за {(time.time() - t0) / 3600:.1f} ч')
        except Exception:
            log(f'{pt["id"]}: ОШИБКА программы: ' + traceback.format_exc())
    return cur, cur_p


def main():
    pts = list(csv.DictReader(open(DESIGN, encoding='utf-8')))
    work = [p for p in pts if p['set'] != 'повтор с нуля']
    rep = [p for p in pts if p['set'] == 'повтор с нуля']
    by_geo = {}
    for p in work:
        by_geo.setdefault((float(p['L_mm']), float(p['t_d'])), []).append(p)
    for k in by_geo:
        by_geo[k].sort(key=lambda p: float(p['p_cons']))
    log(f'=== А9: {len(work)} точек (обучение + контроль) + {len(rep)} повтора; порядок 400 → 200 → 660 мм')
    # L 400 mm: pilot fields of each t/d
    for td in (1.4, 1.2, 1.6):
        run_geometry(by_geo[(400.0, td)], SRC400[td], SRC400_P)
    # L 200 / 660: scratch at t/d 1.4 (first point), transfer to 1.2 / 1.6 from the first t/d-1.4 result
    for l_mm in (200.0, 660.0):
        pts14 = by_geo[(l_mm, 1.4)]
        first = done_dir(pts14[0]['id']) or scratch(pts14[0], pts14[0]['id'])
        log(f'  {pts14[0]["id"]}: с нуля — {"готово" if first else "НЕТ РЕЗУЛЬТАТА"}')
        run_geometry(pts14[1:], first, float(pts14[0]['p_cons']) if first else None)
        for td in (1.2, 1.6):
            g = by_geo[(l_mm, td)]
            res = done_dir(g[0]['id']) or (transfer(first, g[0]) if first else None)
            log(f'  {g[0]["id"]}: перенос — {"готово" if res else "НЕТ РЕЗУЛЬТАТА"}')
            run_geometry(g[1:], res, float(g[0]['p_cons']) if res else None)
    for pt in rep:
        try:
            if not done_dir(pt['id']):
                scratch(pt, pt['id'])
        except Exception:
            log(f'{pt["id"]}: ОШИБКА программы: ' + traceback.format_exc())


if __name__ == '__main__':
    qlog('=== А9 датасет-эталон — начат')
    try:
        main()
    except Exception:
        log('А9: ОШИБКА программы: ' + traceback.format_exc())
    qlog('=== А9 датасет-эталон — закончен')

"""15.10.2026 — A9, L 660 mm (12 points), after the contact fix in mesh_variant.py (duplicate 'Contact Region 2' with an
empty source deleted on a failed export; checked on the test copy: t_l660b exported).  Same order as run_a9.main:
scratch at t/d 1.4 (first point), then rising pressure, then transfer to t/d 1.2 / 1.6.  Waits for run_a9.py and
run_a9_finish.py to end."""
import csv, subprocess, sys, time, traceback
sys.path.insert(0, r'F:\Leontiev_Project\dataset')
import run_a9 as A

if __name__ == '__main__':
    while A.PC.running(r'run_a9\.py') or A.PC.running(r'run_a9_finish\.py'):
        time.sleep(60)
    A.POINT_LIMIT = 3000     # 16.10 author: speed first; unconverged points reviewed later
    A.RESUME_CONT = False
    A.qlog('=== А9: L 660 мм — начат')
    try:
        pts = [p for p in csv.DictReader(open(A.DESIGN, encoding='utf-8'))
               if p['set'] != 'повтор с нуля' and float(p['L_mm']) == 660.0]
        by_td = {}
        for p in pts:
            by_td.setdefault(float(p['t_d']), []).append(p)
        for k in by_td:
            by_td[k].sort(key=lambda p: float(p['p_cons']))
        A.log(f'=== А9 L 660: {len(pts)} точек')
        pts14 = by_td[1.4]
        p0, tag = pts14[0], pts14[0]['id']
        ideal = A.BASE / f'{tag}_ideal'
        # 15.10 17:00: the runner was stopped by mistake during the ideal stage of A9_42; its Fluent finished it alone
        # -> wait for that Fluent, then PR from the saved ideal field (same as the second half of A.scratch)
        def _alive(pid):
            return subprocess.run(['tasklist', '/FI', f'PID eq {pid}', '/NH'], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.count(str(pid)) > 0
        # the journal ends without /exit (the window was closed by the runner) -> close it once axis.csv is written
        while len(sys.argv) > 1 and _alive(sys.argv[1]) and not (ideal / 'axis.csv').exists():   # orphaned Fluent (pid)
            time.sleep(60)
        if len(sys.argv) > 1:
            time.sleep(60)
            for pid in sys.argv[1:]:
                subprocess.run(['taskkill', '/PID', pid, '/T', '/F'])
            time.sleep(20)
        if not A.done_dir(tag) and A.ok(ideal):
            A.log(f'  {tag}_ideal: поле идеального газа сохранено Fluent без управляющей программы — продолжение ПР')
            first = A.cont(ideal / 'result.cas.h5', tag, A.regime(p0), list(A.L.CH4_PR_LINES), float(p0['t0_svz']),
                           float(p0['t0_dzv']), f'с нуля: продолжение {tag}_ideal (ПР)', A.CSV, l_mm=float(p0['L_mm']))
        else:
            first = A.done_dir(tag) or A.scratch(p0, tag)
        A.log(f'  {pts14[0]["id"]}: с нуля — {"готово" if first else "НЕТ РЕЗУЛЬТАТА"}')
        A.run_geometry(pts14[1:], first, float(pts14[0]['p_cons']) if first else None)
        for td in (1.2, 1.6):
            g = by_td[td]
            res = A.done_dir(g[0]['id']) or (A.transfer(first, g[0]) if first else None)
            A.log(f'  {g[0]["id"]}: перенос — {"готово" if res else "НЕТ РЕЗУЛЬТАТА"}')
            A.run_geometry(g[1:], res, float(g[0]['p_cons']) if res else None)
    except Exception:
        A.log('А9 L 660: ОШИБКА программы: ' + traceback.format_exc())
    A.qlog('=== А9: L 660 мм — закончен')

        pts = [p for p in csv.DictReader(open(A.DESIGN, encoding='utf-8'))
               if p['set'] != 'повтор с нуля' and float(p['L_mm']) == 660.0]
        by_td = {}
        for p in pts:
            by_td.setdefault(float(p['t_d']), []).append(p)
        for k in by_td:
            by_td[k].sort(key=lambda p: float(p['p_cons']))
        A.log(f'=== А9 L 660: {len(pts)} точек')
        pts14 = by_td[1.4]
        p0, tag = pts14[0], pts14[0]['id']
        ideal = A.BASE / f'{tag}_ideal'
        # 15.10 17:00: the runner was stopped by mistake during the ideal stage of A9_42; its Fluent finished it alone
        # -> wait for that Fluent, then PR from the saved ideal field (same as the second half of A.scratch)
        def _alive(pid):
            return subprocess.run(['tasklist', '/FI', f'PID eq {pid}', '/NH'], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.count(str(pid)) > 0
        # the journal ends without /exit (the window was closed by the runner) -> close it once axis.csv is written
        while len(sys.argv) > 1 and _alive(sys.argv[1]) and not (ideal / 'axis.csv').exists():   # orphaned Fluent (pid)
            time.sleep(60)
        if len(sys.argv) > 1:
            time.sleep(60)
            for pid in sys.argv[1:]:
                subprocess.run(['taskkill', '/PID', pid, '/T', '/F'])
            time.sleep(20)
        if not A.done_dir(tag) and A.ok(ideal):
            A.log(f'  {tag}_ideal: поле идеального газа сохранено Fluent без управляющей программы — продолжение ПР')
            first = A.cont(ideal / 'result.cas.h5', tag, A.regime(p0), list(A.L.CH4_PR_LINES), float(p0['t0_svz']),
                           float(p0['t0_dzv']), f'с нуля: продолжение {tag}_ideal (ПР)', A.CSV, l_mm=float(p0['L_mm']))
        else:
            first = A.done_dir(tag) or A.scratch(p0, tag)
        A.log(f'  {pts14[0]["id"]}: с нуля — {"готово" if first else "НЕТ РЕЗУЛЬТАТА"}')
        A.run_geometry(pts14[1:], first, float(pts14[0]['p_cons']) if first else None)
        for td in (1.2, 1.6):
            g = by_td[td]
            res = A.done_dir(g[0]['id']) or (A.transfer(first, g[0]) if first else None)
            A.log(f'  {g[0]["id"]}: перенос — {"готово" if res else "НЕТ РЕЗУЛЬТАТА"}')
            A.run_geometry(g[1:], res, float(g[0]['p_cons']) if res else None)
    except Exception:
        A.log('А9 L 660: ОШИБКА программы: ' + traceback.format_exc())
    A.qlog('=== А9: L 660 мм — закончен')


===========================================================================
FILE: dataset/run_a9_архив_20261016_0930.py

"""A9 — the reference dataset (14.10.2026, author approved the plan План_А9_датасет_20261014.md, consumer pressure
0.3-1.6 MPa).  Design: runs\\a9\\a9_design.csv (make_a9_design.py).  Unit cell, counterflow, symmetry, methane PR,
brass 110, wall 1.5 mm, 5.5 MPa before the nozzle; global pseudo step (Conservative x1, fallback x0.5); auto-stop
(continuity 1.5e-4), watchdog, energy guard (growing > 300 W).
Order: L 400 mm (fields of the pilot) -> 200 mm -> 660 mm (one from-scratch start per length, at t/d 1.4; other t/d by
field transfer at the same length); inside a geometry the points go by rising consumer pressure, each from the previous
one; a jump of the consumer pressure > 0.35 MPa is made in 0.3-MPa steps (auxiliary stages, a9_aux.csv).
Repeats 'с нуля' at the end.  Rows -> runs\\a9\\a9_results.csv (training / control / repeat marked by the design id)."""
import csv, math, subprocess, sys, time, traceback
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0, r'F:\Leontiev_Project\dataset')
import run_night1213 as R          # Conservative global pseudo step in L.SOLVER_HEADER
import cont_util as U
import leontiev_pipeline as L
import gui_runner as G
import run_a3 as A3
import run_pilot_cell as PC

BASE = Path(r'F:\Leontiev_Project\runs\a9')
CSV = BASE / 'a9_results.csv'
AUX = BASE / 'a9_aux.csv'
DESIGN = BASE / 'a9_design.csv'
PILOT = Path(r'F:\Leontiev_Project\runs\pilot')
SRC400 = {1.2: PILOT / 'cell_a_t12_m03_p03_pg', 1.4: PILOT / 'cell_smooth_dp93', 1.6: PILOT / 'cell_b_t16_dp5_p03_pg2'}
SRC400_P = 0.3
CONS = '/solve/set/pseudo-time-method/global-time-step-settings yes 1 1 yes 1'
HALF = '/solve/set/pseudo-time-method/global-time-step-settings yes 1 0.5 yes 1'
ATM = 0.101325
U.NPROC, U.CFL, U.GUARD_ENERGY_W = 7, 20.0, 300.0


def log(s):
    line = time.strftime('%H:%M:%S ') + s
    print(line, flush=True)
    BASE.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with (BASE / 'a9_log.txt').open('a', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        f.write(line + '\n')


def qlog(s):
    PC.qlog(s)


def set_step(line):
    i = L.SOLVER_HEADER.index(next(x for x in L.SOLVER_HEADER if 'global-time-step-settings' in x))
    L.SOLVER_HEADER[i] = line


def ok(d):
    return (Path(d) / 'result.cas.h5').exists()


def done_dir(pid):
    """The latest saved result of a design point (resume after a pause): id, idh, idc, idch."""
    for t in (pid + 'ch', pid + 'c', pid + 'h', pid):
        if ok(BASE / t):
            return BASE / t
    return None


def converged(d):
    import gui_convergence as C
    rows = C.closed_samples(d)
    return C.decision(rows) if rows else False


def regime(pt):
    return (5.5, float(pt['p_cons']), 5.5, round(5.5 - float(pt['dp_dzv_kPa']) / 1000.0, 6))


def cont(src_case, tag, reg, extra, t0s, t0d, start, csv_path, limit=6000, l_mm=400.0):
    """One continuation stage with the half-step fallback; returns the output dir that has a result (or None)."""
    for step, suffix in ((CONS, ''), (HALF, 'h')):
        set_step(step)
        U.LIMIT = limit
        out = BASE / (tag + suffix)
        mins = U.continue_case(src_case, out, list(extra), reg, log, tag + suffix, t0_C=t0s, t0_dzv_C=t0d)
        U.record(csv_path, tag + suffix, 'work_v2', 'ch4_pr', reg, out, mins, log, start=start + (' (шаг ×0,5)' if suffix else ''),
                 t0_C=t0s, t0_dzv_C=t0d, l_heat_mm=l_mm)
        if ok(out):
            set_step(CONS)
            return out
        log(f'  {tag + suffix}: нет результата' + (' — повтор с половинным псевдошагом' if not suffix else ''))
    set_step(CONS)
    return None


def to_regime(src_dir, src_p, pt, start):
    """Ramp the consumer pressure in 0.3-MPa steps if the jump is large, then the design point itself."""
    reg = regime(pt)
    t0d, t0s = float(pt['t0_dzv']), float(pt['t0_svz'])
    cur, p = Path(src_dir), src_p
    k = 0
    while abs(reg[1] - p) > 0.35:
        p = round(p + math.copysign(0.3, reg[1] - p), 3)
        k += 1
        aux = cont(cur / 'result.cas.h5', f'{pt["id"]}_r{k}', (5.5, p, 5.5, reg[3]), [], t0s, t0d,
                   f'ступень давления потребителя {p} МПа к {pt["id"]}', AUX, limit=1500, l_mm=float(pt['L_mm']))
        if not aux:
            log(f'  {pt["id"]}: ступень {p} МПа не прошла — точка с прежнего поля')
            break
        cur = aux
    return cont(cur / 'result.cas.h5', pt['id'], reg, [], t0s, t0d, start, CSV, l_mm=float(pt['L_mm']))


def cell_params(td, l_mm, run_id, pt, gas, startup, coupled):
    cell = L.cell_geometry(td, 1.5, 4.8, 3.3)
    reg = regime(pt)
    p = dict(G.DEFAULTS)
    p.update(A3.MESHES['work_v2'], prt=0.85, mesh_custom=True, wait_free=True, dzv_counterflow=True,
             dzv_layers=PC.dzv_layers(cell['gap_mm']), p_out_svz_MPa=reg[1], p_out_dzv_MPa=reg[3], gas=gas,
             extra_lines=[L.SYMMETRY_DZV_LINE] + U.t0_lines(float(pt['t0_svz']), float(pt['t0_dzv'])),
             retries=1 if coupled > 10 else 0, startup_iters=startup, coupled_iters=coupled, cfl=5.0, l_heat_mm=l_mm,
             run_id=run_id, **{k: cell[k] for k in ('gap_mm', 'wall_thickness_inlet_mm', 'wall_thickness_end_mm')})
    return p, cell


def scratch(pt, tag):
    """From scratch: ideal methane (FMG, startup 1000, 5500 coupled), then PR at the design regime."""
    G.RUNS = BASE
    p, _ = cell_params(float(pt['t_d']), float(pt['L_mm']), f'{tag}_ideal', pt, 'ch4_ideal', 1000, 5500)
    log(f'=== {tag}: С НУЛЯ (идеальный метан → ПР), t/d {pt["t_d"]}, L {pt["L_mm"]} мм')
    t0 = time.time()
    G.run(p, lambda s: log('  ' + s), lambda: False)
    U.record(AUX, f'{tag}_ideal', 'work_v2', 'ch4_ideal', regime(pt), BASE / p['run_id'], round((time.time() - t0) / 60, 1),
             log, start='с нуля (FMG)', t0_C=float(pt['t0_svz']), t0_dzv_C=float(pt['t0_dzv']), l_heat_mm=float(pt['L_mm']))
    if not ok(BASE / p['run_id']):
        return None
    return cont(BASE / p['run_id'] / 'result.cas.h5', tag, regime(pt), list(L.CH4_PR_LINES), float(pt['t0_svz']),
                float(pt['t0_dzv']), f'с нуля: продолжение {tag}_ideal (ПР)', CSV, l_mm=float(pt['L_mm']))


def write_ip(case, ip):
    jou = ip.with_suffix('.jou')
    jou.write_text('\n'.join([f'/file/read-case-data "{L.fl(case)}"', f'/file/interpolate/write-data "{L.fl(ip)}" yes yes',
                              '/exit yes']) + '\n', encoding='ascii')
    t = time.time()
    try:
        subprocess.Popen([L.FLUENT, '2ddp', '-t1', '-g', '-i', str(jou)], cwd=str(ip.parent)).wait(900)
    finally:
        G.kill_since(t)
    return ip.exists()


def transfer(src_dir, pt):
    """New t/d at the same length: template (10 it.) + interpolation of the neighbour's field, DZV started moving."""
    G.RUNS = BASE
    td, l_mm = float(pt['t_d']), float(pt['L_mm'])
    tag = pt['id']
    p, cell = cell_params(td, l_mm, f'{tag}_tpl', pt, 'ch4_ideal', 10, 10)
    log(f'=== {tag}: шаблон новой геометрии t/d {td}, L {l_mm} мм; перенос поля {Path(src_dir).name}')
    G.run(p, lambda s: log('  ' + s), lambda: False)
    tpl = BASE / f'{tag}_tpl' / 'result.cas.h5'
    ip = BASE / 'ip' / f'{Path(src_dir).name}.ip'
    ip.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    if not tpl.exists() or not (ip.exists() or write_ip(Path(src_dir) / 'result.cas.h5', ip)):
        log(f'  {tag}: нет шаблона или файла переноса'); return None
    reg = regime(pt)
    t0d, t0s = float(pt['t0_dzv']), float(pt['t0_svz'])
    area = math.pi * (cell['cell_r_eq_mm'] ** 2 - cell['cell_r_outer_mm'] ** 2) * 1e-6
    u = -float(pt['m_target']) * 0.162 / (42.0 * area)
    init = [f'/file/interpolate/read-data "{L.fl(ip)}"', f'/solve/patch air_dzv () pressure {reg[3] / ATM:.5f}',
            f'/solve/patch air_dzv () temperature {t0d:g}', f'/solve/patch air_dzv () x-velocity ok {u:.2f}',
            '/solve/patch air_dzv () y-velocity ok 0', '/solve/patch air_dzv () k 0.1', '/solve/patch air_dzv () omega 1000',
            f'/solve/patch wall_abonite () temperature {(t0d + t0s) / 2:g}']
    return cont(tpl, tag, reg, list(L.CH4_PR_LINES) + init, t0s, t0d,
                f'перенос поля {Path(src_dir).name} на t/d {td}; ДЗВ с {u:.1f} м/с', CSV, l_mm=l_mm)


def run_geometry(points, first_src=None, first_p=None):
    """points of one geometry sorted by consumer pressure; first_src: a field of THIS geometry (pilot) or None."""
    cur, cur_p = first_src, first_p
    for pt in points:
        t0 = time.time()
        try:
            done = done_dir(pt['id'])
            if done:   # resume after a pause: converged -> reuse; saved but not converged -> continue it (tag ...c)
                if not converged(done):
                    log(f'  {pt["id"]}: возобновление — досчёт сохранённого {done.name}')
                    done = cont(done / 'result.cas.h5', pt['id'] + 'c', regime(pt), [], float(pt['t0_svz']),
                                float(pt['t0_dzv']), f'досчёт {done.name} после паузы', CSV, l_mm=float(pt['L_mm'])) or done
                cur, cur_p = done, float(pt['p_cons'])
                continue
            if cur is None:
                res = None
            else:
                res = to_regime(cur, cur_p, pt, f'продолжение {Path(cur).name}')
            if res:
                cur, cur_p = res, float(pt['p_cons'])
            log(f'  {pt["id"]}: {"готово" if res else "НЕТ РЕЗУЛЬТАТА"} за {(time.time() - t0) / 3600:.1f} ч')
        except Exception:
            log(f'{pt["id"]}: ОШИБКА программы: ' + traceback.format_exc())
    return cur, cur_p


def main():
    pts = list(csv.DictReader(open(DESIGN, encoding='utf-8')))
    work = [p for p in pts if p['set'] != 'повтор с нуля']
    rep = [p for p in pts if p['set'] == 'повтор с нуля']
    by_geo = {}
    for p in work:
        by_geo.setdefault((float(p['L_mm']), float(p['t_d'])), []).append(p)
    for k in by_geo:
        by_geo[k].sort(key=lambda p: float(p['p_cons']))
    log(f'=== А9: {len(work)} точек (обучение + контроль) + {len(rep)} повтора; порядок 400 → 200 → 660 мм')
    # L 400 mm: pilot fields of each t/d
    for td in (1.4, 1.2, 1.6):
        run_geometry(by_geo[(400.0, td)], SRC400[td], SRC400_P)
    # L 200 / 660: scratch at t/d 1.4 (first point), transfer to 1.2 / 1.6 from the first t/d-1.4 result
    for l_mm in (200.0, 660.0):
        pts14 = by_geo[(l_mm, 1.4)]
        first = done_dir(pts14[0]['id']) or scratch(pts14[0], pts14[0]['id'])
        log(f'  {pts14[0]["id"]}: с нуля — {"готово" if first else "НЕТ РЕЗУЛЬТАТА"}')
        run_geometry(pts14[1:], first, float(pts14[0]['p_cons']) if first else None)
        for td in (1.2, 1.6):
            g = by_geo[(l_mm, td)]
            res = done_dir(g[0]['id']) or (transfer(first, g[0]) if first else None)
            log(f'  {g[0]["id"]}: перенос — {"готово" if res else "НЕТ РЕЗУЛЬТАТА"}')
            run_geometry(g[1:], res, float(g[0]['p_cons']) if res else None)
    for pt in rep:
        try:
            if not done_dir(pt['id']):
                scratch(pt, pt['id'])
        except Exception:
            log(f'{pt["id"]}: ОШИБКА программы: ' + traceback.format_exc())


if __name__ == '__main__':
    qlog('=== А9 датасет-эталон — начат')
    try:
        main()
    except Exception:
        log('А9: ОШИБКА программы: ' + traceback.format_exc())
    qlog('=== А9 датасет-эталон — закончен')

    return (5.5, float(pt['p_cons']), 5.5, round(5.5 - float(pt['dp_dzv_kPa']) / 1000.0, 6))


POINT_LIMIT = 6000   # 16.10 author: cap per design point (run_a9_l660 sets 3000); unconverged -> reviewed later
RESUME_CONT = True   # 16.10: False -> a saved unconverged point is reused as is (no continuation on resume)


def cont(src_case, tag, reg, extra, t0s, t0d, start, csv_path, limit=None, l_mm=400.0):
    """One continuation stage with the half-step fallback; returns the output dir that has a result (or None)."""
    for step, suffix in ((CONS, ''), (HALF, 'h')):
        set_step(step)
        U.LIMIT = min(limit, POINT_LIMIT) if limit else POINT_LIMIT
        out = BASE / (tag + suffix)
        mins = U.continue_case(src_case, out, list(extra), reg, log, tag + suffix, t0_C=t0s, t0_dzv_C=t0d)
        U.record(csv_path, tag + suffix, 'work_v2', 'ch4_pr', reg, out, mins, log, start=start + (' (шаг ×0,5)' if suffix else ''),
                 t0_C=t0s, t0_dzv_C=t0d, l_heat_mm=l_mm)
        if ok(out):
            set_step(CONS)
            return out
        log(f'  {tag + suffix}: нет результата' + (' — повтор с половинным псевдошагом' if not suffix else ''))
    set_step(CONS)
    return None


def to_regime(src_dir, src_p, pt, start):
    """Ramp the consumer pressure in 0.3-MPa steps if the jump is large, then the design point itself."""
    reg = regime(pt)
    t0d, t0s = float(pt['t0_dzv']), float(pt['t0_svz'])
    cur, p = Path(src_dir), src_p
    k = 0
    while abs(reg[1] - p) > 0.35:
        p = round(p + math.copysign(0.3, reg[1] - p), 3)
        k += 1
        done_aux = [BASE / f'{pt["id"]}_r{k}{s}' for s in ('', 'h') if ok(BASE / f'{pt["id"]}_r{k}{s}')]
        if not done_aux and (BASE / f'{pt["id"]}_r{k}h').exists():   # 16.10: this step already failed twice (full + half)
            log(f'  {pt["id"]}: ступень {p} МПа уже не прошла (оба псевдошага) — точка с прежнего поля')
            break
        aux = done_aux[0] if done_aux else cont(cur / 'result.cas.h5', f'{pt["id"]}_r{k}', (5.5, p, 5.5, reg[3]), [], t0s, t0d,
                   f'ступень давления потребителя {p} МПа к {pt["id"]}', AUX, limit=1500, l_mm=float(pt['L_mm']))   # 16.10: reuse a saved step
        if not aux:
            log(f'  {pt["id"]}: ступень {p} МПа не прошла — точка с прежнего поля')
            break
        cur = aux
    return cont(cur / 'result.cas.h5', pt['id'], reg, [], t0s, t0d, start, CSV, l_mm=float(pt['L_mm']))


def cell_params(td, l_mm, run_id, pt, gas, startup, coupled):
