             extra_lines=[L.SYMMETRY_DZV_LINE] + U.t0_lines(float(pt['t0_svz']), float(pt['t0_dzv'])),
             retries=1 if coupled > 10 else 0, startup_iters=startup, coupled_iters=coupled, cfl=5.0, l_heat_mm=l_mm,
             run_id=run_id, **{k: cell[k] for k in ('gap_mm', 'wall_thickness_inlet_mm', 'wall_thickness_end_mm')})
    return p, cell


def scratch(pt, tag):
    """From scratch: ideal methane (FMG, startup 1000, 5500 coupled), then PR at the design regime."""
    G.RUNS = BASE
    p, _ = cell_params(float(pt['t_d']), float(pt['L_mm']), f'{tag}_ideal', pt, 'ch4_ideal', 1000, 5500)
    log(f'=== {tag}: С НУЛЯ (идеальный метан → ПР), t/d {pt["t_d"]}, L {pt["L_mm"]} мм')
    t0 = time.time()
    G.run(p, lambda s: log('  ' + s), lambda: False)
    U.record(AUX, f'{tag}_ideal', 'work_v2', 'ch4_ideal', regime(pt), BASE / p['run_id'], round((time.time() - t0) / 60, 1),
             log, start='с нуля (FMG)', t0_C=float(pt['t0_svz']), t0_dzv_C=float(pt['t0_dzv']), l_heat_mm=float(pt['L_mm']))
    if not ok(BASE / p['run_id']):
        return None
    return cont(BASE / p['run_id'] / 'result.cas.h5', tag, regime(pt), list(L.CH4_PR_LINES), float(pt['t0_svz']),
                float(pt['t0_dzv']), f'с нуля: продолжение {tag}_ideal (ПР)', CSV, l_mm=float(pt['L_mm']))


def write_ip(case, ip):
    jou = ip.with_suffix('.jou')
    jou.write_text('\n'.join([f'/file/read-case-data "{L.fl(case)}"', f'/file/interpolate/write-data "{L.fl(ip)}" yes yes',
                              '/exit yes']) + '\n', encoding='ascii')
    t = time.time()
    try:
        subprocess.Popen([L.FLUENT, '2ddp', '-t1', '-g', '-i', str(jou)], cwd=str(ip.parent)).wait(900)
    finally:
        G.kill_since(t)
    return ip.exists()


def transfer(src_dir, pt):
    """New t/d at the same length: template (10 it.) + interpolation of the neighbour's field, DZV started moving."""
    G.RUNS = BASE
    td, l_mm = float(pt['t_d']), float(pt['L_mm'])
    tag = pt['id']
    p, cell = cell_params(td, l_mm, f'{tag}_tpl', pt, 'ch4_ideal', 10, 10)
    log(f'=== {tag}: шаблон новой геометрии t/d {td}, L {l_mm} мм; перенос поля {Path(src_dir).name}')
    G.run(p, lambda s: log('  ' + s), lambda: False)
    tpl = BASE / f'{tag}_tpl' / 'result.cas.h5'
    ip = BASE / 'ip' / f'{Path(src_dir).name}.ip'
    ip.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    if not tpl.exists() or not (ip.exists() or write_ip(Path(src_dir) / 'result.cas.h5', ip)):
        log(f'  {tag}: нет шаблона или файла переноса'); return None
    reg = regime(pt)
    t0d, t0s = float(pt['t0_dzv']), float(pt['t0_svz'])
    area = math.pi * (cell['cell_r_eq_mm'] ** 2 - cell['cell_r_outer_mm'] ** 2) * 1e-6
    u = -float(pt['m_target']) * 0.162 / (42.0 * area)
    init = [f'/file/interpolate/read-data "{L.fl(ip)}"', f'/solve/patch air_dzv () pressure {reg[3] / ATM:.5f}',
            f'/solve/patch air_dzv () temperature {t0d:g}', f'/solve/patch air_dzv () x-velocity ok {u:.2f}',
            '/solve/patch air_dzv () y-velocity ok 0', '/solve/patch air_dzv () k 0.1', '/solve/patch air_dzv () omega 1000',
            f'/solve/patch wall_abonite () temperature {(t0d + t0s) / 2:g}']
    return cont(tpl, tag, reg, list(L.CH4_PR_LINES) + init, t0s, t0d,
                f'перенос поля {Path(src_dir).name} на t/d {td}; ДЗВ с {u:.1f} м/с', CSV, l_mm=l_mm)


def run_geometry(points, first_src=None, first_p=None):
    """points of one geometry sorted by consumer pressure; first_src: a field of THIS geometry (pilot) or None."""
    cur, cur_p = first_src, first_p
    for pt in points:
        t0 = time.time()
        try:
            done = done_dir(pt['id'])
            if done:   # resume after a pause: converged -> reuse; saved but not converged -> continue it (tag ...c)
                if RESUME_CONT and not converged(done):
                    log(f'  {pt["id"]}: возобновление — досчёт сохранённого {done.name}')
                    done = cont(done / 'result.cas.h5', pt['id'] + 'c', regime(pt), [], float(pt['t0_svz']),
                                float(pt['t0_dzv']), f'досчёт {done.name} после паузы', CSV, l_mm=float(pt['L_mm'])) or done
                cur, cur_p = done, float(pt['p_cons'])
                continue
            if cur is None:
                res = None
            else:
                res = to_regime(cur, cur_p, pt, f'продолжение {Path(cur).name}')
            if res:
                cur, cur_p = res, float(pt['p_cons'])
            log(f'  {pt["id"]}: {"готово" if res else "НЕТ РЕЗУЛЬТАТА"} за {(time.time() - t0) / 3600:.1f} ч')
        except Exception:
            log(f'{pt["id"]}: ОШИБКА программы: ' + traceback.format_exc())
    return cur, cur_p


def main():
    pts = list(csv.DictReader(open(DESIGN, encoding='utf-8')))
    work = [p for p in pts if p['set'] != 'повтор с нуля']
    rep = [p for p in pts if p['set'] == 'повтор с нуля']
    by_geo = {}
    for p in work:
        by_geo.setdefault((float(p['L_mm']), float(p['t_d'])), []).append(p)
    for k in by_geo:
        by_geo[k].sort(key=lambda p: float(p['p_cons']))
    log(f'=== А9: {len(work)} точек (обучение + контроль) + {len(rep)} повтора; порядок 400 → 200 → 660 мм')
    # L 400 mm: pilot fields of each t/d
    for td in (1.4, 1.2, 1.6):
        run_geometry(by_geo[(400.0, td)], SRC400[td], SRC400_P)
    # L 200 / 660: scratch at t/d 1.4 (first point), transfer to 1.2 / 1.6 from the first t/d-1.4 result
    for l_mm in (200.0, 660.0):
        pts14 = by_geo[(l_mm, 1.4)]
        first = done_dir(pts14[0]['id']) or scratch(pts14[0], pts14[0]['id'])
        log(f'  {pts14[0]["id"]}: с нуля — {"готово" if first else "НЕТ РЕЗУЛЬТАТА"}')
        run_geometry(pts14[1:], first, float(pts14[0]['p_cons']) if first else None)
        for td in (1.2, 1.6):
            g = by_geo[(l_mm, td)]
            res = done_dir(g[0]['id']) or (transfer(first, g[0]) if first else None)
            log(f'  {g[0]["id"]}: перенос — {"готово" if res else "НЕТ РЕЗУЛЬТАТА"}')
            run_geometry(g[1:], res, float(g[0]['p_cons']) if res else None)
    for pt in rep:
        try:
            if not done_dir(pt['id']):
                scratch(pt, pt['id'])
        except Exception:
            log(f'{pt["id"]}: ОШИБКА программы: ' + traceback.format_exc())


if __name__ == '__main__':
    qlog('=== А9 датасет-эталон — начат')
    try:
        main()
    except Exception:
        log('А9: ОШИБКА программы: ' + traceback.format_exc())
    qlog('=== А9 датасет-эталон — закончен')

"""A9 — the reference dataset (14.10.2026, author approved the plan План_А9_датасет_20261014.md, consumer pressure
0.3-1.6 MPa).  Design: runs\\a9\\a9_design.csv (make_a9_design.py).  Unit cell, counterflow, symmetry, methane PR,
brass 110, wall 1.5 mm, 5.5 MPa before the nozzle; global pseudo step (Conservative x1, fallback x0.5); auto-stop
(continuity 1.5e-4), watchdog, energy guard (growing > 300 W).
Order: L 400 mm (fields of the pilot) -> 200 mm -> 660 mm (one from-scratch start per length, at t/d 1.4; other t/d by
field transfer at the same length); inside a geometry the points go by rising consumer pressure, each from the previous
one; a jump of the consumer pressure > 0.35 MPa is made in 0.3-MPa steps (auxiliary stages, a9_aux.csv).
Repeats 'с нуля' at the end.  Rows -> runs\\a9\\a9_results.csv (training / control / repeat marked by the design id)."""
import csv, math, subprocess, sys, time, traceback
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0, r'F:\Leontiev_Project\dataset')
import run_night1213 as R          # Conservative global pseudo step in L.SOLVER_HEADER
import cont_util as U
import leontiev_pipeline as L
import gui_runner as G
import run_a3 as A3
import run_pilot_cell as PC

BASE = Path(r'F:\Leontiev_Project\runs\a9')
CSV = BASE / 'a9_results.csv'
AUX = BASE / 'a9_aux.csv'
DESIGN = BASE / 'a9_design.csv'
PILOT = Path(r'F:\Leontiev_Project\runs\pilot')
SRC400 = {1.2: PILOT / 'cell_a_t12_m03_p03_pg', 1.4: PILOT / 'cell_smooth_dp93', 1.6: PILOT / 'cell_b_t16_dp5_p03_pg2'}
SRC400_P = 0.3
CONS = '/solve/set/pseudo-time-method/global-time-step-settings yes 1 1 yes 1'
HALF = '/solve/set/pseudo-time-method/global-time-step-settings yes 1 0.5 yes 1'
ATM = 0.101325
U.NPROC, U.CFL, U.GUARD_ENERGY_W = 7, 20.0, 300.0


def log(s):
    line = time.strftime('%H:%M:%S ') + s
    print(line, flush=True)
    BASE.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with (BASE / 'a9_log.txt').open('a', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        f.write(line + '\n')


def qlog(s):
    PC.qlog(s)


def set_step(line):
    i = L.SOLVER_HEADER.index(next(x for x in L.SOLVER_HEADER if 'global-time-step-settings' in x))
    L.SOLVER_HEADER[i] = line


def ok(d):
    return (Path(d) / 'result.cas.h5').exists()


def done_dir(pid):
    """The latest saved result of a design point (resume after a pause): id, idh, idc, idch."""
    for t in (pid + 'ch', pid + 'c', pid + 'h', pid):
        if ok(BASE / t):
            return BASE / t
    return None


def converged(d):
    import gui_convergence as C
    rows = C.closed_samples(d)
    return C.decision(rows) if rows else False


def regime(pt):
    return (5.5, float(pt['p_cons']), 5.5, round(5.5 - float(pt['dp_dzv_kPa']) / 1000.0, 6))


POINT_LIMIT = 6000   # 16.10 author: cap per design point (run_a9_l660 sets 3000); unconverged -> reviewed later
RESUME_CONT = True   # 16.10: False -> a saved unconverged point is reused as is (no continuation on resume)


def cont(src_case, tag, reg, extra, t0s, t0d, start, csv_path, limit=None, l_mm=400.0):
    """One continuation stage with the half-step fallback; returns the output dir that has a result (or None)."""
    for step, suffix in ((CONS, ''), (HALF, 'h')):
        set_step(step)
        U.LIMIT = min(limit, POINT_LIMIT) if limit else POINT_LIMIT
        out = BASE / (tag + suffix)
        mins = U.continue_case(src_case, out, list(extra), reg, log, tag + suffix, t0_C=t0s, t0_dzv_C=t0d)
        U.record(csv_path, tag + suffix, 'work_v2', 'ch4_pr', reg, out, mins, log, start=start + (' (шаг ×0,5)' if suffix else ''),
                 t0_C=t0s, t0_dzv_C=t0d, l_heat_mm=l_mm)
        if ok(out):
            set_step(CONS)
            return out
        log(f'  {tag + suffix}: нет результата' + (' — повтор с половинным псевдошагом' if not suffix else ''))
    set_step(CONS)
    return None


def to_regime(src_dir, src_p, pt, start):
    """Ramp the consumer pressure in 0.3-MPa steps if the jump is large, then the design point itself."""
    reg = regime(pt)
    t0d, t0s = float(pt['t0_dzv']), float(pt['t0_svz'])
    cur, p = Path(src_dir), src_p
    k = 0
    while abs(reg[1] - p) > 0.35:
        p = round(p + math.copysign(0.3, reg[1] - p), 3)
        k += 1
        done_aux = [BASE / f'{pt["id"]}_r{k}{s}' for s in ('', 'h') if ok(BASE / f'{pt["id"]}_r{k}{s}')]
        if not done_aux and (BASE / f'{pt["id"]}_r{k}h').exists():   # 16.10: this step already failed twice (full + half)
            log(f'  {pt["id"]}: ступень {p} МПа уже не прошла (оба псевдошага) — точка с прежнего поля')
            break
        aux = done_aux[0] if done_aux else cont(cur / 'result.cas.h5', f'{pt["id"]}_r{k}', (reg[0], p, reg[2], reg[3]), [], t0s, t0d,
                   f'ступень давления потребителя {p} МПа к {pt["id"]}', AUX, limit=1500, l_mm=float(pt['L_mm']))   # 16.10: reuse a saved step
        if not aux:
            log(f'  {pt["id"]}: ступень {p} МПа не прошла — точка с прежнего поля')
            break
        cur = aux
    return cont(cur / 'result.cas.h5', pt['id'], reg, [], t0s, t0d, start, CSV, l_mm=float(pt['L_mm']))


def cell_params(td, l_mm, run_id, pt, gas, startup, coupled):
    cell = L.cell_geometry(td, 1.5, 4.8, 3.3)
    reg = regime(pt)
    p = dict(G.DEFAULTS)
    p.update(A3.MESHES['work_v2'], prt=0.85, mesh_custom=True, wait_free=True, dzv_counterflow=True,
             dzv_layers=PC.dzv_layers(cell['gap_mm']), p_out_svz_MPa=reg[1], p_out_dzv_MPa=reg[3], gas=gas,
             extra_lines=[L.SYMMETRY_DZV_LINE] + U.t0_lines(float(pt['t0_svz']), float(pt['t0_dzv'])),
             retries=1 if coupled > 10 else 0, startup_iters=startup, coupled_iters=coupled, cfl=5.0, l_heat_mm=l_mm,
             run_id=run_id, **{k: cell[k] for k in ('gap_mm', 'wall_thickness_inlet_mm', 'wall_thickness_end_mm')})
    return p, cell

"""Queue after run_resume_0909.py (09.10.2026, agreed by the author 10:15: run items 3-7 of the pre-dataset list back to
back, no idle machine).  Waits for run_resume_0909.py to finish.  Rows -> runs\\day0909\\day0909_results.csv, log
day0909_log.txt (cont_util.record: Fluent total temperatures + enthalpy-based temperatures for methane).
  P1 L700 coarse (methane PR) continuation: the night run stopped on the iteration limit by continuity only
  P2 brass wall k = 110 W/(m K) on the anchor (work_v2, methane PR, continuation of a6_ch4_pr, wall 234 -> 110)
  P3 targeted mass flow at the DZV outlet (Fluent 'targeted-mf' at outlet_dzv, syntax checked 09.10 10:33 on a -t1 probe):
     a) target = anchor G_dzv 0.049462 kg/s (must reproduce p_out_dzv ~ 5.2 MPa = 51.32 atm),
     b) target 0.095 kg/s (m ~ 0.6) from a); the actual outlet pressure is read back by a short -t1 report session
  P4 start boundary on the consumer pressure: chamber case (air) 1.2 -> 1.6 -> 2.0 -> 2.5 MPa until the shock enters
     the channel (run_a4.back_pressure, same stop rule as run_a4.main)
The night series wall (234) is kept for P1/P3 (comparison with their bases); P2 sets 110 explicitly."""
import re, subprocess, sys, time, traceback
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0, r'F:\Leontiev_Project\dataset')
import leontiev_pipeline as L
import gui_runner as G
import cont_util as U

BASE = Path(r'F:\Leontiev_Project\runs\day0909')
CSV = BASE / 'day0909_results.csv'
QLOG = Path(r'F:\Leontiev_Project\runs\queue_log.txt')
ANCHOR = (5.5, 0.3, 5.5, 5.2)
WORK_PR = Path(r'F:\Leontiev_Project\runs\a6\a6_ch4_pr\result.cas.h5')
L700_PR = Path(r'F:\Leontiev_Project\runs\night\pair_L700_coarse_pr\result.cas.h5')
CHAMBER_120 = Path(r'F:\Leontiev_Project\runs\a4\a4_chamber_p120\result.cas.h5')
ATM = 0.101325   # MPa


def log(s):
    line = time.strftime('%H:%M:%S ') + s
    print(line, flush=True)
    BASE.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with (BASE / 'day0909_log.txt').open('a', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        f.write(line + '\n')


def qlog(s):
    with QLOG.open('a', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        f.write(time.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S ') + s + '\n')


def running(name):
    out = subprocess.run(['powershell', '-NoProfile', '-Command',
                          f"Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter \"Name='python.exe'\" | ? {{$_.CommandLine -match '{name}'}} | Measure-Object | % Count"],
                         capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.strip()
    return out not in ('', '0')


def tmf_lines(g):
    # pmin/pmax are absolute pressures in the case units (atm): 5 atm (0.51 MPa) .. 54 atm (5.47 MPa < p0 5.5 MPa)
    return [f'/define/boundary-conditions/set/pressure-outlet outlet_dzv () targeted-mf-boundary? yes targeted-mf no {g:g} '
            'targeted-mf-pmin no 5 targeted-mf-pmax no 54 q']


def outlet_pressures(out):
    """Short -t1 session: area-weighted static pressure at outlet_dzv / outlet_svz (atm, operating pressure 0)."""
    out = Path(out); trn = out / 'report_p.trn'
    jou = out / 'report_p.jou'
    jou.write_text('\n'.join([f'/file/start-transcript "{L.fl(out)}/report_p.trn"',
                              f'/file/read-case-data "{L.fl(out)}/result.cas.h5"',
                              '/report/surface-integrals/area-weighted-avg outlet_dzv outlet_svz () pressure no',
                              '/file/stop-transcript', '/exit yes', 'yes', '']), encoding='ascii')
    while G.fluent_running():
        time.sleep(30)
    with open(jou, 'rb') as stdin:
        subprocess.run([L.FLUENT, '2ddp', '-t1', '-g'], cwd=str(out), stdin=stdin, stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,
                       stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL, timeout=600)
    txt = trn.read_text(errors='ignore') if trn.exists() else ''
    vals = dict(re.findall(r'^\s*(outlet_dzv|outlet_svz)\s+([-\d.eE+]+)\s*$', txt, re.M))
    return {k: float(v) * ATM for k, v in vals.items()}


def cont(tag, mesh, src, regime, extra=(), wall_k=None, l_heat_mm=400.0, gas='ch4_pr', tmf=False):
    out = BASE / tag
    m = U.continue_case(src, out, list(extra), regime, log, tag, wall_k=wall_k)
    if tmf and (out / 'result.cas.h5').exists():
        try:
            p = outlet_pressures(out)
            if 'outlet_dzv' in p:
                log(f'  {tag}: давление на выходе ДЗВ при заданном расходе {p["outlet_dzv"]:.4f} МПа '
                    f'(СВЗ {p.get("outlet_svz", float("nan")):.4f} МПа)')
                regime = (regime[0], regime[1], regime[2], round(p['outlet_dzv'], 4))
        except Exception:
            log(f'  {tag}: давление на выходе ДЗВ не прочитано: ' + traceback.format_exc().splitlines()[-1])
    U.record(CSV, tag, mesh, gas, regime, out, m, log, start=f'продолжение {Path(src).parent.name}', l_heat_mm=l_heat_mm)
    return out / 'result.cas.h5' if (out / 'result.cas.h5').exists() else None


def step(name, fn):
    qlog(f'день 09.10: {name} — начат'); t0 = time.time()
    try:
        fn(); qlog(f'день 09.10: {name} — скрипт завершён за {(time.time() - t0) / 60:.0f} мин (приёмка — по результатам)')
    except Exception:
        qlog(f'день 09.10: {name} — ОШИБКА программы:\n' + traceback.format_exc())


def boundary():
    import run_a4
    prev = CHAMBER_120
    if not prev.exists():
        return log('P4: нет кейса камеры 1,2 МПа — пропуск')
    for pout in (1.6, 2.0, 2.5):
        res, case = run_a4.back_pressure(prev, pout, 'chamber')
        if (res.get('status') == 'сбой' or res.get('x_shock_m') not in ('', None)
                or 'нет сверхзвука' in str(res.get('reason')) or not case.exists()):
            run_a4.log(f'chamber: при {pout} МПа канал уже не сверхзвуковой по всей длине (или сбой) — граница запуска найдена')
            break
        prev = case


if __name__ == '__main__':
    G.DEFAULTS['wall_k'] = None
    qlog('=== день 09.10 (P1–P4): жду окончания run_resume_0909')
    while running('run_resume_0909'):
        time.sleep(60)
    step('P1 L700 грубая (метан ПР), доводка', lambda: cont('L700_coarse_pr_cont', 'coarse_v2', L700_PR, ANCHOR, l_heat_mm=700.0))
    step('P2 стенка латунь 110 (якорь, рабочая)', lambda: cont('brass110_work_pr', 'work_v2', WORK_PR, ANCHOR, wall_k=110))

    def tmf():
        a = cont('tmf_0495_work_pr', 'work_v2', WORK_PR, ANCHOR, extra=tmf_lines(0.049462), tmf=True)
        if a:
            cont('tmf_0950_work_pr', 'work_v2', a, ANCHOR, extra=tmf_lines(0.095), tmf=True)
    step('P3 заданный расход на выходе ДЗВ (метан ПР, рабочая)', tmf)
    step('P4 граница запуска: камера 1,6 / 2,0 / 2,5 МПа (воздух)', boundary)
    qlog('=== день 09.10 (P1–P4): очередь закончена')

===========================================================================
FILE: dataset/run_cell_checks.py
===========================================================================
"""13.10.2026 (author agreed): checks of the unit cell left from the pilot plan (plan v2, item 6), global pseudo step
(Conservative).  Reference: cell_d_t14_m01_p03_pg (t/d 1.4, wall 1.5 mm, gap 2.96 mm, p 0.3 MPa, DZV drop 0.5 kPa,
m 0.155, Q 510.4 W, effect +1.44 K).
T1/T2 wall at the channel end 1.0 / 2.0 mm with the SAME gap 2.96 mm (only the wall changes; the tube OD and the cell
radius follow) — transfer from d;  T3 coarse mesh (coarse_v2, DZV layers for h1 0.2 um) — transfer from d;
T4 start boundary at the highest m: cell_c_t14_m10_p03_pg (m 1.11) continued to consumer pressure 1.6 and 2.0 MPa."""
import sys, time, traceback
sys.path.insert(0, r'F:\Leontiev_Project\dataset')
import run_night1213 as R          # Conservative global pseudo step in L.SOLVER_HEADER
import leontiev_pipeline as L
import gui_runner as G
import run_a3 as A3
F, P, U, log = R.F, R.P, R.U, R.log
REF = 'cell_d_t14_m01_p03_pg'
GAP14 = L.cell_geometry(1.4, 1.5, 4.8, 3.3)['gap_mm']


def template(tag, wall_mm=1.5, mesh='work_v2', h1=1e-4):
    cell = L.cell_geometry(1.4, wall_mm, 4.8, 3.3)
    p = dict(G.DEFAULTS)
    p.update(A3.MESHES[mesh], prt=0.85, mesh_custom=True, wait_free=True, dzv_counterflow=True,
             dzv_layers=P.dzv_layers(GAP14, h1_mm=h1), p_out_svz_MPa=0.3, p_out_dzv_MPa=5.4995, gas='ch4_ideal',
             extra_lines=[L.SYMMETRY_DZV_LINE, U.t0_line(15.0)], retries=0, startup_iters=10, coupled_iters=10, cfl=5.0,
             gap_mm=GAP14, wall_thickness_inlet_mm=cell['wall_thickness_inlet_mm'], wall_thickness_end_mm=wall_mm,
             run_id=f'{tag}_tpl')
    G.RUNS = P.BASE
    log(f'=== {tag}: шаблон (стенка {wall_mm} мм, зазор {GAP14:.2f} мм, сетка {mesh})')
    G.run(p, lambda s: log('  ' + s), lambda: False)
    return P.BASE / p['run_id'] / 'result.cas.h5'


def transfer(tag, **kw):
    U.LIMIT = 5000
    tpl = template(tag, **kw)
    ip = P.BASE / 'ip' / f'{REF}.ip'
    ip.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    if not tpl.exists() or not (ip.exists() or F.write_ip(REF, ip)):
        return log(f'  {tag}: нет шаблона или файла переноса')
    reg = (5.5, 0.3, 5.5, 5.4995)
    F.cont(tpl, f'{tag}_pg', reg, list(L.CH4_PR_LINES) + F.interp_lines(ip, reg[3]), None, f'перенос поля {REF}; {kw}')
    r, r0 = F.rows(f'{tag}_pg'), F.rows(REF)
    for k in ('G_dzv', 'Q', 'dT_svz_vs_throttle', 'dT_dzv_h'):
        try:
            log(f'  {tag} против {REF}, {k}: {float(r[k]):.4f} / {float(r0[k]):.4f} (разница {float(r[k]) - float(r0[k]):+.4f})')
        except Exception:
            pass


def boundary():
    U.LIMIT = 5000
    src = 'cell_c_t14_m10_p03_pg'
    for pout in (1.6, 2.0):
        tag = f'cell_c_t14_dp24_p{int(pout * 10):02d}_pg'
        F.cont(P.BASE / src / 'result.cas.h5', tag, (5.5, pout, 5.5, 5.47603), [], None,
               f'продолжение {src}: давление потребителя {pout} МПа (граница запуска)')
        if F.ok(tag):
            src = tag


if __name__ == '__main__':
    P.qlog('=== проверки ячейки (стенка 1,0/2,0, грубая сетка, граница запуска) — начат')
    for name, fn in (('стенка 1,0 мм', lambda: transfer('cell_w10', wall_mm=1.0)),
                     ('стенка 2,0 мм', lambda: transfer('cell_w20', wall_mm=2.0)),
                     ('грубая сетка', lambda: transfer('cell_coarse', mesh='coarse_v2', h1=2e-4)),
                     ('граница запуска', boundary)):
        t0 = time.time()
        try:
            fn()
            P.qlog(f'проверки ячейки: {name} — {(time.time() - t0) / 60:.0f} мин')
        except Exception:
            log(f'{name}: ОШИБКА программы: ' + traceback.format_exc())
    P.qlog('=== проверки ячейки — закончен')


===========================================================================
FILE: dataset/run_cfl_test.py
===========================================================================
"""11.10.2026 ~12:40 (author agreed): CFL test on the pilot cell, then the rest of the pilot.
Problem: at CFL 5 the DZV flow of the cell drifts very slowly after a change of the DZV outlet pressure (cell a p1:
0.0965 -> 0.0889 kg/s over 5000 it., still drifting) -> stages end at the iteration limit, m corrections miss.
Test from cell_a_t12_m03_p03_p2 (saved, ~21 500 it., m 0.50, same regime 5.5 -> 5.49663 MPa): 1500 iterations at
CFL 20; if it fails (FPE / journal error / stall) -> 1500 at CFL 10.  Measures: stability, DZV flow drift per 100 it.
(CFL 5 reference: ~0.15 %/100).  The stable CFL (or 5) is then used: continue point a to convergence with one m
correction, then the neighbour chain c -> d -> e -> b of run_pilot_fast.py."""
import sys, time, traceback
sys.path.insert(0, r'F:\Leontiev_Project\dataset')
import run_pilot_fast as F
import cont_util as U
import gui_convergence as C

P, log = F.P, F.log
REG = (5.5, 0.3, 5.5, 5.49663)
G_T = 0.3 * 0.162438


def drift(tag):
    rows = C.closed_samples(P.BASE / tag)
    if len(rows) < 2:
        return None
    a, b = rows[0], rows[-1]
    n = (b['iteration'] - a['iteration']) / 100
    return abs(b['m_dzv'] - a['m_dzv']) / abs(a['m_dzv']) * 100 / n if n else None, a['m_dzv'], b['m_dzv']


def test():
    src = P.BASE / 'cell_a_t12_m03_p03_p2' / 'result.cas.h5'
    for cfl in (20.0, 10.0):
        U.CFL, U.LIMIT = cfl, 1500
        tag = f'cell_a_cfl{int(cfl)}'
        F.cont(src, tag, REG, [], G_T, f'тест CFL {cfl:g} от cell_a_t12_m03_p03_p2')
        d = drift(tag)
        good = F.ok(tag)
        log(f'  тест CFL {cfl:g}: результат {"есть" if good else "НЕТ (сбой)"}; расход ДЗВ {d[1]:.5f} -> {d[2]:.5f} кг/с, '
            f'дрейф {d[0]:.3f} %/100 ит. (CFL 5: ~0,15)' if d else f'  тест CFL {cfl:g}: нет данных')
        if good:
            return cfl, tag
    return 5.0, 'cell_a_t12_m03_p03_p2'


def main():
    cfl, src_tag = test()
    U.CFL, U.LIMIT = cfl, 5500
    log(f'=== выбран CFL {cfl:g}; точка a: продолжение до сходимости от {src_tag}')
    r = F.cont(P.BASE / src_tag / 'result.cas.h5', 'cell_a_t12_m03_p03_p3', REG, [], G_T, f'продолжение {src_tag} (CFL {cfl:g})')
    tag = 'cell_a_t12_m03_p03_p3'
    if F.ok(tag) and r.get('G_dzv'):
        mc = float(r['G_dzv']) / float(r['G_svz'])
        log(f'  {tag}: m {mc:.3f} (цель 0,3)')
        if abs(mc - 0.3) / 0.3 > 0.05:
            dp = 0.00337 * (0.3 / mc) ** 1.8
            r = F.cont(P.BASE / tag / 'result.cas.h5', 'cell_a_t12_m03_p03_p4', (5.5, 0.3, 5.5, round(5.5 - dp, 6)), [], G_T,
                       f'продолжение {tag} (CFL {cfl:g})')
    a = next((t for t in ('cell_a_t12_m03_p03_p4', 'cell_a_t12_m03_p03_p3', 'cell_a_t12_m03_p03_p2')
              if F.ok(t) and F.rows(t).get('G_dzv')), None)
    gap_a, gap14 = F.params(1.2, 0.3)[1], F.params(1.4, 0.3)[1]
    c = F.point('cell_c_t14_m10_p03', 1.4, 1.0, 0.3, a, gap_a, False)
    if c:
        F.point('cell_d_t14_m01_p03', 1.4, 0.1, 0.3, c, gap14, True)
        F.point('cell_e_t14_m03_p12', 1.4, 0.3, 1.2, c, gap14, True)
        F.point('cell_b_t16_m03_p03', 1.6, 0.3, 0.3, c, gap14, False)
    else:
        F.point('cell_b_t16_m03_p03', 1.6, 0.3, 0.3, a, gap_a, False)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    P.qlog('=== тест CFL на ячейке + пилот (цепочка) — начат')
    try:
        main()
    except Exception:
        log('тест CFL / пилот: ОШИБКА программы: ' + traceback.format_exc())
    P.qlog('=== тест CFL + пилот — закончен')

"""12.10.2026 21:30 (author agreed): does the global pseudo time step (D2) change a converged steady answer?

(same settings as D2) for up to 3000 it. at the same regime; compare dTc, dTh (total T), Q, G_dzv with m075e.
Then (if unchanged) continue the pilot points c and d (their last stages) with the same method to convergence."""
import sys, time, traceback

    try:
        main()
    except Exception:
        log('проверка: ОШИБКА программы: ' + traceback.format_exc())
    P.qlog('=== проверка глобального псевдошага — закончен')

FILE: dataset/run_check_pseudo_a5b.py

"""12.10.2026 22:40 — the global pseudo step with the 'Aggressive' length scale DIVERGED on the experiment-check point
a5v3_m075e (air 1.05 MPa, AMG divergence at it. 15742, ~250 it. after the start), while on the methane cell (5.5 MPa) it
converged fast (e: 46 min, c: 24 min).  Second try on m075e with the 'Conservative' length scale (option 1), factor 1;
if it fails again — factor 0.5.  Waits for run_check_pseudo_a5.py (point d) to finish.  Compares with m075e."""
import sys, time, traceback
sys.path.insert(0, r'F:\Leontiev_Project\dataset')
import run_diag_d2 as D2
import leontiev_pipeline as L
import run_a5v3b6 as B6
import cont_util as U
P = D2.P
B, A = B6.B, B6.A
U.NPROC, U.LIMIT, U.CFL = 7, 3000, 20.0
GLOBAL = '/solve/set/pseudo-time-method/global-time-step-settings yes 0 1 yes 1'


def run(variant, settings):
    L.SOLVER_HEADER[L.SOLVER_HEADER.index(next(x for x in L.SOLVER_HEADER if 'global-time-step-settings' in x))] = settings
    src, tag, pod = 'a5v3_m075e', f'a5v3_m075e_pg{variant}', 1.033195
    A.log(f'=== проверка глобального псевдошага на m075e, вариант {variant}: {settings.split("settings ")[1]}')
    mins = U.continue_case(A.BASE / src / 'result.cas.h5', A.BASE / tag, A.TMF_OFF, (B.P0, 0.1, B.P0, pod), A.log, tag,
                           t0_C=A.T0_C)
    r = U.record(A.CSV, tag, 'rig_work_v2', 'air', (B.P0, 0.1, B.P0, pod), A.BASE / tag, mins, A.log,
                 start=f'продолжение {src} (глобальный псевдошаг, {variant})', t0_C=A.T0_C, l_heat_mm=700.0)
    if not (A.BASE / tag / 'result.cas.h5').exists():
        return False
    r0 = B6.rows_of(src)
    for k in ('dT_svz_total', 'dT_dzv_total', 'Q', 'G_dzv'):
        a, b = float(r0[k]), float(r[k])
        A.log(f'  сравнение {k}: CFL 5 {a:.4f} / глобальный шаг {b:.4f} (разница {b - a:+.4f})')
    return True


def main():
    while P.running('run_check_pseudo_a5\\.py'):
        time.sleep(30)
    if not run('cons', '/solve/set/pseudo-time-method/global-time-step-settings yes 1 1 yes 1'):
        run('cons05', '/solve/set/pseudo-time-method/global-time-step-settings yes 1 0.5 yes 1')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    P.qlog('=== проверка глобального псевдошага на m075e (Conservative) — ждёт')
    try:
        main()
    except Exception:
        A.log('проверка (Conservative): ОШИБКА программы: ' + traceback.format_exc())
    P.qlog('=== проверка глобального псевдошага (Conservative) — закончен')

FILE: dataset/run_checks_finish.py

"""13.10.2026 — finish the cell checks after run_cell_checks.py and test_geometry_v5.py:
- cell_w20_pg reached the 5000-it. limit with the DZV flow still building up from rest (0.0168 kg/s vs 0.0251 for the
  1.5-mm wall) -> continue up to 5000 it.;
- the same for cell_coarse_pg if it did not converge;
- wall 1.0 mm retry (export COM error at 08:24)."""
import sys, time, traceback
sys.path.insert(0, r'F:\Leontiev_Project\dataset')
import run_cell_checks as CC
import gui_convergence as C
F, P, U, log = CC.F, CC.P, CC.U, CC.log
REG = (5.5, 0.3, 5.5, 5.4995)


def converged(tag):
    rows = C.closed_samples(P.BASE / tag)
    return C.decision(rows) if rows else False


def cont(tag):
    if F.ok(tag) and not converged(tag):
        U.LIMIT = 5000
        F.cont(P.BASE / tag / 'result.cas.h5', tag + '2', REG, [], None, f'продолжение {tag}')
        new, r0 = F.rows(tag + '2'), F.rows(CC.REF)
        for k in ('G_dzv', 'Q', 'dT_svz_vs_throttle', 'dT_dzv_h'):
            try:
                log(f'  {tag}2 против {CC.REF}, {k}: {float(new[k]):.4f} / {float(r0[k]):.4f} (разница {float(new[k]) - float(r0[k]):+.4f})')
            except Exception:
                pass


if __name__ == '__main__':
    while P.running('run_cell_checks') or P.running('test_geometry_v5'):
        time.sleep(60)
    P.qlog('=== доводка проверок ячейки (w20, coarse, повтор w10) — начат')
    for name, fn in (('стенка 2,0 доводка', lambda: cont('cell_w20_pg')), ('грубая сетка доводка', lambda: cont('cell_coarse_pg')),
                     ('стенка 1,0 повтор', lambda: CC.transfer('cell_w10b', wall_mm=1.0)),
                     ('стенка 1,0 доводка', lambda: cont('cell_w10b_pg'))):
        try:
            fn()
        except Exception:
            log(f'{name}: ОШИБКА программы: ' + traceback.format_exc())
    P.qlog('=== доводка проверок ячейки — закончен')


===========================================================================
FILE: dataset/run_dataset.py
===========================================================================
"""Dataset orchestrator: geometry variant -> mesh (Workbench macro) -> Fluent case -> regime runs -> dataset.csv

Usage:
    python run_dataset.py doe_geometry.json        # list of variants, see make_doe()
Each variant:
    {"id": "v001", "r_end_mm": 4.8, "l_heat_mm": 400, "gap_mm": 0.3,
     "regimes": [{"p0_svz_MPa":1.6,"p_out_svz_MPa":0.3,"p0_dzv_MPa":5.5,"p_out_dzv_MPa":5.2}, ...]}
The Workbench step uses RunWB2 with the project closed in the GUI (the project file must not be open
elsewhere).  Result of every step is written to dataset/variants/<id>/ ; failures are recorded, never skipped silently.
"""
import json, random, shutil, subprocess, sys, time
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).parent))
import leontiev_pipeline as L
import build_fluent_case as B

RUNWB = r'C:\Program Files\ANSYS Inc\v242\Framework\bin\Win64\RunWB2.exe'
PROJECT = r'F:\Leontiev_Project\g_08_1.wbpj'
MACRO = r'F:\Leontiev_Project\dataset\wb_build_variant.wbjn'
SPEC = L.DS / 'current_variant.json'


REFERENCE = r'F:\Leontiev_Project\эталон_проекта_20261102\g_08_1.wbpj'   # 02.11.2026: fixed state (copy of g_08_1.wbpj of 02.11 14:44)
WORK = Path(r'F:\Leontiev_wb_work')                                        # scratch copy, recreated for every build


def fresh_copy(ref):
    """02.11.2026 (author): every build starts from the SAME fixed state — a fresh scratch copy of the reference project
    (wbpj + _files). The reference and the old master g_08_1.wbpj are never opened or saved by a build."""
    if WORK.exists():
        shutil.rmtree(WORK)   # scratch copy only (not data): previous build's working project
    WORK.mkdir(parents=True)
    shutil.copy2(ref, WORK / 'g_08_1.wbpj')
    shutil.copytree(Path(ref).parent / 'g_08_1_files', WORK / 'g_08_1_files', ignore=shutil.ignore_patterns('.lock'))
    return str(WORK / 'g_08_1.wbpj')


def _sha(f):
    import hashlib
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(f).read_bytes()).hexdigest().upper()


def build_mesh(v, timeout=1500, project=None):
    # 08.10: a test copy of the project can be used; 02.11: `project` is the REFERENCE to copy from (default REFERENCE),
    # the build itself runs in a fresh scratch copy; the reference must stay byte-identical (checked below)
    ref = project or REFERENCE
    ref_hash = _sha(ref)
    project = fresh_copy(ref)
    vd = L.DS / 'variants' / v['id']; vd.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    msh = vd / 'mesh.msh'; res = vd / 'mesh_result.json'
    for p in (res, Path(str(res) + '.wb.json')):
        if p.exists():
            p.unlink()
    spec = dict(id=v['id'], geometry=L.geometry_params(v), msh=str(msh), result=str(res), force_nudge=True)
    if v.get('axial_size_mm'):
        spec['axial_size_m'] = v['axial_size_mm'] * 1e-3      # coarser/finer axial mesh (default 0.5 mm)
    if v.get('convergent_div'):
        spec['convergent_div'] = v['convergent_div']
    for k in ('layer_div', 'core_div', 'dzv_h1_mm', 'dzv_layers', 'global_size_mm', 'nozzle_div', 'nozzle_bias',
              'layer_div_convergent'):   # stage A3 mesh settings
        if v.get(k):
            spec[k] = v[k]
    SPEC.write_text(json.dumps(spec, indent=1))
    # 08.10 (geometry v3): options read by the geometry script itself, written for EVERY mesh (no stale values)
    # 09.10 (geometry v4): + DZV counterflow (inlet at the far end); ignored by the v3 script
    (Path(project).parent / 'geometry_options.json').write_text(json.dumps({'l_cone_mm': float(v.get('l_cone_mm') or 0.0),
                                                                            'dzv_counterflow': bool(v.get('dzv_counterflow')),
                                                                            'knurl_dzv': v.get('knurl_dzv') or None,     # 13.10 (v5)
                                                                            'knurl_svz': v.get('knurl_svz') or None}))   # 20.10 (v6)
    for name in ('AnsysFWW.exe', 'AnsysWBU.exe', 'SpaceClaim.exe', 'AnsysFW.exe'):
        subprocess.run(['taskkill', '/F', '/IM', name], capture_output=True)
    time.sleep(3)
    lock = Path(project).parent / 'g_08_1_files' / '.lock'
    if lock.exists():
        lock.unlink()
    p = subprocess.Popen([RUNWB, '-F', project, '-R', MACRO])
    t0 = time.time()
    def _done(f):   # the macro creates the .wb.json early and fills it at the end: wait for valid JSON
        try:
            return f.exists() and f.stat().st_size > 0 and json.loads(f.read_text(encoding='utf-8')) is not None
        except (OSError, ValueError):
            return False
    while time.time() - t0 < timeout:
        if _done(res) and _done(Path(str(res) + '.wb.json')):
            break
        time.sleep(5)
    time.sleep(5)
    for name in ('AnsysFWW.exe', 'AnsysWBU.exe', 'SpaceClaim.exe'):   # always release the project
        subprocess.run(['taskkill', '/F', '/IM', name], capture_output=True)
    if not res.exists():
        return None
    out = json.loads(res.read_text())
    out.update(reference=ref, reference_sha256=ref_hash, reference_unchanged=_sha(ref) == ref_hash, work_copy=project)
    if not out['reference_unchanged']:
        out['passed'] = False
        out['reference_error'] = 'эталон проекта изменился во время сборки — сборка не принимается'
    res.write_text(json.dumps(out, indent=1))
    return out


def make_doe(n, seed=1, start=1):
    """Latin hypercube over geometry + regime variables (bounds are the screening ranges)."""
    rnd = random.Random(seed)
    # Variables from the screening + literature hints (G_dzv/G_svz 0.05-1.5 is controlled by the DZV gap and
    # the DZV pressure drop; pi = p0_svz/p_out_svz up to ~12-16 is a separate regime study, p_out_svz 0.1-0.4 MPa).
    names = ['r_end_mm', 'l_heat_mm', 'gap_mm', 'p0_svz_MPa', 'p_out_svz_MPa', 'dp_dzv_MPa']
    lo = [4.2, 250, 0.15, 1.1, 0.10, 0.02]
    hi = [6.0, 500, 0.6, 1.6, 0.40, 0.30]
    cols = []
    for _ in names:
        idx = list(range(n)); rnd.shuffle(idx); cols.append([(i + rnd.random()) / n for i in idx])
    out = []
    for i in range(n):
        d = {nm: lo[j] + (hi[j] - lo[j]) * cols[j][i] for j, nm in enumerate(names)}
        out.append(dict(id=f'v{start+i:03d}', r_end_mm=d['r_end_mm'], l_heat_mm=d['l_heat_mm'], gap_mm=d['gap_mm'],
                        regimes=[dict(p0_svz_MPa=d['p0_svz_MPa'], p_out_svz_MPa=d['p_out_svz_MPa'],
                                      p0_dzv_MPa=5.5, p_out_dzv_MPa=5.5 - d['dp_dzv_MPa'])]))
    return out


def run_variant(v, reuse_mesh=False):
    vd = L.DS / 'variants' / v['id']
    log = {'id': v['id']}
    if not reuse_mesh:
        r = build_mesh(v)
        log['mesh'] = r
        if not r or not r.get('passed'):
            L.append_row(dict(case_id=v['id'], geom_r_end_mm=v['r_end_mm'], geom_l_heat_mm=v['l_heat_mm'], geom_gap_mm=v['gap_mm']),
                         dict(status='mesh_failed', converged=0, why=str(r)[:200]))
            return log
    try:
        c = B.build(vd / 'mesh.msh', vd / 'fluent', p0_svz_MPa=v['regimes'][0]['p0_svz_MPa'])
    except Exception as e:
        L.append_row(dict(case_id=v['id'], geom_r_end_mm=v['r_end_mm'], geom_l_heat_mm=v['l_heat_mm'], geom_gap_mm=v['gap_mm']),
                     dict(status='fluent_case_failed', converged=0, why=str(e)[:200]))
        return log
    base = c['initial_case']
    for k, reg in enumerate(v['regimes']):
        spec = dict(reg, case_id=f"{v['id']}_r{k}", geom_r_end_mm=v['r_end_mm'], geom_l_heat_mm=v['l_heat_mm'], geom_gap_mm=v['gap_mm'])
        res = L.run_case(spec, base, vd / f'run_r{k}', max_stages=6, iters=300, threads=4)
        L.append_row(spec, res)
        log[f'run{k}'] = res
        if res.get('final_case'):
            base = res['final_case']          # warm start next regime from the previous result
    return log


if __name__ == '__main__':
    variants = json.loads(Path(sys.argv[1]).read_text())
    for v in variants:
        print(json.dumps(run_variant(v), default=str)[:400], flush=True)

        log[f'run{k}'] = res
        if res.get('final_case'):
            base = res['final_case']          # warm start next regime from the previous result
    return log


if __name__ == '__main__':
    variants = json.loads(Path(sys.argv[1]).read_text())
    for v in variants:
        print(json.dumps(run_variant(v), default=str)[:400], flush=True)

FILE: dataset/run_dataset_архив_20261008_1048.py

"""Dataset orchestrator: geometry variant -> mesh (Workbench macro) -> Fluent case -> regime runs -> dataset.csv

Usage:
    python run_dataset.py doe_geometry.json        # list of variants, see make_doe()
Each variant:
    {"id": "v001", "r_end_mm": 4.8, "l_heat_mm": 400, "gap_mm": 0.3,
     "regimes": [{"p0_svz_MPa":1.6,"p_out_svz_MPa":0.3,"p0_dzv_MPa":5.5,"p_out_dzv_MPa":5.2}, ...]}
The Workbench step uses RunWB2 with the project closed in the GUI (the project file must not be open
elsewhere).  Result of every step is written to dataset/variants/<id>/ ; failures are recorded, never skipped silently.
"""
import json, random, subprocess, sys, time
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).parent))
import leontiev_pipeline as L
import build_fluent_case as B

RUNWB = r'C:\Program Files\ANSYS Inc\v242\Framework\bin\Win64\RunWB2.exe'
PROJECT = r'F:\Leontiev_Project\g_08_1.wbpj'
MACRO = r'C:\Users\RomanR\Documents\Codex\2026-10-04\new-chat\work\wb_build_variant.wbjn'
SPEC = L.DS / 'current_variant.json'


def build_mesh(v, timeout=1500):
    vd = L.DS / 'variants' / v['id']; vd.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    msh = vd / 'mesh.msh'; res = vd / 'mesh_result.json'
    for p in (res, Path(str(res) + '.wb.json')):
        if p.exists():
            p.unlink()
    spec = dict(id=v['id'], geometry=L.geometry_params(v), msh=str(msh), result=str(res), force_nudge=True)
    if v.get('axial_size_mm'):
        spec['axial_size_m'] = v['axial_size_mm'] * 1e-3      # coarser/finer axial mesh (default 0.5 mm)
    if v.get('convergent_div'):
        spec['convergent_div'] = v['convergent_div']
    for k in ('layer_div', 'core_div', 'dzv_h1_mm', 'dzv_layers', 'global_size_mm'):   # stage A3 mesh settings
        if v.get(k):
            spec[k] = v[k]
    SPEC.write_text(json.dumps(spec, indent=1))
    for name in ('AnsysFWW.exe', 'AnsysWBU.exe', 'SpaceClaim.exe', 'AnsysFW.exe'):
        subprocess.run(['taskkill', '/F', '/IM', name], capture_output=True)
    time.sleep(3)
    lock = Path(PROJECT).parent / 'g_08_1_files' / '.lock'
    if lock.exists():
        lock.unlink()
    p = subprocess.Popen([RUNWB, '-F', PROJECT, '-R', MACRO])
    t0 = time.time()
    def _done(f):   # the macro creates the .wb.json early and fills it at the end: wait for valid JSON
        try:
            return f.exists() and f.stat().st_size > 0 and json.loads(f.read_text(encoding='utf-8')) is not None
        except (OSError, ValueError):
            return False
    while time.time() - t0 < timeout:
        if _done(res) and _done(Path(str(res) + '.wb.json')):
            break
        time.sleep(5)
    time.sleep(5)
    for name in ('AnsysFWW.exe', 'AnsysWBU.exe', 'SpaceClaim.exe'):   # always release the project
        subprocess.run(['taskkill', '/F', '/IM', name], capture_output=True)
    if not res.exists():
        return None
    return json.loads(res.read_text())


def make_doe(n, seed=1, start=1):
    """Latin hypercube over geometry + regime variables (bounds are the screening ranges)."""
    rnd = random.Random(seed)
    # Variables from the screening + literature hints (G_dzv/G_svz 0.05-1.5 is controlled by the DZV gap and
    # the DZV pressure drop; pi = p0_svz/p_out_svz up to ~12-16 is a separate regime study, p_out_svz 0.1-0.4 MPa).
    names = ['r_end_mm', 'l_heat_mm', 'gap_mm', 'p0_svz_MPa', 'p_out_svz_MPa', 'dp_dzv_MPa']
    lo = [4.2, 250, 0.15, 1.1, 0.10, 0.02]
    hi = [6.0, 500, 0.6, 1.6, 0.40, 0.30]
    cols = []
    for _ in names:
        idx = list(range(n)); rnd.shuffle(idx); cols.append([(i + rnd.random()) / n for i in idx])
    out = []
    for i in range(n):
        d = {nm: lo[j] + (hi[j] - lo[j]) * cols[j][i] for j, nm in enumerate(names)}
        out.append(dict(id=f'v{start+i:03d}', r_end_mm=d['r_end_mm'], l_heat_mm=d['l_heat_mm'], gap_mm=d['gap_mm'],
                        regimes=[dict(p0_svz_MPa=d['p0_svz_MPa'], p_out_svz_MPa=d['p_out_svz_MPa'],
                                      p0_dzv_MPa=5.5, p_out_dzv_MPa=5.5 - d['dp_dzv_MPa'])]))
    return out


def run_variant(v, reuse_mesh=False):
    vd = L.DS / 'variants' / v['id']
    log = {'id': v['id']}
    if not reuse_mesh:
        r = build_mesh(v)
        log['mesh'] = r
        if not r or not r.get('passed'):
            L.append_row(dict(case_id=v['id'], geom_r_end_mm=v['r_end_mm'], geom_l_heat_mm=v['l_heat_mm'], geom_gap_mm=v['gap_mm']),
                         dict(status='mesh_failed', converged=0, why=str(r)[:200]))
            return log
    try:
        c = B.build(vd / 'mesh.msh', vd / 'fluent', p0_svz_MPa=v['regimes'][0]['p0_svz_MPa'])
    except Exception as e:
        L.append_row(dict(case_id=v['id'], geom_r_end_mm=v['r_end_mm'], geom_l_heat_mm=v['l_heat_mm'], geom_gap_mm=v['gap_mm']),
                     dict(status='fluent_case_failed', converged=0, why=str(e)[:200]))
        return log
    base = c['initial_case']
    for k, reg in enumerate(v['regimes']):
        spec = dict(reg, case_id=f"{v['id']}_r{k}", geom_r_end_mm=v['r_end_mm'], geom_l_heat_mm=v['l_heat_mm'], geom_gap_mm=v['gap_mm'])
        res = L.run_case(spec, base, vd / f'run_r{k}', max_stages=6, iters=300, threads=4)
        L.append_row(spec, res)
        log[f'run{k}'] = res
        if res.get('final_case'):
            base = res['final_case']          # warm start next regime from the previous result
    return log


if __name__ == '__main__':
    variants = json.loads(Path(sys.argv[1]).read_text())
    for v in variants:
        print(json.dumps(run_variant(v), default=str)[:400], flush=True)

        subprocess.run(['taskkill', '/F', '/IM', name], capture_output=True)
    time.sleep(3)
    lock = Path(project).parent / 'g_08_1_files' / '.lock'
    if lock.exists():
        lock.unlink()
    p = subprocess.Popen([RUNWB, '-F', project, '-R', MACRO])
    t0 = time.time()
    def _done(f):   # the macro creates the .wb.json early and fills it at the end: wait for valid JSON
        try:
            return f.exists() and f.stat().st_size > 0 and json.loads(f.read_text(encoding='utf-8')) is not None
        except (OSError, ValueError):
            return False
    while time.time() - t0 < timeout:
        if _done(res) and _done(Path(str(res) + '.wb.json')):
            break
        time.sleep(5)
    time.sleep(5)
    for name in ('AnsysFWW.exe', 'AnsysWBU.exe', 'SpaceClaim.exe'):   # always release the project
        subprocess.run(['taskkill', '/F', '/IM', name], capture_output=True)
    if not res.exists():
        return None
    return json.loads(res.read_text())


def make_doe(n, seed=1, start=1):
    """Latin hypercube over geometry + regime variables (bounds are the screening ranges)."""
    rnd = random.Random(seed)
    # Variables from the screening + literature hints (G_dzv/G_svz 0.05-1.5 is controlled by the DZV gap and
    # the DZV pressure drop; pi = p0_svz/p_out_svz up to ~12-16 is a separate regime study, p_out_svz 0.1-0.4 MPa).
    names = ['r_end_mm', 'l_heat_mm', 'gap_mm', 'p0_svz_MPa', 'p_out_svz_MPa', 'dp_dzv_MPa']
    lo = [4.2, 250, 0.15, 1.1, 0.10, 0.02]
    hi = [6.0, 500, 0.6, 1.6, 0.40, 0.30]
    cols = []
    for _ in names:
        idx = list(range(n)); rnd.shuffle(idx); cols.append([(i + rnd.random()) / n for i in idx])
    out = []
    for i in range(n):
        d = {nm: lo[j] + (hi[j] - lo[j]) * cols[j][i] for j, nm in enumerate(names)}
        out.append(dict(id=f'v{start+i:03d}', r_end_mm=d['r_end_mm'], l_heat_mm=d['l_heat_mm'], gap_mm=d['gap_mm'],
                        regimes=[dict(p0_svz_MPa=d['p0_svz_MPa'], p_out_svz_MPa=d['p_out_svz_MPa'],
                                      p0_dzv_MPa=5.5, p_out_dzv_MPa=5.5 - d['dp_dzv_MPa'])]))
    return out


def run_variant(v, reuse_mesh=False):
    vd = L.DS / 'variants' / v['id']
    log = {'id': v['id']}
    if not reuse_mesh:
        r = build_mesh(v)
        log['mesh'] = r
        if not r or not r.get('passed'):
            L.append_row(dict(case_id=v['id'], geom_r_end_mm=v['r_end_mm'], geom_l_heat_mm=v['l_heat_mm'], geom_gap_mm=v['gap_mm']),
                         dict(status='mesh_failed', converged=0, why=str(r)[:200]))
            return log
    try:
        c = B.build(vd / 'mesh.msh', vd / 'fluent', p0_svz_MPa=v['regimes'][0]['p0_svz_MPa'])
    except Exception as e:
        L.append_row(dict(case_id=v['id'], geom_r_end_mm=v['r_end_mm'], geom_l_heat_mm=v['l_heat_mm'], geom_gap_mm=v['gap_mm']),
                     dict(status='fluent_case_failed', converged=0, why=str(e)[:200]))
        return log
    base = c['initial_case']
    for k, reg in enumerate(v['regimes']):
        spec = dict(reg, case_id=f"{v['id']}_r{k}", geom_r_end_mm=v['r_end_mm'], geom_l_heat_mm=v['l_heat_mm'], geom_gap_mm=v['gap_mm'])
        res = L.run_case(spec, base, vd / f'run_r{k}', max_stages=6, iters=300, threads=4)
        L.append_row(spec, res)
        log[f'run{k}'] = res
        if res.get('final_case'):
            base = res['final_case']          # warm start next regime from the previous result
    return log


if __name__ == '__main__':
    variants = json.loads(Path(sys.argv[1]).read_text())
    for v in variants:
        print(json.dumps(run_variant(v), default=str)[:400], flush=True)

The Workbench step uses RunWB2 with the project closed in the GUI (the project file must not be open
elsewhere).  Result of every step is written to dataset/variants/<id>/ ; failures are recorded, never skipped silently.
"""
import json, random, subprocess, sys, time
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).parent))
import leontiev_pipeline as L
import build_fluent_case as B

RUNWB = r'C:\Program Files\ANSYS Inc\v242\Framework\bin\Win64\RunWB2.exe'
PROJECT = r'F:\Leontiev_Project\g_08_1.wbpj'
MACRO = r'C:\Users\RomanR\Documents\Codex\2026-10-04\new-chat\work\wb_build_variant.wbjn'
SPEC = L.DS / 'current_variant.json'


def build_mesh(v, timeout=1500, project=None):
    project = project or PROJECT   # 08.10: a test copy of the project can be used
    vd = L.DS / 'variants' / v['id']; vd.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    msh = vd / 'mesh.msh'; res = vd / 'mesh_result.json'
    for p in (res, Path(str(res) + '.wb.json')):
        if p.exists():
            p.unlink()
    spec = dict(id=v['id'], geometry=L.geometry_params(v), msh=str(msh), result=str(res), force_nudge=True)
    if v.get('axial_size_mm'):
        spec['axial_size_m'] = v['axial_size_mm'] * 1e-3      # coarser/finer axial mesh (default 0.5 mm)
    if v.get('convergent_div'):
        spec['convergent_div'] = v['convergent_div']
    for k in ('layer_div', 'core_div', 'dzv_h1_mm', 'dzv_layers', 'global_size_mm', 'nozzle_div', 'nozzle_bias',
              'layer_div_convergent'):   # stage A3 mesh settings
        if v.get(k):
            spec[k] = v[k]
    SPEC.write_text(json.dumps(spec, indent=1))
    # 08.10 (geometry v3): options read by the geometry script itself, written for EVERY mesh (no stale values)
    # 09.10 (geometry v4): + DZV counterflow (inlet at the far end); ignored by the v3 script
    (Path(project).parent / 'geometry_options.json').write_text(json.dumps({'l_cone_mm': float(v.get('l_cone_mm') or 0.0),
                                                                            'dzv_counterflow': bool(v.get('dzv_counterflow')),
                                                                            'knurl_dzv': v.get('knurl_dzv') or None}))   # 13.10 (v5)
    for name in ('AnsysFWW.exe', 'AnsysWBU.exe', 'SpaceClaim.exe', 'AnsysFW.exe'):
        subprocess.run(['taskkill', '/F', '/IM', name], capture_output=True)
    time.sleep(3)
    lock = Path(project).parent / 'g_08_1_files' / '.lock'
    if lock.exists():
        lock.unlink()
    p = subprocess.Popen([RUNWB, '-F', project, '-R', MACRO])
    t0 = time.time()
    def _done(f):   # the macro creates the .wb.json early and fills it at the end: wait for valid JSON
        try:
            return f.exists() and f.stat().st_size > 0 and json.loads(f.read_text(encoding='utf-8')) is not None
        except (OSError, ValueError):
            return False
    while time.time() - t0 < timeout:
        if _done(res) and _done(Path(str(res) + '.wb.json')):
            break
        time.sleep(5)
    time.sleep(5)
    for name in ('AnsysFWW.exe', 'AnsysWBU.exe', 'SpaceClaim.exe'):   # always release the project
        subprocess.run(['taskkill', '/F', '/IM', name], capture_output=True)
    if not res.exists():
        return None
    return json.loads(res.read_text())

"""12.10.2026 — D2 (author agreed): the same cell e continuation as D1 but with the brass k back to 110 and the coupled
solver in PSEUDO-TRANSIENT mode with a GLOBAL pseudo time step (Fluent probe 20:24: formulation 0 = Off, which is what
the project used so far; 1 = Global Time Step).  Settings: automatic step, length scale 'Aggressive', factor 1, solid

"""G4c (coarse mesh) at Prt 0.65: build Fluent case from variants/g4c/mesh.msh, then run 2000 it with
Prt applied through the Viscous Model dialog OK (Fluent with a window).  Compare with fine G4 run_s2."""
import json, sys
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0, r'F:\Leontiev_Project\dataset')
import leontiev_pipeline as L
import build_fluent_case as B
from make_gui_prt_journal import with_prt

import subprocess, time


def _pids():
    out = subprocess.run(['tasklist', '/FI', 'IMAGENAME eq cx2420.exe', '/FO', 'CSV', '/NH'], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
    return {l.split('","')[1] for l in out.splitlines() if l.startswith('"cx2420')}


def run_gui(journal_path, threads=7, gui=True, timeout=7200):
    """Fluent with a window: fluent.exe returns at once, so wait until the new cx2420 sessions are gone."""
    before = _pids()
    subprocess.Popen([L.FLUENT, '2ddp', f'-t{threads}', '-i', str(journal_path)], cwd=str(Path(journal_path).parent))
    t0 = time.time()
    while time.time() - t0 < 120 and not (_pids() - before):
        time.sleep(2)
    print(time.strftime('%H:%M:%S'), Path(journal_path).name, 'started', sorted(_pids() - before), flush=True)
    while time.time() - t0 < timeout and (_pids() - before):
        time.sleep(5)
    print(time.strftime('%H:%M:%S'), Path(journal_path).name, 'finished', flush=True)
    return not (_pids() - before)


L.run_fluent = run_gui  # visible windows, sequential stages

OUT = Path(r'F:\Leontiev_Project\runs\grs_g4c')
r = B.build(r'F:\Leontiev_Project\dataset\variants\g4c\mesh.msh', OUT)
print(json.dumps(r, indent=1), flush=True)

s = dict(p0_svz_MPa=1.6, p_out_svz_MPa=0.3, p0_dzv_MPa=5.5, p_out_dzv_MPa=5.2)
trn = OUT / 'run_prt065.trn'
if trn.exists():
    trn.unlink()
j = L.stage_journal(s, OUT / 'initial.cas.h5', OUT / 'run_prt065.cas.h5', trn, 2000, 10, report_every=100)
(OUT / 'run_prt065.jou').write_text(with_prt(j, 0.65), encoding='utf-8')
L.run_fluent(OUT / 'run_prt065.jou', threads=7, gui=True, timeout=6 * 3600)
print('done', flush=True)

"""27.10.2026 — замечание (через автора), п. 6: до семинара набрать 3–5 полных циклов журнала решений.
Четыре новые станционные точки (зима/лето, газ 0/+10 °C, потребитель 0,6 МПа, подогрев СВЗ 0), которых нет в обучении.
Для каждой ДО расчёта: прогноз ГП ± σ (station_gp, 98 точек), p CatBoost (classifier_final: 101 точка, p_hi 0,922),
статус по П1–П3 (δ = 0,5 K) — в runs\\journal\\forecasts.json и журнал; затем расчёт Fluent (run_a9.cont).
 ST5: t/d 1,4, L 400, перепад 30 кПа, магистраль 5,5 (от ST1);

 ST8: t/d 1,2, L 660, перепад 50 кПа, магистраль 5,5 (от ST3)."""
import io, contextlib, json, math, sys, time
import numpy as np
sys.path.insert(0, r'F:\Leontiev_Project\dataset')
import run_a9 as A
import run_station as S

DELTA, P_HI = 0.5, 0.922
J = S.OUT.parent / 'journal'
POINTS = (('ST5', 1.4, 400, 30.0, 5.5, 0.0, 'ST1', ()),
          ('ST6', 1.2, 660, 105.0, 4.0, 0.0, 'ST3', (4.75,)),
          ('ST7', 1.4, 400, 10.0, 4.0, 10.0, 'ST2', ()),
          ('ST8', 1.2, 660, 50.0, 5.5, 0.0, 'ST3', ()))


def forecasts():
    import station_gp as G
    with contextlib.redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()):
        import classifier_final as CF
    import model_compare as MC, heldout_check as H
    fr, fc, pr, pc = MC.models()['CatBoost']
    cb = fc(H.Z(CF.X), CF.w)
    out = {}
    for tag, td, L, dp, pm, t0, src, steps in POINTS:
        xr = [td, L / 6.6, math.log(dp), 0.6, t0, 0.0, pm]
        x = G.Z(np.array([xr]))
        outs = [g.predict(x, return_std=True) for g in G.GP]
        mu = [float(o[0][0]) for o in outs]; sd = [float(o[1][0]) for o in outs]
        p = float(pc(cb, H.Z(np.array([xr])))[0])
        inside = bool(np.all((np.array(xr) >= G.lo - 1e-9) & (np.array(xr) <= G.hi + 1e-9)))
        m = mu[3] / mu[2]
        if not inside or not (0.2 <= m <= 1.0):
            rule, status = 'П1', 'Δ3 «вернуть задачу»'
        elif p < P_HI or sd[0] > DELTA:
            rule, status = 'П2', 'Δ2 «досчитать»'
        else:
            rule, status = 'П3', 'Δ1 «выдать»'
        d = float(np.sqrt(((G.Z(G.X) - x) ** 2).sum(1)).min())
        out[tag] = dict(x=xr, effect_K=mu[0], sigma_K=sd[0], Q=mu[1], sigma_Q=sd[1], G_svz=mu[2], G_dzv=mu[3], m=m,
                        p_catboost=p, inside=inside, nearest=d, rule=rule, status=status, time=time.strftime('%d.%m.%Y %H:%M:%S'))
        A.log(f"=== {tag}: ПРОГНОЗ ДО расчёта: эффект {mu[0]:+.2f} ± {sd[0]:.2f} K, Q {mu[1]:.0f} ± {sd[1]:.0f} Вт, m {m:.3f}, "
              f"p CatBoost {p:.3f}, {rule} → {status}; расстояние до обучения {d:.3f}")
    J.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    json.dump(out, open(J / 'forecasts.json', 'w', encoding='utf-8'), ensure_ascii=False, indent=1)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    forecasts()
    for tag, td, L, dp, pm, t0, src, steps in POINTS:
        cur = S.OUT / src
        for k, p0 in enumerate(steps, 1):
            cur = A.cont(cur / 'result.cas.h5', f'{tag}_r{k}', S.reg(p0, dp), [], t0, t0, f'ступень магистрали {p0} МПа от {cur.name}',
                         A.AUX, limit=1500, l_mm=float(L)) or cur
        A.cont(cur / 'result.cas.h5', tag, S.reg(pm, dp), [], t0, t0, f'журнал решений: от {cur.name}', A.CSV, l_mm=float(L))
    A.qlog('=== точки журнала ST5–ST8 — закончены')

def knurl(tag, h):
    U.LIMIT = 6000
    cell = L.cell_geometry(1.4, 1.5, 4.8, 3.3)
    p = dict(G.DEFAULTS)
    p.update(A3.MESHES['work_v2'], prt=0.85, mesh_custom=True, wait_free=True, dzv_counterflow=True,
             dzv_layers=P.dzv_layers(cell['gap_mm']), p_out_svz_MPa=0.3, p_out_dzv_MPa=5.4995, gas='ch4_ideal',
             extra_lines=[L.SYMMETRY_DZV_LINE, U.t0_line(15.0)], retries=0, startup_iters=10, coupled_iters=10, cfl=5.0,
             knurl_dzv=dict(h_mm=h, pitch_mm=9.0, width_mm=3.0, x_first_mm=9.0), run_id=f'{tag}_tpl',
             **{k: cell[k] for k in ('gap_mm', 'wall_thickness_inlet_mm', 'wall_thickness_end_mm')})
    G.RUNS = P.BASE
    log(f'=== {tag}: накатка со стороны ДЗВ h {h} мм, шаг 9 мм, ширина 3 мм (t/d 1,4, перепад ДЗВ 0,5 кПа)')

    ip = P.BASE / 'ip' / f'{CC.REF}.ip'
    if not tpl.exists() or not (ip.exists() or F.write_ip(CC.REF, ip)):
        return log(f'  {tag}: нет шаблона или файла переноса')
    reg = (5.5, 0.3, 5.5, 5.4995)
    init = [f'/file/interpolate/read-data "{L.fl(ip)}"',
            f'/solve/patch air_dzv () pressure {reg[3] / ATM:.5f}', '/solve/patch air_dzv () temperature 15',

            '/solve/patch air_dzv () k 0.1', '/solve/patch air_dzv () omega 1000', '/solve/patch wall_abonite () temperature 15']
    F.cont(tpl, f'{tag}_pg', reg, list(L.CH4_PR_LINES) + init, None,
           f'перенос поля {CC.REF}; накатка ДЗВ h {h} мм; ДЗВ стартует с -4 м/с')
    r, r0 = F.rows(f'{tag}_pg'), F.rows(CC.REF)
    for k in ('G_dzv', 'Q', 'dT_svz_vs_throttle', 'dT_dzv_h'):

                f'(разница {float(r[k]) - float(r0[k]):+.4f})')
        except Exception:
            pass

import run_pilot_night as N   # N._cont = the unpatched continuation of run_pilot_fast


def set_step(line):
    i = L.SOLVER_HEADER.index(next(x for x in L.SOLVER_HEADER if 'global-time-step-settings' in x))
    L.SOLVER_HEADER[i] = line


def cont(src_case, tag, regime, extra, g_target, start):
    t0 = time.time()
    set_step(CONS)
    RF_cont = N._cont
    r = RF_cont(src_case, tag, regime, extra, g_target, start + ' (глобальный шаг ×1)')
    if not (P.BASE / tag / 'result.cas.h5').exists():
        log(f'  {tag}: нет результата — повтор с половинным псевдошагом')
        set_step(HALF)
        r = RF_cont(src_case, tag + 'h', regime, extra, g_target, start + ' (глобальный шаг ×0,5)')
        set_step(CONS)
    log(f'  {tag}: этап занял {(time.time() - t0) / 3600:.1f} ч')
    return r


def main():
    U.LIMIT = 6000
    cont(P.BASE / 'cell_d_t14_m01_p03_pg' / 'result.cas.h5', 'cell_smooth_dp18', (5.5, 0.3, 5.5, 5.4982), [], None,
         'гладкая, перепад ДЗВ 1,8 кПа (сравнение накатки при равном m)')
    cont(P.BASE / 'cell_knurl05b_pg' / 'result.cas.h5', 'cell_knurl05_dp27', (5.5, 0.3, 5.5, 5.4973), [], None,
         'накатка h 0,5, перепад ДЗВ 2,7 кПа')
    tpl = P.BASE / 'cell_knurl10_tpl' / 'result.cas.h5'
    ip = P.BASE / 'ip' / 'cell_d_t14_m01_p03_pg.ip'
    reg = (5.5, 0.3, 5.5, 5.46)
    init = [f'/file/interpolate/read-data "{L.fl(ip)}"',
            f'/solve/patch air_dzv () pressure {reg[3] / 0.101325:.5f}', '/solve/patch air_dzv () temperature 15',
            '/solve/patch air_dzv () x-velocity ok -8', '/solve/patch air_dzv () y-velocity ok 0',
            '/solve/patch air_dzv () k 0.1', '/solve/patch air_dzv () omega 1000', '/solve/patch wall_abonite () temperature 15']
    cont(tpl, 'cell_knurl10_dp40', reg, list(L.CH4_PR_LINES) + init, None, 'накатка h 1,0, перепад ДЗВ 40 кПа, ДЗВ с -8 м/с')
    for t in ('cell_smooth_dp18', 'cell_knurl05_dp27', 'cell_knurl10_dp40'):
        for tt in (t, t + 'h'):
            r = F.rows(tt)
            if r.get('G_dzv'):
                log(f'  сравнение при равном m: {tt}: m {float(r["G_dzv"]) / float(r["G_svz"]):.3f}, Q {r["Q"]} Вт, '
                    f'эффект {r.get("dT_svz_vs_throttle")} K, холод ДЗВ {r.get("dT_dzv_h")} K, статус {r.get("status")}')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    P.qlog('=== накатка: сравнение при равном m ~0,3 — начат')
    try:
        main()
    except Exception:
        log('накатка (равный m): ОШИБКА программы: ' + traceback.format_exc())
    P.qlog('=== накатка: сравнение при равном m — закончен')

===========================================================================
FILE: dataset/run_night.py

"""Night 08->09.10.2026 (agreed plan; plan gas = methane Peng-Robinson, author 14:45).  Starts after run_day3.py.
  N1 A4 chamber (air, 20 mm widening) at 0.3 / 0.6 / 1.2 MPa
  N2 A3 coarse_v2 (air) — retry after the Workbench crash
  N3 methane base on coarse_v2: ideal from scratch + Peng-Robinson continuation (anchor 5.5->0.3 / 5.5->5.2)
  N4 A7 hysteresis on coarse methane PR: 5.2 -> 5.45 -> 5.2 and 5.2 -> 5.0 -> 5.2 (vs from-scratch 5.2)
  N5 A7 inlet T0 on work_v2 methane PR: 10 C and 40 C (vs 25 C)
  N6 pairs, regimes (methane PR): work_v2 5.45 / 5.35 / 5.0 / GRS (SVZ 1.6); coarse 5.35 / GRS (5.45, 5.0 from N4)
  N7 pairs, geometries (methane PR): L 700 mm, DZV gap 1.0 mm — coarse and work, ideal from scratch + PR continuation
  N8 A3 fine_v2 (air)
Rows with Fluent total temperatures AND enthalpy-based temperatures: runs\\night\\night_results.csv; log night_log.txt."""
import subprocess, sys, time, traceback
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0, r'F:\Leontiev_Project\dataset')
import leontiev_pipeline as L
import gui_runner as G
import run_a3 as A3
import cont_util as U

BASE = Path(r'F:\Leontiev_Project\runs\night')
CSV = BASE / 'night_results.csv'
QLOG = Path(r'F:\Leontiev_Project\runs\queue_log.txt')
ANCHOR = (5.5, 0.3, 5.5, 5.2)
WORK_PR = Path(r'F:\Leontiev_Project\runs\a6\a6_ch4_pr\result.cas.h5')


def log(s):
    line = time.strftime('%H:%M:%S ') + s
    print(line, flush=True)
    BASE.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with (BASE / 'night_log.txt').open('a', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        f.write(line + '\n')


def qlog(s):
    with QLOG.open('a', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        f.write(time.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S ') + s + '\n')


def methane_scratch(tag, mesh, geo=None):
    """Methane ideal from scratch (FMG) -> Peng-Robinson continuation.  Returns the PR case path or None."""
    p = dict(G.DEFAULTS)
    p.update(A3.MESHES[mesh], run_id=f'{tag}_ideal', prt=0.85, mesh_custom=True, wait_free=True, gas='ch4_ideal', **(geo or {}))
    G.RUNS = BASE
    log(f'=== {tag}: метан идеальный с нуля, сетка {mesh}' + (f', геометрия {geo}' if geo else ''))
    t0 = time.time()
    G.run(p, lambda s: log('  ' + s), lambda: False)
    src = BASE / p['run_id'] / 'result.cas.h5'
    U.record(CSV, f'{tag}_ideal', mesh, 'ch4_ideal', ANCHOR, BASE / p['run_id'], round((time.time() - t0) / 60, 1), log,
             start='с нуля (FMG)', l_heat_mm=p['l_heat_mm'])
    if not src.exists():
        return None
    out = BASE / f'{tag}_pr'
    m = U.continue_case(src, out, L.CH4_PR_LINES, ANCHOR, log, f'{tag}_pr')
    U.record(CSV, f'{tag}_pr', mesh, 'ch4_pr', ANCHOR, out, m, log, start=f'продолжение {tag}_ideal', l_heat_mm=p['l_heat_mm'])
    return out / 'result.cas.h5' if (out / 'result.cas.h5').exists() else None


def cont(tag, mesh, src, regime, t0_C=None, extra=()):
    out = BASE / tag
    m = U.continue_case(src, out, list(extra), regime, log, tag, t0_C=t0_C)
    U.record(CSV, tag, mesh, 'ch4_pr', regime, out, m, log, start=f'продолжение {Path(src).parent.name}',
             t0_C=25.0 if t0_C is None else t0_C)
    return out / 'result.cas.h5' if (out / 'result.cas.h5').exists() else None


def step(name, fn):
    qlog(f'ночь: {name} — начат'); t0 = time.time()
    try:
        fn(); qlog(f'ночь: {name} — скрипт завершён за {(time.time() - t0) / 60:.0f} мин (приёмка — по результатам)')
    except Exception:
        qlog(f'ночь: {name} — ОШИБКА программы:\n' + traceback.format_exc())


def day3_running():
    out = subprocess.run(['powershell', '-NoProfile', '-Command',
                          "Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter \"Name='python.exe'\" | ? {$_.CommandLine -match 'run_day3'} | Measure-Object | % Count"],
                         capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.strip()
    return out not in ('', '0')


def chamber_resume(run_a4):
    """Pause 08.10 17:25: the chamber run (0.3 MPa) was stopped at a block boundary with saving; continue it, then the
    chamber at 0.6 / 1.2 MPa (same rules as run_a4.main)."""
    src = run_a4.BASE / 'a4_chamber_rec20' / 'result.cas.h5'
    if not src.exists():
        return run_a4.main(['K'])
    out = run_a4.BASE / 'a4_chamber_rec20_cont'
    m = U.continue_case(src, out, [], ANCHOR, run_a4.log, 'камера 20 мм, 0,3 МПа (продолжение после паузы)')
    r = run_a4.record('камера (расширение 20 мм), продолжение', dict(G.DEFAULTS), out, m)
    prev = out / 'result.cas.h5'
    if r.get('reason') == 'нет результата' or not prev.exists():
        return
    for pout in run_a4.BACK:
        res, case = run_a4.back_pressure(prev, pout, 'chamber')
        if (res.get('status') == 'сбой' or res.get('x_shock_m') not in ('', None)
                or 'нет сверхзвука' in str(res.get('reason')) or not case.exists()):
            run_a4.log(f'chamber: при {pout} МПа канал уже не сверхзвуковой по всей длине (или сбой) — дальше не повышаю')
            break
        prev = case


if __name__ == '__main__':
    # usage: python run_night.py            — first start (waits for run_day3)
    #        python run_night.py resume [Nk] — after the pause 08.10 17:25: continue the chamber, then N2...; Nk = first step
    resume = len(sys.argv) > 1 and sys.argv[1] == 'resume'
    first = sys.argv[2] if len(sys.argv) > 2 else 'N1'
    order = ['N1', 'N2', 'N3', 'N4', 'N5', 'N6', 'N7', 'N8']
    todo = set(order[order.index(first):])
    if resume:
        # the night series compares variants with its bases computed with the old wall (234 W/(m K) from the settings);
        # the new default (brass 110, for the dataset) is switched off here on purpose
        G.DEFAULTS['wall_k'] = None
        qlog(f'=== ночь: продолжение после паузы, с шага {first}')
    else:
        qlog('=== ночь: жду окончания run_day3 (А4 штатный выход, А5)')
        while day3_running():
            time.sleep(60)
    import run_a4
    state = {}
    if 'N3' not in todo:   # base on the coarse mesh already exists
        pr = BASE / 'm_coarse_pr' / 'result.cas.h5'
        state['coarse_pr'] = pr if pr.exists() else None
    _step = step
    def step(name, fn):
        if name.split()[0] in todo:
            _step(name, fn)
    step('N1 А4 камера (воздух)', (lambda: chamber_resume(run_a4)) if resume else (lambda: run_a4.main(['K'])))
    step('N2 А3 грубая v2 (воздух)', lambda: A3.run('coarse_v2'))
    step('N3 метан, грубая v2: база', lambda: state.update(coarse_pr=methane_scratch('m_coarse', 'coarse_v2')))

    def hysteresis():
        src = state.get('coarse_pr')
        if not src:
            return log('N4: нет базы на грубой сетке — пропуск')
        up = cont('h_coarse_545', 'coarse_v2', src, (5.5, 0.3, 5.5, 5.45))
        if up: cont('h_coarse_545_to_520', 'coarse_v2', up, ANCHOR)
        dn = cont('h_coarse_500', 'coarse_v2', src, (5.5, 0.3, 5.5, 5.0))
        if dn: cont('h_coarse_500_to_520', 'coarse_v2', dn, ANCHOR)
    step('N4 А7 гистерезис (метан, грубая)', hysteresis)

    def t0_check():
        for t in (10.0, 40.0):
            cont(f't0_work_{int(t)}', 'work_v2', WORK_PR, ANCHOR, t0_C=t)
    step('N5 А7 температура входа (метан, рабочая)', t0_check)

    def regime_pairs():
        for tag, reg in (('545', (5.5, 0.3, 5.5, 5.45)), ('535', (5.5, 0.3, 5.5, 5.35)), ('500', (5.5, 0.3, 5.5, 5.0)),
                         ('grs', (1.6, 0.3, 5.5, 5.2))):
            cont(f'pair_work_{tag}', 'work_v2', WORK_PR, reg)
        src = state.get('coarse_pr')
        if src:
            for tag, reg in (('535', (5.5, 0.3, 5.5, 5.35)), ('grs', (1.6, 0.3, 5.5, 5.2))):
                cont(f'pair_coarse_{tag}', 'coarse_v2', src, reg)
    step('N6 пары: режимы (метан)', regime_pairs)

    def geometry_pairs():
        for tag, geo in (('L700', dict(l_heat_mm=700.0)), ('gap10', dict(gap_mm=1.0))):
            for mesh in ('coarse_v2', 'work_v2'):
                methane_scratch(f'pair_{tag}_{mesh.split("_")[0]}', mesh, geo)
    step('N7 пары: геометрии (метан)', geometry_pairs)
    step('N8 А3 мелкая v2 (воздух)', lambda: A3.run('fine_v2'))
    qlog('=== ночь: очередь закончена')


===========================================================================
FILE: dataset/run_night1112c.py

"""Night 11->12.10.2026, queue extension at 07:45 (author: >= 12 h, i.e. until ~13:00).
1) anchor_dzvfix_pr reached the 4000-iteration limit (energy imbalance 66 W, continuity 2e-4) -> continue to convergence
   (anchor_dzvfix_pr2, LIMIT 5500).
2) the same anchor at the OLD DZV flow 0.0495 kg/s (the resolved DZV mesh gives 0.0354 kg/s at 5.5 -> 5.2 MPa): DZV outlet
   pressure from dp ~ G^1.8 (anchor_dzvfix_m, one correction) -> effect of the mesh at equal m.
3) pilot cell points (geometry v4, counterflow, symmetry, brass 110, methane, T0 15 C) as DIAGNOSTICS (author decides on
   the A5 verdict in the morning): ideal from scratch with a small DZV drop (5.5 -> 5.45 MPa) -> PR -> the DZV flow is set
   by the outlet PRESSURE with up to two corrections dp*(m_target/m)^1.8 (no targeted mass flow: unstable on resolved
   layers, 10.10).  Order a, b, c, d, e — as many as fit."""
import sys, time, traceback
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0, r'F:\Leontiev_Project\dataset')
import run_pilot_cell as P
import cont_util as U
import leontiev_pipeline as L
import gui_runner as G
import run_a3 as A3

U.NPROC = 7
U.CFL = 5.0
U.LIMIT = 5500
log = P.log


def cont(src_dir, tag, regime, t0_C, g_target=None):
    out = P.BASE / tag
    m = U.continue_case(P.BASE / src_dir / 'result.cas.h5', out, [], regime, log, tag, t0_C=t0_C)
    return U.record(P.CSV, tag, 'work_v2', 'ch4_pr', regime, out, m, log, start=f'продолжение {src_dir}', t0_C=t0_C,
                    g_dzv_target=g_target)


def ok(tag):
    return (P.BASE / tag / 'result.cas.h5').exists()


def anchor():
    reg = (5.5, 0.3, 5.5, 5.2)
    r = cont('anchor_dzvfix_pr', 'anchor_dzvfix_pr2', reg, 25.0)
    src = 'anchor_dzvfix_pr2' if ok('anchor_dzvfix_pr2') else 'anchor_dzvfix_pr'
    g = float(r['G_dzv']) if r.get('G_dzv') else 0.0354
    g_old = 0.049462
    dp = min(0.3 * (g_old / g) ** 1.8, 1.0)
    for i in (1, 2):
        tag = 'anchor_dzvfix_m' + ('' if i == 1 else '2')
        r = cont(src, tag, (5.5, 0.3, 5.5, round(5.5 - dp, 5)), 25.0, g_target=g_old)
        if not (ok(tag) and r.get('G_dzv')):
            break
        g = float(r['G_dzv'])
        if abs(g - g_old) / g_old <= 0.03:
            break
        src, dp = tag, min(dp * (g_old / g) ** 1.8, 1.0)


def pilot():
    pts = [('cell_a_t12_m03_p03', 1.2, 0.3, 0.3), ('cell_b_t16_m03_p03', 1.6, 0.3, 0.3), ('cell_c_t14_m10_p03', 1.4, 1.0, 0.3),
           ('cell_d_t14_m01_p03', 1.4, 0.1, 0.3), ('cell_e_t14_m03_p12', 1.4, 0.3, 1.2)]
    for tag, td, m, pout in pts:
        try:
            cell = L.cell_geometry(td, 1.5, 4.8, 3.3)
            p = dict(G.DEFAULTS)
            p.update(A3.MESHES['work_v2'], prt=0.85, mesh_custom=True, wait_free=True, dzv_counterflow=True,
                     dzv_layers=P.dzv_layers(cell['gap_mm']), p_out_svz_MPa=pout, p_out_dzv_MPa=5.45,
                     extra_lines=[L.SYMMETRY_DZV_LINE, U.t0_line(15.0)],
                     **{k: cell[k] for k in ('gap_mm', 'wall_thickness_inlet_mm', 'wall_thickness_end_mm')})
            P.scratch_then_pr(tag, p, (5.5, pout, 5.5, 5.45), 15.0)
            src, dp, g_t = f'{tag}_pr', 0.05, None
            if not ok(src):
                continue
            for i in (1, 2):
                rows = [x for x in __import__('csv').DictReader(open(P.CSV, encoding='utf-8')) if x.get('tag') == src]
                r = rows[-1] if rows else {}
                if not r.get('G_dzv') or not r.get('G_svz'):
                    break
                g_svz, g = float(r['G_svz']), float(r['G_dzv'])
                g_t = m * g_svz
                mc = g / g_svz
                log(f'  {src}: m {mc:.3f} (цель {m})')
                if mc <= 0 or abs(mc - m) / m <= 0.05:
                    break
                dp = max(min(dp * (m / mc) ** 1.8, 5.499 - pout - 0.1), 0.001)
                nt = f'{tag}_p{i}'
                cont(src, nt, (5.5, pout, 5.5, round(5.5 - dp, 5)), 15.0, g_target=g_t)
                if not ok(nt):
                    break
                src = nt
        except Exception:
            log(f'{tag}: ОШИБКА программы: ' + traceback.format_exc())


if __name__ == '__main__':
    P.qlog('=== ночь 11→12.10 (07:45, продолжение): якорь до сходимости, якорь при старом расходе ДЗВ, пилот ячейки (диагностика)')
    for name, fn in (('якорь', anchor), ('пилот ячейки (диагностика)', pilot)):
        t0 = time.time()
        try:
            fn()
            P.qlog(f'ночь 11→12.10: {name} — завершён за {(time.time() - t0) / 60:.0f} мин')
        except Exception:
            log(f'{name}: ОШИБКА программы: ' + traceback.format_exc())
    P.qlog('=== ночь 11→12.10 (продолжение) — очередь закончена')

def log(s):
    line = time.strftime('%H:%M:%S ') + s
    print(line, flush=True)
    BASE.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with (BASE / 'night_log.txt').open('a', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        f.write(line + '\n')


def qlog(s):
    with QLOG.open('a', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        f.write(time.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S ') + s + '\n')


def methane_scratch(tag, mesh, geo=None):
    """Methane ideal from scratch (FMG) -> Peng-Robinson continuation.  Returns the PR case path or None."""
    p = dict(G.DEFAULTS)
    p.update(A3.MESHES[mesh], run_id=f'{tag}_ideal', prt=0.85, mesh_custom=True, wait_free=True, gas='ch4_ideal', **(geo or {}))
    G.RUNS = BASE
    log(f'=== {tag}: метан идеальный с нуля, сетка {mesh}' + (f', геометрия {geo}' if geo else ''))
    t0 = time.time()
    G.run(p, lambda s: log('  ' + s), lambda: False)
    src = BASE / p['run_id'] / 'result.cas.h5'
    U.record(CSV, f'{tag}_ideal', mesh, 'ch4_ideal', ANCHOR, BASE / p['run_id'], round((time.time() - t0) / 60, 1), log,
             start='с нуля (FMG)', l_heat_mm=p['l_heat_mm'])
    if not src.exists():
        return None
    out = BASE / f'{tag}_pr'
    m = U.continue_case(src, out, L.CH4_PR_LINES, ANCHOR, log, f'{tag}_pr')
    U.record(CSV, f'{tag}_pr', mesh, 'ch4_pr', ANCHOR, out, m, log, start=f'продолжение {tag}_ideal', l_heat_mm=p['l_heat_mm'])
    return out / 'result.cas.h5' if (out / 'result.cas.h5').exists() else None


def cont(tag, mesh, src, regime, t0_C=None, extra=()):
    out = BASE / tag
    m = U.continue_case(src, out, list(extra), regime, log, tag, t0_C=t0_C)
    U.record(CSV, tag, mesh, 'ch4_pr', regime, out, m, log, start=f'продолжение {Path(src).parent.name}',
             t0_C=25.0 if t0_C is None else t0_C)
    return out / 'result.cas.h5' if (out / 'result.cas.h5').exists() else None


def step(name, fn):

    try:
        fn(); qlog(f'ночь: {name} — скрипт завершён за {(time.time() - t0) / 60:.0f} мин (приёмка — по результатам)')
    except Exception:
        qlog(f'ночь: {name} — ОШИБКА программы:\n' + traceback.format_exc())

    return out not in ('', '0')

    def hysteresis():

            return log('N4: нет базы на грубой сетке — пропуск')

def cell_params(*a, **k):
    p, cell = _orig(*a, **k)
    # 21.10: шаг/ширина — параметры (серия «шаг патента» S/D 0,72: шаг 4,75 мм, ширина 1,6 мм — та же доля 1/3, что 3/9)

    return p, cell
