    m=f['meshes/1'];p=np.concatenate([d[()] for d in m['nodes/coords'].values()])
    n=max(int(g.attrs['maxId'][0]) for g in m['faces/nodes'].values());e=np.zeros((n,2),dtype=int)
    for g in m['faces/nodes'].values():
        nn=g['nnodes'][()];assert set(np.unique(nn)).issubset({0,2})
        e[int(g.attrs['minId'][0])-1+np.flatnonzero(nn==2)]=g['nodes'][()].reshape(-1,2)
    sides=[]
    for key in ('c0','c1'):
        v=np.zeros(n,dtype=int)
        for d in m['faces/'+key].values():v[int(d.attrs['minId'][0])-1:int(d.attrs['minId'][0])-1+len(d)]=d[()]
        sides.append(v)
    z=m['faces/zoneTopology'];names=z['name'][0].decode().split(';');active=np.zeros(n,dtype=bool);wallindices={}
    gaswalls=('wall_outer-air_svz','wall-air_svz-wall_abonite-shadow','wall_outer-air_dzv','interior-air_dzv-wall_abonite-shadow')
    for name,lo,hi,kind in zip(names,z['minId'][()],z['maxId'][()],z['zoneType'][()]):
        if int(kind)==31:continue
        active[int(lo)-1:int(hi)]=True
        if name in gaswalls:wallindices[name]=np.arange(int(lo)-1,int(hi))
    wallcells=set(int(sides[0][i]) for indices in wallindices.values() for i in indices)
    vertices={i:set() for i in wallcells}
    for v in sides:
        hits=np.flatnonzero(active & np.isin(v,list(wallcells)))
        for idx in hits:vertices[int(v[idx])].update(int(x)-1 for x in e[idx] if x>0)
    out={}
    for name,indices in wallindices.items():
        heights=[];centerd=[]
        for idx in indices:
            q=p[list(vertices[int(sides[0][idx])])];c=q.mean(axis=0);q=q[np.argsort(np.arctan2(q[:,1]-c[1],q[:,0]-c[0]))]
            area=abs(np.dot(q[:,0],np.roll(q[:,1],-1))-np.dot(q[:,1],np.roll(q[:,0],-1)))/2
            edge=p[e[idx]-1];L=np.linalg.norm(edge[1]-edge[0]);heights.append(area/L*1e6)
        out[name]={'active_wall_faces':len(indices),'area_over_wall_edge_length_um_min_p50_max':np.percentile(heights,[0,50,100]).tolist()}
report={'case':str(path),'method':'Planar polygon cell area / wall-edge length. Geometric first-cell height proxy, not y+; parent hierarchy faces excluded.','wall_spacing':out}
(root/sys.argv[2]).write_text(json.dumps(report,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),encoding='utf-8');print(json.dumps(report,indent=2))

"""Audit native adaptive case physics and boundary geometry, including parent/child zones."""
from pathlib import Path
import sys,re,json,hashlib
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path(__file__).parent/'python_packages'))
import h5py,numpy as np
from summarize_cases import expr
from grs_configure import balanced
root=Path(r'F:\Leontiev_Project')
source=root/'runs/grs_pilot_mid/20261005_085310_4f84f74e/pilot_initial.cas.h5'
candidate=root/(sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv)>1 else 'grs_wall_adapt_l3.cas.h5')
output=root/(sys.argv[2] if len(sys.argv)>2 else 'grs_wall_adapt_validation.json')
def read(p):
    with h5py.File(p) as f:
        rp=f['settings/Rampant Variables'][0].decode();tv=f['settings/Thread Variables'][0].decode()
        m=f['meshes/1'];coords=np.concatenate([d[()] for d in m['nodes/coords'].values()])
        z=m['faces/zoneTopology']; names=z['name'][0].decode().split(';')
        n=max(int(g.attrs['maxId'][0]) for g in m['faces/nodes'].values());edges=np.zeros((n,2),dtype=int)
        for g in m['faces/nodes'].values():
            counts=g['nnodes'][()];assert set(np.unique(counts)).issubset({0,2})
            edges[int(g.attrs['minId'][0])-1+np.flatnonzero(counts==2)]=g['nodes'][()].reshape(-1,2)
        geom={}
        for name,lo,hi,kind in zip(names,z['minId'][()],z['maxId'][()],z['zoneType'][()]):
            if int(kind)==31:continue # Native hanging-node parent hierarchy; not active faces.
            e=edges[int(lo)-1:int(hi)];e=e[np.all(e>0,axis=1)];points=coords[e-1]
            if name not in geom:geom[name]=[]
            geom[name].append(points)
        geom={k:np.concatenate(v) for k,v in geom.items()}
        return rp,tv,geom,len(coords),m['cells/zoneTopology/maxId'][()].tolist()
a,at,ag,an,ac=read(source);b,bt,bg,bn,bc=read(candidate)
keys=['materials','operating-pressure','keprt','wallprt','kw-sst-on?','named-expressions','viscous-energy-dissipation?','report/energy-flux/include-viscous-work?','mom/scheme','temperature/scheme','k/scheme','omega/scheme']
assert all(expr(a,k) is not None and expr(b,k) is not None for k in keys)
physics={k:expr(a,k)==expr(b,k) for k in keys}
thermal=('wall-air_svz-wall_abonite','wall-air_svz-wall_abonite-shadow','interior-air_dzv-wall_abonite','interior-air_dzv-wall_abonite-shadow')
def block(tv,name):
    hit=re.search(r'^\(39 \(\d+ \S+ '+re.escape(name)+r' 1\)',tv,re.M)
    assert hit,name
    return balanced(tv,hit.start())
settings={k:block(at,k)==block(bt,k) for k in thermal+('inlet_svz','inlet_dzv','outlet_svz','outlet_dzv')}
# Native child faces split straight segments; check lengths and axisymmetric surface integrals.
def measures(p):
    d=np.linalg.norm(p[:,1]-p[:,0],axis=1)
    return np.array([d.sum(),np.sum(d*np.mean(p[:,:,1],axis=1)*2*np.pi)])
boundaries={}
for name in thermal+('inlet_svz','inlet_dzv','outlet_svz','outlet_dzv','wall_outer-air_svz','wall_outer-air_dzv','axis','wall-wall_abonite'):
    va=measures(ag[name]);vb=measures(bg[name]);boundaries[name]={'before':va.tolist(),'after':vb.tolist(),'preserved':bool(np.allclose(va,vb,rtol=1e-10,atol=1e-12))}
def edge_set(p):return set(tuple(sorted(tuple(np.round(x,12)) for x in pair)) for pair in p)
pairs={'svz':edge_set(bg[thermal[0]])==edge_set(bg[thermal[1]]),'dzv':edge_set(bg[thermal[2]])==edge_set(bg[thermal[3]])}
report={'passed':all(physics.values()) and all(settings.values()) and all(v['preserved'] for v in boundaries.values()) and all(pairs.values()),'source':str(source),'candidate':str(candidate),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(candidate.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'physics_unchanged':physics,'boundary_thread_settings_unchanged':settings,'physical_surface_measures':boundaries,'conformal_thermal_pairs_match':pairs,'nodes_before':an,'nodes_after':bn,'stored_cell_zone_maxIds':bc,'native_active_cells':int(sys.argv[3]) if len(sys.argv)>3 else 303487,'nominal_wall_first_layer_um':0.125,'mesh_quality_limitation':'Numerical recovery candidate; consult native mesh quality transcript and wall spacing audit, not yet an accepted mesh-independent result','grid_independence_verified':False}
output.write_text(json.dumps(report,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps(report,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2));assert report['passed']

"""Prepare the approved air/Prt=.75 GRS pressure study using native Fluent settings."""
from pathlib import Path
import csv,json,re,uuid
from datetime import datetime,timezone,timedelta
ROOT=Path(r'F:\Leontiev_Project')
OUT=Path(r'C:\Users\RomanR\Documents\Codex\2026-10-04\new-chat\outputs')
PHYS_FIELDS=['secondary_inlet_mode','p0_inlet_svz_MPa','p_outlet_svz_MPa','p0_inlet_dzv_MPa','p_outlet_dzv_MPa','mass_flow_inlet_dzv_kg_s','T0_inlet_svz_K','T0_inlet_dzv_K','gas_material','gas_model','wall_material','turbulent_prandtl','first_layer_height_um']
def balanced(text,start):
    depth=0;quoted=False;escape=False
    for i in range(start,len(text)):
        c=text[i]
        if escape:escape=False;continue
        if c=='\\' and quoted:escape=True;continue
        if c=='"':quoted=not quoted
        if not quoted:
            if c=='(':depth+=1
            elif c==')':
                depth-=1
                if depth==0:return text[start:i+1]
    raise ValueError('Unbalanced Scheme settings')
def form(text,key):
    m=re.search(r'^\('+re.escape(key)+r'(?=\s|\))',text,re.M)
    if not m:raise KeyError(key)
    return balanced(text,m.start())
def bc(text,name):
    m=re.search(r'^\(bc \('+re.escape(name)+r'\s',text,re.M)
    if not m:raise KeyError(name)
    return balanced(text,m.start())
def replace_property(block,key,new):
    return block.replace(form(block,key),new,1)
def build_settings(row):
    text=(ROOT/'fluent_transfer_settings_before.set').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    expressions=form(text,'named-expressions')
    for name,value in [('inlet_svz',float(row['p0_inlet_svz_MPa'])*1e6),('outlet_svz',float(row['p_outlet_svz_MPa'])*1e6),('outlet_dzv',float(row['p_outlet_dzv_MPa'])*1e6)]:
        expressions,count=re.subn(r'(\(name \. "'+name+r'"\) \(definition \. ")[^"]+("\))',lambda m:m.group(1)+format(value,'.15g')+' [kg m^-1 s^-2]'+m.group(2),expressions)
        assert count==1
    if row['secondary_inlet_mode']=='pressure':
        value=float(row['p0_inlet_dzv_MPa'])*1e6
        entry=' ((name . "pressure_inlet_dzv") (definition . "'+format(value,'.15g')+' [kg m^-1 s^-2]") (description . "GRS absolute total pressure") (parameterid . "real-5") (parametername . "pressure_inlet_dzv") (unit . "pressure") (input-parameter . #t) (output-parameter . #f))'
        assert expressions.endswith('))');expressions=expressions[:-2]+entry+'))'
        old=bc(text,'inlet_dzv');new=bc(text,'inlet_svz')
        new=new.replace('(bc (inlet_svz pressure-inlet mixture)','(bc (inlet_dzv pressure-inlet mixture)',1)
        new=new.replace('(profile __expr__ "inlet_svz")','(profile __expr__ "pressure_inlet_dzv")')
        new=replace_property(new,'t0','(t0 (constant . '+str(float(row['T0_inlet_dzv_K']))+') (profile "" ""))')
        text=text.replace(old,new,1)
    else:
        expressions,count=re.subn(r'(\(name \. "inlet_dzv"\) \(definition \. ")[^"]+("\))',lambda m:m.group(1)+str(float(row['mass_flow_inlet_dzv_kg_s']))+' [kg s^-1]'+m.group(2),expressions);assert count==1
    text=text.replace(form(text,'named-expressions'),expressions,1)
    for name,key in [('inlet_svz','T0_inlet_svz_K'),('inlet_dzv','T0_inlet_dzv_K')]:
        old=bc(text,name);new=replace_property(old,'t0','(t0 (constant . '+str(float(row[key]))+') (profile "" ""))');text=text.replace(old,new,1)
    # Check top-level forms structurally before Fluent reads them.
    form(text,'rp');bc(text,'inlet_svz');bc(text,'inlet_dzv');form(text,'ni')
    return text
def prepare_table():
    path=ROOT/'project_inputs.csv'
    with path.open(newline='',encoding='utf-8-sig') as f:
        reader=csv.DictReader(f);fields=reader.fieldnames;rows=list(reader)
    geometries=[k for k in fields if k.endswith('_mm')]
    assert len(geometries)==21
    for row in rows[:3]:
        for k,v in {'secondary_inlet_mode':'mass_flow','p0_inlet_svz_MPa':.8106,'p_outlet_svz_MPa':.20265,'p0_inlet_dzv_MPa':'','p_outlet_dzv_MPa':.20265,'mass_flow_inlet_dzv_kg_s':.04,'T0_inlet_svz_K':298.15,'T0_inlet_dzv_K':298.15,'gas_material':'air','gas_model':'ideal','wall_material':'latun','turbulent_prandtl':.75,'first_layer_height_um':1.0}.items():row[k]=v
    rows=rows[:3];base=rows[0]
    for pdzv in (3.5,5.5,7.5):
        for psvz in (.6,1.1,1.6):
            row=dict(base);row.update(case_id=('grs_pilot_mid' if pdzv==5.5 and psvz==1.1 else 'grs_dzv_'+str(pdzv).replace('.','p')+'_svz_'+str(psvz).replace('.','p')),secondary_inlet_mode='pressure',p0_inlet_svz_MPa=psvz,p_outlet_svz_MPa=.3,p0_inlet_dzv_MPa=pdzv,p_outlet_dzv_MPa=round(pdzv-.3,8),mass_flow_inlet_dzv_kg_s='')
            rows.append(row)
    fields=['case_id','mesh_mode']+geometries+PHYS_FIELDS
    for dest in (path,OUT/path.name):
        with dest.open('w',newline='',encoding='utf-8') as f:
            writer=csv.DictWriter(f,fields);writer.writeheader();writer.writerows(rows)
    return rows
def main():
    rows=prepare_table();row=next(r for r in rows if r['case_id']=='grs_pilot_mid')
    token=datetime.now(timezone(timedelta(hours=4))).strftime('%Y%m%d_%H%M%S')+'_'+uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]
    run=ROOT/'runs'/row['case_id']/token;run.mkdir(parents=True)
    (run/'boundary_settings.set').write_text(build_settings(row),encoding='utf-8')
    config={'case_id':row['case_id'],'run_token':token,'run_dir':str(run),'inputs':row,'pressure_basis':'absolute','inlet_pressure_kind':'total','outlet_pressure_kind':'static','temperature_assumption':'Source-project 298.15 K retained','convergence':{'residual_other':1e-4,'residual_energy':1e-8,'window_iterations':200,'temperature_range_K':.02,'mass_flow_relative_range':.001,'channel_mass_imbalance':.001,'min_iterations':500,'max_iterations':5000,'sampling_interval':10,'required_consecutive_checks':3},'yplus_maximum':1.0,'mesh_first_layer_height_um':1.0,'status':'configuring'}
    (run/'manifest.json').write_text(json.dumps(config,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
    (ROOT/'grs_active_run.json').write_text(json.dumps(config,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
    r=run.as_posix()
    journal=f'''/file/confirm-overwrite? no
/file/start-transcript "{r}/setup.trn"
/file/read-case "F:/Leontiev_Project/fluent_baseline_prepared.cas.h5"
/mesh/modify-zones/zone-type inlet_dzv pressure-inlet
/file/read-settings "{r}/boundary_settings.set"
(rpsetvar 'keprt 0.75)
(rpsetvar 'wallprt 0.75)
(display "GRS_STOP_API ") (write (file-exists? "{r}/stop.flag")) (newline)
(display "GRS_COURANT ") (write (rpgetvar 'pressure-coupled/courant-number)) (newline)
(display "GRS_RESIDUAL ") (write (rpgetvar 'residuals/settings)) (newline)
(ti-menu-load-string "/define/boundary-conditions/list-zones")
/mesh/check
/file/confirm-overwrite? no
/file/write-case "{r}/configured.cas.h5"
/file/stop-transcript
/exit yes
'''
    (run/'setup.jou').write_text(journal,encoding='utf-8')
    print(json.dumps({'run_dir':str(run),'setup_journal':str(run/'setup.jou'),'csv_rows':len(rows)},ensure_ascii=False))
if __name__=='__main__':main()

from pathlib import Path
import sys,json
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path(__file__).parent/'python_packages'))
import h5py,numpy as np
from collections import Counter

root=Path(r'F:\Leontiev_Project')
cfg=json.loads((root/'grs_active_run.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'));run=Path(cfg['run_dir'])
with h5py.File(run/'configured.cas.h5') as f:
    m=f['meshes/1'];z=m['cells/zoneTopology']
    n=int(max(z['maxId'][()]));parent=np.arange(n+1)
    def find(a):
        while parent[a]!=a:
            parent[a]=parent[parent[a]];a=parent[a]
        return int(a)
    c0=np.zeros(int(max(m['faces/zoneTopology/maxId'][()]))+1,dtype=np.int64)
    c1=c0.copy()
    for key,out in [('c0',c0),('c1',c1)]:
        for g in m['faces'][key].values():
            lo=int(np.asarray(g.attrs['minId']).reshape(-1)[0]);hi=int(np.asarray(g.attrs['maxId']).reshape(-1)[0]);out[lo:hi+1]=g[()]
    for a,b in zip(c0,c1):
        if a and b:
            pa,pb=find(int(a)),find(int(b))
            if pa!=pb:parent[pb]=pa
    cellzone=np.zeros(n+1,dtype=np.int64)
    result={}
    for name,id,lo,hi in zip(z['name'][0].decode().split(';'),z['id'][()],z['minId'][()],z['maxId'][()]):
        counts=Counter(find(i) for i in range(int(lo),int(hi)+1))
        cellzone[int(lo):int(hi)+1]=id
        result[name]={'cells':int(hi-lo+1),'connected_components':len(counts),'component_sizes':sorted(counts.values(),reverse=True)[:10]}
    fz=m['faces/zoneTopology'];boundaries={}
    for name,lo,hi in zip(fz['name'][0].decode().split(';'),fz['minId'][()],fz['maxId'][()]):
        if name.startswith(('inlet','outlet','sys-')):
            boundaries[name]={'faces':int(hi-lo+1),'c0_zones':dict(Counter(map(int,cellzone[c0[int(lo):int(hi)+1]]))),
                'c1_zones':dict(Counter(map(int,cellzone[c1[int(lo):int(hi)+1]])))}
    proof={'passed':all(v['connected_components']==1 for v in result.values()),'cell_zones':result,'boundaries':boundaries}
    (run/'connectivity_validation.json').write_text(json.dumps(proof,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
    print(json.dumps(proof,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))

from pathlib import Path
import sys,json
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path(__file__).parent/'python_packages'))
import h5py,numpy as np
root=Path(r'F:\Leontiev_Project')
def read(path):

import json,traceback,math,time,System
from Ansys.ACT.Interfaces.Common import SelectionTypeEnum
from Ansys.Mechanical.DataModel.Enums import SizingType,SizingBehavior,MethodType,PhaseType,BiasType,BiasOptionType
log=r'F:\Leontiev_Project\grs_g2_setup.jsonl'
def record(step,value=None):
    with open(log,'a') as f:f.write(json.dumps({'time':time.time(),'step':step,'value':value})+'\n');f.flush()
try:
    model=ExtAPI.DataModel.Project.Model;geo=ExtAPI.DataModel.GeoData
    ns={str(n.Name):n for n in model.NamedSelections.Children if list(n.Location.Ids)}
    sections=('convergent','nozzle','heat','exit_contraction','exit_rounding','exit_recovery','exit_tail')
    for s in sections:
        for group in ('','_axial_edges','_layer_edges','_core_radial_edges'):
            assert 'MESH_'+s+group in ns
    record('scope preflight passed')
    model.Mesh.PhysicsPreference=System.Enum.Parse(model.Mesh.PhysicsPreference.GetType(),'CFD');model.Mesh.ElementSize=Quantity('0.5 [mm]')
    for b in model.Geometry.GetChildren(DataModelObjectCategory.Body,True):
        name=str(b.Name).split('\\')[-1]
        if name in ('air_svz','air_dzv','wall_abonite'):b.FluidSolidPhase=PhaseType.Solid if name=='wall_abonite' else PhaseType.LiquidGas
    record('CFD physics and gas/solid phases configured')
    for name,n in ns.items():
        if name.startswith('MESH_'):n.SendToSolver=False
    old=[o for o in model.Mesh.Children if str(o.Name)=='Structured_core']
    fm=old[0] if old else model.Mesh.AddFaceMeshing();fm.Name='Structured_core';fm.Location=ns['MESH_core_structured'].Location;fm.MappedMesh=True;fm.ConstrainBoundary=True
    record('face meshing configured')
    for section in sections:
        faces=[geo.GeoEntityById(i) for i in ns['MESH_'+section].Location.Ids]
        assert len(faces)==21 and all(len(f.Edges)==4 for f in faces)
        try:
            _v=json.load(open(r'F:\Leontiev_Project\dataset\current_variant.json'))
        except Exception:
            _v={}
        _ax=float(_v.get('axial_size_m') or .0005);_conv=int(_v.get('convergent_div') or 200)
        axial=int(math.ceil(max(geo.GeoEntityById(i).Length for i in ns['MESH_'+section+'_axial_edges'].Location.Ids)/_ax))
        if section=='convergent':axial=_conv
        prefix='Nozzle_' if section=='nozzle' else 'Nozzle_'+section+'_'
        for suffix,group,count in (('axial','_axial_edges',axial),('layers','_layer_edges',1),('core_radial' if section=='nozzle' else 'radial','_core_radial_edges',70)):
            name=prefix+suffix;old=[o for o in model.Mesh.Children if str(o.Name)==name];o=old[0] if old else model.Mesh.AddSizing()
            o.Name=name;o.NamedSelection=ns['MESH_'+section+group];o.Type=SizingType.NumberOfDivisions;o.NumberOfDivisions=count;o.Behavior=SizingBehavior.Hard
            if group=='_core_radial_edges':
                o.BiasType=BiasType.ooooo_ooo_o_o;o.BiasOption=BiasOptionType.Factor;o.BiasFactor=100.
                reverse=[]
                for i in o.Location.Ids:
                    e=geo.GeoEntityById(i)
                    vertices=list(e.Vertices)
                    if vertices[0].Y>vertices[-1].Y:reverse.append(i)
                if reverse:
                    info=ExtAPI.SelectionManager.CreateSelectionInfo(SelectionTypeEnum.GeometryEntities);info.Ids=reverse;o.ReverseBias=info
            record('sizing '+name,{'count':count,'ids':list(o.Location.Ids),'bias':str(o.BiasType)})
    bodies={str(b.Name).split('\\')[-1]:b for a in geo.Assemblies for p in a.Parts for b in p.Bodies}
    gas_edges=set(e.Id for e in bodies['air_dzv'].Edges)
    wallids=sorted(gas_edges.intersection(set(i for n in ('wall_outer-air_dzv','interior-air_dzv-wall_abonite') for i in ns[n].Location.Ids)))
    assert wallids
    old=[n for n in model.NamedSelections.Children if str(n.Name)=='MESH_walls_dzv'];n=old[0] if old else model.AddNamedSelection();n.Name='MESH_walls_dzv'
    info=ExtAPI.SelectionManager.CreateSelectionInfo(SelectionTypeEnum.GeometryEntities);info.Ids=wallids;n.Location=info;n.SendToSolver=False
    old=[o for o in model.Mesh.Children if str(o.Name)=='Inflation_air_dzv'];o=old[0] if old else model.Mesh.AddInflation();o.Name='Inflation_air_dzv';o.NamedSelection=ns['air_dzv'];o.BoundaryNamedSelection=n
    o.InflationOption=1;o.FirstLayerHeight=Quantity('0.0001 [mm]');o.MaximumLayers=20;o.NumberOfLayers=20;o.GrowthRate=1.2
    record('DC inflation configured',{'walls':wallids,'h1_um':.1,'layers':20,'growth':1.2})
    for o in model.Mesh.Children:
        if str(o.Name)=='Core_quadrilateral_method':o.NamedSelection=ns['MESH_core_structured']
    record('setup finished; no mesh generation yet')
except:record('python exception',traceback.format_exc())

"""Ideal-gas area/normal-shock screening only, never substituted for CFD."""
from pathlib import Path
import math,json
root=Path(r'F:\Leontiev_Project');g=1.3990088734067945;rt=2.25
def area(M):return ((2/(g+1))*(1+(g-1)*M*M/2))**((g+1)/(2*(g-1)))/M
def pshock(M):return (1+(g-1)*M*M/2)**(-g/(g-1))*(2*g*M*M-(g-1))/(g+1)
def bisect(fn,target,lo,hi):
    for _ in range(100):
        mid=(lo+hi)/2
        if fn(mid)<target:lo=mid
        else:hi=mid
    return (lo+hi)/2
rows=[]
for p0 in (.6,1.1,1.6):
    M=bisect(lambda m:-pshock(m),-.3/p0,2,10)
    rows.append(dict(p0_MPa=p0,pout_MPa=.3,ideal_M_before_normal_shock=M,
        ideal_area_ratio=area(M),ideal_radius_before_normal_shock_mm=rt*math.sqrt(area(M))))
details=[]
for r in (3.3,4,4.5,5,6,8,10):
    M=bisect(area,(r/rt)**2,1.00000001,10)
    details.append(dict(radius_mm=r,area_ratio=(r/rt)**2,ideal_supersonic_M=M,
        ideal_static_before_shock_MPa=1.1*(1+(g-1)*M*M/2)**(-g/(g-1)),
        ideal_static_after_shock_MPa=1.1*pshock(M)))
result=dict(diagnostic_only=True,CFD_result=False,gamma=g,throat_radius_mm=rt,
    assumptions='1D calorically perfect ideal gas, choked sonic throat, isentropic upstream, normal shock exactly at selected section; no wall friction/heat/separation/outlet diffuser',
    disclaimer='Radius is a screening estimate, not an optimum or guarantee. Long channel friction and coupled heat change shock placement. No project geometry changed.',
    sources=['https://www.grc.nasa.gov/www/BGH/astar.html','https://www.grc.nasa.gov/www/BGH/normal.html'],
    pressure_rows=rows,midpressure_radius_screen=details)
(root/'grs_geometry_ideal_screen.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))

from pathlib import Path
import sys,json,re
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path(__file__).parent/'python_packages'))
import h5py,numpy as np
from summarize_cases import expr
from grs_configure import balanced
root=Path(r'F:\Leontiev_Project');run=Path(sys.argv[2]) if len(sys.argv)>2 else root/'runs/grs_pilot_mid/20261005_094409_69c18117'
stage=sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv)>1 else 'pilot_local_cfl25'
with h5py.File(run/(stage+'.cas.h5')) as f:
    m=f['meshes/1'];coords=np.vstack([np.zeros((1,2)),np.concatenate([d[()] for d in m['nodes/coords'].values()])])
    nf=int(max(m['faces/zoneTopology/maxId'][()]));nc=int(max(m['cells/zoneTopology/maxId'][()]))
    edges=np.zeros((nf+1,2),dtype=int)
    for g in m['faces/nodes'].values():
        lo=int(g.attrs['minId'][0]);nn=g['nnodes'][()];assert np.all(nn==2)
        edges[lo:lo+len(nn)]=g['nodes'][()].reshape(-1,2)
    sides=[]
    for k in ('c0','c1'):
        a=np.zeros(nf+1,dtype=int)
        for d in m['faces'][k].values():
            lo=int(d.attrs['minId'][0]);a[lo:lo+len(d)]=d[()]
        sides.append(a)
    a,b=coords[edges[:,0]],coords[edges[:,1]]
    cross=(a[:,0]*b[:,1]-b[:,0]*a[:,1])/2
    area=np.zeros(nc+1);moment=np.zeros((nc+1,2))
    for side,sign in zip(sides,(1,-1)):
        np.add.at(area,side,sign*cross);np.add.at(moment,side,sign*cross[:,None]*(a+b)/3)
    center=moment[1:]/area[1:,None]
    rp=f['settings/Rampant Variables'][0].decode();materials=expr(rp,'materials')
    air=balanced(materials,materials.index('(air fluid'))
    cp=float(re.search(r'\(specific-heat \(constant \. ([^)]*)\)',air).group(1))
    mw=float(re.search(r'\(molecular-weight \(constant \. ([^)]*)\)',air).group(1))
    z=m['cells/zoneTopology'];names=z['name'][0].decode().split(';')
    zones=dict(zip(names,zip(z['minId'][()],z['maxId'][()])))
with h5py.File(run/(stage+'.dat.h5')) as f:
    g=f['results/1/phase-1/cells']
    def field(k):
        a=np.full(nc,np.nan)
        for d in g[k].values():
            lo=int(d.attrs['minId'][0])-1;a[lo:lo+len(d)]=d[()]
        return a
    t,u,v,p,rho=[field(k) for k in ('SV_T','SV_U','SV_V','SV_P','SV_DENSITY')]
R=8314.46261815324/mw;gamma=cp/(cp-R)
mach=np.sqrt(u*u+v*v)/np.sqrt(gamma*R*t)
records=[];details={}
bins=np.arange(-.025,.751,.005)
for channel,zone in (('svz','air_svz'),('dzv','air_dzv')):
    lo,hi=map(int,zones[zone]);mask=np.zeros(nc,dtype=bool);mask[lo-1:hi]=True
    details[channel]=dict(maximum_Mach=float(np.nanmax(mach[mask])),Cp_J_kg_K=cp,
                          molecular_weight_kg_kmol=mw,R_J_kg_K=R,gamma=gamma)
    for x0,x1 in zip(bins[:-1],bins[1:]):
        sel=mask&(center[:,0]>=x0)&(center[:,0]<x1)
        if not np.any(sel):continue
        vol=np.abs(area[1:])*2*np.pi*center[:,1]
        w=vol[sel];core=sel&(center[:,1]<(np.max(center[sel,1])*.75)) if channel=='svz' else sel
        records.append(dict(channel=channel,x_mid_m=(x0+x1)/2,cell_count=int(sum(sel)),
                            max_Mach=float(np.nanmax(mach[sel])),median_Mach=float(np.nanmedian(mach[sel])),
                            core_Mach_median=float(np.nanmedian(mach[core])) if np.any(core) else None,
                            volume_weighted_Mach=float(np.average(mach[sel],weights=w)),
                            supersonic_volume_fraction=float(np.sum(w[mach[sel]>1])/np.sum(w)),
                            mean_pressure_Pa=float(np.average(p[sel],weights=w))))
result=dict(diagnostic_only=True,source_case=str(run/(stage+'.cas.h5')),source_data=str(run/(stage+'.dat.h5')),
            convergence_accepted=False,method='Mach from saved native cell U,V,T and constant ideal-air Cp/MW; polygon centroids reconstructed from mesh',
            channels=details,bins=records)
output=Path(sys.argv[3]) if len(sys.argv)>3 else root/'grs_mach_diagnostic.json'
output.write_text(json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps(dict(channels=details,svz_selected_bins=[r for r in records if r['channel']=='svz' and round(r['x_mid_m'],4) in (.0025,.0225,.0525,.1025,.2025,.4025,.6025)]),indent=2))

    with open(log,'a') as f:f.write(json.dumps({'step':step,'value':value})+'\n');f.flush()

    record('start')
    obj=[o for o in ExtAPI.DataModel.Project.Model.Mesh.Children if str(o.Name)=='Nozzle_core_radial'][0]

from Ansys.ACT.Interfaces.Common import SelectionTypeEnum

log=r'F:\Leontiev_Project\grs_mesh_recovery_setup.jsonl'
def record(step,value=None):
    with open(log,'a') as f:f.write(json.dumps({'time':time.time(),'step':step,'value':value})+'\n');f.flush()
try:
    model=ExtAPI.DataModel.Project.Model;geo=ExtAPI.DataModel.GeoData
    ns={str(n.Name):n for n in model.NamedSelections.Children if list(n.Location.Ids)}
    sections=('convergent','nozzle','heat','exit_contraction','exit_rounding','exit_recovery','exit_tail')
    for s in sections:
        for group in ('','_axial_edges','_layer_edges','_core_radial_edges'):
            assert 'MESH_'+s+group in ns
    record('scope preflight passed')
    model.Mesh.PhysicsPreference=System.Enum.Parse(model.Mesh.PhysicsPreference.GetType(),'CFD');model.Mesh.ElementSize=Quantity('0.5 [mm]')
    for b in model.Geometry.GetChildren(DataModelObjectCategory.Body,True):
        name=str(b.Name).split('\\')[-1]
        if name in ('air_svz','air_dzv','wall_abonite'):b.FluidSolidPhase=PhaseType.Solid if name=='wall_abonite' else PhaseType.LiquidGas
    record('CFD physics and gas/solid phases configured')
    for name,n in ns.items():
        if name.startswith('MESH_'):n.SendToSolver=False
    old=[o for o in model.Mesh.Children if str(o.Name)=='Structured_core']
    fm=old[0] if old else model.Mesh.AddFaceMeshing();fm.Name='Structured_core';fm.Location=ns['MESH_core_structured'].Location;fm.MappedMesh=True;fm.ConstrainBoundary=True
    record('face meshing configured')
    for section in sections:
        faces=[geo.GeoEntityById(i) for i in ns['MESH_'+section].Location.Ids]
        assert len(faces)==21 and all(len(f.Edges)==4 for f in faces)
        axial=int(math.ceil(max(geo.GeoEntityById(i).Length for i in ns['MESH_'+section+'_axial_edges'].Location.Ids)/.0005))
        prefix='Nozzle_' if section=='nozzle' else 'Nozzle_'+section+'_'
        for suffix,group,count in (('axial','_axial_edges',axial),('layers','_layer_edges',1),('core_radial' if section=='nozzle' else 'radial','_core_radial_edges',70)):
            name=prefix+suffix;old=[o for o in model.Mesh.Children if str(o.Name)==name];o=old[0] if old else model.Mesh.AddSizing()
            o.Name=name;o.NamedSelection=ns['MESH_'+section+group];o.Type=SizingType.NumberOfDivisions;o.NumberOfDivisions=count;o.Behavior=SizingBehavior.Hard
            if group=='_core_radial_edges':
                o.BiasType=BiasType.ooooo_ooo_o_o;o.BiasOption=BiasOptionType.Factor;o.BiasFactor=100.
                reverse=[]
                for i in o.Location.Ids:
                    e=geo.GeoEntityById(i)
                    vertices=list(e.Vertices)
                    if vertices[0].Y>vertices[-1].Y:reverse.append(i)
                if reverse:
                    info=ExtAPI.SelectionManager.CreateSelectionInfo(SelectionTypeEnum.GeometryEntities);info.Ids=reverse;o.ReverseBias=info
            record('sizing '+name,{'count':count,'ids':list(o.Location.Ids),'bias':str(o.BiasType)})
    bodies={str(b.Name).split('\\')[-1]:b for a in geo.Assemblies for p in a.Parts for b in p.Bodies}
    gas_edges=set(e.Id for e in bodies['air_dzv'].Edges)
    wallids=sorted(gas_edges.intersection(set(i for n in ('wall_outer-air_dzv','interior-air_dzv-wall_abonite') for i in ns[n].Location.Ids)))
    assert wallids
    old=[n for n in model.NamedSelections.Children if str(n.Name)=='MESH_walls_dzv'];n=old[0] if old else model.AddNamedSelection();n.Name='MESH_walls_dzv'
    info=ExtAPI.SelectionManager.CreateSelectionInfo(SelectionTypeEnum.GeometryEntities);info.Ids=wallids;n.Location=info;n.SendToSolver=False
    old=[o for o in model.Mesh.Children if str(o.Name)=='Inflation_air_dzv'];o=old[0] if old else model.Mesh.AddInflation();o.Name='Inflation_air_dzv';o.NamedSelection=ns['air_dzv'];o.BoundaryNamedSelection=n
    o.InflationOption=1;o.FirstLayerHeight=Quantity('0.0001 [mm]');o.MaximumLayers=20;o.NumberOfLayers=20;o.GrowthRate=1.2

from pathlib import Path
import sys,json
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path(__file__).parent/'python_packages'))
import h5py,numpy as np
root=Path(r'F:\Leontiev_Project')
paths=[root/'runs/grs_pilot_mid/20261005_085310_4f84f74e/pilot_initial.cas.h5',root/'runs/grs_pilot_mid/20261005_094409_69c18117/configured.cas.h5',root/'fluent_grs_h01um_control_prepared.cas.h5']
report=[]
for path in paths:
    with h5py.File(path) as f:
        m=f['meshes/1']; coords=np.concatenate([d[()] for d in m['nodes/coords'].values()]); coords=np.vstack([np.zeros((1,2)),coords])
        nf=int(max(m['faces/zoneTopology/maxId'][()]));nc=int(max(m['cells/zoneTopology/maxId'][()]))
        edges=np.zeros((nf+1,2),dtype=int)
        for g in m['faces/nodes'].values():
            lo=int(g.attrs['minId'][0]);nn=g['nnodes'][()];assert np.all(nn==2)
            edges[lo:lo+len(nn)]=g['nodes'][()].reshape(-1,2)
        side=[]
        for key in ('c0','c1'):
            arr=np.zeros(nf+1,dtype=int)
            for d in m['faces'][key].values():
                lo=int(d.attrs['minId'][0]);arr[lo:lo+len(d)]=d[()]
            side.append(arr)
        c0,c1=side
        a=coords[edges[:,0]];b=coords[edges[:,1]];cross=(a[:,0]*b[:,1]-b[:,0]*a[:,1])/2
        area=np.zeros(nc+1);np.add.at(area,c0,cross);np.add.at(area,c1,-cross);area=np.abs(area)
        both=(c0>0)&(c1>0);valid=both&(area[c0]>1e-25)&(area[c1]>1e-25)
        ratio=np.maximum(area[c0[valid]]/area[c1[valid]],area[c1[valid]]/area[c0[valid]])
        ids=np.flatnonzero(valid);worst=np.argsort(ratio)[-5:][::-1]
        row={'source':str(path),'minimum_polygon_area_m2':float(min(area[1:])),
            'maximum_adjacent_cell_area_ratio':float(max(ratio)),
            'adjacent_area_ratio_percentiles':dict(zip(['50','95','99','99.9'],map(float,np.percentile(ratio,[50,95,99,99.9])))),
            'pairs_ratio_above_100':int(sum(ratio>100)),'worst_face_midpoints_m':((a[ids[worst]]+b[ids[worst]])/2).tolist()}
        report.append(row)
proof={'diagnostic_only':True,'meshes':report}
(root/'grs_mesh_transition_diagnostic.json').write_text(json.dumps(proof,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps(proof,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))

"""Parse native Fluent reports with explicit units and audit convergence."""
from pathlib import Path
import re, json, csv, sys

NUM = r'[-+]?(?:\d+(?:\.\d*)?|\.\d+)(?:[eE][-+]?\d+)?'
RES = re.compile(r'^\s*(\d+)\s+' + r'\s+'.join([f'({NUM})']*6) + r'\s+\d+:\d+:\d+', re.M)
NAMES = ('outlet_total_temp_svz outlet_total_temp_dzv outlet_total_pressure_dzv '
         'outlet_total_pressure_svz outlet_static_pressure_svz outlet_static_pressure_dzv '
         'inlet_static_pressure_dzv inlet_static_pressure_svz inlet_total_pressure_svz '
         'inlet_mass_flow_rate_svz inlet_mass_flow_rate_dzv outlet_mass_flow_rate_dzv '
         'outlet_mass_flow_rate_svz').split()
EQ = ('continuity','x_velocity','y_velocity','energy','k','omega')

def convert(name, value, unit):
    if 'temp' in name:
        if unit == 'C': return value + 273.15
        if unit == 'K': return value
    elif 'pressure' in name:
        if unit == 'atm': return value * 101325.0
        if unit == 'Pa': return value
        if unit == 'MPa': return value * 1e6
    elif 'mass_flow' in name and unit == 'kg/s': return value
    raise ValueError(f'Unsupported units for {name}: {unit!r}')

def parse(text):
    samples=[]
    previous=0
    for sample in re.finditer(r'^GRS_SAMPLE_START (\d+)\s*\n(.*?)^GRS_SAMPLE_END\s*$', text, re.M|re.S):
        body=sample.group(2)
        residuals=list(RES.finditer(text[previous:sample.start()]))
        if not residuals: raise ValueError('No residual record preceding sample')
        residual=residuals[-1]
        row={'iteration':int(residual.group(1))}
        row.update({'residual_'+k:float(v) for k,v in zip(EQ,residual.groups()[1:])})
        for name in NAMES:
            block=re.search(r'^'+re.escape(name)+r'\s*\n.*?\[([^\]]+)\]\s*\n[^\n]*\n\s*(?:inlet|outlet)_(?:svz|dzv)\s+('+NUM+r')\s*$',body,re.M|re.S)
            if block is None: raise ValueError('Missing report '+name)
            row[name]=convert(name,float(block.group(2)),block.group(1).strip())
        for channel in ('svz','dzv'):
            wallblock=re.search(r'^GRS_YPLUS_'+channel.upper()+r'\s*\n(.*?)(?=^GRS_YPLUS_|\Z)',body,re.M|re.S)
            maximum=re.search(r'^\s*Net\s+('+NUM+r')\s*$',wallblock.group(1),re.M)
            row['yplus_max_'+channel]=float(maximum.group(1))
            incoming=row['inlet_mass_flow_rate_'+channel]; outgoing=row['outlet_mass_flow_rate_'+channel]
            row['mass_imbalance_'+channel]=abs(incoming+outgoing)/max(abs(incoming),abs(outgoing),1e-30)
        fluxblock=re.search(r'^GRS_ENERGY_FLUX_START\s*\n(.*?)^GRS_ENERGY_FLUX_END\s*$',body,re.M|re.S)
        if fluxblock:
            rates={n:float(v) for n,v in re.findall(r'^\s*(\S+)\s+('+NUM+r')\s*$',fluxblock.group(1),re.M)}
            row['energy_imbalance_global_W']=rates['Net']
            row['energy_imbalance_svz_W']=sum(rates[n] for n in ('inlet_svz','outlet_svz','wall_outer-air_svz','wall-air_svz-wall_abonite-shadow'))
            row['energy_imbalance_dzv_W']=sum(rates[n] for n in ('inlet_dzv','outlet_dzv','wall_outer-air_dzv','interior-air_dzv-wall_abonite-shadow'))
            row['energy_imbalance_solid_W']=sum(rates[n] for n in ('wall-air_svz-wall_abonite','interior-air_dzv-wall_abonite','wall-wall_abonite'))
            row['heat_into_svz_W']=rates['wall-air_svz-wall_abonite-shadow']
            row['heat_into_dzv_W']=rates['interior-air_dzv-wall_abonite-shadow']
        samples.append(row); previous=sample.end()
    return samples

def evaluate(samples, criteria, yplus_limit):
    if not samples: return {'accepted':False,'reason':'No complete samples'}
    last=samples[-1]; window=[s for s in samples if s['iteration']>=last['iteration']-criteria['window_iterations']]
    checks={'min_iterations':last['iteration']>=criteria['min_iterations'],
            'complete_window':window[0]['iteration']<=last['iteration']-criteria['window_iterations']}
    metrics={}
    if 'energy_balance_absolute_W' in criteria:
        for domain in ('global','svz','dzv','solid'):
            key='energy_imbalance_'+domain+'_W'
            checks['energy_balanced_'+domain]=all(key in s and abs(s[key])<=criteria['energy_balance_absolute_W'] for s in window)
    for eq in EQ:
        checks['residual_'+eq]=last['residual_'+eq] <= criteria['residual_energy' if eq=='energy' else 'residual_other']
    for channel in ('svz','dzv'):
        key='outlet_total_temp_'+channel
        spread=max(s[key] for s in window)-min(s[key] for s in window)
        metrics[key+'_range_K']=spread; checks[key+'_stable']=spread<=criteria['temperature_range_K']
        checks['mass_balanced_'+channel]=all(s['mass_imbalance_'+channel]<=criteria['channel_mass_imbalance'] for s in window)
        metrics['yplus_window_max_'+channel]=max(s['yplus_max_'+channel] for s in window)
        checks['yplus_'+channel]=metrics['yplus_window_max_'+channel]<=yplus_limit
        checks['forward_flow_'+channel]=last['inlet_mass_flow_rate_'+channel]>0 and last['outlet_mass_flow_rate_'+channel]<0
        for end in ('inlet','outlet'):
            key=end+'_mass_flow_rate_'+channel
            spread=(max(s[key] for s in window)-min(s[key] for s in window))/max(abs(last[key]),1e-30)
            metrics[key+'_relative_range']=spread; checks[key+'_stable']=spread<=criteria['mass_flow_relative_range']
    return {'accepted':all(checks.values()),'flow_converged':all(v for k,v in checks.items() if not k.startswith('yplus_')),
            'checks':checks,'metrics':metrics,'last':last}

if __name__=='__main__':
    root=Path(r'F:\Leontiev_Project')
    cfg=json.loads((root/'grs_active_run.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
    run=Path(cfg['run_dir']);stage=sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv)>1 else cfg['solver_stage']
    samples=parse((run/(stage+'.trn')).read_text(encoding='utf-8',errors='replace'))
    result=evaluate(samples,cfg['convergence'],cfg['yplus_maximum'])
    consecutive=cfg['convergence']['required_consecutive_checks']
    result['required_consecutive_checks']=consecutive
    result['consecutive_flow_checks_passed']=len(samples)>=consecutive and all(evaluate(samples[:len(samples)-i],cfg['convergence'],cfg['yplus_maximum'])['flow_converged'] for i in range(consecutive))
    result['accepted']=result['accepted'] and len(samples)>=consecutive and all(evaluate(samples[:len(samples)-i],cfg['convergence'],cfg['yplus_maximum'])['accepted'] for i in range(consecutive))
    result['numerical_checks_passed']=result['accepted']
    if cfg.get('warmup_only',False):
        result['accepted']=False
        result['qualification_note']='First-order warmup only; restore second-order and verify before accepting physical results'
    if cfg.get('numerical_stage_only',False):
        result['accepted']=False
        result['qualification_note']=cfg['acceptance_block_reason']
    result['canonical_units']={'temperature':'K','pressure':'Pa','mass_flow':'kg/s'}
    result['samples']=len(samples);result['source_transcript']=str(run/(stage+'.trn'))
    (run/(stage+'_validation.json')).write_text(json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
    if samples:
        with (run/(stage+'_monitors.csv')).open('w',encoding='utf-8-sig',newline='') as f:
            writer=csv.DictWriter(f,fieldnames=list(samples[0]));writer.writeheader();writer.writerows(samples)
    print(json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))

from pathlib import Path
import sys,json
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path(__file__).parent/'python_packages'))
import h5py,numpy as np
root=Path(r'F:\Leontiev_Project')
source=root/'mesh_grs_h01um_control_protected.cas.h5'
assert json.loads((root/'mesh_grs_h01um_control_smoothing_validation.json').read_text())['passed']
with h5py.File(source) as f:
    m=f['meshes/1'];coords=np.concatenate([d[()] for d in m['nodes/coords'].values()]);nf=int(max(m['faces/zoneTopology/maxId'][()]));con=np.zeros((nf,2),dtype=int)
    for g in m['faces/nodes'].values():
        lo=int(g.attrs['minId'][0])-1;nn=g['nnodes'][()];con[lo+np.flatnonzero(nn==2)]=g['nodes'][()].reshape(-1,2)
    z=m['faces/zoneTopology'];zones=dict(zip(z['name'][0].decode().split(';'),zip(z['minId'][()],z['maxId'][()])))
    from collections import Counter
    def edges(name):
        lo,hi=zones[name]
        return Counter(tuple(sorted(tuple(np.round(coords[n-1],14)) for n in pair)) for pair in con[int(lo)-1:int(hi)] if min(pair)>0)
    pairs=('wall-air_svz-wall_abonite-contact_region','interior-air_dzv-wall_abonite-contact_region_2')
    # Compare ordered physical segments, allowing only numerical coordinate noise.
    # The original mesh has independently exported nodes at coincident body faces.
    checks={}
    for p in pairs:
        a=np.array(sorted(edges(p+'-src').elements()))
        b=np.array(sorted(edges(p+'-trg').elements()))
        same_shape=a.shape==b.shape
        max_difference=float(np.max(np.abs(a-b))) if same_shape else None
        checks[p]=dict(source_segments=len(a),target_segments=len(b),same_shape=same_shape,
                       max_coordinate_difference_m=max_difference,
                       passed=same_shape and max_difference<=1e-12)
proof=dict(passed=all(v['passed'] for v in checks.values()),source=str(source),
           coordinate_tolerance_m=1e-12,thermal_pair_segment_checks=checks)
(root/'grs_control_transfer_preflight.json').write_text(json.dumps(proof,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps(proof))
assert proof['passed'],'Non-conformal thermal boundaries: do not fuse'
text=(root/'prepare_fluent_grs_h01um.jou').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
text=text.replace('prepare_fluent_grs_h01um.trn','prepare_fluent_grs_h01um_control.trn').replace('mesh_grs_h01um_protected_repeated.cas.h5',source.name).replace('fluent_grs_h01um_prepared.cas.h5','fluent_grs_h01um_control_prepared.cas.h5')
path=root/'prepare_fluent_grs_h01um_control.jou';path.write_text(text,encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps(proof));print(path)

FILE: development_scripts/grs_prepare_run.py

"""Create a versioned GRS run from the existing CSV, without regenerating it."""
from pathlib import Path
import csv,json,uuid,hashlib,re,sys
from datetime import datetime,timezone,timedelta
from grs_configure import build_settings

ROOT=Path(r'F:\Leontiev_Project')
def digest(path):return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def prepare(case_id,proof_path=None,activate=True):
    with (ROOT/'project_inputs.csv').open(encoding='utf-8-sig',newline='') as f:rows=list(csv.DictReader(f))
    candidates=[r for r in rows if r['case_id']==case_id]
    assert len(candidates)==1,'Case ID must identify one row'
    row=candidates[0]
    assert re.fullmatch(r'[A-Za-z0-9_-]+',case_id),'Case ID must be a safe directory name'
    assert (row['gas_material'],row['gas_model'],row['wall_material'])==('air','ideal','latun'),'Only approved air/latun material setup is currently supported'
    assert row['secondary_inlet_mode']=='pressure','This GRS runner requires pressure inlet mode'
    assert 0<float(row['turbulent_prandtl'])<2
    for key in ('p0_inlet_svz_MPa','p_outlet_svz_MPa','p0_inlet_dzv_MPa','p_outlet_dzv_MPa','T0_inlet_svz_K','T0_inlet_dzv_K'):assert float(row[key])>0
    proof_path=Path(proof_path or ROOT/'fluent_grs_mesh_provenance.json')
    proof=json.loads(proof_path.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
    assert proof['passed']
    case=Path(proof['prepared_case'])
    assert digest(case)==proof['prepared_case_sha256'],'Prepared mesh case changed after validation'
    assert abs(float(row['first_layer_height_um'])-proof['first_layer_height_um'])<1e-12
    assert row['mesh_mode']==proof['mesh_mode']
    geometry={k:float(v) for k,v in row.items() if k.endswith('_mm')}
    assert set(geometry)==set(proof['geometry_mm'])
    assert all(abs(v-proof['geometry_mm'][k])<1e-9 for k,v in geometry.items()),'Generate and validate a mesh for the changed geometry before solving'
    criteria={'residual_other':1e-4,'residual_energy':1e-8,'window_iterations':200,'temperature_range_K':.02,'mass_flow_relative_range':.001,'channel_mass_imbalance':.001,'min_iterations':500,'max_iterations':5000,'sampling_interval':10,'required_consecutive_checks':3}
    fingerprint=hashlib.sha256(json.dumps({'inputs':row,'mesh_case_sha256':proof['prepared_case_sha256'],'convergence':criteria},sort_keys=True).encode()).hexdigest()
    token=datetime.now(timezone(timedelta(hours=4))).strftime('%Y%m%d_%H%M%S')+'_'+uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]
    run=ROOT/'runs'/case_id/token;run.mkdir(parents=True)
    cfg={'case_id':case_id,'run_token':token,'run_dir':str(run),'inputs':row,'input_fingerprint':fingerprint,'mesh_proof':str(proof_path),'prepared_case_sha256':proof['prepared_case_sha256'],'pressure_basis':'absolute','inlet_pressure_kind':'total','outlet_pressure_kind':'static','temperature_assumption':'Source-project 298.15 K retained for approved GRS rows','convergence':criteria,'yplus_maximum':1.0,'mesh_first_layer_height_um':proof['first_layer_height_um'],'status':'configuring'}
    (run/'boundary_settings.set').write_text(build_settings(row),encoding='utf-8')
    r=run.as_posix();prt=float(row['turbulent_prandtl'])
    journal=f'''/file/confirm-overwrite? no
/file/start-transcript "{r}/setup.trn"
/file/read-case "{case.as_posix()}"
/mesh/modify-zones/zone-type inlet_dzv pressure-inlet
/file/read-settings "{r}/boundary_settings.set"
(rpsetvar 'keprt {prt})
(rpsetvar 'wallprt {prt})
(ti-menu-load-string "/define/boundary-conditions/list-zones")
/mesh/check
/file/confirm-overwrite? no
/file/write-case "{r}/configured.cas.h5"
/file/stop-transcript
/exit yes
'''
    (run/'setup.jou').write_text(journal,encoding='utf-8')
    destinations=[run/'manifest.json']
    if activate:destinations.append(ROOT/'grs_active_run.json')
    for dest in destinations:dest.write_text(json.dumps(cfg,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
    return cfg
if __name__=='__main__':
    cfg=prepare(sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv)>1 else 'grs_pilot_mid')
    print(json.dumps({'run_dir':cfg['run_dir'],'setup_journal':str(Path(cfg['run_dir'])/'setup.jou')},ensure_ascii=False))

"""Recovery mesh candidate: retain topology and BL outer envelope, reduce first height.
Only mesh coordinates in a separate native HDF5 case are edited. Fluent must reload,
check and rewrite it before solving; original source files remain intact.
"""
from pathlib import Path

import h5py,numpy as np
root=Path(r'F:\Leontiev_Project');source=root/'grs_coarse_protected_repaired.cas.h5';target=root/'grs_redistributed_candidate_v4.cas.h5'

ref=next(ast.literal_eval(n.value) for n in ast.walk(tree) if isinstance(n,ast.Assign) and any(isinstance(t,ast.Name) and t.id=='reference' for t in n.targets))
wallcurve=ref['air_svz']['edges'][2]
cp=np.array([c['position'][:2] for c in wallcurve['control_points']]);knots=np.array([k['parameter'] for k in wallcurve['knots'] for _ in range(k['multiplicity'])]);degree=wallcurve['degree']
def bspline(t):
    if t>=1:return cp[-1].copy()
    i=int(np.searchsorted(knots,t,side='right')-1);d=cp[i-degree:i+1].copy()
    for r in range(1,degree+1):
        for j in range(degree,r-1,-1):
            k=i-degree+j;alpha=(t-knots[k])/(knots[k+degree-r+1]-knots[k]);d[j]=(1-alpha)*d[j-1]+alpha*d[j]
    return d[degree]
sample=np.array([bspline(t) for t in np.linspace(0,1,10001)])
inletcurve=ref['air_svz']['edges'][3]
def inletpoint(t):
    icp=np.array([c['position'][:2] for c in inletcurve['control_points']]);ik=np.array([k['parameter'] for k in inletcurve['knots'] for _ in range(k['multiplicity'])]);deg=inletcurve['degree']
    if t>=1:return icp[-1].copy()
    i=int(np.searchsorted(ik,t,side='right')-1);d=icp[i-deg:i+1].copy()
    for r in range(1,deg+1):
        for j in range(deg,r-1,-1):
            k=i-deg+j;alpha=(t-ik[k])/(ik[k+deg-r+1]-ik[k]);d[j]=(1-alpha)*d[j-1]+alpha*d[j]
    return d[deg]
xstart=cp[0,0];xt=cp[-1,0];xn=ref['air_svz']['edges'][0]['start'][0];xh=.7;xa=ref['air_svz']['edges'][9]['end'][0];xb=ref['air_svz']['edges'][8]['end'][0];xc=.72;xo=.725
rt=cp[-1,1];rn=.0033;rh=.01;rneck=.008;rout=.01
nf=math.sqrt(1+((rn-rt)/(xn-xt))**2);hf=math.sqrt(1+((rh-rn)/(xh-xn))**2)
old=np.r_[0,np.cumsum(1e-6*1.2**np.arange(20))];H=old[-1];lo,hi=1.,2.
for _ in range(80):
    mid=(lo+hi)/2
    if np.sum(1e-7*mid**np.arange(20))<H:lo=mid
    else:hi=mid
growth=(lo+hi)/2;new=np.r_[0,np.cumsum(1e-7*growth**np.arange(20))];new[-1]=H
with h5py.File(source) as f:
    m=f['meshes/1'];datasets=list(m['nodes/coords'].values());assert len(datasets)==1
    coords=datasets[0][()];p=coords.copy();nfaces=max(int(g.attrs['maxId'][0]) for g in m['faces/nodes'].values());edges=np.zeros((nfaces,2),dtype=int)
    for g in m['faces/nodes'].values():
        nn=g['nnodes'][()];assert np.all(nn==2);edges[int(g.attrs['minId'][0])-1:int(g.attrs['maxId'][0])]=g['nodes'][()].reshape(-1,2)
    z=m['faces/zoneTopology'];names=z['name'][0].decode().split(';');zones={name:(int(a)-1,int(b)) for name,a,b in zip(names,z['minId'][()],z['maxId'][()])}
    side=[]
    for key in ('c0','c1'):
        v=np.zeros(nfaces,dtype=int)
        for d in m['faces/'+key].values():v[int(d.attrs['minId'][0])-1:int(d.attrs['maxId'][0])]=d[()]
        side.append(v)
    cz=m['cells/zoneTopology'];cn=cz['name'][0].decode().split(';');bounds={name:(int(a),int(b)) for name,a,b in zip(cn,cz['minId'][()],cz['maxId'][()])}
    def zone_nodes(name):
        a,b=bounds[name];mask=((side[0]>=a)&(side[0]<=b))|((side[1]>=a)&(side[1]<=b));return np.unique(edges[mask])-1
    svz=zone_nodes('air_svz');dzv=zone_nodes('air_dzv');solid=zone_nodes('wall_abonite')
    protected=set(solid.tolist())
    for name in ('axis','wall_outer-air_svz','wall_outer-air_dzv','wall-air_svz-wall_abonite-shadow','interior-air_dzv-wall_abonite-shadow'):
        a,b=zones[name];protected.update((np.unique(edges[a:b])-1).tolist())
    wallids=[]
    for name in ('wall_outer-air_svz','wall-air_svz-wall_abonite-shadow'):
        a,b=zones[name];wallids.extend((np.unique(edges[a:b])-1).tolist())
    wp=p[np.unique(wallids)];wp=wp[np.argsort(wp[:,0])]
    assert np.all(np.diff(wp[:,0])>0),'Physical wall must be single valued in x'
    ilo,ihi=zones['inlet_svz'];inletnodes=set((np.unique(edges[ilo:ihi])-1).tolist());ri=cp[0,1]
    for idx in svz:
        if int(idx) in protected:continue
        x,y=p[idx];factor=1.
        if x<=xstart+1e-12 and 1e-12<ri-y<H:
            oldd=ri-y;newd=float(np.interp(oldd,old,new));p[idx,1]=ri-newd
            p[idx,0]=xstart+(x-xstart)*newd/oldd
            if int(idx) in inletnodes:
                a,b=0.,1.
                for _ in range(60):
                    t=(a+b)/2
                    if inletpoint(t)[1]>p[idx,1]:a=t
                    else:b=t
                p[idx]=inletpoint((a+b)/2)
            continue
        if xstart-1e-12<=x<=xt:
            # Evaluate NURBS exactly at the original x using a bracket from the sampled curve.
            j=max(0,min(len(sample)-2,int(np.searchsorted(sample[:,0],x)-1)));a=j/10000;b=(j+1)/10000
            for _ in range(40):
                t=(a+b)/2
                if bspline(t)[0]<x:a=t
                else:b=t
            wall=bspline((a+b)/2)[1];factor=1+(nf-1)*(x-xstart)/(xt-xstart)
        elif xt<x<=xn:wall=rt+(rn-rt)*(x-xt)/(xn-xt);factor=nf
        elif xn<x<=xh:wall=rn+(rh-rn)*(x-xn)/(xh-xn);factor=nf+(hf-nf)*(x-xn)/(xh-xn)
        elif xh<x<=xa:wall=rh+(rneck-rh)*(x-xh)/(xa-xh);factor=hf+(1-hf)*(x-xh)/(xa-xh)
        elif xa<x<=xb:
            rad=ref['air_svz']['edges'][8]['radius'];cy=ref['air_svz']['edges'][8]['origin'][1];wall=cy-math.sqrt(rad**2-(x-(xa+xb)/2)**2)
        elif xb<x<=xc:wall=rneck+(rout-rneck)*(x-xb)/(xc-xb)
        elif xc<x<=xo+1e-12:wall=rout
        else:continue
        # The finite-volume boundary is the native piecewise linear wall, not the
        # underlying smooth CAD spline. Its chord deviation exceeds h1 locally.
        wall=float(np.interp(x,wp[:,0],wp[:,1]))
        dist=(wall-y)/factor
        if 1e-12<dist<H-1e-12:p[idx,1]=wall-factor*np.interp(dist,old,new)
    low=ref['air_dzv']['edges'][1]['start'][1];high=ref['air_dzv']['edges'][3]['start'][1]
    for idx in dzv:
        if int(idx) in protected:continue
        y=p[idx,1];dlo=y-low;dhi=high-y
        if 1e-12<dlo<H-1e-12:p[idx,1]=low+np.interp(dlo,old,new)
        elif 1e-12<dhi<H-1e-12:p[idx,1]=high-np.interp(dhi,old,new)
    assert np.array_equal(p[list(protected)],coords[list(protected)])
shutil.copy2(source,target);shutil.copy2(source.with_name(source.name.replace('.cas.','.dat.')),target.with_name(target.name.replace('.cas.','.dat.')))
with h5py.File(target,'r+') as f:list(f['meshes/1/nodes/coords'].values())[0][...]=p
out={'source':str(source),'candidate':str(target),'status':'coordinate_candidate_requires_native_preflight','topology_preserved':True,'protected_physical_wall_axis_and_solid_nodes_unchanged':True,'inlet_cap_mesh_change':'Near-wall inlet nodes reparameterized onto the SAME original CAD NURBS inlet curve; discrete chord approximation changes and must be measured.','changed_nodes':int(np.sum(np.any(p!=coords,axis=1))),'old_first_layer_um':1.,'requested_first_layer_um':.1,'layers':20,'old_growth':1.2,'new_growth':growth,'outer_layer_envelope_preserved_m':H,'limitation':'Only CFD mesh coordinates changed; CAD mesh partitions and Workbench mesh database remain separate. Boundary inlet/outlet straight-line discretization may move along the same physical line. Validate native mesh and actual wall spacing before use.'}
(root/'grs_redistribution_candidate.json').write_text(json.dumps(out,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),encoding='utf-8');print(json.dumps(out,indent=2))

Папка этапа: `{run}`. Журнал решателя: `{cfg['solver_journal']}`. Proof: `{cfg['mesh_proof']}`. Ранее control density и native hanging-node adaptation сохранены как несошедшиеся попытки. Первая адаптация привела к temperature clipping, остановлена; изменять физические выводы по этим полям нельзя.

Критерии: невязки ≤1e-4, energy≤1e-8; балансы массы обоих каналов ≤0,1%; стабильность расходов и полных температур на окне 200 итераций; y+≤1. Абсолютный энергетический дисбаланс глобально и в каждом канале/стенке ≤0,1 Вт на всём окне, три последовательные проверки. Первый порядок всегда запрещён к окончательной приёмке.

Workbench CAD: 21 параметр размера проверен, `GEO_first_layer_height` восстановлен 0,0001 мм после диагностической проверки 1 мкм. Mesh database Workbench и текущая перераспределённая CFD-сетка — разные представления. В диагностической системе SYS (GRS_Mesh_Recovery) настройка Sizing/числа делений/BiasType/BiasFactor прошла без аварии при отказе от массового чтения Properties. Настроены 7 участков СВЗ: 70 радиальных делений с bias factor 100 к наружному краю, осевые размеры около 0,5 мм, 20 явных CAD слоёв по одной ячейке. ДЗВ inflation h1=0,1 мкм/20 слоёв/growth1,2. Запущена новая генерация native mesh; состояние см. `grs_mesh_recovery_generate.json`. Предыдущие native аварии остаются недиагностированными до конца, предполагаемое проблемное чтение Properties больше не вызывается. Исходные базы и экспорты сохранены.

Энергоразделение на разрешённой сетке пока не подтверждено. Подробности всех попыток: [Журнал_работ.md](Журнал_работ.md). Литература: [Энергоразделение_источники_и_проверки.md](Энергоразделение_источники_и_проверки.md); статьи с Рудником Р.С. не использованы.

"""Watch a native Fluent GUI journal; request a saved stop after verified convergence."""
from pathlib import Path
import json, sys, time
from datetime import datetime
from grs_monitor import parse, evaluate

root = Path(r'F:\Leontiev_Project')
cfg = json.loads((root/'grs_active_run.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
run = Path(cfg['run_dir'])
stage = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv)>1 else cfg['solver_stage']
transcript = run/(stage+'.trn')
stop = run/(stage+'_stop.flag')
started = time.monotonic()
last_iteration = -1
consecutive = cfg['convergence']['required_consecutive_checks']
while time.monotonic()-started < 7200:
    if transcript.exists():
        try:
            native_text = transcript.read_text(encoding='utf-8',errors='replace')
            # Persistent clipping is a failed numerical attempt, never an energy-separation result.
            recent=native_text.rsplit('GRS_SAMPLE_END',1)[-1]
            if recent.count('temperature limited to')>=3 and not stop.exists():
                stop.write_text('Persistent native temperature clipping: save state and stop failed numerical attempt.\n',encoding='utf-8')
                print('Temperature clipping detected; requested native saved stop.',flush=True)
                break
            samples = parse(native_text)
            if samples and samples[-1]['iteration'] != last_iteration:
                last_iteration = samples[-1]['iteration']
                result = evaluate(samples,cfg['convergence'],cfg['yplus_maximum'])
                result['accepted'] = bool(result['accepted'] and len(samples)>=consecutive and all(
                    evaluate(samples[:len(samples)-i],cfg['convergence'],cfg['yplus_maximum'])['accepted']
                    for i in range(consecutive)))
                result['numerical_checks_passed']=result['accepted']
                if cfg.get('warmup_only',False):
                    result['accepted']=False
                    result['qualification_note']='First-order warmup only; restore second-order and verify before accepting physical results'
                if cfg.get('numerical_stage_only',False):
                    result['accepted']=False
                    result['qualification_note']=cfg['acceptance_block_reason']
                result['required_consecutive_checks'] = consecutive
                result['samples'] = len(samples)
                result['source_transcript'] = str(transcript)
                result['timestamp'] = datetime.now().isoformat()
                (run/(stage+'_live_validation.json')).write_text(json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
                last = samples[-1]
                print(json.dumps({'iteration':last_iteration,'accepted':result['accepted'],
                    'continuity':last['residual_continuity'],'yplus_svz':last['yplus_max_svz'],
                    'yplus_dzv':last['yplus_max_dzv'],'T0out_svz_K':last['outlet_total_temp_svz'],
                    'T0out_dzv_K':last['outlet_total_temp_dzv']},ensure_ascii=False),flush=True)
                if result['accepted']:
                    stop.write_text('Verified convergence: request native journal to save case/data and stop.\n',encoding='utf-8')
                    print('Verified convergence; native stop flag written.',flush=True)
                    break
                if (cfg.get('warmup_only',False) or cfg.get('numerical_stage_only',False)) and result['numerical_checks_passed']:
                    stop.write_text('First-order warmup numerically converged; save state for second-order verification. Final acceptance false.\n',encoding='utf-8')
                    print('Warmup checks passed; save for second-order continuation, not final acceptance.',flush=True)
                    break
                if last_iteration>=cfg['convergence']['max_iterations']:
                    print('Iteration limit reached without verified acceptance.',flush=True)
                    break
            if native_text.rstrip().endswith('/file/stop-transcript'):
                print('Native journal finished and saved; inspect final validation. No false acceptance.',flush=True)
                break
            if stop.exists():
                print('External stop requested; native journal will save the current state.',flush=True)
                break
        except (ValueError,KeyError,AttributeError) as exc:
            # A partially flushed report is retried, never counted as convergence.
            print('Incomplete report, retry: '+str(exc),flush=True)
    time.sleep(10)
else:
    stop.write_text('Watcher time limit reached; save current state. Acceptance not confirmed.\n',encoding='utf-8')
    raise SystemExit('Watcher timeout; acceptance not confirmed.')

from pathlib import Path
import sys,json,re,shutil

import h5py
from summarize_cases import expr
root=Path(r'F:\Leontiev_Project')
out=Path(r'C:\Users\RomanR\Documents\Codex\2026-10-04\new-chat\outputs')
before=root/'g_08_1_files/dp6/FFF-1/Fluent/SYS-1.3-17.cas.h5'
after=root/'fluent_transfer_baseline.cas.h5'
keys=['case-config','kw-sst-on?','keprt','wallprt','operating-pressure','flow/scheme','mom/scheme','temperature/scheme','k/scheme','omega/scheme','materials','residuals/settings','monitor/convergencesets']
def load(path):
    with h5py.File(path,'r') as f:
        rp=f['settings/Rampant Variables'][0].decode(errors='replace')
        tv=f['settings/Thread Variables'][0].decode(errors='replace')
        mesh=f['meshes/1']
        n=int(max(mesh['cells/zoneTopology/maxId'][()]))
        z=[]
        for kind in ('cells','faces'):
            topo=mesh[kind+'/zoneTopology']
            names=topo['name'][0].decode().split(';')
            z.extend({'name':name,'id':int(i),'kind':kind,'count':int(hi-lo+1)} for name,i,lo,hi in zip(names,topo['id'][()],topo['minId'][()],topo['maxId'][()]))
    (root/(path.stem+'_rp.txt')).write_text(rp,encoding='utf-8')
    (root/(path.stem+'_threads.txt')).write_text(tv,encoding='utf-8')
    return {'cell_count':n,'settings':{k:expr(rp,k) for k in keys},'zones':z,'thread_variables':tv,'rp':rp}
b=load(before);a=load(after)
checks={k:{'equal':b['settings'][k]==a['settings'][k],'before':b['settings'][k],'after':a['settings'][k]} for k in keys}
r={'source':str(before),'candidate':str(after),'cell_count':a['cell_count'],'global_checks':checks,'zones':a['zones'],'iterations_run':0,'accepted_for_cfd':False,'note':'Candidate only: boundaries, thermal coupling, reports and parameters require semantic validation.'}

shutil.copy2(root/'fluent_transfer_comparison.json',out/'fluent_transfer_comparison.json')
print(json.dumps({'cell_count':r['cell_count'],'global_checks':{k:v['equal'] for k,v in checks.items()},'zones':r['zones']},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))

FILE: development_scripts/inspect_projects.py

import ast
import json
import re
from pathlib import Path
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

def data(obj):
    s = obj.findtext('member-data') or '{}'
    s = re.sub(r'(?<![\"\'])\$\$[\w-]+', lambda m: repr(m.group()), s)
    s = re.sub(r'<[^<>]+>', lambda m: repr(m.group()), s)
    try:
        return ast.literal_eval(s)
    except Exception:
        return {'RAW': s}

def read_project(path):
    root = ET.parse(path)
    objs = root.findall('.//Container[@Name="Parameters"]/Object')
    params = {o.get('Name').split(':')[-1]: data(o) for o in objs if '/Parameter:' in o.get('Name','')}
    refs = {}
    for el in root.findall('.//ReferenceList'):
        try:
            refs.update(json.loads(el.text))
        except Exception:
            pass
    guids = {'$$'+k: v.split(':')[-1] for k,v in refs.items() if '/Parameters/Parameter:' in v}
    points = []
    for obj in objs:
        if '/DesignPoint:' not in obj.get('Name',''):
            continue
        d = data(obj)
        values = {guids.get(k,k): v.get('value') if isinstance(v,dict) else v for k,v in d.get('CurrentValues',{}).items()}
        points.append({'id': obj.get('Name').split(':')[-1], 'values': values, 'inputs': {guids.get(k,k):v for k,v in d.get('Parameters',{}).items()}, 'solved': d.get('HasBeenSolved'), 'up_to_date':d.get('IsUpToDate'), 'errors':d.get('ErrorsOnLastUpdate')})
    return {'path':str(path),'version':root.findtext('./Project/external-version-string'), 'base_dp':root.findtext('./Project/base-designpoint-name'),'data_exists':path.with_name(path.stem+'_files').exists(),'parameters':params,'points':points}

if __name__ == '__main__':
    files = sorted(list(Path('F:/').glob('*.wbpj'))+list(Path('F:/latun').glob('*.wbpj')))
    projects = []
    candidates = []
    for path in files:
        try:
            project = read_project(path)
            projects.append(project)
            for dp in project['points']:
                names={project['parameters'].get(k,{}).get('DisplayText',k):v for k,v in dp['values'].items()}
                def num(n):
                    try: return float(names.get(n,'nan').split()[0])
                    except: return float('nan')
                if abs(num('outlet_total_temp_svz-op')-303.48)<0.2 and abs(num('outlet_total_temp_dzv-op')-293.48)<0.2:
                    candidates.append({'project':str(path),'dp':dp['id'],'values':names,'solved':dp['solved'],'up_to_date':dp['up_to_date']})
        except Exception as e:
            print('ERROR',path,str(e))
    out = Path(__file__).parent
    (out/'projects_inventory.json').write_text(json.dumps(projects,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
    (out/'reference_candidates.json').write_text(json.dumps(candidates,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
    print('PROJECTS',len(projects),'POINTS',sum(len(p['points']) for p in projects),'WITH_DATA',sum(p['data_exists'] for p in projects))
    print('VERSIONS',sorted(set(str(p['version']) for p in projects)))
    print('CANDIDATES',json.dumps(candidates,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))

from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,re,shutil
root=Path(r'F:\Leontiev_Project');out=Path(r'C:\Users\RomanR\Documents\Codex\2026-10-04\new-chat\outputs')
case=root/'fluent_grs_h01um_prepared.cas.h5'
comparison=json.loads((root/(case.stem+'_comparison.json')).read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
smooth=json.loads((root/'mesh_grs_h01um_smoothing_validation.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
quality=json.loads((root/'mesh_grs_h01um_series_quality.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
row=json.loads((root/'last_mesh_row.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
text=(root/'prepare_fluent_grs_h01um.trn').read_text(encoding='utf-8',errors='replace')
minq=float(re.search(r'Minimum Orthogonal Quality\s*=\s*([\d.eE+-]+)',text).group(1))
maxar=float(re.search(r'Maximum Aspect Ratio\s*=\s*([\d.eE+-]+)',text).group(1))
assert comparison['preservation_checks_passed'] and smooth['passed']
assert quality['exported'] and quality['structure']['passed'] and quality['layers']['passed'] and quality['wall_layers']['passed']
assert minq>=.01 and not re.search(r'(?m)^ERROR:|^Error:',text)
assert re.search(r'Checking mesh\.+\s*Done\.',text)
result={'passed':True,'prepared_case':str(case),'prepared_case_sha256':hashlib.sha256(case.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'mesh_mode':row['mesh_mode'],'geometry_mm':{key[4:]+'_mm':value for key,value in row['geometry_mm'].items() if key!='GEO_first_layer_height'},'first_layer_height_um':float(quality['first_layer_height_um']),'cell_count':comparison['cell_count'],'minimum_orthogonal_quality':minq,'maximum_aspect_ratio':maxar,'protected_native_improvement_validation':str(root/'mesh_grs_h01um_smoothing_validation.json'),'mesh_quality_validation':str(root/'mesh_grs_h01um_series_quality.json'),'settings_validation':str(root/(case.stem+'_comparison.json')),'minimum_orthogonal_quality_acceptance':.01,'grid_independence_verified':False,'yplus_verified':False}
for directory in (root,out):(directory/'fluent_grs_mesh_provenance.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
for name in ('mesh_grs_h01um_smoothing_validation.json','first_layer_native_publish.json'):
    shutil.copy2(root/name,out/name)
print(json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))

from pathlib import Path
import shutil
workspace=Path(r'C:\Users\RomanR\Documents\Codex\2026-10-04\new-chat')
folder=Path(r'F:\Leontiev_Project')
for source,name in [('mesh_repair.py','mesh_scope.py'),('mesh_generate.py','mesh_generate.py'),('mesh_quality.py','mesh_quality.py')]:
    shutil.copy2(workspace/'work'/source,folder/name)
script='''# Open F:\\Leontiev_Project\\g_08_1.wbpj in Workbench 2024 R2 first.
# Builds geometry and mesh for ONE selected CSV row. No Fluent solve.
TABLE_PATH = r'F:\\Leontiev_Project\\geometry_inputs.csv'
ROW_INDEX = 0
ROOT = r'F:\\Leontiev_Project'
import csv,math,json,time
def stage(name):
    with open(ROOT+r'\\mesh_workflow_progress.json','w') as f:
        json.dump({'row':ROW_INDEX,'stage':name,'time':time.time()},f)
stage('reading_table')
with open(TABLE_PATH,'rb') as f:
    reader=csv.DictReader(f)
    reader.fieldnames=[s.lstrip('\\xef\\xbb\\xbf') for s in reader.fieldnames]
    rows=list(reader)
row=rows[ROW_INDEX]
parameters=dict((str(p.DisplayText),p) for p in Parameters.GetAllParameters())
values={}
for key,value in row.items():
    if key=='case_id':continue
    name='GEO_'+key[:-3] if key.endswith('_mm') else None
    if name not in parameters:raise ValueError('Unknown geometry column: '+key)
    number=float(value)
    if math.isnan(number) or math.isinf(number):raise ValueError('Non-finite dimension '+key)
    values[name]=number
if set(values)!=set(n for n in parameters if n.startswith('GEO_')):
    raise ValueError('CSV must contain every geometry parameter')
system1=GetSystem(Name='SYS 1')
dp=Parameters.GetBaseDesignPoint()

stage('closing_mesh_before_geometry')

stage('mesh_refresh')
system1.GetComponent(Name='Mesh').Refresh()
mesh.Edit()
mesh.SendCommand(Language='Python',Command="execfile(r'"+ROOT+r"\\mesh_scope.py')")
scope=json.load(open(ROOT+r'\\mesh_repair.json'))
if scope.get('error'):raise RuntimeError(scope['error'])
stage('mesh_generation')
mesh.SendCommand(Language='Python',Command="MESH_RESULT_PATH=r'"+ROOT+r"\\mesh_current_generated.json'; execfile(r'"+ROOT+r"\\mesh_generate.py')")
generated=json.load(open(ROOT+r'\\mesh_current_generated.json'))
if generated.get('error') or not generated.get('generated'):
    raise RuntimeError(generated.get('error','Mesh generation not confirmed'))
if int(generated.get('Elements','0'))<=0:raise RuntimeError('Mesh has no elements')
stage('quality_and_export')
mesh.SendCommand(Language='Python',Command="MESH_QUALITY_PATH=r'"+ROOT+r"\\mesh_current_quality.json'; MESH_EXPORT_PATH=r'"+ROOT+r"\\mesh_current.msh'; execfile(r'"+ROOT+r"\\mesh_quality.py')")
quality=json.load(open(ROOT+r'\\mesh_current_quality.json'))
if not quality.get('exported'):raise RuntimeError(quality.get('export_error','Mesh export not confirmed'))
stage('saving_mesh')
mesh.Exit(SaveDatabase=True)
system1.GetComponent(Name='Mesh').Update(AllDependencies=True)
Save()
with open(ROOT+r'\\last_mesh_row.json','w') as f:
    json.dump({'case_id':row['case_id'],'row_index':ROW_INDEX,'geometry_mm':values,'mesh':generated},f,indent=2)
stage('complete')
print('Geometry and mesh saved for row '+str(ROW_INDEX)+': '+row['case_id'])

import json,traceback,math
from Ansys.ACT.Interfaces.Common import SelectionTypeEnum
from Ansys.Mechanical.DataModel.Enums import SizingType,SizingBehavior,MethodType
r={}
try:
    model=ExtAPI.DataModel.Project.Model
    ns={str(n.Name):n for n in model.NamedSelections.Children if list(n.Location.Ids)}
    sections=('convergent','nozzle','heat','exit_contraction','exit_rounding','exit_recovery','exit_tail')
    for name,n in ns.items():
        if name.startswith('MESH_'):n.SendToSolver=False
    mode=globals().get('MESH_MODE','series')
    h={'series':0.00075,'control':0.00025}[mode]
    radial_count=int(math.ceil(max(ExtAPI.DataModel.GeoData.GeoEntityById(i).Length for section in sections for i in ns['MESH_'+section+'_core_radial_edges'].Location.Ids)/h))
    gas=[b for a in ExtAPI.DataModel.GeoData.Assemblies for p in a.Parts for b in p.Bodies if str(b.Name).split('\\')[-1]=='air_svz'][0]
    old=[o for o in model.Mesh.Children if str(o.GetType()).endswith('.AutomaticMethod')]
    method=old[0] if old else model.Mesh.AddAutomaticMethod()
    for duplicate in old[1:]:duplicate.Suppressed=True
    method.Method=MethodType.Automatic
    method.Name='Core_quadrilateral_method'
    method.Suppressed=False
    info=ExtAPI.SelectionManager.CreateSelectionInfo(SelectionTypeEnum.GeometryEntities)
    info.Ids=[gas.Id];method.Location=info
    infl=[o for o in model.Mesh.Children if str(o.Name)=='Inflation_air_svz'][0]
    infl.Suppressed=True
    for o in model.Mesh.Children:
        if str(o.Name)=='Short_sections_refinement':o.Suppressed=True
    faces=[o for o in model.Mesh.Children if str(o.GetType()).endswith('.FaceMeshing')]
    fm=faces[0] if faces else model.Mesh.AddFaceMeshing()
    fm.Name='Structured_core'
    fm.Location=ns['MESH_core_structured'].Location
    fm.Suppressed=False;fm.MappedMesh=True;fm.ConstrainBoundary=True
    for section in sections:
        fs=[ExtAPI.DataModel.GeoData.GeoEntityById(i) for i in ns['MESH_'+section].Location.Ids]
        if len(fs)!=21 or any(len(f.Edges)!=4 for f in fs):raise ValueError('Invalid structured section '+section)
    controls=[]
    for section in sections:
        axial_count=int(math.ceil(max(ExtAPI.DataModel.GeoData.GeoEntityById(i).Length for i in ns['MESH_'+section+'_axial_edges'].Location.Ids)/h))
        prefix='Nozzle_' if section=='nozzle' else 'Nozzle_'+section+'_'
        for suffix,group,count in (('axial','MESH_'+section+'_axial_edges',axial_count),('layers','MESH_'+section+'_layer_edges',1),('core_radial' if section=='nozzle' else 'radial','MESH_'+section+'_core_radial_edges',radial_count)):
            name=prefix+suffix
            old=[o for o in model.Mesh.Children if str(o.Name)==name]
            o=old[0] if old else model.Mesh.AddSizing()
            o.Name=name;o.NamedSelection=ns[group]
            o.Type=SizingType.NumberOfDivisions;o.NumberOfDivisions=count
            o.Behavior=SizingBehavior.Hard;o.Suppressed=False
            controls.append({'name':name,'count':count,'ids':list(ns[group].Location.Ids)})
    r['controls']=controls;r['configured']=True
except:r['error']=traceback.format_exc()
with open(r'F:\Leontiev_Project\nozzle_setup.json','w') as f:json.dump(r,f,indent=2)

FILE: development_scripts/mesh_cell_audit.py

import json,math,traceback
r={'faces':[],'walls':[]}
try:
    model=ExtAPI.DataModel.Project.Model
    md=ExtAPI.DataModel.MeshDataByName('Global')
    names={str(n.Name):n for n in model.NamedSelections.Children if list(n.Location.Ids)}
    for name in ('MESH_walls_svz','MESH_walls_dzv'):
        for gid in names[name].Location.Ids:
            e=ExtAPI.DataModel.GeoData.GeoEntityById(gid)
            r['walls'].append({'id':gid,'vertices':[(v.X,v.Y) for v in e.Vertices],'length':e.Length,'members':dir(e),'curve_type':str(e.CurveType),'signatures':[str(m) for m in e.GetType().GetMethods() if str(m.Name) in ('ParamAtPoint','PointAtParam','PointsAtParams')]})
    for a in ExtAPI.DataModel.GeoData.Assemblies:
        for p in a.Parts:
            for b in p.Bodies:
                for f in b.Faces:
                    out={'body':str(b.Name),'face':f.Id,'count':0,'concave_count':0,'tiny_count':0,'examples':[]}
                    for eid in md.MeshRegionById(f.Id).ElementIds:
                        elem=md.ElementById(eid)
                        if str(elem.Type)!='kQuad4':continue
                        ns=[md.NodeById(nid) for nid in elem.NodeIds]
                        xy=[(n.X,n.Y) for n in ns]
                        cross=[]
                        for i in range(4):
                            v=xy[i];u=xy[(i+1)%4];w=xy[(i+2)%4]
                            cross.append((u[0]-v[0])*(w[1]-u[1])-(u[1]-v[1])*(w[0]-u[0]))
                        concave=min(cross)<0<max(cross)
                        tiny=min(abs(x) for x in cross)<1e-18
                        out['count']+=1
                        if concave:out['concave_count']+=1
                        if tiny:out['tiny_count']+=1
                        if (concave or tiny) and len(out['examples'])<4:out['examples'].append({'eid':eid,'xy':xy,'cross':cross})
                    r['faces'].append(out)
except:r['error']=traceback.format_exc()
with open(r'F:\Leontiev_Project\mesh_cell_audit.json','w') as f:json.dump(r,f,indent=2)
