# Python Script, API Version = V242
import json,traceback,clr
from System.Reflection import BindingFlags
from System import Array,Object
r={'groups':[]}
try:
    for assembly in ('SpaceClaim','Stored Selection','ScriptingContextContracts'):clr.AddReference(assembly)
    from SpaceClaim import NamedScriptGroupProxyDef
    flags=BindingFlags.Public|BindingFlags.NonPublic|BindingFlags.Instance
    doc=GetRootPart().Document
    inner=doc.GetType().GetField('innerWrapper',flags).GetValue(doc)
    native=inner.GetType().GetProperty('Subject',flags).GetValue(inner,None)
    context=native.GetType().GetProperty('Context',flags).GetValue(native,None)
    code='#V242\n'+open(r'F:\Leontiev_Project\geometry_script.py').read()
    definitions=[d for d in native.Definitions if d.GetType().FullName=='SpaceClaim.ScriptExecutionProxyDef']
    for d in definitions:
        proxy=d.GetEvaluation(context)
        proxy.Script=code
        sg=proxy.ScriptGroup
        item={'id':str(d.Id),'group_type':str(sg.GetType()),'before_length':len(sg.Code)}
        sg.ScriptEnvironment.SetApi(242)
        sg.Code=code
        sg.GetType().GetProperty('Latest',flags).SetValue(sg,code,None)
        sg.ScriptEnvironment.GetType().GetMethod('UpdateCode',flags).Invoke(sg.ScriptEnvironment,Array[Object]([code]))
        item['save_result']=str(sg.Save(False))
        proxy.Script=sg.Code
        item['after_length']=len(sg.Code);item['contains_grid']='MESH_core_structured' in sg.Code
        r['groups'].append(item)
    if not r['groups'] or not all(g['contains_grid'] for g in r['groups']):raise ValueError('Published geometry code not updated')
    DocumentSave.Execute(r'F:\Leontiev_Project\g_08_1_files\dp6\SYS-1\DM\SYS-1.scdoc')
    r['saved']=True
except:r['error']=traceback.format_exc()
with open(r'F:\Leontiev_Project\script_persistence_live.json','w') as f:json.dump(r,f,indent=2)

import sys, json, re
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path(__file__).parent/'python_packages'))
import h5py, numpy as np

def expr(text,key):
    match=re.search(r'^\('+re.escape(key)+r'(?=\s|\))',text,re.M)
    if not match: return None
    start=match.start(); depth=0; string=False; esc=False
    for i in range(start,len(text)):
        c=text[i]
        if esc: esc=False; continue
        if c=='\\' and string: esc=True; continue
        if c=='"': string=not string
        if not string:
            if c=='(': depth+=1
            if c==')':
                depth-=1
                if depth==0: return text[start:i+1]

def summary(path):
    with h5py.File(path,'r') as f:
        rp=f['settings/Rampant Variables'][0].decode(errors='replace')
        tv=f['settings/Thread Variables'][0].decode(errors='replace')
        out={'case':str(path),'version':f['settings/Version'][0].decode(),'settings':{}}
        keys=['case-config','kw-sst-on?','keprt','wallprt','operating-pressure','flow/scheme','mom/scheme','temperature/scheme','k/scheme','omega/scheme','materials','residuals/settings','monitor/convergencesets','number-of-iterations']
        for key in keys:
            value=expr(rp,key)
            if value: out['settings'][key]=value
        out['interesting_lines']=[l for l in rp.splitlines() if any(q in l.lower() for q in ['prandtl','residual','sst','material','molecular-weight','conductivity','monitor/convergence']) and len(l)<2000]
        out['thread_boundaries']=[]
        for l in tv.splitlines():
            if len(l)<350 and any(q in l for q in ['pressure-inlet','pressure-outlet','mass-flow-inlet','fluid ','solid ','material .','p0 ','p ','t0 ','temperature ','mass-flow ','thermal-bc','q-dot','heat-flux']):
                out['thread_boundaries'].append(l)
        mesh=f['meshes/1']; coords=np.concatenate([d[()] for d in mesh['nodes/coords'].values()])
        faces=mesh['faces/zoneTopology']; names=faces['name'][0].decode().split(';')
        connectivity=np.concatenate([g['nodes'][()].reshape(-1,2) for g in mesh['faces/nodes'].values()])
        zones={}
        for name,lo,hi,zid in zip(names,faces['minId'][()],faces['maxId'][()],faces['id'][()]):
            if name.startswith('interior'): continue
            pts=coords[np.unique(connectivity[int(lo)-1:int(hi)])-1]
            if len(pts)==0: continue
            zones[name]={'id':int(zid),'min_m':pts.min(axis=0).tolist(),'max_m':pts.max(axis=0).tolist(),'node_at_min_radius_m':pts[pts[:,1].argmin()].tolist()}
        out['boundary_geometry']=zones
        out['cell_count']=int(max(mesh['cells/zoneTopology/maxId'][()]))
        out['matched_data_files']=[]
        for dat in path.parent.glob(path.name.removesuffix('.cas.h5')+'-*.dat.h5'):
            with h5py.File(dat,'r') as df:
                entry={'data':str(dat)}
                if 'Case File' in df['settings']:
                    entry['case_reference']=df['settings/Case File'][0].decode(errors='replace')
                yp=df.get('results/1/phase-1/faces/SV_WALL_YPLUS')
                if yp is not None:
                    entry['saved_max_wall_yplus']=max(float(np.nanmax(d[()])) for d in yp.values() if d.size)
                out['matched_data_files'].append(entry)
        return out

if __name__=='__main__':
    base=Path(__file__).parent
    projects=json.loads((base/'projects_inventory.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
    summaries=[]
    for project in projects:
        p=Path(project['path']); folder=p.with_name(p.stem+'_files')/('dp'+str(project['base_dp']))
        files=list(folder.glob('*/Fluent/*.cas.h5'))
        files=[p for p in files if 'Setup-Output' not in p.name] or files
        if not files: continue
        path=max(files,key=lambda p:p.stat().st_mtime)
        try:
            d=summary(path); d['project']=project['path']; d['dp']=project['base_dp']; summaries.append(d)
            w=d['boundary_geometry'].get('wall_outer-air_svz-wall_abonite',{})
            print(p.name,'DP'+str(project['base_dp']),'cells',d['cell_count'],'throat',w.get('node_at_min_radius_m'))
        except Exception as e: print('ERROR',path,str(e))
    (base/'case_summaries.json').write_text(json.dumps(summaries,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
    print('TOTAL',len(summaries))

Для каждой операции проверяется уникальный run_token; неполная/просроченная сетка и непройденные проверки запрещают экспорт.

Принятый экспорт первой базы: mesh_all_series.msh. mesh_current.msh соответствует последней успешно проверенной строке; во время испытаний таблицы рабочая геометрия может временно отличаться от этого файла. Исторические mesh_series.msh, mesh_control.msh и mesh_restored.msh относятся к более ранней топологии; использовать новые mesh_validated_* после завершения испытаний.

Текущая проверка CSV: изменённый вариант (горло 2,4 мм, теплообменный участок 700 мм, входная толщина стенки 12 мм), контрольная база 0,25 мм, восстановление серийной базы. Итог записывается в final_mesh_validation.json. Первоначальный запуск изменённой строки остановлен из-за дополнительных автоматических контактов; сценарий исправлен, повторная проверка продолжается.

Доказательства: geometry_all_layers_probe.json; all_layers_install.json; all_layers_workbench_install.json; mesh_all_series_generated.json; mesh_all_series_structure.json; mesh_all_series_nozzle_check.json; mesh_all_series_wall_layers.json; mesh_all_series_quality.json; mesh_all_series_checks.json; fluent_all_series_check.trn/json. Вся история и неудачные эксперименты записаны в Журнал_работ.md.
'''
next_steps='''# Следующие этапы

1. Завершить испытание CSV с изменением геометрии, режимом control 0,25 мм и возвратом к серийной базе 0,75 мм. Проверить новые экспорты Fluent; сохранить итоговые отчёты и проект.
2. Перенести новую сетку в исходную постановку Fluent и проверить типы зон, граничные условия, тепловые сопряжения и прежние выходы P1–P17. Сам mesh-файл имеет начальные inlet types и не заменяет сохранённый case.
3. Для контрольного расчёта согласовать выявленные ранее расхождения: фактически air с M=28,966 вместо methane M=16,04; λ стенки 234 вместо 109/0,16; Prt 0,85 вместо 0,75; исходная стенка переменной толщины 11,193→4,493 мм вместо 2 мм. 4. Уточнить отсутствующие численные допуски стабилизации выходных отчётов и баланса массы. Сохранённый DP7 имеет расход дозвукового входа 0,02 кг/с, поэтому он не совпадает с проверочным режимом 0,05 кг/с и 303,48/293,48 К из задания.
5. Реализовать автоматический Fluent-расчёт, проверку y+ и сгущение слоёв, обработку неудачных строк/повторного запуска, общую таблицу и изображения. Нового расчёта и проверки эталонных температур пока нет.
'''

Рабочая папка содержит проект, CAD, сценарии, таблицы и протоколы. История: Журнал_работ.md.

import sys,json

import h5py,numpy as np

with h5py.File(p) as f:
 m=f['meshes/1'];c=np.concatenate([d[()] for d in m['nodes/coords'].values()]);z=m['faces/zoneTopology'];n=int(max(z['maxId'][()]));e=np.zeros((n,2),int)
 for g in m['faces/nodes'].values():
  nn=g['nnodes'][()];e[int(g.attrs['minId'][0])-1+np.flatnonzero(nn==2)]=g['nodes'][()].reshape(-1,2)
 for name,lo,hi in zip(z['name'][0].decode().split(';'),z['minId'][()],z['maxId'][()]):
  if name in ('wall-air_svz','wall-air_svz.1','wall_outer-air_svz','inlet_svz'):
   q=c[np.unique(e[int(lo)-1:int(hi)])-1];print(name, 'bounds',q.min(0),q.max(0),'firstlast',q[0],q[-1])

import json,traceback,shutil,time
ROOT=r'F:\Leontiev_Project'
r={'started':time.time(),'runs':[]}
before=[(str(p.Name),str(p.DisplayText),str(p.Expression)) for p in Parameters.GetAllParameters() if int(str(p.Name)[1:])<=17]
with open(ROOT+r'\apply_geometry_and_mesh_row.wbjn') as f:source=f.read()
try:
    for index,label in ((2,'changed_series'),(1,'baseline_control'),(0,'baseline_series')):
        run={'row':index,'label':label}
        try:
            exec(source.replace('ROW_INDEX = 0','ROW_INDEX = '+str(index)),globals())
            for name in ('mesh_current_generated.json','mesh_current_quality.json','mesh_current_wall_layers.json','mesh_current_structure.json','mesh_current_nozzle_check.json','last_mesh_row.json'):
                shutil.copy2(ROOT+'\\'+name,ROOT+'\\validated_'+label+'_'+name)
            shutil.copy2(ROOT+r'\mesh_current.msh',ROOT+'\\mesh_validated_'+label+'.msh')
            with open(ROOT+r'\mesh_current_generated.json') as f:run['mesh']=json.load(f)
            run['passed']=True
        except:run['error']=traceback.format_exc();run['passed']=False
        r['runs'].append(run)
        with open(ROOT+r'\final_mesh_validation.json','w') as f:json.dump(r,f,indent=2)
        if not run['passed'] and index==0:raise ValueError('Baseline restore failed')
    after=[(str(p.Name),str(p.DisplayText),str(p.Expression)) for p in Parameters.GetAllParameters() if int(str(p.Name)[1:])<=17]
    r['original_parameters_preserved']=before==after
    r['passed']=all(x.get('passed') for x in r['runs']) and r['original_parameters_preserved']
except:r['error']=traceback.format_exc()
with open(ROOT+r'\final_mesh_validation.json','w') as f:json.dump(r,f,indent=2)
print('Final geometry/mesh validation: '+str(r.get('passed',False)))

import json,traceback
root=r'C:\Users\RomanR\Documents\Codex\2026-10-04\new-chat'
r={}
system1=GetSystem(Name='SYS 1')
geo=system1.GetContainer(ComponentName='Geometry')
component=system1.GetComponent(Name='Geometry')
dp=Parameters.GetBaseDesignPoint()
changes={'GEO_r_throat':'2.4 [mm]','GEO_l_heat_exchange':'700 [mm]','GEO_wall_thickness_inlet':'12 [mm]'}
original={}
try:
    for p in Parameters.GetAllParameters():
        if p.DisplayText in changes:
            original[p.Name]=p.Expression
            dp.SetParameterExpression(Parameter=p,Expression=changes[p.DisplayText])
    r['changed_parameters']=changes
    component.Update(AllDependencies=True)
    geo.Edit(IsSpaceClaimGeometry=True)
    geo.RunScript(ScriptFile=root+r'\work\sc_geometry_stats.py')
    geo.Exit()
    r['changed']=json.load(open(root+r'\work\current_geometry_stats.json'))
except:r['error']=traceback.format_exc()
finally:
    try:
        for name,expr in original.items():dp.SetParameterExpression(Parameter=Parameters.GetParameter(Name=name),Expression=expr)
        component.Update(AllDependencies=True)
        geo.Edit(IsSpaceClaimGeometry=True)
        geo.RunScript(ScriptFile=root+r'\work\sc_geometry_stats.py')
        geo.Exit()
        r['restored']=json.load(open(root+r'\work\current_geometry_stats.json'))
        r['parameters']=[(p.Name,str(p.DisplayText),str(p.Expression)) for p in Parameters.GetAllParameters()]
        Save()
        r['saved_project']=True
    except:r['restore_error']=traceback.format_exc()
with open(root+r'\work\wb_geometry_roundtrip.json','w') as f:json.dump(r,f,indent=2)

import json,traceback,time,os,shutil
ROOT=r'F:\Leontiev_Project'
rp=ROOT+r'\grs_geometry_tolerance_probe.json'
report={'stage':'starting','passed':False,'started':time.time(),'hypothesis':'Very thin explicit CAD layer faces may cause update/reopen crash; compare 1 um CAD partitioning without changing physical tube dimensions'}
def emit(stage):
    report['stage']=stage
    with open(rp,'w') as f:json.dump(report,f,indent=2)
try:
    source=GetSystem(Name='SYS 1');fresh=GetSystem(Name='SYS')
    for sys in (fresh,source):
        try:sys.GetContainer(ComponentName='Mesh').Exit(SaveDatabase=False)
        except:pass
    ps=Parameters.GetAllParameters()
    report['physical_before']=[(p.Name,str(p.DisplayText),str(p.Expression)) for p in ps if str(p.DisplayText).startswith('GEO_') and str(p.DisplayText)!='GEO_first_layer_height']
    layer=[p for p in ps if str(p.DisplayText)=='GEO_first_layer_height']
    if len(layer)!=1:raise RuntimeError('Expected exactly one native first-layer parameter')
    report['layer_before']=str(layer[0].Expression)
    os.makedirs(ROOT+r'\diagnostics') if not os.path.exists(ROOT+r'\diagnostics') else None
    cad=ROOT+r'\g_08_1_files\dp6\SYS-1\DM\SYS-1.scdoc'
    backup=ROOT+r'\diagnostics\geometry_before_1um_tolerance_probe.scdoc'
    if not os.path.exists(backup):shutil.copy2(cad,backup)
    report['cad_checkpoint']=backup
    Parameters.GetBaseDesignPoint().SetParameterExpression(Parameter=layer[0],Expression='0.001 [mm]')
    emit('updating_source_geometry_1um')
    source.GetComponent(Name='Geometry').Update(AllDependencies=True)
    report['physical_after']=[(p.Name,str(p.DisplayText),str(p.Expression)) for p in Parameters.GetAllParameters() if str(p.DisplayText).startswith('GEO_') and str(p.DisplayText)!='GEO_first_layer_height']
    if report['physical_before']!=report['physical_after']:raise RuntimeError('Physical geometry parameters changed unexpectedly')
    report['physical_parameters_preserved']=True
    Save();emit('opening_1um_fresh_mesh')
    fresh.GetComponent(Name='Geometry').Update(AllDependencies=True)
    fresh.GetComponent(Name='Mesh').Refresh()
    mesh=fresh.GetContainer(ComponentName='Mesh');mesh.Edit()
    emit('probing_1um_native_geometry')
    mesh.SendCommand(Language='Python',Command="import json;data={'named_selections':[str(n.Name) for n in ExtAPI.DataModel.Project.Model.NamedSelections.Children]};f=open(r'F:\\Leontiev_Project\\grs_1um_mesh_native_state.json','w');json.dump(data,f,indent=2);f.close()")
    report['native_probe_complete']=True
    report['passed']=True;emit('complete')
except:
    report['error']=traceback.format_exc();emit('failed')
report['seconds']=time.time()-report['started'];emit(report['stage'])

import json,time,shutil,traceback
ROOT=r'F:\Leontiev_Project'
s=GetSystem(Name='SYS 1')
m=s.GetContainer(ComponentName='Mesh')
r={'modes':{}}
def progress(stage,mode):
    json.dump({'stage':stage,'mode':mode,'time':time.time()},open(ROOT+r'\mesh_modes_progress.json','w'))
try:
    m.Edit()
    for mode in ('control','series'):
        progress('scoping',mode)
        m.SendCommand(Language='Python',Command="MESH_MODE="+repr(mode)+";execfile(r'"+ROOT+r"\mesh_scope.py')")
        scope=json.load(open(ROOT+r'\mesh_repair.json'))
        if scope.get('error'):raise RuntimeError(scope['error'])
        progress('generating',mode)
        m.SendCommand(Language='Python',Command="MESH_RESULT_PATH=r'"+ROOT+"\\mesh_"+mode+"_generated.json';execfile(r'"+ROOT+r"\mesh_generate.py')")
        gen=json.load(open(ROOT+'\\mesh_'+mode+'_generated.json'))
        if gen.get('error') or not gen.get('generated'):raise RuntimeError(str(gen))
        progress('quality_export',mode)
        m.SendCommand(Language='Python',Command="MESH_QUALITY_PATH=r'"+ROOT+"\\mesh_"+mode+"_quality.json';MESH_EXPORT_PATH=r'"+ROOT+"\\mesh_"+mode+".msh';execfile(r'"+ROOT+r"\mesh_quality.py')")
        quality=json.load(open(ROOT+'\\mesh_'+mode+'_quality.json'))
        if not quality.get('exported'):raise RuntimeError(str(quality))
        r['modes'][mode]={'scope':scope,'mesh':gen,'quality':quality}

    progress('saving','series')
    m.Exit(SaveDatabase=True)
    s.GetComponent(Name='Mesh').Update(AllDependencies=True)
    Save()
    shutil.copy2(ROOT+r'\mesh_series.msh',ROOT+r'\mesh_current.msh')
    r['saved']=True
    progress('complete','series')
except:
    r['error']=traceback.format_exc()
    progress('failed','unknown')
json.dump(r,open(ROOT+r'\mesh_modes_checks.json','w'),indent=2)
print('Mesh mode checks complete: '+str(r.get('saved',False)))

import json,traceback,shutil,time
root=r'F:\Leontiev_Project'
result={'started':time.time()}
source=open(root+r'\apply_geometry_and_mesh_row.wbjn').read()
source=source.replace("TABLE_PATH = r'F:\\Leontiev_Project\\geometry_inputs.csv'", "TABLE_PATH = r'F:\\Leontiev_Project\\mesh_validation_inputs.csv'")
def run_row(index,label):
    code=source.replace('ROW_INDEX = 0','ROW_INDEX = '+str(index))
    exec(compile(code,root+r'\apply_geometry_and_mesh_row.wbjn','exec'),globals())
    data=json.load(open(root+r'\last_mesh_row.json'))
    data['quality']=json.load(open(root+r'\mesh_current_quality.json'))
    shutil.copyfile(root+r'\mesh_current.msh',root+'\\mesh_'+label+'.msh')
    with open(root+'\\mesh_'+label+'_checks.json','w') as f:json.dump(data,f,indent=2)
    return data
try:
    result['changed']=run_row(1,'changed')
except:result['changed_error']=traceback.format_exc()
finally:
    try:
        result['restored']=run_row(0,'restored')
        result['baseline_saved']=True
        result['parameters']=[(p.Name,str(p.DisplayText),str(p.Expression)) for p in Parameters.GetAllParameters()]
    except:result['restore_error']=traceback.format_exc()
result['seconds']=time.time()-result['started']
with open(root+r'\workbench_mesh_checks.json','w') as f:json.dump(result,f,indent=2)
print('Mesh roundtrip: changed='+str('changed' in result)+', restored='+str(result.get('baseline_saved',False)))

from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
import json
from grs_monitor import parse

root=Path(r'F:\Leontiev_Project')
cfg=json.loads((root/'grs_active_run.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
run=Path(cfg['run_dir']); stage=cfg['solver_stage']
tr=run/(stage+'.trn'); raw=tr.read_text(errors='replace')
samples=parse(raw); last=samples[-1] if samples else {}
finished=raw.rstrip().endswith('/file/stop-transcript')
case=run/(stage+'.cas.h5'); data=run/(stage+'.dat.h5')
mesh=json.loads((root/'grs_mesh_recovery_generate.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
status={'captured_at':datetime.now().isoformat(),'stage':stage,'transcript_finished':finished,'case_exists':case.exists(),'data_exists':data.exists(),'last_sample':last,'new_mesh':mesh,'accepted':False}
(root/'Передача_состояние.json').write_text(json.dumps(status,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
text=r'''# Передача работы в новый чат — труба Леонтьева в Ansys

Снимок состояния: __TIME__ (Самара, UTC+4). Прочитай этот файл полностью, затем актуальные файлы состояния. Продолжай существующую работу, не начинай с нуля. Новая сетка успешно построена, но ещё не проверена решателем. Энергоразделение на разрешённой, сходящейся сетке пока НЕ подтверждено.

## Задание и уже выданное разрешение

Пользователь Roman разрешил экспериментировать непосредственно в проекте, без обязательного создания копии на каждый шаг, управлять открытыми Ansys приложениями, менять геометрию и численные настройки по необходимости. Нужно сделать полностью параметрический расчёт всей трубы (не только сопла), подобрать режимы для внедрения в ГРС и добиться физически подтверждённого энергоразделения: из дозвукового канала выходит охлаждённый газ, из сверхзвукового — нагретый. Нельзя выдавать переходные/несошедшиеся поля за эффект.

Оставить воздух, Prt=0,75, существующую стенку. Все давления АБСОЛЮТНЫЕ. Целевые давления присоединения: ДЗВ вход 3,5–7,5 МПа, выход соответственно 3,2–7,2 МПа; СВЗ вход 0,6–1,6 МПа, выход 0,3 МПа. Пользователь разрешил выбрать критерии сходимости самостоятельно. Литературу разрешил искать в интернете, но статьи с соавтором Рудник Р.С. НЕ читать/НЕ использовать.

Сейчас пилот использует ПОЛНЫЕ входные давления p0_СВЗ=1,1 МПа, p0_ДЗВ=5,5 МПа и СТАТИЧЕСКИЕ выходные 0,3 и 5,2 МПа; T0 обоих входов=298,15 K (сохранено из исходного задания). Статические входные давления отдельно контролируются. Их ещё нужно согласовать с целевыми статическими давлениями присоединения к ГРС; нельзя считать p0 автоматически равным статическому входному давлению.

## Краткая история неудачных/непринятых вариантов

- Грубый seed: `runs\grs_pilot_mid\20261005_085310_4f84f74e\pilot_initial.cas.h5/dat.h5`. 84790 cells,87731 nodes,h1=1 мкм. Поток сошёлся (native810, continuity≈6,45e−7), T0_SVZ≈300,338 K, T0_DZV≈298,080 K, но y+≈3,66/6,66 >1. Не принятый пристенный результат; поздний строгий энергоаудит тоже требуется.
- Fine/control: `runs\grs_pilot_mid_control\20261005_113836_78979e7e`:411882 cells,h1=0,1 мкм,bulk0,25 мм. Coupled и density CASM варианты не сошлись, энергодисбаланс доходил до киловатт. Все сохранены; не повторять те же настройки без причины.
- Ранее тонкая сетка ~84808 cells/0,75 мм:энергодисбаланс≈51–52 Вт, охлаждение ДЗВ≈0,004 K меньше неопределённости, отвергнуто.
- Hanging-node adaptation coarseseed:303487 cells, minOrth≈0,0016; CoupledCFL50 вызвал temperature clipping 1/5000 K, остановлен. Дополнительная ДЗВ адаптация459055 cells не решила плохую ортогональность; CFD на ней не запускали. В Ansys2024 2D нет аналогичного 3D anisotropic prismatic refinement.
- Redistributed v1–v3 имели ошибки/3 отрицательные ячейки; никогда не использованы как решение. Рабочий v4→`grs_redistributed_improved.cas.h5/dat.h5`; узлы стенки/solid сохранены; lowQ и небольшое изменение дискретного входа зафиксированы. Protected smoothing менял только внутренние узлы, не физические стенки.
- RedistributedCoupledCFL1firstorder: native1080 continuity0,0458,energy1,24e−5,global≈65,3W, rejected.
- SIMPLE+centroidsfirstorder: сохранён в текущей папке как `simple_centroids_firstorder.cas.h5/dat.h5`; поток улучшился (continuity≈9e−5), энергия≈183,5W не сошлась. Затем текущий второй порядок с более строгим AMG.

## Критерии приёмки — не ослаблять ради видимого эффекта

- Второй порядок, невязки остальных уравнений≤1e−4, energy≤1e−8.
- Окно200 nativeитераций; min500,max5000; отсчётыкаждые10;3последовательные проверки.
- Разброс mass-weighted outlet T0≤0,02K, относительный разброс расхода≤0,001.
- Массовый дисбаланс отдельно каждого канала≤0,001(0,1%); поток по направлению на входах/выходах.
- max y+≤1 на всех4стенках gas.
- |полный энергетический дисбаланс|≤0,1W ГЛОБАЛЬНО и отдельноСВЗ/ДЗВ/solid на ВСЁМ окне. Окончательные эффекты должны превосходить численную неопределённость; нужна сеточная проверка.
- Первому порядку/несходящимся/неквалифицированным сеткам запрещено accepted=true.

Не сравнивать только статические температуры: ускорение само по себе меняет T. Для воздуха сопоставлять mass-weighted полную температуру/энтальпийный поток и согласованный межстеночный теплопоток. При переходе к реальному газу учитывать энтальпию/Joule–Thomson отдельно.

## Проблемы и сложности

1. При тонком h1 плохие ячейки у входа/сопряжений и большие AR; поток и особенно энергия сходились плохо. Новая biased mapped mesh должна проверяться как потенциальное устранение причины, а не гарантированное решение.
2. Сеточная независимость не доказана; грубые поля выглядят как hot/cold, но не являются доказательством эффекта.
3. Native Meshing ранее падал с heap exception ntdll 0xc0000374/0xc0000409. Сейчас адресные sizing/bias+generation прошли. ОС фактически Windows11 25H2, build26200.9457; неподдержанный build обсуждался как гипотеза, причинность НЕ установлена. ОС/установку Ansys не меняли.
4. API Meshing: `InflationOption` — int, не enum; значение1 проверено как FirstLayerThickness. .NET `e.Vertices[-1]` не работает: сначала list(e.Vertices). Не читать массово значения `.Properties`.
5. Новый mesh-export может менять интерфейсы/контакты/названия зон. Не запускать CFD до проверки теплового сопряжения и boundary transfer.
6. Полная CAD→Mesh→Fluent→серия автономная цепочка ещё не квалифицирована. Параметры CAD работают, но ещё нужна проверка новой meshсистемы после изменения размеров.
7. Диффузор СВЗ r_heat_end=10мм и длинный участок694мм могут приводить к скачку/дозвуковому течению задолго до конца. Идеальная оценка для p01,1/out0,3 даёт r≈4,715мм (NASA), но это НЕ CFDоптимум; пока геометрию ради эффекта не меняли. После достоверного пилота исследовать Mach, Taw/heatflux, расходы и геометрию.

## Проверенные источники/физические выводы

Полный список и оговорки — в `Энергоразделение_источники_и_проверки.md`.

- Burtsev2014:https://www.mathnet.ru/php/getFT.phtml?jrnid=tvt&option_lang=eng&paperid=2&what=fullt ; Pr<1, recovery<1,Machtradeoff, теплопроводнаятонкаястенкаполезна; нашэффектне гарантирует.
- Khazov2018(безРудника):https://tptmai.ru/eng/publications.php?ID=106018&mobile=Y .
- NASAидеальнаяоценка:https://www.grc.nasa.gov/www/BGH/astar.html и normal.html; `grs_geometry_ideal_screen.json`.
- Ansyspressurecoupling:https://ansyshelp.ansys.com/public/Views/Secured/corp/v242/en/flu_ug/flu_ug_sec_uns_solve_pvel_1.html ; CoupledCFL<10 частоцелесообразнеезаменятьsegregatedsolver.

'SpaceClaim.Api.V242.Geometry.Line'}, {'bounds': [0.0, 0.694115991927624], 'start': [0.005884008072375991, 0.017499771110159625, 0.0], 'end': [0.7, 0.01749977111015984, 0.0], 'type':     p = dict((k, float(v)/1000.0) for k,v in values.items())
    def v(name): return p[name + '_mm']
    for name, value in p.items():
        if math.isnan(value) or math.isinf(value):
            raise ValueError('Non-finite parameter: '+name)
        if name not in ('x_origin_mm','secondary_inlet_offset_mm') and value <= 0:
            raise ValueError('Parameter must be positive: '+name)
    if not 0 < v('inlet_curve_offset') < v('l_convergent'):
        raise ValueError('Inlet curve offset must be inside convergent length')

    if xi >= xh: raise ValueError('Secondary inlet is beyond heat exchange end')

    ro0=rw0+v('gap_secondary_inlet'); ro1=rw1+v('gap_secondary_end')
    xa=xh+v('l_exit_contraction'); xb=xa+v('l_exit_rounding'); xc=xb+v('l_exit_recovery'); xo=xc+v('l_exit_tail')
    rneck=v('r_exit_neck'); rout=v('r_outlet'); rad=v('r_exit_rounding'); half=v('l_exit_rounding')/2
    cy=rneck+math.sqrt(rad*rad-half*half)
    if cy-rad <= 0: raise ValueError('Rounded neck crosses the axis')

    def line(a,b): return CurveSegment.Create(pt(*a),pt(*b))
    def spline(info, transform):
        knots=Array[Knot]([Knot(k['parameter'], k['multiplicity']) for k in info['knots']])
        cps=Array[ControlPoint]([ControlPoint(pt(*transform(cp['position'][0],cp['position'][1])),cp['weight']) for cp in info['control_points']])
        curve=NurbsCurve.CreateFromControlPoints(NurbsData(info['degree']+1,False,False,knots),cps)
        return CurveSegment.Create(curve,Interval.Create(*info['bounds']))

    inlet=spline(svz[3], lambda x,y:(x0+(x-refx)/(refin[0]-refx)*v('inlet_curve_offset'), y/refri*ri))
    contraction=spline(svz[2], lambda x,y:(x0+v('inlet_curve_offset')+(x-refin[0])/(reft[0]-refin[0])*(v('l_convergent')-v('inlet_curve_offset')),rt+(y-reft[1])/(refri-reft[1])*(ri-rt)))

        if name == 'air_svz':
            cuts=List[ITrimmedCurve]()
            for x,y in ((xt,rt),(xn,rn),(xh,rh)):
                cuts.Add(line((x,0),(x,y)))
            slope=(rn-rt)/(xn-xt)
            normal_factor=math.sqrt(1+slope*slope)
            total=0.0
            for layer in range(20):
                total+=first_layer_height_m*(1.2**layer)
                h=total*normal_factor
                if h>=rt: raise ValueError('Nozzle boundary layers exceed throat radius')
                cuts.Add(line((xt,rt-h),(xn,rn-h)))
            heat_normal_factor=math.sqrt(1+((rh-rn)/(xh-xn))**2)
            total=0.0
            for layer in range(20):
                total+=first_layer_height_m*(1.2**layer)
                if total*max(normal_factor,heat_normal_factor)>=min(rn,rh):
                    raise ValueError('Heat boundary layers exceed local channel radius')
                # Match the same layer endpoints at the nozzle/heat interface.
                cuts.Add(line((xn,rn-total*normal_factor),(xh,rh-total*heat_normal_factor)))
            xstart=x0+v('inlet_curve_offset')
            for x,y in ((xstart,ri),(xa,rneck),(xb,rneck),(xc,rout)):
                cuts.Add(line((x,0),(x,y)))
            total=0.0
            for layer in range(20):
                total+=first_layer_height_m*(1.2**layer)
                def transform_contraction(x,y):
                    xx=xstart+(x-refin[0])/(reft[0]-refin[0])*(v('l_convergent')-v('inlet_curve_offset'))
                    yy=rt+(y-reft[1])/(refri-reft[1])*(ri-rt)
                    factor=1+(normal_factor-1)*(xx-xstart)/(xt-xstart)
                    return (xx,yy-total*factor)
                cuts.Add(spline(svz[2],transform_contraction))
                cuts.Add(line((xh,rh-total*heat_normal_factor),(xa,rneck-total)))
                lower_frame=Frame.Create(pt((xa+xb)/2,cy-total),Direction.Create(0,-1,0),Direction.Create(1,0,0))
                cuts.Add(CurveSegment.Create(Circle.Create(lower_frame,rad),Interval.Create(-math.asin(half/rad),math.asin(half/rad))))
                cuts.Add(line((xb,rneck-total),(xc,rout-total)))
                cuts.Add(line((xc,rout-total),(xo,rout-total)))
            shape.ImprintCurves(cuts,None)
        shapes.append((name,shape))
    root=GetRootPart()
    if clear_existing:
        for g in list(root.Groups):
            # Preserve native script parameters and the published rebuilding script.
            if not g.HasDimension and g.Name != 'TubeGeometry' and not g.Name.startswith('GEO_'): g.Delete()
        for body in list(PartExtensions.GetAllBodies(root)): body.Delete()

        created[name]=DesignBody.Create(root,name,shape)

        for item in items: collection.Add(item)
        return Group.Create(root,name,collection)
    for name,body in created.items(): group(name,list(body.Faces))
    def match_edge(body,curve):
        a=curve.StartPoint; b=curve.EndPoint
        def distance(c,d): return math.sqrt((c.X-d.X)**2+(c.Y-d.Y)**2+(c.Z-d.Z)**2)
        hits=[]
        for e in body.Edges:
            q=e.Shape
            if min(distance(q.StartPoint,a)+distance(q.EndPoint,b),distance(q.StartPoint,b)+distance(q.EndPoint,a)) < 1e-7:

        if len(hits)!=1: raise ValueError('Ambiguous edge match for '+body.Name)

def parameter_mm(obj):
    return float(getattr(obj, "Value", obj)) * 1000.0

    def spline(info, transform):
        knots=Array[Knot]([Knot(k['parameter'], k['multiplicity']) for k in info['knots']])
        cps=Array[ControlPoint]([ControlPoint(pt(*transform(cp['position'][0],cp['position'][1])),cp['weight']) for cp in info['control_points']])
        curve=NurbsCurve.CreateFromControlPoints(NurbsData(info['degree']+1,False,False,knots),cps)
        return CurveSegment.Create(curve,Interval.Create(*info['bounds']))
    svz=reference['air_svz']['edges']; refx=svz[4]['start'][0]; reft=svz[1]['start']; refin=svz[2]['start']; refri=refin[1]
    inlet=spline(svz[3], lambda x,y:(x0+(x-refx)/(refin[0]-refx)*v('inlet_curve_offset'), y/refri*ri))
    # ---- v2 (08.10.2026): profiled Laval nozzle after Izotov (2009), sect. 1.2 ----
    R1_REL=0.75; R2_REL=0.225; ALPHA1=math.radians(25.0)
    def bez_curve(segs):
        # segs: list of cubic Bezier segments [P0,P1,P2,P3]; one NURBS, interior knots multiplicity 3
        ks=[Knot(0.0,4)]+[Knot(float(i),3) for i in range(1,len(segs))]+[Knot(float(len(segs)),4)]
        pts=[segs[0][0]]+[q for s_ in segs for q in s_[1:]]
        cps=Array[ControlPoint]([ControlPoint(pt(x,y),1.0) for x,y in pts])
        return CurveSegment.Create(NurbsCurve.CreateFromControlPoints(NurbsData(4,False,False,Array[Knot](ks)),cps),Interval.Create(0.0,float(len(segs))))
    def arc_seg(cx,cy,R,t0,t1):
        k=4.0/3.0*math.tan((t1-t0)/4.0)
        p0=(cx+R*math.cos(t0),cy+R*math.sin(t0)); p3=(cx+R*math.cos(t1),cy+R*math.sin(t1))
        return [p0,(p0[0]-k*R*math.sin(t0),p0[1]+k*R*math.cos(t0)),(p3[0]+k*R*math.sin(t1),p3[1]-k*R*math.cos(t1)),p3]
    def line_seg(a,b): return [a,(a[0]+(b[0]-a[0])/3.0,a[1]+(b[1]-a[1])/3.0),(a[0]+2*(b[0]-a[0])/3.0,a[1]+2*(b[1]-a[1])/3.0),b]
    dcr=2*rt; r1=R1_REL*dcr; r2=R2_REL*dcr
    xstart=x0+v('inlet_curve_offset'); P0=(xstart,ri)
    # convergent: line from the inlet corner tangent to arc r1 (centre above the throat), then the arc to the throat
    def tang_err(b):
        th=-math.pi/2-b; A=(xt+r1*math.cos(th),rt+r1+r1*math.sin(th))
        return (A[0]-P0[0])*(-math.sin(b))-(A[1]-P0[1])*math.cos(b)
    lo_,hi_=math.radians(1.0),math.radians(89.0)
    if tang_err(lo_)*tang_err(hi_)>0: raise ValueError('No tangent from the inlet corner to the throat arc')
    for _ in range(80):
        mid=(lo_+hi_)/2
        if tang_err(lo_)*tang_err(mid)<=0: hi_=mid
        else: lo_=mid
    beta=(lo_+hi_)/2; thA=-math.pi/2-beta
    A=(xt+r1*math.cos(thA),rt+r1+r1*math.sin(thA))
    if not xstart<A[0]<xt: raise ValueError('Convergent cone does not fit')
    conv_segs=[line_seg(P0,A),arc_seg(xt,rt+r1,r1,thA,-math.pi/2)]
    # divergent: arc r2 from the throat to angle alpha1, parabola (quadratic Bezier) to the exit with the channel slope
    s_h=(rh-rn)/(xh-xn)
    thC=-math.pi/2+ALPHA1; C=(xt+r2*math.cos(thC),rt+r2+r2*math.sin(thC))
    t1=math.tan(ALPHA1); D=(xn,rn)
    xE=(D[1]-C[1]+t1*C[0]-s_h*D[0])/(t1-s_h); E=(xE,C[1]+t1*(xE-C[0]))
    if not C[0]<xE<D[0]: raise ValueError('Parabola control point outside the supersonic part')
    par=[C,(C[0]+2.0/3.0*(E[0]-C[0]),C[1]+2.0/3.0*(E[1]-C[1])),(D[0]+2.0/3.0*(E[0]-D[0]),D[1]+2.0/3.0*(E[1]-D[1])),D]
    noz_segs=[arc_seg(xt,rt+r2,r2,-math.pi/2,thC),par]
    NOZZLE_DESIGN={'beta_deg':math.degrees(beta),'r1_mm':r1*1e3,'r2_mm':r2*1e3,'alpha1_deg':25.0,'alpha2_deg':math.degrees(math.atan(s_h))}
    contraction=bez_curve(conv_segs)
    nozzle_wall=bez_curve(noz_segs)
    frame=Frame.Create(pt((xa+xb)/2,cy),Direction.Create(0,-1,0),Direction.Create(1,0,0))
    arc=CurveSegment.Create(Circle.Create(frame,rad),Interval.Create(-math.asin(half/rad),math.asin(half/rad)))
    core=[line((xn,rn),(xh,rh)),nozzle_wall,contraction,inlet,line((x0,0),(xo,0)),line((xo,rout),(xo,0)),line((xc,rout),(xo,rout)),line((xb,rneck),(xc,rout)),arc,line((xh,rh),(xa,rneck))]
    wall=[line((xi,rw0),(xh,rw1)),line((xh,rw1),(xh,rh)),core[0],line((xn,rn),(xi,rw0))]
    secondary=[line((xi,rw0),(xi,ro0)),wall[0],line((xh,ro1),(xh,rw1)),line((xi,ro0),(xh,ro1))]
    loops=[('air_svz',core),('wall_abonite',wall),('air_dzv',secondary)]
    # Validate all sheets before replacing any existing bodies.
    shapes=[]
    for name,curves in loops:
        collection=List[ITrimmedCurve]()
        for c in curves: collection.Add(c)
        shape=Body.CreatePlanarBody(Plane.PlaneXY,collection)
        if name == 'air_svz':
            cuts=List[ITrimmedCurve]()
            for x,y in ((xt,rt),(xn,rn),(xh,rh)):
                cuts.Add(line((x,0),(x,y)))
            heat_normal_factor=math.sqrt(1+((rh-rn)/(xh-xn))**2)
            normal_factor=heat_normal_factor
            total=0.0
            for layer in range(20):
                total+=first_layer_height_m*(1.2**layer)
                if total>=rt: raise ValueError('Nozzle boundary layers exceed throat radius')
                # v2: vertical shift = total at the throat (horizontal tangent), total*heat_normal_factor at the exit
                def sh(q): return (q[0],q[1]-total*(1+(heat_normal_factor-1)*(q[0]-xt)/(xn-xt)))
                cuts.Add(bez_curve([[sh(q) for q in s_] for s_ in noz_segs]))
            total=0.0
            for layer in range(20):
                total+=first_layer_height_m*(1.2**layer)
                if total*max(normal_factor,heat_normal_factor)>=min(rn,rh):
                    raise ValueError('Heat boundary layers exceed local channel radius')
                # Match the same layer endpoints at the nozzle/heat interface.
                cuts.Add(line((xn,rn-total*heat_normal_factor),(xh,rh-total*heat_normal_factor)))
            for x,y in ((xstart,ri),(xa,rneck),(xb,rneck),(xc,rout)):
                cuts.Add(line((x,0),(x,y)))
            total=0.0
            for layer in range(20):
                total+=first_layer_height_m*(1.2**layer)
                cuts.Add(bez_curve([[(q[0],q[1]-total) for q in s_] for s_ in conv_segs]))
                cuts.Add(line((xh,rh-total*heat_normal_factor),(xa,rneck-total)))
                lower_frame=Frame.Create(pt((xa+xb)/2,cy-total),Direction.Create(0,-1,0),Direction.Create(1,0,0))
                cuts.Add(CurveSegment.Create(Circle.Create(lower_frame,rad),Interval.Create(-math.asin(half/rad),math.asin(half/rad))))
                cuts.Add(line((xb,rneck-total),(xc,rout-total)))
                cuts.Add(line((xc,rout-total),(xo,rout-total)))
            shape.ImprintCurves(cuts,None)
        shapes.append((name,shape))
    root=GetRootPart()
    if clear_existing:
        for g in list(root.Groups):
            # Preserve native script parameters and the published rebuilding script.
            if not g.HasDimension and g.Name != 'TubeGeometry' and not g.Name.startswith('GEO_'): g.Delete()
        for body in list(PartExtensions.GetAllBodies(root)): body.Delete()
    created={}
    for name,shape in shapes:
        created[name]=DesignBody.Create(root,name,shape)
    def group(name,items):
        collection=List[IDocObject]()
        for item in items: collection.Add(item)
        return Group.Create(root,name,collection)
    for name,body in created.items(): group(name,list(body.Faces))
    def match_edge(body,curve):
        a=curve.StartPoint; b=curve.EndPoint
        def distance(c,d): return math.sqrt((c.X-d.X)**2+(c.Y-d.Y)**2+(c.Z-d.Z)**2)
        hits=[]
        for e in body.Edges:
            q=e.Shape
            if min(distance(q.StartPoint,a)+distance(q.EndPoint,b),distance(q.StartPoint,b)+distance(q.EndPoint,a)) < 1e-7:
                hits.append(e)
        if len(hits)!=1: raise ValueError('Ambiguous edge match for '+body.Name)
        return hits[0]
    s=created['air_svz']; d=created['air_dzv']; w=created['wall_abonite']
    sections=[('convergent',x0+v('inlet_curve_offset'),xt),('nozzle',xt,xn),('heat',xn,xh),('exit_contraction',xh,xa),('exit_rounding',xa,xb),('exit_recovery',xb,xc),('exit_tail',xc,xo)]
    all_structured=[]
    for section,lo,hi in sections:
        faces=[]
        for face in s.Faces:
            xs=[q.X for e in face.Edges for q in (e.Shape.StartPoint,e.Shape.EndPoint)]
            if abs(min(xs)-lo)<1e-8 and abs(max(xs)-hi)<1e-8:faces.append(face)
        if len(faces)!=21 or any(f.Edges.Count!=4 for f in faces):raise ValueError('Expected 21 four-sided strips in '+section+'; found '+str(len(faces)))
        group('MESH_'+section,faces)
        all_structured+=faces
        axial=[];thin=[];bulk=[]
        for e in s.Edges:
            a=e.Shape.StartPoint;b=e.Shape.EndPoint
            if min(a.X,b.X)>=lo-1e-8 and max(a.X,b.X)<=hi+1e-8:
                if abs(a.X-b.X)>1e-8:axial.append(e)
                elif abs(a.Y-b.Y)<0.0002:thin.append(e)
                else:bulk.append(e)
        if (len(axial),len(thin),len(bulk))!=(22,40,2):raise ValueError('Bad partition in '+section+': '+str((len(axial),len(thin),len(bulk))))
        group('MESH_'+section+'_axial_edges',axial)
        group('MESH_'+section+'_layer_edges',thin)
        group('MESH_'+section+'_core_radial_edges',bulk)
    group('MESH_core_structured',all_structured)
    group('MESH_inflation_svz',[f for f in s.Faces if f not in all_structured])
    group('inlet_svz',[match_edge(s,core[3])]); group('axis',[e for e in s.Edges if abs(e.Shape.StartPoint.Y)<1e-9 and abs(e.Shape.EndPoint.Y)<1e-9]); group('outlet_svz',[e for e in s.Edges if abs(e.Shape.StartPoint.X-xo)<1e-9 and abs(e.Shape.EndPoint.X-xo)<1e-9])
    group('wall_outer-air_svz',[match_edge(s,core[i]) for i in (1,2,6,7,8,9)])
    group('wall-air_svz-wall_abonite',[match_edge(s,core[0]),match_edge(w,wall[2])])
    group('interior-air_dzv-wall_abonite',[match_edge(d,secondary[1]),match_edge(w,wall[0])])
    group('wall-wall_abonite',[match_edge(w,wall[i]) for i in (1,3)])
    group('inlet_dzv',[match_edge(d,secondary[0])]); group('outlet_dzv',[match_edge(d,secondary[2])]); group('wall_outer-air_dzv',[match_edge(d,secondary[3])])
    return {'nozzle_design':NOZZLE_DESIGN,'bodies':[(b.Name,b.Faces.Count,b.Edges.Count) for b in created.values()], 'x_nozzle_exit_m':xn,'x_heat_exchange_end_m':xh,'x_outlet_m':xo}

def parameter_mm(obj):
    return float(getattr(obj, "Value", obj)) * 1000.0

values = {}

        raise ValueError('Rounding radius must exceed half its chord length')
    x0=v('x_origin'); xt=x0+v('l_convergent'); xn=xt+v('l_nozzle'); xh=xn+v('l_heat_exchange')
    # ---- v3 (08.10.2026): optional cone + cylinder channel (2017 rig); options next to the project ----
    import os
    _opt={}; _optfile=None
    try:
        _dp=str(GetRootPart().Document.Path)
        _optfile=os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(_dp))))),'geometry_options.json')
        if os.path.exists(_optfile): _opt=json.load(open(_optfile))
    except Exception as _e:
        _opt={'_error':str(_e)}
    l_cone=float(_opt.get('l_cone_mm') or 0.0)/1000.0
    if l_cone and not 0 < l_cone < xh-xn-0.02: raise ValueError('Cone length must be inside the heat-exchange length')
    try:
        _log=dict(_opt); _log['options_file']=_optfile; _log['l_cone_m']=l_cone
        if _optfile: open(os.path.join(os.path.dirname(_optfile),'geometry_options_used.json'),'w').write(json.dumps(_log))
    except Exception:
        pass
    xi=xn+v('secondary_inlet_offset')
    if xi >= xh: raise ValueError('Secondary inlet is beyond heat exchange end')
    ri=v('r_inlet'); rt=v('r_throat'); rn=v('r_nozzle_exit'); rh=v('r_heat_exchange_end')
    rw0=rn+v('wall_thickness_inlet'); rw1=rh+v('wall_thickness_end')
    ro0=rw0+v('gap_secondary_inlet'); ro1=rw1+v('gap_secondary_end')
    xa=xh+v('l_exit_contraction'); xb=xa+v('l_exit_rounding'); xc=xb+v('l_exit_recovery'); xo=xc+v('l_exit_tail')
    rneck=v('r_exit_neck'); rout=v('r_outlet'); rad=v('r_exit_rounding'); half=v('l_exit_rounding')/2
    cy=rneck+math.sqrt(rad*rad-half*half)
    if cy-rad <= 0: raise ValueError('Rounded neck crosses the axis')
    def pt(x,y): return Point.Create(x,y,0)
    def line(a,b): return CurveSegment.Create(pt(*a),pt(*b))
    def spline(info, transform):
        knots=Array[Knot]([Knot(k['parameter'], k['multiplicity']) for k in info['knots']])
        cps=Array[ControlPoint]([ControlPoint(pt(*transform(cp['position'][0],cp['position'][1])),cp['weight']) for cp in info['control_points']])
        curve=NurbsCurve.CreateFromControlPoints(NurbsData(info['degree']+1,False,False,knots),cps)
        return CurveSegment.Create(curve,Interval.Create(*info['bounds']))
    svz=reference['air_svz']['edges']; refx=svz[4]['start'][0]; reft=svz[1]['start']; refin=svz[2]['start']; refri=refin[1]
    inlet=spline(svz[3], lambda x,y:(x0+(x-refx)/(refin[0]-refx)*v('inlet_curve_offset'), y/refri*ri))
    # ---- v2 (08.10.2026): profiled Laval nozzle after Izotov (2009), sect. 1.2 ----
    R1_REL=0.75; R2_REL=0.225; ALPHA1=math.radians(25.0)
    def bez_curve(segs):
        # segs: list of cubic Bezier segments [P0,P1,P2,P3]; one NURBS, interior knots multiplicity 3
        ks=[Knot(0.0,4)]+[Knot(float(i),3) for i in range(1,len(segs))]+[Knot(float(len(segs)),4)]
        pts=[segs[0][0]]+[q for s_ in segs for q in s_[1:]]
        cps=Array[ControlPoint]([ControlPoint(pt(x,y),1.0) for x,y in pts])
        return CurveSegment.Create(NurbsCurve.CreateFromControlPoints(NurbsData(4,False,False,Array[Knot](ks)),cps),Interval.Create(0.0,float(len(segs))))
    def arc_seg(cx,cy,R,t0,t1):
        k=4.0/3.0*math.tan((t1-t0)/4.0)
        p0=(cx+R*math.cos(t0),cy+R*math.sin(t0)); p3=(cx+R*math.cos(t1),cy+R*math.sin(t1))
        return [p0,(p0[0]-k*R*math.sin(t0),p0[1]+k*R*math.cos(t0)),(p3[0]+k*R*math.sin(t1),p3[1]-k*R*math.cos(t1)),p3]
    def line_seg(a,b): return [a,(a[0]+(b[0]-a[0])/3.0,a[1]+(b[1]-a[1])/3.0),(a[0]+2*(b[0]-a[0])/3.0,a[1]+2*(b[1]-a[1])/3.0),b]
    dcr=2*rt; r1=R1_REL*dcr; r2=R2_REL*dcr
    xstart=x0+v('inlet_curve_offset'); P0=(xstart,ri)
    # convergent: line from the inlet corner tangent to arc r1 (centre above the throat), then the arc to the throat
    def tang_err(b):
        th=-math.pi/2-b; A=(xt+r1*math.cos(th),rt+r1+r1*math.sin(th))
        return (A[0]-P0[0])*(-math.sin(b))-(A[1]-P0[1])*math.cos(b)
    lo_,hi_=math.radians(1.0),math.radians(89.0)
    if tang_err(lo_)*tang_err(hi_)>0: raise ValueError('No tangent from the inlet corner to the throat arc')
    for _ in range(80):
        mid=(lo_+hi_)/2
        if tang_err(lo_)*tang_err(mid)<=0: hi_=mid
        else: lo_=mid
    beta=(lo_+hi_)/2; thA=-math.pi/2-beta
    A=(xt+r1*math.cos(thA),rt+r1+r1*math.sin(thA))
    if not xstart<A[0]<xt: raise ValueError('Convergent cone does not fit')
    conv_segs=[line_seg(P0,A),arc_seg(xt,rt+r1,r1,thA,-math.pi/2)]
    # divergent: arc r2 from the throat to angle alpha1, parabola (quadratic Bezier) to the exit with the channel slope
    s_h=(rh-rn)/(l_cone if l_cone else (xh-xn))
    thC=-math.pi/2+ALPHA1; C=(xt+r2*math.cos(thC),rt+r2+r2*math.sin(thC))
    t1=math.tan(ALPHA1); D=(xn,rn)
    xE=(D[1]-C[1]+t1*C[0]-s_h*D[0])/(t1-s_h); E=(xE,C[1]+t1*(xE-C[0]))
    if not C[0]<xE<D[0]: raise ValueError('Parabola control point outside the supersonic part')
    par=[C,(C[0]+2.0/3.0*(E[0]-C[0]),C[1]+2.0/3.0*(E[1]-C[1])),(D[0]+2.0/3.0*(E[0]-D[0]),D[1]+2.0/3.0*(E[1]-D[1])),D]
    noz_segs=[arc_seg(xt,rt+r2,r2,-math.pi/2,thC),par]
    NOZZLE_DESIGN={'beta_deg':math.degrees(beta),'r1_mm':r1*1e3,'r2_mm':r2*1e3,'alpha1_deg':25.0,'alpha2_deg':math.degrees(math.atan(s_h))}
    contraction=bez_curve(conv_segs)
    nozzle_wall=bez_curve(noz_segs)
    if l_cone:
        # cone -> arc (R 1 m) -> cylinder, one G1 curve
        xk=xn+l_cone; phi=math.atan(s_h); Rf=1.0; tl=Rf*math.tan(phi/2.0)
        A_=(xk-tl*math.cos(phi),rh-tl*math.sin(phi)); B_=(xk+tl,rh)
        heat_segs=[line_seg((xn,rn),A_),arc_seg(B_[0],rh-Rf,Rf,math.pi/2+phi,math.pi/2),line_seg(B_,(xh,rh))]
    else:
        heat_segs=[line_seg((xn,rn),(xh,rh))]
    heat_wall=bez_curve(heat_segs) if l_cone else line((xn,rn),(xh,rh))
    frame=Frame.Create(pt((xa+xb)/2,cy),Direction.Create(0,-1,0),Direction.Create(1,0,0))
    arc=CurveSegment.Create(Circle.Create(frame,rad),Interval.Create(-math.asin(half/rad),math.asin(half/rad)))
    core=[heat_wall,nozzle_wall,contraction,inlet,line((x0,0),(xo,0)),line((xo,rout),(xo,0)),line((xc,rout),(xo,rout)),line((xb,rneck),(xc,rout)),arc,line((xh,rh),(xa,rneck))]
    wall=[line((xi,rw0),(xh,rw1)),line((xh,rw1),(xh,rh)),core[0],line((xn,rn),(xi,rw0))]
    secondary=[line((xi,rw0),(xi,ro0)),wall[0],line((xh,ro1),(xh,rw1)),line((xi,ro0),(xh,ro1))]
    loops=[('air_svz',core),('wall_abonite',wall),('air_dzv',secondary)]
    # Validate all sheets before replacing any existing bodies.
    shapes=[]
    for name,curves in loops:
        collection=List[ITrimmedCurve]()
        for c in curves: collection.Add(c)
        shape=Body.CreatePlanarBody(Plane.PlaneXY,collection)
        if name == 'air_svz':
            cuts=List[ITrimmedCurve]()
            for x,y in ((xt,rt),(xn,rn),(xh,rh)):
                cuts.Add(line((x,0),(x,y)))
            heat_normal_factor=math.sqrt(1+s_h**2)
            normal_factor=heat_normal_factor
            total=0.0
            for layer in range(20):
                total+=first_layer_height_m*(1.2**layer)
                if total>=rt: raise ValueError('Nozzle boundary layers exceed throat radius')
                # v2: vertical shift = total at the throat (horizontal tangent), total*heat_normal_factor at the exit
                def sh(q): return (q[0],q[1]-total*(1+(heat_normal_factor-1)*(q[0]-xt)/(xn-xt)))
                cuts.Add(bez_curve([[sh(q) for q in s_] for s_ in noz_segs]))
            total=0.0
            for layer in range(20):
                total+=first_layer_height_m*(1.2**layer)
                if total*max(normal_factor,heat_normal_factor)>=min(rn,rh):
                    raise ValueError('Heat boundary layers exceed local channel radius')
                # Match the same layer endpoints at the nozzle/heat interface.
                if l_cone:
                    cuts.Add(bez_curve([[(q[0],q[1]-total*heat_normal_factor) for q in s_] for s_ in heat_segs]))
                else:
                    cuts.Add(line((xn,rn-total*heat_normal_factor),(xh,rh-total*heat_normal_factor)))
            for x,y in ((xstart,ri),(xa,rneck),(xb,rneck),(xc,rout)):
                cuts.Add(line((x,0),(x,y)))
            total=0.0
            for layer in range(20):
                total+=first_layer_height_m*(1.2**layer)
                cuts.Add(bez_curve([[(q[0],q[1]-total) for q in s_] for s_ in conv_segs]))
                cuts.Add(line((xh,rh-total*heat_normal_factor),(xa,rneck-total)))
                lower_frame=Frame.Create(pt((xa+xb)/2,cy-total),Direction.Create(0,-1,0),Direction.Create(1,0,0))
                cuts.Add(CurveSegment.Create(Circle.Create(lower_frame,rad),Interval.Create(-math.asin(half/rad),math.asin(half/rad))))
                cuts.Add(line((xb,rneck-total),(xc,rout-total)))
                cuts.Add(line((xc,rout-total),(xo,rout-total)))
            shape.ImprintCurves(cuts,None)
        shapes.append((name,shape))
    root=GetRootPart()
    if clear_existing:
        for g in list(root.Groups):
            # Preserve native script parameters and the published rebuilding script.
            if not g.HasDimension and g.Name != 'TubeGeometry' and not g.Name.startswith('GEO_'): g.Delete()
        for body in list(PartExtensions.GetAllBodies(root)): body.Delete()
    created={}
    for name,shape in shapes:
        created[name]=DesignBody.Create(root,name,shape)
    def group(name,items):
        collection=List[IDocObject]()
        for item in items: collection.Add(item)
        return Group.Create(root,name,collection)
    for name,body in created.items(): group(name,list(body.Faces))
    def match_edge(body,curve):
        a=curve.StartPoint; b=curve.EndPoint
        def distance(c,d): return math.sqrt((c.X-d.X)**2+(c.Y-d.Y)**2+(c.Z-d.Z)**2)
        hits=[]
        for e in body.Edges:
            q=e.Shape
            if min(distance(q.StartPoint,a)+distance(q.EndPoint,b),distance(q.StartPoint,b)+distance(q.EndPoint,a)) < 1e-7:
                hits.append(e)
        if len(hits)!=1: raise ValueError('Ambiguous edge match for '+body.Name)
        return hits[0]
    s=created['air_svz']; d=created['air_dzv']; w=created['wall_abonite']
    sections=[('convergent',x0+v('inlet_curve_offset'),xt),('nozzle',xt,xn),('heat',xn,xh),('exit_contraction',xh,xa),('exit_rounding',xa,xb),('exit_recovery',xb,xc),('exit_tail',xc,xo)]
    all_structured=[]
    for section,lo,hi in sections:
        faces=[]
        for face in s.Faces:
            xs=[q.X for e in face.Edges for q in (e.Shape.StartPoint,e.Shape.EndPoint)]
            if abs(min(xs)-lo)<1e-8 and abs(max(xs)-hi)<1e-8:faces.append(face)
        if len(faces)!=21 or any(f.Edges.Count!=4 for f in faces):raise ValueError('Expected 21 four-sided strips in '+section+'; found '+str(len(faces)))
        group('MESH_'+section,faces)
        all_structured+=faces
        axial=[];thin=[];bulk=[]
        for e in s.Edges:
            a=e.Shape.StartPoint;b=e.Shape.EndPoint
            if min(a.X,b.X)>=lo-1e-8 and max(a.X,b.X)<=hi+1e-8:
                if abs(a.X-b.X)>1e-8:axial.append(e)
                elif abs(a.Y-b.Y)<0.0002:thin.append(e)
                else:bulk.append(e)
        if (len(axial),len(thin),len(bulk))!=(22,40,2):raise ValueError('Bad partition in '+section+': '+str((len(axial),len(thin),len(bulk))))
        group('MESH_'+section+'_axial_edges',axial)
        group('MESH_'+section+'_layer_edges',thin)
        group('MESH_'+section+'_core_radial_edges',bulk)
    group('MESH_core_structured',all_structured)
    group('MESH_inflation_svz',[f for f in s.Faces if f not in all_structured])
    group('inlet_svz',[match_edge(s,core[3])]); group('axis',[e for e in s.Edges if abs(e.Shape.StartPoint.Y)<1e-9 and abs(e.Shape.EndPoint.Y)<1e-9]); group('outlet_svz',[e for e in s.Edges if abs(e.Shape.StartPoint.X-xo)<1e-9 and abs(e.Shape.EndPoint.X-xo)<1e-9])
    group('wall_outer-air_svz',[match_edge(s,core[i]) for i in (1,2,6,7,8,9)])
    group('wall-air_svz-wall_abonite',[match_edge(s,core[0]),match_edge(w,wall[2])])
    group('interior-air_dzv-wall_abonite',[match_edge(d,secondary[1]),match_edge(w,wall[0])])
    group('wall-wall_abonite',[match_edge(w,wall[i]) for i in (1,3)])
    group('inlet_dzv',[match_edge(d,secondary[0])]); group('outlet_dzv',[match_edge(d,secondary[2])]); group('wall_outer-air_dzv',[match_edge(d,secondary[3])])
    return {'nozzle_design':NOZZLE_DESIGN,'bodies':[(b.Name,b.Faces.Count,b.Edges.Count) for b in created.values()], 'x_nozzle_exit_m':xn,'x_heat_exchange_end_m':xh,'x_outlet_m':xo}

def parameter_mm(obj):
    return float(getattr(obj, "Value", obj)) * 1000.0

values = {}
values['x_origin_mm'] = parameter_mm(Parameters.GEO_x_origin)
values['r_inlet_mm'] = parameter_mm(Parameters.GEO_r_inlet)
values['l_convergent_mm'] = parameter_mm(Parameters.GEO_l_convergent)
values['inlet_curve_offset_mm'] = parameter_mm(Parameters.GEO_inlet_curve_offset)
values['r_throat_mm'] = parameter_mm(Parameters.GEO_r_throat)
values['r_nozzle_exit_mm'] = parameter_mm(Parameters.GEO_r_nozzle_exit)
values['l_nozzle_mm'] = parameter_mm(Parameters.GEO_l_nozzle)
values['l_heat_exchange_mm'] = parameter_mm(Parameters.GEO_l_heat_exchange)
values['r_heat_exchange_end_mm'] = parameter_mm(Parameters.GEO_r_heat_exchange_end)
values['wall_thickness_inlet_mm'] = parameter_mm(Parameters.GEO_wall_thickness_inlet)
values['wall_thickness_end_mm'] = parameter_mm(Parameters.GEO_wall_thickness_end)
values['gap_secondary_inlet_mm'] = parameter_mm(Parameters.GEO_gap_secondary_inlet)
values['gap_secondary_end_mm'] = parameter_mm(Parameters.GEO_gap_secondary_end)
values['secondary_inlet_offset_mm'] = parameter_mm(Parameters.GEO_secondary_inlet_offset)
values['l_exit_contraction_mm'] = parameter_mm(Parameters.GEO_l_exit_contraction)
values['r_exit_neck_mm'] = parameter_mm(Parameters.GEO_r_exit_neck)
values['l_exit_rounding_mm'] = parameter_mm(Parameters.GEO_l_exit_rounding)
values['r_exit_rounding_mm'] = parameter_mm(Parameters.GEO_r_exit_rounding)
values['l_exit_recovery_mm'] = parameter_mm(Parameters.GEO_l_exit_recovery)
values['r_outlet_mm'] = parameter_mm(Parameters.GEO_r_outlet)
values['l_exit_tail_mm'] = parameter_mm(Parameters.GEO_l_exit_tail)
build_geometry(values, first_layer_height_m=float(getattr(Parameters.GEO_first_layer_height, "Value", Parameters.GEO_first_layer_height)))

'SpaceClaim.Api.V242.Geometry.Line'}]}}
    p = dict((k, float(v)/1000.0) for k,v in values.items())
    def v(name): return p[name + '_mm']
    for name, value in p.items():
        if math.isnan(value) or math.isinf(value):
            raise ValueError('Non-finite parameter: '+name)
        if name not in ('x_origin_mm','secondary_inlet_offset_mm') and value <= 0:
            raise ValueError('Parameter must be positive: '+name)
    if not 0 < v('inlet_curve_offset') < v('l_convergent'):
        raise ValueError('Inlet curve offset must be inside convergent length')
    if not v('r_throat') < min(v('r_inlet'),v('r_nozzle_exit')):
        raise ValueError('Throat radius must be smaller than inlet and nozzle exit')
    if v('r_exit_rounding') <= v('l_exit_rounding')/2:
        raise ValueError('Rounding radius must exceed half its chord length')
    x0=v('x_origin'); xt=x0+v('l_convergent'); xn=xt+v('l_nozzle'); xh=xn+v('l_heat_exchange')
    # ---- v3 (08.10.2026): optional cone + cylinder channel (2017 rig); options next to the project ----
    import os
    _opt={}; _optfile=None
    try:
        _dp=str(GetRootPart().Document.Path)
        _optfile=os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(_dp))))),'geometry_options.json')
        if os.path.exists(_optfile): _opt=json.load(open(_optfile))
    except Exception as _e:
        _opt={'_error':str(_e)}
    l_cone=float(_opt.get('l_cone_mm') or 0.0)/1000.0
    dzv_counter=bool(_opt.get('dzv_counterflow') or False)
    if l_cone and not 0 < l_cone < xh-xn-0.02: raise ValueError('Cone length must be inside the heat-exchange length')
    try:
        _log=dict(_opt); _log['options_file']=_optfile; _log['l_cone_m']=l_cone; _log['dzv_counterflow']=dzv_counter
        if _optfile: open(os.path.join(os.path.dirname(_optfile),'geometry_options_used.json'),'w').write(json.dumps(_log))
    except Exception:
        pass
    xi=xn+v('secondary_inlet_offset')
    if xi >= xh: raise ValueError('Secondary inlet is beyond heat exchange end')
    ri=v('r_inlet'); rt=v('r_throat'); rn=v('r_nozzle_exit'); rh=v('r_heat_exchange_end')
    rw0=rn+v('wall_thickness_inlet'); rw1=rh+v('wall_thickness_end')
    ro0=rw0+v('gap_secondary_inlet'); ro1=rw1+v('gap_secondary_end')
    xa=xh+v('l_exit_contraction'); xb=xa+v('l_exit_rounding'); xc=xb+v('l_exit_recovery'); xo=xc+v('l_exit_tail')
    rneck=v('r_exit_neck'); rout=v('r_outlet'); rad=v('r_exit_rounding'); half=v('l_exit_rounding')/2
    cy=rneck+math.sqrt(rad*rad-half*half)
    if cy-rad <= 0: raise ValueError('Rounded neck crosses the axis')
    def pt(x,y): return Point.Create(x,y,0)
    def line(a,b): return CurveSegment.Create(pt(*a),pt(*b))
    def spline(info, transform):
        knots=Array[Knot]([Knot(k['parameter'], k['multiplicity']) for k in info['knots']])
        cps=Array[ControlPoint]([ControlPoint(pt(*transform(cp['position'][0],cp['position'][1])),cp['weight']) for cp in info['control_points']])
        curve=NurbsCurve.CreateFromControlPoints(NurbsData(info['degree']+1,False,False,knots),cps)
        return CurveSegment.Create(curve,Interval.Create(*info['bounds']))
    svz=reference['air_svz']['edges']; refx=svz[4]['start'][0]; reft=svz[1]['start']; refin=svz[2]['start']; refri=refin[1]
    inlet=spline(svz[3], lambda x,y:(x0+(x-refx)/(refin[0]-refx)*v('inlet_curve_offset'), y/refri*ri))
    # ---- v2 (08.10.2026): profiled Laval nozzle after Izotov (2009), sect. 1.2 ----
    R1_REL=0.75; R2_REL=0.225; ALPHA1=math.radians(25.0)
    def bez_curve(segs):
        # segs: list of cubic Bezier segments [P0,P1,P2,P3]; one NURBS, interior knots multiplicity 3
        ks=[Knot(0.0,4)]+[Knot(float(i),3) for i in range(1,len(segs))]+[Knot(float(len(segs)),4)]
        pts=[segs[0][0]]+[q for s_ in segs for q in s_[1:]]
        cps=Array[ControlPoint]([ControlPoint(pt(x,y),1.0) for x,y in pts])
        return CurveSegment.Create(NurbsCurve.CreateFromControlPoints(NurbsData(4,False,False,Array[Knot](ks)),cps),Interval.Create(0.0,float(len(segs))))
    def arc_seg(cx,cy,R,t0,t1):
        k=4.0/3.0*math.tan((t1-t0)/4.0)
        p0=(cx+R*math.cos(t0),cy+R*math.sin(t0)); p3=(cx+R*math.cos(t1),cy+R*math.sin(t1))
        return [p0,(p0[0]-k*R*math.sin(t0),p0[1]+k*R*math.cos(t0)),(p3[0]+k*R*math.sin(t1),p3[1]-k*R*math.cos(t1)),p3]
    def line_seg(a,b): return [a,(a[0]+(b[0]-a[0])/3.0,a[1]+(b[1]-a[1])/3.0),(a[0]+2*(b[0]-a[0])/3.0,a[1]+2*(b[1]-a[1])/3.0),b]
    dcr=2*rt; r1=R1_REL*dcr; r2=R2_REL*dcr
    xstart=x0+v('inlet_curve_offset'); P0=(xstart,ri)
    # convergent: line from the inlet corner tangent to arc r1 (centre above the throat), then the arc to the throat
    def tang_err(b):
        th=-math.pi/2-b; A=(xt+r1*math.cos(th),rt+r1+r1*math.sin(th))
        return (A[0]-P0[0])*(-math.sin(b))-(A[1]-P0[1])*math.cos(b)
    lo_,hi_=math.radians(1.0),math.radians(89.0)
    if tang_err(lo_)*tang_err(hi_)>0: raise ValueError('No tangent from the inlet corner to the throat arc')
    for _ in range(80):
        mid=(lo_+hi_)/2
        if tang_err(lo_)*tang_err(mid)<=0: hi_=mid
        else: lo_=mid
    beta=(lo_+hi_)/2; thA=-math.pi/2-beta
    A=(xt+r1*math.cos(thA),rt+r1+r1*math.sin(thA))
    if not xstart<A[0]<xt: raise ValueError('Convergent cone does not fit')
    conv_segs=[line_seg(P0,A),arc_seg(xt,rt+r1,r1,thA,-math.pi/2)]
    # divergent: arc r2 from the throat to angle alpha1, parabola (quadratic Bezier) to the exit with the channel slope
    s_h=(rh-rn)/(l_cone if l_cone else (xh-xn))
    thC=-math.pi/2+ALPHA1; C=(xt+r2*math.cos(thC),rt+r2+r2*math.sin(thC))
    t1=math.tan(ALPHA1); D=(xn,rn)
    xE=(D[1]-C[1]+t1*C[0]-s_h*D[0])/(t1-s_h); E=(xE,C[1]+t1*(xE-C[0]))
    if not C[0]<xE<D[0]: raise ValueError('Parabola control point outside the supersonic part')
    par=[C,(C[0]+2.0/3.0*(E[0]-C[0]),C[1]+2.0/3.0*(E[1]-C[1])),(D[0]+2.0/3.0*(E[0]-D[0]),D[1]+2.0/3.0*(E[1]-D[1])),D]
    noz_segs=[arc_seg(xt,rt+r2,r2,-math.pi/2,thC),par]
    NOZZLE_DESIGN={'beta_deg':math.degrees(beta),'r1_mm':r1*1e3,'r2_mm':r2*1e3,'alpha1_deg':25.0,'alpha2_deg':math.degrees(math.atan(s_h))}
    contraction=bez_curve(conv_segs)
    nozzle_wall=bez_curve(noz_segs)
    if l_cone:
        # cone -> arc (R 1 m) -> cylinder, one G1 curve
        xk=xn+l_cone; phi=math.atan(s_h); Rf=1.0; tl=Rf*math.tan(phi/2.0)
        A_=(xk-tl*math.cos(phi),rh-tl*math.sin(phi)); B_=(xk+tl,rh)
        heat_segs=[line_seg((xn,rn),A_),arc_seg(B_[0],rh-Rf,Rf,math.pi/2+phi,math.pi/2),line_seg(B_,(xh,rh))]
    else:
        heat_segs=[line_seg((xn,rn),(xh,rh))]
    heat_wall=bez_curve(heat_segs) if l_cone else line((xn,rn),(xh,rh))
    frame=Frame.Create(pt((xa+xb)/2,cy),Direction.Create(0,-1,0),Direction.Create(1,0,0))
    arc=CurveSegment.Create(Circle.Create(frame,rad),Interval.Create(-math.asin(half/rad),math.asin(half/rad)))
    core=[heat_wall,nozzle_wall,contraction,inlet,line((x0,0),(xo,0)),line((xo,rout),(xo,0)),line((xc,rout),(xo,rout)),line((xb,rneck),(xc,rout)),arc,line((xh,rh),(xa,rneck))]
    wall=[line((xi,rw0),(xh,rw1)),line((xh,rw1),(xh,rh)),core[0],line((xn,rn),(xi,rw0))]
    secondary=[line((xi,rw0),(xi,ro0)),wall[0],line((xh,ro1),(xh,rw1)),line((xi,ro0),(xh,ro1))]
    loops=[('air_svz',core),('wall_abonite',wall),('air_dzv',secondary)]
    # Validate all sheets before replacing any existing bodies.
    shapes=[]
    for name,curves in loops:
        collection=List[ITrimmedCurve]()
        for c in curves: collection.Add(c)
        shape=Body.CreatePlanarBody(Plane.PlaneXY,collection)
        if name == 'air_svz':
            cuts=List[ITrimmedCurve]()
            for x,y in ((xt,rt),(xn,rn),(xh,rh)):
                cuts.Add(line((x,0),(x,y)))
            heat_normal_factor=math.sqrt(1+s_h**2)
            normal_factor=heat_normal_factor
            total=0.0
            for layer in range(20):
                total+=first_layer_height_m*(1.2**layer)
                if total>=rt: raise ValueError('Nozzle boundary layers exceed throat radius')
                # v2: vertical shift = total at the throat (horizontal tangent), total*heat_normal_factor at the exit
                def sh(q): return (q[0],q[1]-total*(1+(heat_normal_factor-1)*(q[0]-xt)/(xn-xt)))
                cuts.Add(bez_curve([[sh(q) for q in s_] for s_ in noz_segs]))
            total=0.0
            for layer in range(20):
                total+=first_layer_height_m*(1.2**layer)
                if total*max(normal_factor,heat_normal_factor)>=min(rn,rh):
                    raise ValueError('Heat boundary layers exceed local channel radius')
                # Match the same layer endpoints at the nozzle/heat interface.
                if l_cone:
                    cuts.Add(bez_curve([[(q[0],q[1]-total*heat_normal_factor) for q in s_] for s_ in heat_segs]))
                else:
                    cuts.Add(line((xn,rn-total*heat_normal_factor),(xh,rh-total*heat_normal_factor)))
            for x,y in ((xstart,ri),(xa,rneck),(xb,rneck),(xc,rout)):
                cuts.Add(line((x,0),(x,y)))
            total=0.0
            for layer in range(20):
                total+=first_layer_height_m*(1.2**layer)
                cuts.Add(bez_curve([[(q[0],q[1]-total) for q in s_] for s_ in conv_segs]))
                cuts.Add(line((xh,rh-total*heat_normal_factor),(xa,rneck-total)))
                lower_frame=Frame.Create(pt((xa+xb)/2,cy-total),Direction.Create(0,-1,0),Direction.Create(1,0,0))
                cuts.Add(CurveSegment.Create(Circle.Create(lower_frame,rad),Interval.Create(-math.asin(half/rad),math.asin(half/rad))))
                cuts.Add(line((xb,rneck-total),(xc,rout-total)))
                cuts.Add(line((xc,rout-total),(xo,rout-total)))
            shape.ImprintCurves(cuts,None)
        shapes.append((name,shape))
    root=GetRootPart()
    if clear_existing:
        for g in list(root.Groups):
            # Preserve native script parameters and the published rebuilding script.
            if not g.HasDimension and g.Name != 'TubeGeometry' and not g.Name.startswith('GEO_'): g.Delete()
        for body in list(PartExtensions.GetAllBodies(root)): body.Delete()
    created={}
    for name,shape in shapes:
        created[name]=DesignBody.Create(root,name,shape)
    def group(name,items):
        collection=List[IDocObject]()
        for item in items: collection.Add(item)
        return Group.Create(root,name,collection)
    for name,body in created.items(): group(name,list(body.Faces))
    def match_edge(body,curve):
        a=curve.StartPoint; b=curve.EndPoint
        def distance(c,d): return math.sqrt((c.X-d.X)**2+(c.Y-d.Y)**2+(c.Z-d.Z)**2)
        hits=[]
        for e in body.Edges:
            q=e.Shape
            if min(distance(q.StartPoint,a)+distance(q.EndPoint,b),distance(q.StartPoint,b)+distance(q.EndPoint,a)) < 1e-7:
                hits.append(e)
        if len(hits)!=1: raise ValueError('Ambiguous edge match for '+body.Name)
        return hits[0]
    s=created['air_svz']; d=created['air_dzv']; w=created['wall_abonite']
    sections=[('convergent',x0+v('inlet_curve_offset'),xt),('nozzle',xt,xn),('heat',xn,xh),('exit_contraction',xh,xa),('exit_rounding',xa,xb),('exit_recovery',xb,xc),('exit_tail',xc,xo)]
    all_structured=[]
    for section,lo,hi in sections:
        faces=[]
        for face in s.Faces:
            xs=[q.X for e in face.Edges for q in (e.Shape.StartPoint,e.Shape.EndPoint)]
            if abs(min(xs)-lo)<1e-8 and abs(max(xs)-hi)<1e-8:faces.append(face)
        if len(faces)!=21 or any(f.Edges.Count!=4 for f in faces):raise ValueError('Expected 21 four-sided strips in '+section+'; found '+str(len(faces)))
        group('MESH_'+section,faces)
        all_structured+=faces
        axial=[];thin=[];bulk=[]
        for e in s.Edges:
            a=e.Shape.StartPoint;b=e.Shape.EndPoint
            if min(a.X,b.X)>=lo-1e-8 and max(a.X,b.X)<=hi+1e-8:
                if abs(a.X-b.X)>1e-8:axial.append(e)
                elif abs(a.Y-b.Y)<0.0002:thin.append(e)
                else:bulk.append(e)
        if (len(axial),len(thin),len(bulk))!=(22,40,2):raise ValueError('Bad partition in '+section+': '+str((len(axial),len(thin),len(bulk))))
        group('MESH_'+section+'_axial_edges',axial)
        group('MESH_'+section+'_layer_edges',thin)
        group('MESH_'+section+'_core_radial_edges',bulk)
    group('MESH_core_structured',all_structured)
    group('MESH_inflation_svz',[f for f in s.Faces if f not in all_structured])
    group('inlet_svz',[match_edge(s,core[3])]); group('axis',[e for e in s.Edges if abs(e.Shape.StartPoint.Y)<1e-9 and abs(e.Shape.EndPoint.Y)<1e-9]); group('outlet_svz',[e for e in s.Edges if abs(e.Shape.StartPoint.X-xo)<1e-9 and abs(e.Shape.EndPoint.X-xo)<1e-9])
    group('wall_outer-air_svz',[match_edge(s,core[i]) for i in (1,2,6,7,8,9)])
    group('wall-air_svz-wall_abonite',[match_edge(s,core[0]),match_edge(w,wall[2])])
    group('interior-air_dzv-wall_abonite',[match_edge(d,secondary[1]),match_edge(w,wall[0])])
    group('wall-wall_abonite',[match_edge(w,wall[i]) for i in (1,3)])
    # v4 (09.10.2026): counterflow option - the DZV inlet at the far end of the heat-exchange section (patent RU 2162190),
    # the outlet at the nozzle end; names stay physical (inlet_dzv = where the gas enters)
    if dzv_counter:
        group('inlet_dzv',[match_edge(d,secondary[2])]); group('outlet_dzv',[match_edge(d,secondary[0])])
    else:
        group('inlet_dzv',[match_edge(d,secondary[0])]); group('outlet_dzv',[match_edge(d,secondary[2])])
    group('wall_outer-air_dzv',[match_edge(d,secondary[3])])
    return {'nozzle_design':NOZZLE_DESIGN,'dzv_counterflow':dzv_counter,'bodies':[(b.Name,b.Faces.Count,b.Edges.Count) for b in created.values()], 'x_nozzle_exit_m':xn,'x_heat_exchange_end_m':xh,'x_outlet_m':xo}

def parameter_mm(obj):
    return float(getattr(obj, "Value", obj)) * 1000.0

values = {}

values['l_nozzle_mm'] = parameter_mm(Parameters.GEO_l_nozzle)
values['l_heat_exchange_mm'] = parameter_mm(Parameters.GEO_l_heat_exchange)

values['wall_thickness_inlet_mm'] = parameter_mm(Parameters.GEO_wall_thickness_inlet)

    R1_REL=0.75; R2_REL=0.225; ALPHA1=math.radians(25.0)
    def bez_curve(segs):
        # segs: list of cubic Bezier segments [P0,P1,P2,P3]; one NURBS, interior knots multiplicity 3
        ks=[Knot(0.0,4)]+[Knot(float(i),3) for i in range(1,len(segs))]+[Knot(float(len(segs)),4)]
        pts=[segs[0][0]]+[q for s_ in segs for q in s_[1:]]
        cps=Array[ControlPoint]([ControlPoint(pt(x,y),1.0) for x,y in pts])
        return CurveSegment.Create(NurbsCurve.CreateFromControlPoints(NurbsData(4,False,False,Array[Knot](ks)),cps),Interval.Create(0.0,float(len(segs))))
    def arc_seg(cx,cy,R,t0,t1):
        k=4.0/3.0*math.tan((t1-t0)/4.0)
        p0=(cx+R*math.cos(t0),cy+R*math.sin(t0)); p3=(cx+R*math.cos(t1),cy+R*math.sin(t1))
        return [p0,(p0[0]-k*R*math.sin(t0),p0[1]+k*R*math.cos(t0)),(p3[0]+k*R*math.sin(t1),p3[1]-k*R*math.cos(t1)),p3]
    def line_seg(a,b): return [a,(a[0]+(b[0]-a[0])/3.0,a[1]+(b[1]-a[1])/3.0),(a[0]+2*(b[0]-a[0])/3.0,a[1]+2*(b[1]-a[1])/3.0),b]

    # convergent: line from the inlet corner tangent to arc r1 (centre above the throat), then the arc to the throat
    def tang_err(b):
        th=-math.pi/2-b; A=(xt+r1*math.cos(th),rt+r1+r1*math.sin(th))
        return (A[0]-P0[0])*(-math.sin(b))-(A[1]-P0[1])*math.cos(b)
    lo_,hi_=math.radians(1.0),math.radians(89.0)
    if tang_err(lo_)*tang_err(hi_)>0: raise ValueError('No tangent from the inlet corner to the throat arc')

        if tang_err(lo_)*tang_err(mid)<=0: hi_=mid

    if not C[0]<xE<D[0]: raise ValueError('Parabola control point outside the supersonic part')
    par=[C,(C[0]+2.0/3.0*(E[0]-C[0]),C[1]+2.0/3.0*(E[1]-C[1])),(D[0]+2.0/3.0*(E[0]-D[0]),D[1]+2.0/3.0*(E[1]-D[1])),D]

    NOZZLE_DESIGN={'beta_deg':math.degrees(beta),'r1_mm':r1*1e3,'r2_mm':r2*1e3,'alpha1_deg':25.0,'alpha2_deg':math.degrees(math.atan(s_h))}

    # ---- v5 (13.10.2026): optional knurl on the DZV side of the tube (RU 233137, outer surface; author: sizes free) ----
    # option knurl_dzv = {h_mm, pitch_mm, width_mm, x_first_mm}: smooth humps protruding INTO the DZV gap, the bump foot
    # on the outer tube line; one curve shared by the wall and the DZV bodies

    def match_edge(body,curve):
        a=curve.StartPoint; b=curve.EndPoint
        def distance(c,d): return math.sqrt((c.X-d.X)**2+(c.Y-d.Y)**2+(c.Z-d.Z)**2)
        hits=[]
        for e in body.Edges:
            q=e.Shape
            if min(distance(q.StartPoint,a)+distance(q.EndPoint,b),distance(q.StartPoint,b)+distance(q.EndPoint,a)) < 1e-7:
                hits.append(e)
        if len(hits)!=1: raise ValueError('Ambiguous edge match for '+body.Name)
        return hits[0]

        group('inlet_dzv',[match_edge(d,secondary[2])]); group('outlet_dzv',[match_edge(d,secondary[0])])
    else:
        group('inlet_dzv',[match_edge(d,secondary[0])]); group('outlet_dzv',[match_edge(d,secondary[2])])
    group('wall_outer-air_dzv',[match_edge(d,secondary[3])])
    return {'nozzle_design':NOZZLE_DESIGN,'dzv_counterflow':dzv_counter,'knurl_dzv':KNURL,'bodies':[(b.Name,b.Faces.Count,b.Edges.Count) for b in created.values()], 'x_nozzle_exit_m':xn,'x_heat_exchange_end_m':xh,'x_outlet_m':xo}
