        KNURL={'bumps':n_,'h_mm':kh*1e3,'pitch_mm':kp*1e3,'width_mm':kw*1e3}
    wall=[outer_wall,line((xh,rw1),(xh,rh)),core[0],line((xn,rn),(xi,rw0))]
    secondary=[line((xi,rw0),(xi,ro0)),wall[0],line((xh,ro1),(xh,rw1)),line((xi,ro0),(xh,ro1))]
    loops=[('air_svz',core),('wall_abonite',wall),('air_dzv',secondary)]
    # Validate all sheets before replacing any existing bodies.
    shapes=[]
    for name,curves in loops:
        collection=List[ITrimmedCurve]()
        for c in curves: collection.Add(c)
        shape=Body.CreatePlanarBody(Plane.PlaneXY,collection)
        if name == 'air_svz':
            cuts=List[ITrimmedCurve]()
            for x,y in ((xt,rt),(xn,rn),(xh,rh)):
                cuts.Add(line((x,0),(x,y)))
            heat_normal_factor=math.sqrt(1+s_h**2)
            normal_factor=heat_normal_factor
            total=0.0
            for layer in range(20):
                total+=first_layer_height_m*(1.2**layer)
                if total>=rt: raise ValueError('Nozzle boundary layers exceed throat radius')
                # v2: vertical shift = total at the throat (horizontal tangent), total*heat_normal_factor at the exit
                def sh(q): return (q[0],q[1]-total*(1+(heat_normal_factor-1)*(q[0]-xt)/(xn-xt)))
                cuts.Add(bez_curve([[sh(q) for q in s_] for s_ in noz_segs]))
            total=0.0
            for layer in range(20):
                total+=first_layer_height_m*(1.2**layer)
                if total*max(normal_factor,heat_normal_factor)>=min(rn,rh)-(KNURL_SVZ.get('h_mm',0.0)/1000.0):
                    raise ValueError('Heat boundary layers exceed local channel radius')
                # Match the same layer endpoints at the nozzle/heat interface.
                if svz_segs:
                    cuts.Add(bez_curve([[(q[0],q[1]-total*heat_normal_factor) for q in s_] for s_ in svz_segs]))
                elif l_cone:
                    cuts.Add(bez_curve([[(q[0],q[1]-total*heat_normal_factor) for q in s_] for s_ in heat_segs]))
                else:
                    cuts.Add(line((xn,rn-total*heat_normal_factor),(xh,rh-total*heat_normal_factor)))
            for x,y in ((xstart,ri),(xa,rneck),(xb,rneck),(xc,rout)):
                cuts.Add(line((x,0),(x,y)))
            total=0.0
            for layer in range(20):
                total+=first_layer_height_m*(1.2**layer)
                cuts.Add(bez_curve([[(q[0],q[1]-total) for q in s_] for s_ in conv_segs]))
                cuts.Add(line((xh,rh-total*heat_normal_factor),(xa,rneck-total)))
                lower_frame=Frame.Create(pt((xa+xb)/2,cy-total),Direction.Create(0,-1,0),Direction.Create(1,0,0))
                cuts.Add(CurveSegment.Create(Circle.Create(lower_frame,rad),Interval.Create(-math.asin(half/rad),math.asin(half/rad))))
                cuts.Add(line((xb,rneck-total),(xc,rout-total)))
                cuts.Add(line((xc,rout-total),(xo,rout-total)))
            shape.ImprintCurves(cuts,None)
        shapes.append((name,shape))
    root=GetRootPart()
    if clear_existing:
        for g in list(root.Groups):
            # Preserve native script parameters and the published rebuilding script.
            if not g.HasDimension and g.Name != 'TubeGeometry' and not g.Name.startswith('GEO_'): g.Delete()
        for body in list(PartExtensions.GetAllBodies(root)): body.Delete()
    created={}
    for name,shape in shapes:
        created[name]=DesignBody.Create(root,name,shape)
    def group(name,items):
        collection=List[IDocObject]()
        for item in items: collection.Add(item)
        return Group.Create(root,name,collection)
    for name,body in created.items(): group(name,list(body.Faces))
    def match_edge(body,curve):
        a=curve.StartPoint; b=curve.EndPoint
        def distance(c,d): return math.sqrt((c.X-d.X)**2+(c.Y-d.Y)**2+(c.Z-d.Z)**2)
        hits=[]
        for e in body.Edges:
            q=e.Shape
            if min(distance(q.StartPoint,a)+distance(q.EndPoint,b),distance(q.StartPoint,b)+distance(q.EndPoint,a)) < 1e-7:
                hits.append(e)
        if len(hits)!=1: raise ValueError('Ambiguous edge match for '+body.Name)
        return hits[0]
    s=created['air_svz']; d=created['air_dzv']; w=created['wall_abonite']
    sections=[('convergent',x0+v('inlet_curve_offset'),xt),('nozzle',xt,xn),('heat',xn,xh),('exit_contraction',xh,xa),('exit_rounding',xa,xb),('exit_recovery',xb,xc),('exit_tail',xc,xo)]
    all_structured=[]
    for section,lo,hi in sections:
        faces=[]
        for face in s.Faces:
            xs=[q.X for e in face.Edges for q in (e.Shape.StartPoint,e.Shape.EndPoint)]
            if abs(min(xs)-lo)<1e-8 and abs(max(xs)-hi)<1e-8:faces.append(face)
        if len(faces)!=21 or any(f.Edges.Count!=4 for f in faces):raise ValueError('Expected 21 four-sided strips in '+section+'; found '+str(len(faces)))
        group('MESH_'+section,faces)
        all_structured+=faces
        axial=[];thin=[];bulk=[]
        for e in s.Edges:
            a=e.Shape.StartPoint;b=e.Shape.EndPoint
            if min(a.X,b.X)>=lo-1e-8 and max(a.X,b.X)<=hi+1e-8:
                if abs(a.X-b.X)>1e-8:axial.append(e)
                elif abs(a.Y-b.Y)<0.0002:thin.append(e)
                else:bulk.append(e)
        if (len(axial),len(thin),len(bulk))!=(22,40,2):raise ValueError('Bad partition in '+section+': '+str((len(axial),len(thin),len(bulk))))
        group('MESH_'+section+'_axial_edges',axial)
        group('MESH_'+section+'_layer_edges',thin)
        group('MESH_'+section+'_core_radial_edges',bulk)
    group('MESH_core_structured',all_structured)
    group('MESH_inflation_svz',[f for f in s.Faces if f not in all_structured])
    group('inlet_svz',[match_edge(s,core[3])]); group('axis',[e for e in s.Edges if abs(e.Shape.StartPoint.Y)<1e-9 and abs(e.Shape.EndPoint.Y)<1e-9]); group('outlet_svz',[e for e in s.Edges if abs(e.Shape.StartPoint.X-xo)<1e-9 and abs(e.Shape.EndPoint.X-xo)<1e-9])
    group('wall_outer-air_svz',[match_edge(s,core[i]) for i in (1,2,6,7,8,9)])
    group('wall-air_svz-wall_abonite',[match_edge(s,core[0]),match_edge(w,wall[2])])
    group('interior-air_dzv-wall_abonite',[match_edge(d,secondary[1]),match_edge(w,wall[0])])
    group('wall-wall_abonite',[match_edge(w,wall[i]) for i in (1,3)])
    # v4 (09.10.2026): counterflow option - the DZV inlet at the far end of the heat-exchange section (patent RU 2162190),
    # the outlet at the nozzle end; names stay physical (inlet_dzv = where the gas enters)
    if dzv_counter:
        group('inlet_dzv',[match_edge(d,secondary[2])]); group('outlet_dzv',[match_edge(d,secondary[0])])
    else:
        group('inlet_dzv',[match_edge(d,secondary[0])]); group('outlet_dzv',[match_edge(d,secondary[2])])
    group('wall_outer-air_dzv',[match_edge(d,secondary[3])])
    return {'nozzle_design':NOZZLE_DESIGN,'dzv_counterflow':dzv_counter,'knurl_dzv':KNURL,'knurl_svz':KNURL_SVZ,'bodies':[(b.Name,b.Faces.Count,b.Edges.Count) for b in created.values()], 'x_nozzle_exit_m':xn,'x_heat_exchange_end_m':xh,'x_outlet_m':xo}

def parameter_mm(obj):

values = {}

    mesh=model.Mesh
    mesh.GenerateMesh()
    r['generated']=True
    for key in ('Nodes','Elements','Tri3','Quad4','Minimum','Maximum','Average','MeshMetric','State','ObjectState'):
        try:r[key]=str(getattr(mesh,key))
        except:pass
    r['controls']=[]
    for o in mesh.Children:
        d={'name':str(o.Name),'type':str(o.GetType())}
        for k in ('ScopingMethod','NamedSelection','BoundaryNamedSelection','FirstLayerHeight','MaximumLayers','NumberOfLayers','GrowthRate','ElementSize','State','ObjectState','InflationOption'):
            try:d[k]=str(getattr(o,k))
            except:pass
        try:d['location_ids']=list(o.Location.Ids)
        except:pass
        try:d['boundary_ids']=list(o.BoundaryLocation.Ids)
        except:pass
        r['controls'].append(d)
    r['contacts']=[]
    for o in model.Connections.GetChildren(DataModelObjectCategory.ContactRegion,True):
        d={'name':str(o.Name)}
        for k in ('SourceLocation','TargetLocation','SourceNamedSelection','TargetNamedSelection','Suppressed','State'):
            try:
                v=getattr(o,k)
                d[k]=list(v.Ids) if hasattr(v,'Ids') else str(v)
            except:pass
        r['contacts'].append(d)
    r['messages']=[{'text':str(getattr(m,'DisplayString',m)),'severity':str(getattr(m,'Severity',''))} for m in ExtAPI.Application.Messages]
    if str(mesh.State)!='UpToDate' or str(mesh.ObjectState)!='Solved':
        r['generated']=False
        r['error']='Meshing did not produce a complete up-to-date mesh: '+str(mesh.State)+' / '+str(mesh.ObjectState)
    if any(x['severity']=='Error' for x in r['messages']):
        r['generated']=False
        r['error']='Meshing reported errors; inspect messages'
except:r['error']=traceback.format_exc()
r['seconds']=time.time()-r['started']
with open(globals().get('MESH_RESULT_PATH',r'F:\Leontiev_Project\mesh_baseline_generated.json'),'w') as f:json.dump(r,f,indent=2)


===========================================================================

import json,math,traceback
FIRST_LAYER_HEIGHT_M=float(json.load(open(r'F:\Leontiev_Project\mesh_run_config.json'))['first_layer_height_um'])*1e-6
r={}
r['first_layer_height_um']=FIRST_LAYER_HEIGHT_M*1e6
try:
    model=ExtAPI.DataModel.Project.Model
    md=ExtAPI.DataModel.MeshDataByName('Global')
    r['unit']=str(md.Unit)
    ns={str(n.Name):n for n in model.NamedSelections.Children if list(n.Location.Ids)}
    bodies={}
    for a in ExtAPI.DataModel.GeoData.Assemblies:
        for p in a.Parts:
            for b in p.Bodies:bodies[str(b.Name).split('\\')[-1]]=b
    r['profiles']=[]
    for gas,helper in (('air_svz','MESH_walls_svz'),('air_dzv','MESH_walls_dzv')):
        points=[]
        for nid in md.MeshRegionById(bodies[gas].Id).NodeIds:
            node=md.NodeById(nid)
            points.append((node.X,node.Y))
        for eid in ns[helper].Location.Ids:
            edgepoints=[]
            for nid in md.MeshRegionById(eid).NodeIds:
                node=md.NodeById(nid);edgepoints.append((node.X,node.Y))
            if not edgepoints:continue
            a=min(edgepoints);b=max(edgepoints)
            dx=b[0]-a[0];dy=b[1]-a[1]
            if dx<0.5:continue
            length=math.sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy)
            xmid=(a[0]+b[0])/2
            distances=sorted(abs(dx*(y-a[1])-dy*(x-a[0]))/length for x,y in points if abs(x-xmid)<0.0006)
            distances=[d for d in distances if d>1e-9 and d<FIRST_LAYER_HEIGHT_M*(1.2**20-1)/0.2*1.04]
            clusters=[]
            for d in distances:
                if not clusters or abs(d-clusters[-1][0])>max(2e-8,d*0.01):clusters.append([d])
                else:clusters[-1].append(d)
            levels=[sum(c)/len(c) for c in clusters]
            heights=[levels[0]]+[levels[i]-levels[i-1] for i in range(1,len(levels))] if levels else []
            r['profiles'].append({'gas':gas,'edge':eid,'x':xmid,'wall_start':a,'wall_end':b,'distance_levels_m':levels,'first_distance_m':levels[0] if levels else None,'layer_heights_m':heights,'height_ratios':[heights[i+1]/heights[i] for i in range(len(heights)-1)]})
    expected=[FIRST_LAYER_HEIGHT_M*(1.2**(k+1)-1)/0.2 for k in range(20)]
    for profile in r['profiles']:
        levels=profile['distance_levels_m']
        profile['max_relative_distance_error']=max(abs(a-b)/b for a,b in zip(levels,expected)) if len(levels)==20 else None
        profile['verified']=len(levels)==20 and profile['max_relative_distance_error']<0.02
    r['passed']=len(r['profiles'])==3 and all(p['verified'] for p in r['profiles'])
except:r['error']=traceback.format_exc()
with open(globals().get('MESH_LAYERS_PATH',r'F:\Leontiev_Project\mesh_layers.json'),'w') as f:json.dump(r,f,indent=2)

import json,traceback,math
FIRST_LAYER_HEIGHT_M=float(json.load(open(r'F:\Leontiev_Project\mesh_run_config.json'))['first_layer_height_um'])*1e-6
r={'faces':[]}
r['first_layer_height_um']=FIRST_LAYER_HEIGHT_M*1e6
try:
    model=ExtAPI.DataModel.Project.Model
    md=ExtAPI.DataModel.MeshDataByName('Global')
    ns={str(n.Name):n for n in model.NamedSelections.Children if list(n.Location.Ids)}
    ids=list(ns['MESH_nozzle'].Location.Ids)
    settings=json.load(open(r'F:\Leontiev_Project\nozzle_setup.json'))
    if not settings.get('configured'):raise ValueError('Nozzle controls not configured')
    axial=[c['count'] for c in settings['controls'] if c['name']=='Nozzle_axial'][0]
    radial=[c['count'] for c in settings['controls'] if c['name']=='Nozzle_core_radial'][0]
    for fid in ids:
        reg=md.MeshRegionById(fid)
        elem_ids=list(reg.ElementIds)
        node_ids=sorted(set(nid for eid in elem_ids for nid in md.ElementById(eid).NodeIds))
        points=[md.NodeById(i) for i in node_ids]
        xs=sorted(n.X for n in points)
        stations=[]
        for x in xs:
            if not stations or abs(x-stations[-1])>1e-8:stations.append(x)
        nodes_per_station=[sum(abs(n.X-x)<1e-8 for n in points) for x in stations]
        kinds={}
        for eid in elem_ids:
            e=md.ElementById(eid)
            kind=str(e.Type)
            kinds[kind]=kinds.get(kind,0)+1
        rows=1 if len(elem_ids)==axial else radial
        item={'id':fid,'nodes':len(node_ids),'elements':len(elem_ids),'types':kinds,'stations':len(stations),'nodes_per_station':nodes_per_station,'rows':rows}
        item['structured']=len(stations)==axial+1 and all(n==rows+1 for n in nodes_per_station) and len(elem_ids)==axial*rows and len(node_ids)==(axial+1)*(rows+1) and all('Quad' in k for k in kinds)
        r['faces'].append(item)
    r['structured']=len(r['faces'])==21 and all(f['structured'] for f in r['faces']) and sum(f['rows']==1 for f in r['faces'])==20
    # At a nozzle boundary, geometric distances verify the 20 near-wall layers.
    allnodes=set(nid for fid in ids for eid in md.MeshRegionById(fid).ElementIds for nid in md.ElementById(eid).NodeIds)
    points=[md.NodeById(i) for i in allnodes]
    xmin=min(n.X for n in points);xmax=max(n.X for n in points)
    y0=max(n.Y for n in points if abs(n.X-xmin)<1e-8)
    y1=max(n.Y for n in points if abs(n.X-xmax)<1e-8)
    slope=(y1-y0)/(xmax-xmin)
    distances=sorted(set(round((y0-n.Y)/math.sqrt(1+slope*slope),12) for n in points if abs(n.X-xmin)<1e-8))
    actual=[d for d in distances if 1e-9<d<FIRST_LAYER_HEIGHT_M*(1.2**20-1)/0.2*1.04]
    expected=[FIRST_LAYER_HEIGHT_M*(1.2**(k+1)-1)/0.2 for k in range(20)]
    r['nozzle_distance_levels_m']=actual
    r['layer_max_abs_error_m']=max(abs(a-b) for a,b in zip(actual,expected)) if len(actual)==20 else None
    r['layers_verified']=len(actual)==20 and r['layer_max_abs_error_m']<1e-8
except:r['error']=traceback.format_exc()
with open(globals().get('MESH_NOZZLE_CHECK_PATH',r'F:\Leontiev_Project\nozzle_check.json'),'w') as f:json.dump(r,f,indent=2)

import json,traceback,math
from Ansys.ACT.Interfaces.Common import SelectionTypeEnum
from Ansys.Mechanical.DataModel.Enums import SizingType,SizingBehavior,MethodType
r={}
try:
    model=ExtAPI.DataModel.Project.Model
    ns={str(n.Name):n for n in model.NamedSelections.Children if list(n.Location.Ids)}
    sections=('convergent','nozzle','heat','exit_contraction','exit_rounding','exit_recovery','exit_tail')
    for name,n in ns.items():
        if name.startswith('MESH_'):n.SendToSolver=False
    mode=globals().get('MESH_MODE','series')
    h={'series':0.00075,'control':0.00025}[mode]
    radial_count=int(math.ceil(max(ExtAPI.DataModel.GeoData.GeoEntityById(i).Length for section in sections for i in ns['MESH_'+section+'_core_radial_edges'].Location.Ids)/h))
    gas=[b for a in ExtAPI.DataModel.GeoData.Assemblies for p in a.Parts for b in p.Bodies if str(b.Name).split('\\')[-1]=='air_svz'][0]
    old=[o for o in model.Mesh.Children if str(o.GetType()).endswith('.AutomaticMethod')]
    method=old[0] if old else model.Mesh.AddAutomaticMethod()
    for duplicate in old[1:]:duplicate.Suppressed=True
    method.Method=MethodType.Automatic
    method.Name='Core_quadrilateral_method'
    method.Suppressed=False
    info=ExtAPI.SelectionManager.CreateSelectionInfo(SelectionTypeEnum.GeometryEntities)
    info.Ids=[gas.Id];method.Location=info
    infl=[o for o in model.Mesh.Children if str(o.Name)=='Inflation_air_svz'][0]
    infl.Suppressed=True
    for o in model.Mesh.Children:
        if str(o.Name)=='Short_sections_refinement':o.Suppressed=True
    faces=[o for o in model.Mesh.Children if str(o.GetType()).endswith('.FaceMeshing')]
    fm=faces[0] if faces else model.Mesh.AddFaceMeshing()
    fm.Name='Structured_core'
    fm.Location=ns['MESH_core_structured'].Location
    fm.Suppressed=False;fm.MappedMesh=True;fm.ConstrainBoundary=True
    for section in sections:
        fs=[ExtAPI.DataModel.GeoData.GeoEntityById(i) for i in ns['MESH_'+section].Location.Ids]
        if len(fs)!=21 or any(len(f.Edges)!=4 for f in fs):raise ValueError('Invalid structured section '+section)
    controls=[]
    for section in sections:
        axial_count=int(math.ceil(max(ExtAPI.DataModel.GeoData.GeoEntityById(i).Length for i in ns['MESH_'+section+'_axial_edges'].Location.Ids)/h))
        prefix='Nozzle_' if section=='nozzle' else 'Nozzle_'+section+'_'
        for suffix,group,count in (('axial','MESH_'+section+'_axial_edges',axial_count),('layers','MESH_'+section+'_layer_edges',1),('core_radial' if section=='nozzle' else 'radial','MESH_'+section+'_core_radial_edges',radial_count)):
            name=prefix+suffix
            old=[o for o in model.Mesh.Children if str(o.Name)==name]
            o=old[0] if old else model.Mesh.AddSizing()
            o.Name=name;o.NamedSelection=ns[group]
            o.Type=SizingType.NumberOfDivisions;o.NumberOfDivisions=count
            o.Behavior=SizingBehavior.Hard;o.Suppressed=False
            controls.append({'name':name,'count':count,'ids':list(ns[group].Location.Ids)})
    r['controls']=controls;r['configured']=True
except:r['error']=traceback.format_exc()
with open(r'F:\Leontiev_Project\nozzle_setup.json','w') as f:json.dump(r,f,indent=2)

import json,traceback
FIRST_LAYER_HEIGHT_M=float(json.load(open(r'F:\Leontiev_Project\mesh_run_config.json'))['first_layer_height_um'])*1e-6
from Ansys.Mechanical.DataModel.Enums import MeshMetricType
r={'run_token':globals().get('MESH_RUN_TOKEN'),'metric_names':[n for n in dir(MeshMetricType) if not n.startswith('_')],'metrics':{}}
r['first_layer_height_um']=FIRST_LAYER_HEIGHT_M*1e6
mesh=ExtAPI.DataModel.Project.Model.Mesh
r['internal_members']=dir(mesh.InternalObject)
r['internal_type']=str(mesh.InternalObject.GetType())
for n in ('Skewness','OrthogonalAngle','AspectRatio','ElementQuality'):
    try:
        mesh.MeshMetric=getattr(MeshMetricType,n)
        r['metrics'][n]={k:str(getattr(mesh,k)) for k in ('Minimum','Maximum','Average','StandardDeviation')}
    except:r['metrics'][n]={'error':traceback.format_exc()}
try:
    md=ExtAPI.DataModel.MeshDataByName('Global')
    r['mesh_data_members']=dir(md)
    r['node_count']=md.NodeCount
    r['element_count']=md.ElementCount
    r['body_regions']=[]
    for a in ExtAPI.DataModel.GeoData.Assemblies:
        for p in a.Parts:
            for b in p.Bodies:
                region=md.MeshRegionById(b.Id)
                r['body_regions'].append({'name':str(b.Name),'nodes':len(region.NodeIds),'elements':len(region.ElementIds)})
except:r['meshdata_error']=traceback.format_exc()
try:

import json,traceback
FIRST_LAYER_HEIGHT_M=float(json.load(open(r'F:\Leontiev_Project\mesh_run_config.json'))['first_layer_height_um'])*1e-6
from Ansys.Mechanical.DataModel.Enums import GeometryDefineByType, PhaseType
from Ansys.ACT.Interfaces.Common import SelectionTypeEnum
r={'run_token':globals().get('MESH_RUN_TOKEN'), 'actions':[], 'scoping_enum':dir(GeometryDefineByType)}

try:
    model=ExtAPI.DataModel.Project.Model
    mode=globals().get('MESH_MODE','series')
    if mode not in ('series','control'):raise ValueError('Unknown mesh mode '+str(mode))

    model.Mesh.ElementSize=Quantity(str(size_mm)+' [mm]')
    r['mesh_mode']=mode
    r['mesh_size_mm']=size_mm
    r['body_phases']=[]
    for body in model.Geometry.GetChildren(DataModelObjectCategory.Body,True):
        name=str(body.Name).split('\\')[-1]
        if name not in ('air_svz','air_dzv','wall_abonite'):continue

        body.FluidSolidPhase=PhaseType.Solid if name=='wall_abonite' else PhaseType.LiquidGas

    geometry={}
    valid_ids=set()
    for a in ExtAPI.DataModel.GeoData.Assemblies:
        for p in a.Parts:
            for b in p.Bodies:
                geometry[str(b.Name).split('\\')[-1]]=b
                valid_ids.add(b.Id)
                valid_ids.update(f.Id for f in b.Faces)
                valid_ids.update(e.Id for e in b.Edges)
    ns={}
    for n in model.NamedSelections.Children:
        if 'NamedSelection' not in str(n.GetType()):continue
        ids=list(n.Location.Ids)
        if ids and set(ids).issubset(valid_ids):
            ns[str(n.Name)]=n
        else:
            n.SendToSolver=False
            if not str(n.Name).startswith('LEGACY_EMPTY_'):n.Name='LEGACY_EMPTY_'+str(n.Name)
            r['actions'].append('Disabled empty legacy selection '+str(n.Name))
    for name in ('air_svz','air_dzv','wall_abonite','wall_outer-air_svz','wall-air_svz-wall_abonite','interior-air_dzv-wall_abonite','wall_outer-air_dzv'):
        if name not in ns:raise ValueError('Missing named selection '+name)
    if 'MESH_core_structured' not in ns or len(ns['MESH_core_structured'].Location.Ids)!=147:
        raise ValueError('CAD layer partition missing: expected 147 structured faces. Verify the saved native TubeGeometry script before meshing.')
    def boundary(name,gas_name,source_names):
        gas_edges=set(e.Id for e in geometry[gas_name].Edges)
        ids=sorted(gas_edges.intersection(set(i for src in source_names for i in ns[src].Location.Ids)))
        if not ids:raise ValueError('Empty gas wall '+name)
        candidates=[n for n in model.NamedSelections.Children if str(n.Name)==name]
        n=candidates[0] if candidates else model.AddNamedSelection()
        n.Name=name
        selection=ExtAPI.SelectionManager.CreateSelectionInfo(SelectionTypeEnum.GeometryEntities)
        selection.Ids=ids
        n.Location=selection
        n.SendToSolver=False
        r['actions'].append('Created mesh helper '+name+' '+str(ids))
        return n
    svzwalls=boundary('MESH_walls_svz','air_svz',('wall_outer-air_svz','wall-air_svz-wall_abonite'))
    dzvwalls=boundary('MESH_walls_dzv','air_dzv',('wall_outer-air_dzv','interior-air_dzv-wall_abonite'))
    inflations=[o for o in model.Mesh.Children if str(o.GetType()).endswith('.Inflation')]
    for o,gas,walls in zip(inflations,('air_svz','air_dzv'),(svzwalls,dzvwalls)):
        r['actions'].append('Before '+str(o.Name)+' layers='+str(o.NumberOfLayers)+' max='+str(o.MaximumLayers)+' first='+str(o.FirstLayerHeight)+' growth='+str(o.GrowthRate))
        # Scoping is set by assigning the native named-selection object
        o.Location=ns[gas].Location
        o.BoundaryLocation=walls.Location
        o.MaximumLayers=20
        o.NumberOfLayers=20
        o.GrowthRate=1.2
        o.FirstLayerHeight=Quantity(str(FIRST_LAYER_HEIGHT_M*1000.0)+' [mm]')
        o.Suppressed=False
        o.Name='Inflation_'+gas
        r['actions'].append('Scoped '+str(o.Name)+' to '+gas+' and '+str(walls.Name))
    if len(inflations)!=2:raise ValueError('Expected two inflation controls')
    for o in model.Mesh.Children:
        if str(o.GetType()).endswith('.Sizing') and not str(o.Name).startswith('Nozzle_'):
            # Scoping is set by assigning the native named-selection object
            o.NamedSelection=ns['air_svz']
            o.ElementSize=Quantity(str(size_mm)+' [mm]')
            r['actions'].append('Scoped sizing '+str(o.Name)+' to air_svz; size '+str(o.ElementSize))
    if 'MESH_nozzle' in ns:
        execfile(r'F:\Leontiev_Project\mesh_nozzle_setup.py',{'ExtAPI':ExtAPI,'MESH_MODE':mode})
        r['nozzle_setup']=json.load(open(r'F:\Leontiev_Project\nozzle_setup.json'))
        if not r['nozzle_setup'].get('configured'):raise ValueError(str(r['nozzle_setup']))
    contacts=list(model.Connections.GetChildren(DataModelObjectCategory.ContactRegion,True))
    if len(contacts)<2:raise ValueError('Expected at least two thermal contact pair objects')
    for duplicate in contacts[2:]:
        duplicate.Suppressed=True
        r['actions'].append('Suppressed extra automatic contact '+str(duplicate.Name))
    for contact,group,source_body,target_body in zip(contacts[:2],('wall-air_svz-wall_abonite','interior-air_dzv-wall_abonite'),('air_svz','wall_abonite'),('wall_abonite','air_dzv')):
        ids=set(ns[group].Location.Ids)
        source=sorted(ids.intersection(set(e.Id for e in geometry[source_body].Edges)))
        target=sorted(ids.intersection(set(e.Id for e in geometry[target_body].Edges)))
        if not source or not target:raise ValueError('Incomplete physical contact '+group)
        info=ExtAPI.SelectionManager.CreateSelectionInfo(SelectionTypeEnum.GeometryEntities)
        info.Ids=source;contact.SourceLocation=info
        info=ExtAPI.SelectionManager.CreateSelectionInfo(SelectionTypeEnum.GeometryEntities)
        info.Ids=target;contact.TargetLocation=info
        contact.Suppressed=False
        r['actions'].append('Scoped physical thermal contact '+group+' '+str(source)+' / '+str(target))
    r['named_selections']=[(str(n.Name),list(n.Location.Ids),str(n.SendToSolver)) for n in model.NamedSelections.Children]
except:r['error']=traceback.format_exc()
with open(r'F:\Leontiev_Project\mesh_repair.json','w') as f:json.dump(r,f,indent=2)

import json,traceback
r={'sections':[],'passed':False}
try:
    model=ExtAPI.DataModel.Project.Model
    md=ExtAPI.DataModel.MeshDataByName('Global')
    names={str(n.Name):n for n in model.NamedSelections.Children if list(n.Location.Ids)}
    with open(r'F:\Leontiev_Project\nozzle_setup.json') as f:settings=json.load(f)
    counts={c['name']:c['count'] for c in settings['controls']}
    for section in ('convergent','nozzle','heat','exit_contraction','exit_rounding','exit_recovery','exit_tail'):
        prefix='Nozzle_' if section=='nozzle' else 'Nozzle_'+section+'_'
        axial=counts[prefix+'axial'];radial=counts[prefix+('core_radial' if section=='nozzle' else 'radial')]
        item={'section':section,'faces':[]}
        for fid in names['MESH_'+section].Location.Ids:
            eids=list(md.MeshRegionById(fid).ElementIds)
            incidence={};allquad=True
            for eid in eids:
                e=md.ElementById(eid)
                allquad=allquad and str(e.Type)=='kQuad4'
                for nid in e.NodeIds:incidence[nid]=incidence.get(nid,0)+1
            rows=1 if len(eids)==axial else radial
            frequencies={}
            for v in incidence.values():frequencies[v]=frequencies.get(v,0)+1
            expected={1:4,2:2*(axial+rows-2)}
            if (axial-1)*(rows-1):expected[4]=(axial-1)*(rows-1)
            expected={k:v for k,v in expected.items() if v}
            valid=allquad and len(eids)==axial*rows and len(incidence)==(axial+1)*(rows+1) and frequencies==expected
            item['faces'].append({'id':fid,'elements':len(eids),'nodes':len(incidence),'rows':rows,'incidence':frequencies,'verified':valid})
        item['verified']=len(item['faces'])==21 and all(f['verified'] for f in item['faces']) and sum(f['rows']==1 for f in item['faces'])==20
        r['sections'].append(item)
    r['passed']=len(r['sections'])==7 and all(s['verified'] for s in r['sections'])
except:r['error']=traceback.format_exc()
with open(globals().get('MESH_STRUCTURE_PATH',r'F:\Leontiev_Project\mesh_structure_check.json'),'w') as f:json.dump(r,f,indent=2)

FILE: mesh_wall_layers_check.py

# Follow actual quadrilateral neighbours from each physical gas wall.
import json,math,traceback,time
FIRST_LAYER_HEIGHT_M=float(json.load(open(r'F:\Leontiev_Project\mesh_run_config.json'))['first_layer_height_um'])*1e-6
from System import Array,Double
r={'profiles':[],'started':time.time()}
r['first_layer_height_um']=FIRST_LAYER_HEIGHT_M*1e6
try:
    model=ExtAPI.DataModel.Project.Model
    md=ExtAPI.DataModel.MeshDataByName('Global')
    names={str(n.Name):n for n in model.NamedSelections.Children if list(n.Location.Ids)}
    bodies={str(b.Name).split('\\')[-1]:b for a in ExtAPI.DataModel.GeoData.Assemblies for p in a.Parts for b in p.Bodies}
    pts={}
    def point(nid):
        if nid not in pts:
            n=md.NodeById(nid);pts[nid]=(n.X,n.Y)
        return pts[nid]
    def midpoint(pair):
        a=point(pair[0]);b=point(pair[1]);return ((a[0]+b[0])/2,(a[1]+b[1])/2)
    def key(pair):return tuple(sorted(pair))
    for gas,helper in (('air_svz','MESH_walls_svz'),('air_dzv','MESH_walls_dzv')):
        elements={};adj={}
        for eid in md.MeshRegionById(bodies[gas].Id).ElementIds:
            elem=md.ElementById(eid);nodes=list(elem.NodeIds)
            if str(elem.Type)!='kQuad4':continue
            elements[eid]=nodes
            for i in range(4):adj.setdefault(key((nodes[i],nodes[(i+1)%4])),[]).append(eid)
        for wall in names[helper].Location.Ids:
            edge=ExtAPI.DataModel.GeoData.GeoEntityById(wall)
            bounds=[edge.ParamAtPoint(Array[Double]([v.X,v.Y,v.Z])) for v in edge.Vertices]
            lo=min(bounds);hi=max(bounds)
            def parameter(nid):
                p=point(nid)
                t=edge.ParamAtPoint(Array[Double]([p[0],p[1],0.0]))
                q=edge.PointAtParam(t)
                distance=math.sqrt((q[0]-p[0])**2+(q[1]-p[1])**2+q[2]**2)
                return t,distance
            wallnodes=set(md.MeshRegionById(wall).NodeIds)
            pairs=[pair for pair,eids in adj.items() if len(eids)==1 and pair[0] in wallnodes and pair[1] in wallnodes]
            candidates=[]
            for pair in pairs:
                ts=[parameter(nid) for nid in pair]
                if max(t[1] for t in ts)<2e-8:
                    t=sum(t[0] for t in ts)/2
                    if lo-1e-8<=t<=hi+1e-8:candidates.append((t,pair))
            pairs=candidates
            if not pairs:
                r['profiles'].append({'gas':gas,'wall_edge':wall,'verified':False,'reason':'No quadrilateral boundary segment'})
                continue
            for fraction in (0.1,0.5,0.9):
                pair=min(pairs,key=lambda item:abs(item[0]-(lo+fraction*(hi-lo))))[1]
                start=midpoint(pair);a=point(pair[0]);b=point(pair[1])
                dx=b[0]-a[0];dy=b[1]-a[1];length=math.sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy)
                normal=(-dy/length,dx/length)
                previous=None;levels=[];reason=None
                for layer in range(20):
                    candidates=[eid for eid in adj.get(key(pair),[]) if eid!=previous]
                    if len(candidates)!=1:reason='No unique next quad at layer '+str(layer+1);break
                    eid=candidates[0];nodes=elements[eid]
                    index=[i for i in range(4) if key((nodes[i],nodes[(i+1)%4]))==key(pair)][0]
                    opposite=(nodes[(index+2)%4],nodes[(index+3)%4])
                    p=midpoint(opposite)
                    levels.append(abs((p[0]-start[0])*normal[0]+(p[1]-start[1])*normal[1]))
                    previous=eid;pair=opposite
                heights=[levels[0]]+[levels[i]-levels[i-1] for i in range(1,len(levels))] if levels else []
                ratios=[heights[i+1]/heights[i] for i in range(len(heights)-1)] if heights and min(heights)>0 else []
                growth_error=max(abs(v/1.2-1) for v in ratios) if len(ratios)==19 else None
                verified=len(levels)==20 and bool(ratios) and growth_error<0.1 and 0<heights[0]<=1.02*FIRST_LAYER_HEIGHT_M
                r['profiles'].append({'gas':gas,'wall_edge':wall,'fraction':fraction,'start':start,'levels_m':levels,'heights_m':heights,'first_height_m':heights[0] if heights else None,'max_relative_growth_error':growth_error,'verified':verified,'reason':reason})
    r['passed']=len(r['profiles'])==27 and all(p['verified'] for p in r['profiles'])
except:r['error']=traceback.format_exc();r['passed']=False
r['seconds']=time.time()-r['started']
with open(globals().get('MESH_WALL_CHECK_PATH',r'F:\Leontiev_Project\mesh_wall_layers_check.json'),'w') as f:json.dump(r,f,indent=2)
